label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: Oh… I'm delighted!
et: Oh… Ma olen ülirõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I don't wish to waste your time, so please advise me on this.
et: Ma ei taha su aega raisata, nii et palun anna mulle selles nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I plan to take a BATTLE TOWER challenge soon.
et: Ma kavatsen varsti BATTLE TOWERi väljakutse võtta.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: However, there are two levels…
et: Ent seal on kaks taset…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: Which would be most suitable for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kumb oleks mulle kõige sobivam? Tase 50 või Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice! I see. I will do my best!
et: {STR_VAR_1} on su valik! Ma näen. Ma annan endast parima!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}. I hope I can count on you again. Please take care!
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}. Ma loodan, et saan jälle sinu peale loota. Palun hoia end!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}! You spoke to me! I… I'm overjoyed!
et: Iik! Iik! {PLAYER}! Sa rääkisid minuga! Ma… Ma olen ülirõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Me! My name is {STR_VAR_1}! I just became a TRAINER!
et: Mina! Mu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}! Ma just sain TRAINERIKS!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: I'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER}, the big name in POKéMON circles!
et: Mul on hea meel, et kohtasin sind, {PLAYER}, suurt nime POKéMONide ringkondades!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Oh-oh-oh, I know! May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?
et: Oh-oh-oh, ma tean! Kas tohin paluda suurt teenet, {PLAYER}?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Please take me in as your apprentice! I want to learn from you!
et: Palun võta mind oma õpipoisiks! Ma tahan sinult õppida!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: Waaaah! {PLAYER} turned me down… It… It's an invaluable experience!
et: Vaaaah! {PLAYER} ütles mulle ära… See… See on hindamatu kogemus!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: {PLAYER}, please! I want to hear an affirmative answer this time!
et: {PLAYER}, palun! Ma tahan seekord kuulda jaatavat vastust!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: I beg you for your guidance!
et: Ma anun sinult juhatust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes! {PLAYER} said yes!
et: Hiieeeh! {PLAYER} ütles jah! {PLAYER} ütles jah!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: I won't be able to sleep tonight… Thank you ever so much!
et: Ma ei suuda täna öösel magada… Suur-suur tänu!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Then, here's my question!
et: Siis, siin on mu küsimus!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, what is right for me, Level 50 or Open Level?
et: BATTLE TOWERIS, mis on mulle õige, Tase 50 või Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood! I understand perfectly! I'm deliriously delighted!
et: {STR_VAR_1}! Täiesti selge! Ma saan täiuslikult aru! Ma olen pöörases rõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: I hope you'll be willing to teach me some more another time.
et: Ma loodan, et oled nõus mind mõni teine kord veel õpetama.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Whoa! Could you be… Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?! That strong and famous TRAINER? Well, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!
et: Ohoo! Kas sa võiksid olla… Kas sa oled ehk… {PLAYER}{KUN}?! See tugev ja kuulus TRAINER? Noh, tere, kas ma pole lihtsalt kõige õnnelikum!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Hello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Tere, nimeks on {STR_VAR_1}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: I've been on the lookout for a POKéMON teacher.
et: Ma olen otsinud POKéMON-õpetajat.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: And with impeccably good timing, along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ja laitmatult hea ajastusega tulid sina, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: So, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let me apprentice under you!
et: Nii et seal ta on, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Lase mul olla su õpipoiss!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Gwaaaah! You're quite cool and tough…
et: Gvaaah! Sa oled päris lahe ja kõva…

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Don't be that way, please. I'm asking you!
et: Ära ole selline, palun. Ma palun sind!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply! Excellent, I might add!
et: Oh, jah! See on kindel vastus! Suurepärane, lisan ma!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: So how about a first piece of advice on the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Nii et kuidas oleks esimese nõuandega BATTLE TOWERi kohta?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: If I were to go, what would be better? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma läheksin, mis oleks parem? Tase 50 või Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is! OK, A-OK! I'll go show my mettle, like, jam!
et: Ahaa, {STR_VAR_1} siis! OK, super-OK! Ma lähen näitan oma vahvust, nagu, põmm!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: All right, I'll look to you as my mentor! Adios!
et: Hea küll, ma vaatan sind kui oma mentorit! Adios!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right? The police were looking for you!
et: Oh, hei, {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks? Politsei otsis sind!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: … … … Of course I'm lying!
et: … … … Muidugi ma valetan!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Me, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION! …That's a lie, too!
et: Mina, ma olen {STR_VAR_1}. Hoolimata sellest, kuidas ma välja näen, olen ma POKéMON MEISTER! …Ka see on vale!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: This is no lie, though. I'm not very good at battling.
et: See pole siiski vale. Ma pole võitlemises eriti hea.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: So, how about you becoming my master about all things POKéMON?
et: Nii et kuidas oleks, kui sinust saaks mu meister kõigi POKéMONide asjade osas?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: If you're going to act cold like that, I'll show you what I'll do!
et: Kui sa kavatsed niimoodi külmalt käituda, ma näitan sulle, mida ma teen!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Waaah! Waaah! Waaah! Hiccup!
et: Vaaah! Vaaah! Vaaah! Luksatus!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Hahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!
et: Hahaha, see oli mu FAKE TEARS!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Come on, will you please be my POKéMON master?
et: No kuule, kas sa palun oleksid mu POKéMON-meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Yippee! I'll buy you a boat for that!
et: Jipii! Ma ostan sulle selle eest paadi!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Of course I'm lying again! But… Thank you, master!
et: Muidugi ma valetan jälle! Aga… Aitäh, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: You know how there's Level 50 and Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Tead ju, kuidas BATTLE TOWERIS on Tase 50 ja Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: I'm having trouble deciding which level I should challenge…
et: Mul on raske otsustada, millisele tasemele ma väljakutse esitama peaksin…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Can you decide for me, master?
et: Kas sa saad minu eest otsustada, meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better! I'll go to the other level, then!
et: Olgu, nii et {STR_VAR_1} on parem! Ma lähen siis teisele tasemele!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Ainult naljatan! Ma kuuletun su õpetusele, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Thanks, master! I hope you'll keep teaching me!
et: Aitäh, meister! Ma loodan, et sa õpetad mind edasi!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!
et: A-H-O-I! Ja see teeb kokku ahoi ja tähendab tere!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: I'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR am I!
et: Ma olen {STR_VAR_1}, see räppiv MADRUS olen mina!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Your turn now, tell me a little about yourself, give it a try!
et: Nüüd on sinu kord, räägi endast veidi, proovi!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Uh-huh, uh-huh! {PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name, and POKéMON's your game!
et: Ahaa, ahaa! {PLAYER}{KUN} on su nimi ja POKéMON su ala!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: And you're at a delicate age when all the world's your stage!
et: Ja sa oled õrnas eas, mil kogu maailm on su lava!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Anyway, I just want to say, that you're the tenth TRAINER I've spoken to today.
et: Igatahes, ma tahan lihtsalt öelda, et sa oled kümnes TRAINER, kellega ma täna rääkinud olen.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Let's make that a celebration! Become my mentor for commemoration!
et: Teeme sellest peo! Hakka mu mentoriks mälestuseks!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: But! You have to work with me!
et: Aga! Sa pead minuga koos töötama!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: Don't be such a tease! Become my mentor, please!
et: Ära ole selline narrija! Hakka mu mentoriks, palun!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: That's it! {PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!
et: Just see! {PLAYER}, sul on õige vaim!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: So here's my first question that begs your suggestion!
et: Nii et siin on mu esimene küsimus, mis anub su ettepanekut!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: It's about the BATTLE TOWER, and it hinges on my power!
et: See on BATTLE TOWERi kohta ja see sõltub mu jõust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: Level 50 and Open Level there be, which is the one that's good for me?
et: Tase 50 ja Avatud Tase seal on, kumb on see, mis mulle sobib?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say! I'll go and take it on my way!
et: Olgu, {STR_VAR_1} siis, sa ütled! Ma lähen ja võtan selle teel ette!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: If it's advice I ever need, {PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!
et: Kui ma kunagi nõu vajan, {PLAYER}, su sõna ma alati kuulda võtan!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}? What should I do? Talk to you? Why not? I'm already talking to you!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, are you surprised at me? I'd better tell you who I happen to be!
et: {PLAYER}, kas sa oled minust üllatunud? Ma parem ütlen sulle, kes ma juhtun olema!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me. The brightest star in guitardom, that's me!
et: {STR_VAR_1} on see, mida sa võid mind kutsuda. Kõige eredam täht kitarrimaailmas, see olen mina!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Are you receiving me? You are receiving me!
et: Kas sa võtad mind vastu? Sa võtad mind vastu!

en: My luck's at its best, I'll hit you with a request!
et: Mu õnn on tipus, ma taban sind palvega!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, let me be your underling! I want you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, lase mul olla su käsualune! Ma tahan, et õpetaksid mulle kõike!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: You're turning me down, then? I'll just have to ask you again!
et: Nii et sa ütled mulle ära? Ma pean sinult siis lihtsalt uuesti küsima!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: {PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling! I need you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, ma anun, et olla su käsualune! Ma vajan, et õpetaksid mulle kõike!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Lucky, yeah, woohoo! Should I pop a question to you?
et: Vedas, jah, uuhuu! Kas ma peaksin sulle küsimuse esitama?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Since we're near the BATTLE TOWER, how about a question about its power?
et: Kuna me oleme BATTLE TOWERi lähedal, kuidas oleks küsimusega selle jõu kohta?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Of the choices you see, which is the right one for me?
et: Valikutest, mida näed, kumb on mulle õige?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest, it must be the very best!
et: Kui {STR_VAR_1} on see, mida sa soovitad, peab see olema kõige parim!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me.
et: Noh, {PLAYER}, ma pean vabalt rändama, aga ära sa mind unusta.

en: Oh, hi! You there! Can I get you to massage my shoulder?

et: …Jah, seal! Just see! Ai, ai! Oooh, see tundub suurepärane!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: My name's {STR_VAR_1}. I take karate training, but my body's not built to take the abuse…
et: Mu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}. Ma teen karatetreeningut, aga mu keha pole ehitatud sellist piina taluma…

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: I decided I'll battle POKéMON and toughen myself up.
et: Ma otsustasin, et võitlen POKéMONidega ja karastan end.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you? The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?
et: Sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas pole? POKéMON LEAGUE MEISTER?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: Listen, can I get you to give me advice?
et: Kuula, kas saaksin panna sind mulle nõu andma?

en: Oh, why?
et: Oh, miks?

et: Ma ei ole suureks tüliks, ma luban! Palun?

en: Thank you. Mighty good of you! …Cough! Cough!
et: Aitäh. Vägagi kena sinust! …Köhh! Köhh!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: Oogh, I have to toughen up quick…
et: Uhh, ma pean kähku karastuma…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: I'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER right away, but what would be better for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Ma suundun kohe BATTLE TOWERI poole, aga mis oleks mulle parem? Tase 50 või Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}. I'll go there right away.
et: Hm, hea küll. See on {STR_VAR_1}. Ma lähen sinna kohe.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: I hope I can keep hitting you up for help--after all, you're my mentor!
et: Ma loodan, et saan sinu käest edasi abi paluda – lõppude lõpuks oled sa mu mentor!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?
et: Öö… Ömm… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?

en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all self-conscious.
et: Palun ära vaata mind niimoodi. Sa teed mind üleni ebalevaks.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Ma… Ma olen {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm really embarrassed to say this, but I explore ancient ruins and such.
et: Mul on tõesti piinlik seda öelda, aga ma uurin muistseid varemeid ja muud sellist.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm even more embarrassed to admit I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Mul on veelgi piinlikum tunnistada, et mind huvitab BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as a tough TRAINER…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sul on kõva TRAINERI maine…

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: It's hard for me to say this, but I want to ask something.
et: Mul on raske seda öelda, aga ma tahan midagi küsida.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Could you become my teacher and give me advice?
et: Kas sa saaksid hakata mu õpetajaks ja anda mulle nõu?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please don't brush me off like this! I can't live with the humiliation.
et: Palun ära löö mind niimoodi kõrvale! Ma ei suuda selle alandusega elada.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please become my teacher! I need your advice!
et: Palun hakka mu õpetajaks! Ma vajan su nõu!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: Th-thank you…
et: A-aitäh…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: But please don't look at me like that. It makes me all flustered.
et: Aga palun ära vaata mind niimoodi. See teeb mind üleni ärevaks.

en: Please, answer me without looking at my eyes.
et: Palun vasta mulle mu silmadesse vaatamata.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: At the BATTLE TOWER… Which level should I attempt?
et: BATTLE TOWERIS… Millist taset ma peaksin proovima?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try my hand at that.
et: Oh… Olgu! Ma proovin seda kätt.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: I hope I can make a valiant challenge without getting all flustered…
et: Ma loodan, et suudan esitada vapra väljakutse, ilma et üleni ärevusse satuksin…

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. If we meet again, I hope you will be as helpful.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Kui me jälle kohtume, ma loodan, et oled sama abivalmis.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really real?
et: Hm? Sa näid olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}… Aga kas oled tõesti päris?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: You may call me {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Sa võid mind kutsuda {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: I have been toying with the idea of apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.
et: Ma olen mänginud mõttega hakata õpipoisiks mõne tugeva TRAINERI juures.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: So, I must say I'm lucky you came along! …You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?
et: Nii et ma pean ütlema, et mul vedas, et sa siia sattusid! …Sa oled tõesti {PLAYER}{KUN}, jah?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: No, no, if you are real, it's fine. I merely want you to recognize me as your apprentice.
et: Ei, ei, kui sa oled päris, siis on hea. Ma tahan lihtsalt, et tunnistaksid mind oma õpipoisiks.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Oh? But what would compel you to refuse?
et: Oh? Aga mis sind küll keelduma sunniks?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: I apologize for being skeptical about your identity.
et: Ma palun vabandust, et su isikus kahtlesin.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Please accept my apology and accept me as your apprentice.
et: Palun võta mu vabandus vastu ja võta mind oma õpipoisiks.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: You really are accepting me? I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.
et: Sa tõesti võtad mind vastu? Ma ei taha enneaegselt tähistada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If it is true, I apologize. But now, I need your advice.
et: Kui see on tõsi, ma palun vabandust. Aga nüüd, ma vajan su nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER, what would be worthy of me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma astuksin BATTLE TOWERISSE, mis oleks mind väärt? Tase 50 või Avatud Tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}? Are you certain?
et: {STR_VAR_1}? Kas oled kindel?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I see. If that's the case, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Ma näen. Kui nii on, siis on hea. Ma tänan sind su aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I realize I can annoy, but it delights me that you have accepted me.
et: Ma taipan, et võin tüütu olla, aga mind rõõmustab, et sa oled mind vastu võtnud.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: Let us meet again!
et: Kohtugem jälle!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: Sigh… Sob… Oh, {PLAYER}!
et: Ohh… Nuuks… Oh, {PLAYER}!

en: Give me a battle one day, OK? Adios!
et: Anna mulle ühel päeval lahing, OK? Adios!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, there's big trouble!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, on suur häda!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: When I win a battle, I brag about it for an hour at least!
et: Kui ma lahingu võidan, uhkeldan sellega vähemalt tund aega!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: Of course I'm lying! Wahahaha!
et: Muidugi ma valetan! Vahahahaa!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: This is no lie, though. I'm not very good at chatting.
et: See pole siiski vale. Ma pole vestlemises eriti hea.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
en: So, how about deciding for me what I should say after winning a battle, master?
et: Nii et kuidas oleks, kui otsustaksid minu eest, mida ma pärast lahingu võitmist ütlema peaksin, meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's what I should say, huh? Then, I'll stay away from that!
et: Seda ma peaksin ütlema, mis? Siis ma hoian sellest eemale!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Ainult naljatan! Ma kuuletun su õpetusele, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Thanks for teaching me all this time, master!
et: Aitäh, et mind kogu selle aja õpetasid, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm finally understanding what being a TRAINER is about.
et: Ma lõpuks mõistan, mida tähendab TRAINERIKS olla.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm going to go out and win battles against any TRAINER.
et: Ma lähen välja ja võidan lahinguid iga TRAINERI vastu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Maybe it'll be you one day, master!
et: Ehk oled see ühel päeval sina, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's all! Farewell, my master!
et: See on kõik! Hüvasti, mu meister!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy!
et: A-H-O-I! Ja see teeb kokku ahoi!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: The rappin' SAILOR am I! This will be my last question, don't you cry!
et: Mina olen see räppiv MADRUS! See on mu viimane küsimus, ära sa nuta!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: It's a saying question that begs your suggestion!
et: See on ütluseküsimus, mis anub su ettepanekut!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: If I win a match, what can I say in a real cool way?
et: Kui ma matši võidan, mida saan ma öelda tõeliselt lahedalt?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Perfect! That's what I'll use. I was right to make you choose!
et: Täiuslik! Seda ma kasutan. Mul oli õigus panna sind valima!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: And now, I think it'd be best, if I were to fly the nest!
et: Ja nüüd, ma arvan, et oleks parim, kui ma pesast välja lendaksin!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Thanks for all you taught me. I'll be off on a battle spree!
et: Aitäh kõige eest, mida mulle õpetasid. Ma lähen lahingu-hoole!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! And that spells bon voyage, to you this is my homage!
et: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! Ja see teeb kokku bon voyage, sulle on see mu austusavaldus!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}! I found you again today!
et: Oh, jah, {PLAYER}! Ma leidsin su täna jälle!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: What should I do? Ask you again? Why not? I'm already asking you!
et: Mida ma peaksin tegema? Sinult jälle küsima? Miks mitte? Ma juba küsingi sinult!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Anyways, {PLAYER}… Are you receiving me? You are receiving me! I need some more advice for me!
et: Igatahes, {PLAYER}… Kas sa võtad mind vastu? Sa võtad mind vastu! Ma vajan endale veidi nõu!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: It's about what I should yell. Something cool to holler when a battle ends well.
et: See on selle kohta, mida ma peaksin karjuma. Midagi lahedat karjuda, kui lahing hästi lõpeb.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Come on, I wanna hear you say it!
et: No kuule, ma tahan sind kuulda seda ütlemas!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: All right, all right! I'll use that because it's so tight!
et: Hea küll, hea küll! Ma kasutan seda, sest see on nii vinge!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: I'm out of things to ask you. Waving bye is all that's left to do.
et: Mul pole enam midagi sinult küsida. Hüvastiviipamine on ainus, mis üle jääb.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But maybe one day we'll meet, with one destined to go down in defeat.
et: Aga ehk me ühel päeval kohtume, üks meist määratud kaotusesse langema.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But, it really is time to say farewell.
et: Aga on tõesti aeg hüvasti jätta.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me!
et: Noh, {PLAYER}, ma pean vabalt rändama, aga ära sa mind unusta!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Take care, {PLAYER}! Love ya!
et: Hoia end, {PLAYER}! Armastan sind!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished… My nose won't stop dripping…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mul on lõpp käes… Mu nina ei lakka tilkumast…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: I was trying to think up something cool to say when I win a battle.
et: Ma üritasin välja mõelda midagi lahedat öelda, kui lahingu võidan.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: It inspired me so much, it made me cry, and now my nose won't stop running…
et: See inspireeris mind nii väga, et pani mind nutma, ja nüüd ei lakka mu nina jooksmast…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: So, things being this way, I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Nii et asjade nõnda olles vajan ma, et sa otsustaksid minu eest, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: When I win a battle, what should I say?
et: Kui ma lahingu võidan, mida ma peaksin ütlema?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: … … …That's good. No, it's awe inspiring! It's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!
et: … … …See on hea. Ei, see on aukartustäratav! See toob mu silmadesse värsked pisarad!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: But in spite of my tears and runny nose, I will use that saying!
et: Aga vaatamata oma pisaratele ja jooksvale ninale, ma kasutan seda ütlust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: I'm plumb out of things to ask you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Mul pole enam midagi sinult küsida, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: From now on, we're rivals! Thanks for everything!
et: Nüüdsest oleme rivaalid! Aitäh kõige eest!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: Öö… Ömm… {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all nervous.
et: Palun ära vaata mind niimoodi. Sa teed mind üleni närviliseks.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: I… I need your advice again. I'll make it my last, though…
et: Ma… Ma vajan su nõu jälle. Ma teen sellest siiski oma viimase…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: It's really embarrassing to ask, but what if I win a battle? What should I say?
et: On tõesti piinlik küsida, aga mis siis, kui ma lahingu võidan? Mida ma peaksin ütlema?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try to say that! I might be too nervous to say it…
et: Oh… Olgu! Ma proovin seda öelda! Ma võin liiga närvis olla, et seda öelda…

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I have to say good-bye now.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Ma pean nüüd hüvasti jätma.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: I'll obey all that you've taught me, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.
et: Ma kuuletun kõigele, mida sa mulle õpetasid, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ja annan endast parima.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really? Perhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?
et: Hm? Sa näid olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}… Aga kas oled tõesti? Ehk kaval {PLAYER} NUKK?

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Oh, no, no, no, don't worry! If you really are real, please forget about my rudeness.
et: Oh, ei, ei, ei, ära muretse! Kui sa oled tõesti päris, palun unusta mu ebaviisakus.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: No need to be so angry. All I wish for is more of your fine advice.
et: Pole vaja nii vihane olla. Kõik, mida ma soovin, on veel su head nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: It concerns a saying.
et: See puudutab üht ütlust.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: More precisely, what should I say if I win a battle?
et: Täpsemalt, mida ma peaksin ütlema, kui lahingu võidan?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: … … … … … … When I win a match…
et: … … … … … … Kui ma matši võidan…

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: …Are you serious?
et: …Kas sa oled tõsine?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I see. If you are serious, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Ma näen. Kui sa oled tõsine, siis on hea. Ma tänan sind su aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do hope even I will be able to put that saying to good use.
et: Ma loodan väga, et isegi mina suudan seda ütlust hästi ära kasutada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I seem to have run dry on what advice I need.
et: Näib, et mul on lõppenud, mis nõu ma vajan.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do believe it's high time I bid you farewell and strike out on my own.
et: Ma usun küll, et on ülim aeg sulle hüvasti jätta ja omal jõul minema asuda.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: Thank you, my mentor! I apologize for my skepticism!
et: Aitäh, mu mentor! Ma palun vabandust oma umbusu pärast!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
en: Oh? You seem to have no room for this.
et: Oh? Näib, et sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
en: Please make room in your BAG and let me know.
et: Palun tee oma KOTIS ruumi ja anna mulle teada.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
en: We've been waiting for you!
et: Me oleme sind oodanud!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
en: Before we resume your challenge, I must save the game.
et: Enne kui su väljakutset jätkame, pean mängu salvestama.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't save before you quit playing last time.
et: Kahju seda öelda, aga sa ei salvestanud enne, kui viimati mängu jätsid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: As a result, you have been disqualified from your challenge.
et: Selle tulemusel oled sa oma väljakutsest diskvalifitseeritud.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnPersonalMons
en: We'll return your personal POKéMON.
et: Me anname su isiklikud POKéMONid tagasi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Swap rules are listed.
et: Battle Swapi reeglid on loetletud.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three POKéMON.
et: Battle Swapi üritusel võid kasutada vaid kolme POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Whether you are renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same POKéMON.
et: Kas rendid või vahetad, su meeskonnas ei tohi olla kahte või enamat sama POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap POKéMON only with the TRAINER you have just defeated.
et: Sa võid POKéMONe vahetada vaid TRAINERiga, kelle just alistasid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap for only those POKéMON used by the beaten TRAINER.
et: Sa võid vahetada vaid nende POKéMONide vastu, keda alistatud TRAINER kasutas.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's POKéMON.
et: Pärast iga võidetud lahingut võid vahetada ühe oma alistatud vastase POKéMONi vastu.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: You will not be able to swap POKéMON with the third TRAINER in the event.
et: Sa ei saa ürituse kolmanda TRAINERIGA POKéMONe vahetada.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping POKéMON.
et: POKéMONide vahetamisel tuleb silmas pidada kahte olulist asja.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the POKéMON you are about to receive.
et: Esiteks, vahetades ei saa sa kontrollida POKéMONi näitajaid, keda hakkad saama.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: Second, the POKéMON on your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
et: Teiseks, su meeskonna POKéMONid on reastatud järjekorras, olenevalt sellest, mis järjekorras sa nad rentisid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
et: See järjekord jääb samaks isegi siis, kui vahetused tehakse.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT are all rentals.
et: SLATEPORTI BATTLE TENTI POKéMONid on kõik renditavad.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: All rental POKéMON are kept at Level 30.
et: Kõiki rendi-POKéMONe hoitakse Tasemel 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTI reeglid on loetletud.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.
et: Siin VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTIS peavad POKéMONid ise mõtlema ja võitlema.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
et: Erinevalt loodusest käituvad inimestega elavad POKéMONid olenevalt oma loomusest erinevalt.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.
et: Olenevalt loomusest võib POKéMON eelistada rünnata, ükskõik mis.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.
et: Teine POKéMON võib eelistada end igasuguse kahju eest kaitsta.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
et: Veel üks võib nautida vaenlaste ärritamist või segadusse ajamist.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.
et: Sõltuvalt oma loomusest on POKéMONil lemmikvõtted, mida ta on osav kasutama.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.
et: Ta võib ka mõnda võtet mitte sallida, mille kasutamisega tal on raskusi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.
et: On ründevõtteid, mis teevad vaenlasele otsest kahju.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
et: On kaitsevõtteid, mida kasutatakse vaenlase rünnakuteks valmistumiseks või elupunktide taastamiseks jne.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.
et: On ka teisi veidravõitu võtteid, mis võivad vaenlasi nõrgestada seisundihädadega, sealhulgas mürgi ja halvatusega.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.
et: POKéMON kaalub nendesse kolme kategooriasse kuuluvate võtete kasutamist.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.
et: Kui POKéMON pole TRAINERi käsu all, ei pruugi ta teatud võtteid tõhusalt kasutada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
et: POKéMON pole hea üheski võttes, mida ta ei salli.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
et: Kui POKéMON oskab vaid võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi, ei suuda ta sageli oma potentsiaali täita.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
et: Olenevalt loomusest võib POKéMON hädas hakata kasutama võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
et: Kui POKéMON hakkab kitsikuses veidralt käituma, jälgi teda hoolikalt.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON.
et: Selles BATTLE TENTIS kohandatakse su vastaste tasemed su POKéMONide tasemetega sobivaks.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 30.
et: Ent ühelgi TRAINERIL, keda kohtad, ei ole POKéMONe alla Taseme 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTI reeglid on loetletud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!
et: ISA: Tere, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: I just received a very rare BERRY. I'd like you to have it.
et: Ma sain just väga haruldase BERRY. Ma tahaksin, et sa selle saaksid.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy soil, feel free to take them.
et: Kui näed mullases pinnases kasvavaid BERRY-sid, võta need julgelt.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: But make sure you plant a BERRY in the same spot. That's common courtesy.
et: Aga kindlasti istuta BERRY samasse kohta. See on üldine viisakus.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: Here, I'll share this with you.
et: Siin, ma jagan seda sinuga.

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: The way you look, you must be a TRAINER, no?
et: Su väljanägemise järgi pead sa olema TRAINER, kas pole?

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: TRAINERS often make POKéMON hold BERRIES.
et: TRAINERID lasevad tihti POKéMONidel BERRY-sid hoida.

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: It's up to you whether to grow BERRIES or use them.
et: See on sinu otsustada, kas BERRY-sid kasvatada või kasutada.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: I watered the plants every day. They grew lots of flowers.
et: Ma kastsin taimi iga päev. Neil kasvas palju lilli.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: And they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.
et: Ja nad andsid mulle ka palju BERRY-sid.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: Here you go! You can have it!
et: Palun, siin ta on! Sa võid selle saada!

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I'm going to try really hard and make BERRIES in different colors.
et: Ma kavatsen tõesti kõvasti pingutada ja teha BERRY-sid eri värvides.

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I hope you try hard, too!
et: Ma loodan, et sinagi pingutad kõvasti!

label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
en: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look for today?
et: Huvitav, mis värvi BERRY-sid ma täna otsin?

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine, so I'm collecting BERRIES.
et: Ma armastan BERRY CRUSH masina kasutamist, nii et ma kogun BERRY-sid.

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I'll share one with you, if you'd like.
et: Ma jagan sinuga ühe, kui soovid.

label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
en: You should try the BERRY CRUSH machine with your friends.
et: Sa peaksid proovima BERRY CRUSH masinat oma sõpradega.

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: Which BERRY should be planted? Should you use or hoard BERRIES?
et: Millist BERRY-t peaks istutama? Kas peaksid BERRY-sid kasutama või varuma?

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: It's fun to think about.
et: Selle üle on lõbus mõelda.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.
et: BERRY-d kasvavad, imedes päikesevalgust.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: We help the BERRIES grow by watering them regularly.
et: Me aitame BERRY-del kasvada, kastes neid regulaarselt.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: It's an expression of love, isn't it?
et: See on armastuse väljendus, kas pole?

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: Yes, yes. You understand what I mean.
et: Jah, jah. Sa saad aru, mida ma mõtlen.

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: You should take this.
et: Sa peaksid selle võtma.

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: Oh… But it is important to make your own impressions, I guess…
et: Oh… Aga on tähtis luua oma muljeid, ma arvan…

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: You can have this.
et: Sa võid selle saada.

label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
en: I think that BERRY is rare. I hope you raise it with loving care.
et: Ma arvan, et see BERRY on haruldane. Ma loodan, et kasvatad seda armastava hoolega.

label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
en: I'll get more BERRIES from the BERRY MASTER.
et: Ma hangin BERRY MASTERILT rohkem BERRY-sid.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: The same way suits suit me perfectly, a crisp breeze suits the sea.
et: Samamoodi nagu ülikonnad sobivad mulle täiuslikult, sobib värske tuulehoog merele.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: And you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…
et: Ja sulle, BERRY sobib sulle täpselt…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: Why should that be so?
et: Miks see nõnda peaks olema?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: It's because you're a TRAINER!
et: See on sellepärast, et sa oled TRAINER!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: The way dignified simplicity suits me, {POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.
et: Nii nagu väärikas lihtsus sobib mulle, sobivad {POKEBLOCK}id täiuslikult POKéMONidele.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.
et: Sa võid mind kutsuda BERRY MASTERIKS.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: I dream of filling the world with beautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES and hand them out to everyone.
et: Ma unistan maailma täitmisest kaunite lilledega, nii et ma kasvatan BERRY-sid ja jagan neid kõigile.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You're deserving of one!
et: Sa väärid üht!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
en: Why be stingy? Take another!
et: Milleks olla ihne? Võta veel üks!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL flower shop near RUSTBORO.
et: Külasta kindlasti PRETTY PETAL lillepoodi RUSTBORO lähedal.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Täitku lilled maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: I'm done for today. Come again another day.
et: Ma olen tänaseks valmis. Tule mõni teine päev jälle.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Täitku lilled maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: The way my husband grows BERRIES, oh, he's the best in the world.
et: See, kuidas mu abikaasa BERRY-sid kasvatab, oh, ta on maailma parim.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: He makes me proud, that he does.
et: Ta teeb mind uhkeks, seda ta teeb.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: Incidentally, child, have you heard a good saying lately?
et: Muuseas, laps, kas oled viimasel ajal head ütlust kuulnud?

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: Ah! What a remarkable saying! Inspirational, it is!
et: Ah! Milline tähelepanuväärne ütlus! Inspireeriv, on ta!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Ma tahan, et sa selle saaksid.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: Oh! A good saying it is. You're quite remarkable.
et: Oh! See on hea ütlus. Sa oled päris tähelepanuväärne.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Ma tahan, et sa selle saaksid.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Our four grandchildren should become more accomplished than my husband.
et: Meie neli lapselast peaksid mu abikaasast osavamaks saama.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Joy never goes out of my life!
et: Rõõm ei kao mu elust kunagi!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
en: Ah…
et: Ah…

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop. Spreading flowers all over the world!
et: See on PRETTY PETAL lillepood. Levitame lilli üle kogu maailma!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sooviksid BERRY-de kohta õppida?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: Your name is?
et: Su nimi on?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}. That's a nice name.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}. See on kena nimi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sooviksid BERRY-de kohta õppida?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: BERRIES grow on trees that thrive only in soft, loamy soil.
et: BERRY-d kasvavad puudel, mis edenevad ainult pehmes, mullases pinnases.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: If you take some BERRIES, be sure to plant one in the loamy soil again.
et: Kui võtad mõned BERRY-d, istuta kindlasti üks jälle mullasesse pinnasesse.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: A planted BERRY will soon sprout, grow into a plant, flower beautifully, then grow BERRIES again.
et: Istutatud BERRY idaneb varsti, kasvab taimeks, õitseb kaunilt, siis kasvatab jälle BERRY-sid.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: I want to see the whole wide world filled with beautiful flowers. That's my dream.
et: Ma tahan näha kogu maailma kaunite lilledega täidetud. See on mu unistus.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: Please help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES and bring more flowers into the world.
et: Palun aita mind, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Istuta BERRY-sid ja too maailma rohkem lilli.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
en: Flowers bring so much happiness to people, don't they?
et: Lilled toovad inimestele nii palju õnne, kas pole?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: The more attention you give to flowers, the more beautifully they bloom.
et: Mida rohkem tähelepanu lilledele pöörad, seda kaunimalt nad õitsevad.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: You'll like tending flowers. I'm sure of it. You can have this.
et: Sulle meeldib lillede eest hoolitseda. Ma olen selles kindel. Sa võid selle saada.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: While BERRY plants are growing, water them with the WAILMER PAIL.
et: Sel ajal, kui BERRY-taimed kasvavad, kasta neid WAILMER PAILIGA.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Oh, another thing.
et: Oh, veel üks asi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: If you don't pick BERRIES for a while, they'll drop off onto the ground. But they'll sprout again.
et: Kui sa mõnda aega BERRY-sid ei korja, kukuvad need maha. Aga nad idanevad uuesti.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Isn't that awesome? It's like they have the will to live.
et: Kas pole see äge? See on nagu neil oleks tahe elada.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: I'm trying to be like my big sisters. I'm growing flowers, too!
et: Ma püüan olla nagu mu suured õed. Ma kasvatan ka lilli!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: Here you go! It's for you!
et: Palun, siin ta on! See on sulle!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big, or you can make a POKéMON hold it.
et: Sa võid BERRY istutada ja suureks kasvatada või lasta POKéMONil seda hoida.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: But now they have a machine that mixes up different BERRIES and makes candies for POKéMON.
et: Aga nüüd on neil masin, mis segab erinevaid BERRY-sid ja teeb POKéMONidele komme.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: I want some candy, too.
et: Minagi tahan veidi komme.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: Hi, what's your name?
et: Tere, mis su nimi on?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: … … … … … … … … … Okay. That's nice!
et: … … … … … … … … … Olgu. See on kena!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My name is KIRI.
et: Mu nimi on KIRI.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My mommy and daddy named me that so I would grow healthy and warmhearted. That's what they wished.
et: Mu emme ja issi panid mulle selle nime, et ma kasvaksin terve ja soojasüdamlik. Seda nad soovisid.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo

et: KIRI annab sulle ka selle BERRY! Mulle see tõesti väga meeldib!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
en: I wonder what kind of wish is included in your name.
et: Huvitav, milline soov sinu nimesse peidetud on.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
et: Kevad, suvi, sügis ja talv.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: If you're born in springtime, do you like the spring, and if you're born in the summer, do you like the summer?
et: Kui sa oled sündinud kevadel, kas sulle meeldib kevad, ja kui sa oled sündinud suvel, kas sulle meeldib suvi?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Then KIRI was born in the autumn, so I love the autumn!
et: Siis KIRI on sündinud sügisel, nii et ma armastan sügist!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Which season do you like?
et: Milline aastaaeg sulle meeldib?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: Oh… It doesn't matter…
et: Oh… Pole tähtis…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: There's so much that I want to know…
et: On nii palju, mida ma teada tahan…

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!
et: Tere! Vabandust, et sind ootel hoidsin!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Welcome to the world of POKéMON!
et: Tere tulemast POKéMONide maailma!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: My name is BIRCH.
et: Mu nimi on BIRCH.

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: But everyone calls me the POKéMON PROFESSOR.
et: Aga kõik kutsuvad mind POKéMONI PROFESSORIKS.

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
en: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”
et: Seda me nimetame „POKéMONiks.”

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: This world is widely inhabited by creatures known as POKéMON.
et: Seda maailma asustavad laialdaselt olendid, keda tuntakse POKéMONide nime all.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: We humans live alongside POKéMON, at times as friendly playmates, and at times as cooperative workmates.
et: Meie, inimesed, elame POKéMONide kõrval, vahel sõbralike mängukaaslastena ja vahel koostööaltide töökaaslastena.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: And sometimes, we band together and battle others like us.
et: Ja vahel me ühineme ja võitleme teiste meiesugustega.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: But despite our closeness, we don't know everything about POKéMON.
et: Aga hoolimata meie lähedusest ei tea me POKéMONide kohta kõike.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: In fact, there are many, many secrets surrounding POKéMON.
et: Tegelikult ümbritseb POKéMONe väga-väga palju saladusi.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: To unravel POKéMON mysteries, I've been undertaking research. That's what I do.
et: POKéMONide mõistatuste lahtiharutamiseks olen ma teinud uurimistööd. See on see, mida ma teen.

label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
en: And you are?
et: Ja sina oled?

label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
en: Are you a boy? Or are you a girl?
et: Kas sa oled poiss? Või oled tüdruk?

label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
en: All right. What's your name?
et: Hea küll. Mis su nimi on?

label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
en: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Nii et see on {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: Ah, okay!
et: Ah, olgu!

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my hometown of LITTLEROOT. I get it now!
et: Sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}, kes kolib minu kodulinna LITTLEROOTI. Nüüd ma saan aru!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: All right, are you ready?
et: Hea küll, kas oled valmis?

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Your very own adventure is about to unfold.
et: Su enda seiklus on kohe avanemas.

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Take courage, and leap into the world of POKéMON where dreams, adventure, and friendships await!
et: Kogu julgust ja hüppa POKéMONide maailma, kus ootavad unistused, seiklus ja sõprus!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Well, I'll be expecting you later. Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.
et: Noh, ma ootan sind hiljem. Tule mind vaatama mu POKéMON LABORISSE.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am! The BLEND MASTER am I!
et: SEGAMISMEISTER: Tõesti olen! SEGAMISMEISTER olen mina!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: Blend with me, and you shall witness the mastery I bring to blending!
et: Sega minuga ja sa saad tunnistajaks meisterlikkusele, mille ma segamisse toon!

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
en: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to see my mastery in action?
et: SEGAMISMEISTER: Hmmm! Nii et sa soovid näha mu meisterlikkust tegevuses?

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: So, you are too busy now, I see!
et: Nii et sul on nüüd liiga kiire, ma näen!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: But fear not! I shall be here all day! Hurry back from your errand!
et: Aga ära karda! Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kiirusta oma askeldusest tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: You haven't got a single BERRY!
et: Sul pole ühtki BERRY-t!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: I shall be here all day! Hurry back with some BERRIES!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kiirusta tagasi mõne BERRY-ga!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Of course! Of course!
et: Muidugi! Muidugi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Incidentally… You do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S from BERRIES?
et: Muuseas… Sa ju tead, kuidas BERRY-dest {POKEBLOCK}e segada?

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Ah, but it is a simple process!
et: Ah, aga see on lihtne protsess!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When the BLENDER's arrow comes to your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDERI nool jõuab su tähiseni, vajuta lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: That's all you have to do.
et: See on kõik, mida sa tegema pead.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When you see how precisely I press the A Button, you will understand.
et: Kui näed, kui täpselt ma A-nuppu vajutan, sa saad aru.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Fine!
et: Hea küll!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: All together with the BLEND MASTER, let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Kõik koos SEGAMISMEISTRIGA, BERRY BLENDERdame!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: You don't appear to have gotten the {POKEBLOCK} CASE!
et: Näib, et sa pole {POKEBLOCK} CASE'i saanud!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: I shall be here all day! Obtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Hangi {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!
et: Näib, et su {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: I shall be here all day! Use some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kasuta mõned {POKEBLOCK}id ära ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
en: Whoa! Awesome!
et: Ohoo! Äge!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
en: Wickedly fast!
et: Pööraselt kiire!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
en: What an expert!
et: Milline ekspert!

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
en: When I blended with the MASTER, we made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!
et: Kui ma MEISTRIGA segasin, tegime hämmastavaid {POKEBLOCK}e!

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Eyes that track the arrow with machinelike intensity…
et: Silmad, mis jälgivad noolt masinaliku intensiivsusega…

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: A hand that taps the A Button with clockwork-like precision…
et: Käsi, mis toksib A-nuppu kellavärgi täpsusega…

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Possessing these qualities makes the BLEND MASTER truly great.
et: Nende omaduste olemasolu teeb SEGAMISMEISTRI tõeliselt suureks.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work on his skills deep in the mountains.
et: SEGAMISMEISTER peaks oma oskusi lihvima sügaval mägedes.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: Sometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE to blend BERRIES all day long.
et: Vahel tuleb ta LILYCOVE'i, et BERRY-sid terve päev segada.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
en: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…
et: Praam SLATEPORTI on…

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
en: I beg your pardon? Can we sail to this place on the map?
et: Ma palun vabandust? Kas me saame kaardil sellesse kohta purjetada?

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
en: I know someone who will help you better. Please wait.
et: Ma tean kedagi, kes aitab sind paremini. Palun oota.

label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
en: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…
et: Praam SLATEPORTI on…

label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
en: Oh? That PASS…
et: Oh? See PASS…

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: Aye, mate, are you the one who brought that mighty odd PASS?
et: Jah, sõber, kas sina oled see, kes tõi selle vägaviisi veidra PASSI?

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: I'll tell you, you're trying to reach a tiny spit of an island far in the south.
et: Ma ütlen sulle, sa üritad jõuda tillukesele saarekesele kaugel lõunas.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: There's no telling what we'll encounter once we reach there, aye. That shivers my timbers!
et: Pole öelda, mida me kohtame, kui sinna jõuame, jah. See paneb mind judisema!

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
en: All aboard!
et: Kõik pardale!

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
en: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to see or do on this forgettable island.
et: Jah, sõber, sellel unustataval saarel pole midagi näha ega teha.

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
en: What say we sail back to LILYCOVE?
et: Mis oleks, kui purjetaksime tagasi LILYCOVE'i?

label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
en: Aye, right, then! Sail home we will!
et: Jah, õige siis! Purjetame koju!

label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
en: Aye, right, as you like, then.
et: Jah, õige, nagu soovid siis.

label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
en: “All dreams are but another reality. Never forget…”
et: „Kõik unistused on vaid teine reaalsus. Ära kunagi unusta…”

label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
en: “Those whose memories fade seek to carve them in their hearts…”
et: „Need, kelle mälestused hääbuvad, püüavad neid oma südamesse raiuda…”

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: What's up, youngster?
et: Mis lahti, nooruke?

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: What, it's you who's supposed to have a tattered old map?
et: Mida, kas see oled sina, kellel peaks olema räbaldunud vana kaart?

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: Let's have a look. … … … … … …
et: Vaatame. … … … … … …

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
en: Boy, this is quite a ways away. I'm afraid I can't help you…
et: Poiss, see on päris kaugel. Ma kardan, et ma ei saa sind aidata…

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
en: BRINEY: Hold on a second!
et: BRINEY: Pea hetk kinni!

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
en: What's the idea of turning down someone that I owe so much to?
et: Mis mõte on ära öelda kellelegi, kellele ma nii palju võlgu olen?

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: You came to me seeking my help, and we almost turned you away.
et: Sa tulid minu juurde mu abi otsides ja me peaaegu saatsime su minema.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: Well, let me make things right.
et: Noh, las ma teen asjad korda.

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: We'll sail right away, of course!
et: Me purjetame kohe, muidugi!

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
en: Let's find this island on this OLD SEA MAP!
et: Leiame selle saare sellelt OLD SEA MAPILT!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Is it you who brought that odd ticket?
et: Kas sina oled see, kes tõi selle veidra pileti?

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Where you're trying to go is an island that's far, far away.
et: Koht, kuhu sa üritad minna, on saar, mis on kaugel-kaugel.

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: No one knows what awaits there…
et: Keegi ei tea, mis seal ees ootab…

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: The very thought excites my blood as a sailing man!
et: Juba ainuüksi see mõte erutab mu verd kui meremehel!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
en: Get on board, youngster!
et: Astu pardale, nooruke!

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_SailorReturn
en: CAPT. BRINEY can be so maddeningly fickle…
et: KAPTEN BRINEY võib olla nii hulluksajavalt tujukas…

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_SailorReturn
en: Do you want to return to LILYCOVE?
et: Kas tahad LILYCOVE'i tagasi minna?

label: BirthIsland_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
en: What an oddly shaped island, eh? Do you want to return to LILYCOVE?
et: Milline veidra kujuga saar, mis? Kas tahad LILYCOVE'i tagasi minna?

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: Is it you who brought those odd tickets?
et: Kas sina oled see, kes tõi need veidrad piletid?

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: These tickets will get you to islands that are far, far away.
et: Need piletid viivad su saartele, mis on kaugel-kaugel.

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: No one knows what awaits there, or what may happen there.
et: Keegi ei tea, mis seal ees ootab või mis seal juhtuda võib.

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: The very thought excites my blood as a sailing man!
et: Juba ainuüksi see mõte erutab mu verd kui meremehel!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
en: Get on board, youngster! Where shall we sail first?
et: Astu pardale, nooruke! Kuhu me kõigepealt purjetame?

label: NavelRock_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
en: Did… Did you hear that? That low growling from deep in there.
et: Kas… Kas sa kuulsid seda? Seda madalat urinat sügavalt sealt seest.

label: NavelRock_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
en: Are you sure it's safe? Do you think we should leave?
et: Kas oled kindel, et see on ohutu? Kas arvad, et me peaksime lahkuma?

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_Sign
en: The writing is fading as if it was written a long time ago…
et: Kiri hääbub, justkui oleks see ammu kirjutatud…

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_Sign
en: “…ber, 6th day If any human…sets foot here… again…et it be a kindhearted pers… …ith that hope, I depar…”
et: „…ber, 6. päev Kui mõni inimene…astub siia jälle… jalaga…olgu see lahke süd…inimene… …selle lootusega ma lahk…”

en: Urk…
et: Urk…

en: Hah!
et: Hah!

label: gText_LucyDefeatGold
en: Darn!
et: Neetud!

label: gText_BrandonDefeatSilver

et: Just nii! Sa tegid seda! Sa töötasid selle nimel!
