en: In the best port was the best TRAINER…
et: Parimas sadamas oli parim TRAINER…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
en: Urrrrppp… Battle? With me?
et: Örrrrpppp… Lahing? Minuga?

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
en: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Urrrrpppp…
et: Örp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Örrrrpppp…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog!
et: Ma olen tavaliselt sellest tugevam! Ma olen lihtsalt merehaige nagu koer!

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm a SAILOR, but…
et: Ma olen MADRUS, aga…

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
en: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
et: Mul on janu… Mul kuluks üks SODA POP RANNAMAJAST…

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
en: Groan…
et: Oiga…

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
en: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…
et: Ma lähen näljaseks… Mu ujurõngas näeb välja nagu hiiglaslik sõõrik…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
en: Will you have another match with me when I'm not all thirsty?
et: Kas peaksid minuga veel matši, kui ma pole enam janune?

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
en: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in me for a battle!
et: Mul on kõht tühi, aga mul on lahinguks piisavalt hoogu sees!

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
en: I lost… It's because I'm hungry…
et: Ma kaotasin… See on sellepärast, et mul on kõht tühi…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
en: When you eat on a beach, everything seems to taste a little better.
et: Kui sööd rannas, näib kõik veidi paremini maitsevat.

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
en: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like a giant flower?
et: Kas rannavari ei näe välja nagu hiiglaslik lill?

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
en: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!
et: Kui vaatad randa taevast, näeb see välja nagu suur lilleaed!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
en: Me? I'm here every day!
et: Mina? Ma olen siin iga päev!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
en: I'm not losing to you again! That's why I have my inner tube!
et: Ma ei kaota sulle jälle! Just seepärast on mul ujurõngas!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
en: If I have an inner tube, me and my POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
et: Kui mul on ujurõngas, tõuseb minu ja mu POKéMONi armsus kõvasti!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
en: I can't swim without my inner tube, but I won't lose at POKéMON!
et: Ma ei oska ilma oma ujurõngata ujuda, aga POKéMONides ma ei kaota!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
en: Did I lose because I have an inner tube?
et: Kas ma kaotasin, sest mul on ujurõngas?

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
en: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.
et: Mu ujurõngas on moe-ese. Mind ei tohi ilma selleta näha.

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
en: Hi, big TRAINER. Will you battle with me?
et: Tere, suur TRAINER. Kas võitled minuga?

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
en: Oh, you're strong.
et: Oh, sa oled tugev.

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
en: How did you get to be so strong?
et: Kuidas sa nii tugevaks said?

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
en: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch himself a big one!
et: Vahahaa! See sell püüab endale suure!

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
en: This dude just lost one…
et: See sell just kaotas ühe…

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
en: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!
et: See sell arvab, et sa oled suur. Ei, sa oled tulevane suur!

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.
et: PAUL: Noh, see on tujurikkuja.

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: I wish you wouldn't disturb our precious time together.
et: Ma sooviksin, et sa ei häiriks meie kallist ühist aega.

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
en: PAUL: Well, I give up.
et: PAUL: Noh, ma annan alla.

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
en: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!
et: PAUL: Noh, ära ütle kellelegi, et me siin oleme. See on lihtsalt meie kahe privaatne maailm!

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
en: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: PAUL: Me oleme täiesti, sügavalt armunud. Just seepärast paneme oma POKéMONid koos võitlema.

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
en: MEL: We're, like, totally in love. Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu täiesti armunud. Meie romanss kuumutab kogu HOENNI!

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
en: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault! PAUL will hate me!
et: MEL: Me kaotasime ja see on minu süü! PAUL vihkab mind!

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
en: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me? Please don't be angry.
et: MEL: Öö, PAUL, kas sa oled minu peale vihane? Palun ära ole vihane.

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
en: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu sügavalt ja tõeliselt armunud. Just seepärast paneme oma POKéMONid koos võitlema.

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
en: Tadaah! See? My inner tube's round!
et: Tadaah! Näed? Mu ujurõngas on ümmargune!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
en: Oh, oh! Too bad!
et: Oh, oh! Kahju!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
en: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…
et: Pärast seda, kui ma sulle oma ümmargust ujurõngast näitasin…

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
en: I can't swim, so I'm pretending to swim.
et: Ma ei oska ujuda, nii et ma teesklen ujumist.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
en: I thought so! I didn't think we could win.
et: Ma arvasingi! Ma ei arvanud, et suudame võita.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
en: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.
et: Kui ma õpin ujuma, ma arvan, et mu POKéMON muutub kõvemaks.

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
en: For a guy as macho as me, this kind of POKéMON is the perfect match!
et: Minusuguse matšo tüübi jaoks sobib seda liiki POKéMON ideaalselt!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
en: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
et: Ma olen lahe isegi lüüasaamises, mis?

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting!
et: Minusuguse matšo tüübi jaoks on sadam ideaalne miljöö!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
et: Ma vist suundun SLATEPORTI.

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
en: Whoa! Watch it! I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
et: Ohoo! Ettevaatust! Ma arvan, et sa pole JALGRATTA-võiduajamisega harjunud.

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
en: Whoa! My brakes failed!
et: Ohoo! Mu pidurid vedasid alt!

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
en: Flat tires and brake problems can cause serious injury! Inspect your BIKE for problems!
et: Tühjad rehvid ja piduriprobleemid võivad põhjustada tõsiseid vigastusi! Kontrolli oma JALGRATAST probleemide osas!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
en: Yo, you! Can you keep up with my speed?
et: Jou, sina! Kas suudad mu kiirusega järge pidada?

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
en: Crash and burn!
et: Prantsatus ja põleng!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
en: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON. I need to reconsider this…
et: Ainuüksi kiirus ei lase mul POKéMONides võita. Ma pean seda ümber mõtlema…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
en: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
et: Ära satu paanikasse, kui su JALGRATAS kiiresti kihutab!

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
en: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON battles…
et: Ma ei tohiks POKéMON-lahingute ajal paanikasse sattuda…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanitseda ega stressata. Võta rahulikult. Aega on küllaga.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
en: I'll keep chugging on without stressing. Give me a shout if you're up to it.
et: Ma pöhinen edasi ilma stressita. Hõiga mulle, kui oled valmis.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
en: Aren't you going a little too fast? Take it easy and let's battle.
et: Kas sa ei kihuta veidi liiga kiiresti? Võta rahulikult ja võitleme.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
en: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
et: Ma ei paanitsenud, aga ma ikka kaotasin…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanitseda ega stressata. Võta rahulikult. Aega on küllaga.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.
et: Triatlon on äärmuseni raske.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: You have to complete the three events of swimming, cycling, and running.
et: Sa pead läbima kolm ala: ujumise, rattasõidu ja jooksmise.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
en: POKéMON battles are hard, too!
et: POKéMON-lahingud on ka rasked!

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
en: I'm exhausted, so I need a break. It's important to get proper rest.
et: Ma olen kurnatud, nii et ma vajan pausi. On tähtis korralikult puhata.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
en: You know, I like you! Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
et: Tead, sa meeldid mulle! Peame revanši JALGRATTATEEL.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
en: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while cycling?
et: Kas pole tore pidada lahingut rattaga sõites?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
en: Wow… How could you be so strong?
et: Ohoo… Kuidas sa nii tugev olla saad?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: Were you going after a record?
et: Kas sa jahtisid rekordit?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: I'm sorry if I held you up!
et: Vabandust, kui ma sind kinni pidasin!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
en: I've been riding without stopping. My thighs are like rocks!
et: Ma olen sõitnud peatumata. Mu reied on nagu kivid!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
en: I'm worried about muscle cramps…
et: Ma muretsen lihaskrampide pärast…

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
en: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES? No wonder you're so strong!
et: Oh, sul on mõned SAALI MÄRGID? Pole ime, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
en: I have foreseen your intentions! I cannot possibly lose!
et: Ma olen ette näinud su kavatsusi! Ma ei saa kuidagi kaotada!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
en: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
et: Mul ei õnnestunud ennustada omaenda hukku!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: I see your future…
et: Ma näen su tulevikku…

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: Hmm… I see a shining light…
et: Hmm… Ma näen helendavat valgust…

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
en: Ahahahaha! I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
et: Ahahahaa! Ma pimestan sind oma imedega!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
en: I wondrously lost!
et: Ma kaotasin imepäraselt!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
en: You managed to win only because it was a wonder! Yes, a wonder! Don't think you can win all the time!
et: Sul õnnestus võita ainult sellepärast, et see oli ime! Jah, ime! Ära arva, et suudad kogu aeg võita!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma saaksin näha su POKéMONi? Ainult üks pilk, palun?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
en: I wanted to complete my collection…
et: Ma tahtsin oma kollektsiooni täiendada…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
en: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know, my passion as a collector is ignited!
et: Kui ma näen POKéMONi, keda ma ei tunne, süttib mu kollektsionääri kirg!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
en: I like collecting MATCH CALL registrations, too…
et: Mulle meeldib ka MATCH CALL registreeringuid koguda…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?
et: Tere, kas oled püüdnud uusi POKéMONe?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma saaksin näha su POKéMONi? Ainult üks pilk, palun?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
en: Your POKéMON… I envy you.
et: Su POKéMON… Ma kadestan sind.

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
en: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON mine!
et: Oh, ma igatsen teha kõik haruldased POKéMONid enda omaks!

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
en: Hey! Don't sneak up behind me like that!
et: Hei! Ära hiili niimoodi mu selja taha!

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
en: I lost! Drat!
et: Ma kaotasin! Pagan!

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
en: Fishing is all about concentration. You have to focus on the floater.
et: Kalastuses on kõik keskendumises. Sa pead keskenduma ujukile.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
en: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show off my delightful POKéMON.
et: Ahahaha! Ma läheksin kuhu iganes, et oma veetlevat POKéMONi eksponeerida.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
en: Oh, dear, this won't do.
et: Oh, heldeke, see ei sobi.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
en: Rather than battling, perhaps I should show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.
et: Selle asemel, et võidelda, peaksin ma ehk oma POKéMONi FAN CLUBIS eksponeerima.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
en: That wasn't close to what I could do to show off my POKéMON.
et: See polnud lähedalgi sellele, mida ma oma POKéMONi eksponeerimiseks teha suudan.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
en: I'll have you as my captive audience as often as possible!
et: Ma teen sinust oma kinnise publiku nii tihti kui võimalik!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
en: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show off my POKéMON as often as you like!
et: Ahahahaa! Mul oleks hea meel oma POKéMONi eksponeerida nii tihti kui tahad!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
en: Oh, dear, this won't do.
et: Oh, heldeke, see ei sobi.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
en: I don't think that I could ever stop from showing off my POKéMON.
et: Ma ei arva, et suudaksin kunagi oma POKéMONi eksponeerimist lõpetada.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
en: But I like to battle, too!
et: Aga mulle meeldib ka võidelda!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
en: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass around here!
et: Ma leidsin siinkandi rohust mõned lahedad POKéMONid!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
en: Being cool isn't enough to win…
et: Lahe olemisest ei piisa võiduks…

label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
en: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you just caught.
et: Raske on võidelda POKéMONidega, kelle just püüdsid.

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
en: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…
et: Ma kukkusin JALGRATTATEELT alla…

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
en: I'll get over my embarrassment by battling with you!
et: Ma saan oma piinlikkusest üle sinuga võideldes!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
en: Oops! I ended up losing!
et: Uups! Ma lõpuks kaotasin!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
en: Falling… Losing… This is so humiliating for me!
et: Kukkumine… Kaotamine… See on mulle nii alandav!

label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
en: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't groove, you get left behind!
et: Olgu! Täisgaasi aeg! Kui sa hoogu sisse ei saa, jääd maha!

label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
en: You got into the groove all right…
et: Sa said hoo sisse küll…

label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
en: This isn't going to bring me down! Losing has made me a better man!
et: See mind maha ei murra! Kaotamine on teinud minust parema mehe!

label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
en: When cute POKéMON help each other… You won't see a more adorable sight!
et: Kui armsad POKéMONid üksteist aitavad… Sa ei näe armsamat vaatepilti!

label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
en: Have you no compassion or pity?
et: Kas sul pole kaastunnet ega halastust?

label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
en: Okay, okay, you've done the best you could, my pretties.
et: Olgu, olgu, te andsite endast parima, mu kaunikesed.

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
en: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you. But I think they look better on me.
et: Oh, hei! Need GO-GOGGLES sobivad sulle. Aga ma arvan, et minu peal näevad nad paremad välja.

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
en: Let's decide who they look better on with a battle!
et: Otsustame lahinguga, kelle peal nad paremad välja näevad!

label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
en: I couldn't see what was happening at my sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.
et: Ma ei näinud, mis mu külgedel toimub, GO-GOGGLES'ide tõttu.

label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
en: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to get through sandstorms. That makes me happy!
et: GO-GOGGLES teevad võimalikuks liivatormidest läbi saada. See teeb mind õnnelikuks!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
en: I'm having a picnic in the desert.
et: Mul on kõrbes piknik.

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
en: You can always find a TRAINER, so I can enjoy a battle here, too!
et: TRAINERit leiab alati, nii et ma saan siinki lahingut nautida!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
en: Ohhh! You're mean!
et: Ohhh! Sa oled õel!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
en: When you're battling in a sandstorm, watch out for your POKéMON's HP.
et: Kui võitled liivatormis, hoia silm peal oma POKéMONi HP-l.

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
en: It can faint if you don't keep an eye on it!
et: Ta võib minestada, kui sa tal silma peal ei hoia!

label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
en: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me feel like a superhero. Right now, nobody can beat me!
et: Nende GO-GOGGLES'ide kandmine paneb mind end superkangelasena tundma. Just praegu ei suuda keegi mind võita!

label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
en: I can't win on spirit alone…
et: Ma ei suuda ainuüksi vaimuga võita…

label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
en: I'm going to be a real hero one day. I'm going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.
et: Ma saan ühel päeval päris kangelaseks. Ma töötan kõvemini, et teha end ja oma POKéMONe tugevamaks.

label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
en: I heard there are fossils to be found in the desert. Where could they be?
et: Ma kuulsin, et kõrbes on fossiile leida. Kus need küll olla võiksid?

label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
en: I came up short…
et: Ma jäin napilt hätta…

label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
en: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.
et: Kui nad kõrbes fossiile leiavad, pidi see enne meri olema.

label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! I am to be challenged?
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid! Kas mulle esitatakse väljakutse?

label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
en: While I have searched for ruins, I've not searched for strong POKéMON.
et: Kuigi ma olen varemeid otsinud, pole ma tugevaid POKéMONe otsinud.

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
en: No, wait, was that forty years? Which was it now?
et: Ei, oota, kas see oli nelikümmend aastat? Kumb see nüüd oli?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
en: I haven't been searching for any tough POKéMON.
et: Ma pole ühtki kõva POKéMONi otsinud.

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
en: But, for some reason, I sure do like POKéNAVS.
et: Aga millegipärast meeldivad mulle küll POKéNAVID.

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
en: No, wait, was that forty years? Anyway, am I to be challenged?
et: Ei, oota, kas see oli nelikümmend aastat? Igatahes, kas mulle esitatakse väljakutse?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
en: I've found no ruins, nor have I found any strong POKéMON…
et: Ma pole leidnud varemeid ega ka ühtki tugevat POKéMONi…

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: No, wait, was that forty years I've searched?
et: Ei, oota, kas ma otsisin nelikümmend aastat?

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: Hmm… It could even be fifty… How long have I been at this?
et: Hmm… See võib olla isegi viiskümmend… Kui kaua ma seda teinud olen?

label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
en: I'm full of pep! And my POKéMON is peppy, too!
et: Ma olen hoogu täis! Ja mu POKéMON on ka hoogne!

label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
en: My POKéMON lost its pep…
et: Mu POKéMON kaotas oma hoo…

label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
en: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep, I can't help looking.
et: Kui ma näen TRAINERit, kel on palju hoogu, ma ei saa muud, kui vaatan.

label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
en: I don't know where you're going, but would you like to battle?
et: Ma ei tea, kuhu sa lähed, aga kas sooviksid võidelda?

label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
en: Oh, you're disgustingly good!
et: Oh, sa oled vastikult hea!

label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
en: I'm thinking that I should go to MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around here is very nice, too.
et: Ma mõtlen, et peaksin MT. CHIMNEYSSE minema, aga vaade siin kandis on ka väga kena.

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
en: To train myself, I challenge all whom I meet!
et: Et end treenida, esitan ma väljakutse kõigile, keda kohtan!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
en: Uncle! I give up!
et: Onu! Ma annan alla!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
en: All I can do is keep training until I can defeat strong TRAINERS such as yourself.
et: Kõik, mida ma teha saan, on jätkata treenimist, kuni suudan alistada tugevaid TRAINEREID nagu sina.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
en: Show me how much you've toughened your POKéMON.
et: Näita mulle, kui palju sa oma POKéMONe karastanud oled.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
en: I see, you've toughened them considerably.
et: Ma näen, sa oled neid tublisti karastanud.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
en: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much through battling.
et: POKéMONid ja TRAINERID õpivad võideldes palju.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
en: What's important is to never give up even if you lose.
et: Tähtis on mitte kunagi alla anda, isegi kui kaotad.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
en: There is much to be learned from your training style.
et: Su treeningstiilist on palju õppida.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
en: I request a rematch if it behooves you.
et: Ma palun revanši, kui see sulle sobib.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
en: We're training here to elevate our game to the next level. Stay and train with us!
et: Me treenime siin, et tõsta oma mängu järgmisele tasemele. Jää ja treeni meiega!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
en: Ooh, you're decent!
et: Ohh, sa oled korralik!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
en: Since you're that strong, you should aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Kuna sa oled nii tugev, peaksid sihtima POKéMON LEAGUE'i.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
en: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious actors. I have to ask you for an engagement.
et: Oh, su POKéMONid näevad välja nagu tõsised näitlejad. Ma pean sult angažeeringut paluma.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
en: They didn't just look strong, they are strong!
et: Nad mitte üksnes ei näinud tugevad välja, nad on tugevad!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
en: I thought I was raising my POKéMON diligently, but, oh no, there is still much to be done.
et: Ma arvasin, et kasvatan oma POKéMONe usinasti, aga, oh ei, veel on palju teha.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
en: I wish I could become friends with more strong people like you!
et: Ma sooviksin, et saaksin sõbraks rohkemate sinusuguste tugevate inimestega!

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
en: You can make POKéMON stronger or weaker depending on the moves you teach them.
et: Sa saad teha POKéMONid tugevamaks või nõrgemaks sõltuvalt võtetest, mida neile õpetad.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
en: What kinds of moves do your POKéMON know?
et: Milliseid võtteid su POKéMONid oskavad?

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
en: You've taught them good moves!
et: Sa oled õpetanud neile häid võtteid!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
en: Maybe I should have stopped my POKéMON from evolving until they learned better moves…
et: Ehk oleksin pidanud oma POKéMONe arenemast peatama, kuni nad paremad võtted õpivad…

label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
en: I shouldn't have come to a place like this for a picnic!
et: Ma poleks pidanud tulema sellisesse kohta piknikule!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
en: Aww! I really shouldn't have come!
et: Ohh! Ma poleks tõesti pidanud tulema!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
en: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set the places for a picnic even with my GO-GOGGLES on…
et: Sellises liivatormis ei saa ma piknikuks laudu katta isegi oma GO-GOGGLES'idega…

label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
en: How tough are you? We shall expose that secret!
et: Kui kõva sa oled? Me paljastame selle saladuse!

label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
en: Oh! Your strength! It is shrouded in mystery!
et: Oh! Su jõud! See on mõistatuse loori taga!

label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
en: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
et: See kõrb peidab mõistatusi oma tuiskavas liivas!

label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
en: I'll give you some of my sandwich if you'll lose.
et: Ma annan sulle veidi oma võileiba, kui sa kaotad.

label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
en: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be enough of a bribe…
et: Tsc! Ma arvasin, et võileib on piisav altkäemaks…

label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
en: My SANDSHREW loves eating my sandwiches.
et: Mu SANDSHREW armastab mu võileibade söömist.

label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
en: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!
et: See on mu lemmikliiki POKéMON!

label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
en: Wait! Did you get a good look at my POKéMON?
et: Oota! Kas sa vaatasid mu POKéMONi hoolega?

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
en: When having a battle, I get a kick out of showing off my POKéMON.
et: Lahingut pidades saan ma naudingu oma POKéMONi eksponeerimisest.

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
en: I bet everyone feels that way when they enter a battle!
et: Vean kihla, et kõik tunnevad nii, kui nad lahingusse astuvad!

label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
en: Show me how to put a little excitement into my life.
et: Näita mulle, kuidas oma ellu veidi elevust tuua.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
en: Oh… My… That was too much excitement.
et: Oh… Heldeke… See oli liiga palju elevust.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
en: My pulse is still racing. You're one fabulous TRAINER.
et: Mu pulss peksleb ikka veel. Sa oled üks vapustav TRAINER.

label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
en: When you're as famished as I am, there is no room for pity!
et: Kui oled sama näljane kui mina, pole ruumi halastusele!

label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
en: Groan…
et: Oiga…

label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
en: My stomach is grumbling! Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…
et: Mu kõht koriseb! Ehk saan mõned BERRY-d grillida…

label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
en: Did you come from MAUVILLE? Then you should be full of energy!
et: Kas tulid MAUVILLEST? Siis pead olema energiat täis!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
en: Ooh lala! That's a lot to take!
et: Ohh lala! Seda on palju võtta!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
en: This road here… You have quite a ways to travel.
et: See tee siin… Sul on omajagu maad rännata.

label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
en: Hahahaha! How about we have a battle? You and me! Hahahaha!
et: Hahahaa! Kuidas oleks, kui peaksime lahingu? Sina ja mina! Hahahaa!

label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
en: I lost! Hahahaha!
et: Ma kaotasin! Hahahaa!

label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
en: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose! Hahahaha-hatchoo!
et: Hahahahaa! Miski lendas mulle ninna! Hahahaa-atšuu!

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
en: My legs are solid from pounding up and down the mountains.
et: Mu jalad on tugevad mägedel üles-alla tampimisest.

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
en: They're not going to buckle easily, friend!
et: Nad ei murdu kergesti, sõber!

label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
en: Ouch! My legs cramped up!
et: Ai! Mu jalgadel läks kramp!

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
en: Try hiking, and I mean really pounding, on these mountain trails with a heavy pack weighing dozens of pounds.
et: Proovi matkata, ja ma mõtlen tõesti tampida, neil mägiradadel raske seljakotiga, mis kaalub kümneid naelu.

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
en: That, my friend, will get your body into serious shape.
et: See, mu sõber, viib su keha tõsisesse vormi.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
en: Ow, my legs have cramped up. Can you grab me some bandages from my backpack?
et: Ai, mu jalgadel läks kramp. Kas sa saaksid mulle mu seljakotist mõned sidemed haarata?

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
en: No, that's my POKéNAV! Oh, fine, I'll register you.
et: Ei, see on mu POKéNAV! Oh, hea küll, ma registreerin sind.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
en: I've been keeping fit by hiking. Power, I have in spades!
et: Ma olen end matkates vormis hoidnud. Jõudu on mul kuhjaga!

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
en: I got trumped in power?
et: Mind trumbati jõus üle?

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
en: I hear there are some seriously tough TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.
et: Ma kuulen, et MT. CHIMNEY tipus on mõned tõesti kõvad TRAINERID.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
en: I intend to get up there and give them a challenge!
et: Ma kavatsen sinna üles jõuda ja neile väljakutse esitada!

label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
en: I'm strong. I won't cry if I lose.
et: Ma olen tugev. Ma ei nuta, kui kaotan.

label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
en: Waaaah!
et: Ojoooo!

label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
en: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy! Snivel…
et: Ma ei nuta sellepärast, et ma emmet igatsen! Nuuks…

label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
en: When you're out on a picnic, why, you simply have to sing! Come on, sing with me!
et: Kui oled piknikul, no sa lihtsalt pead laulma! No kuule, laula minuga!

label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
en: Oh, you're so strong!
et: Oh, sa oled nii tugev!

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
en: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing or POKéMON.
et: Pole vahet, kas oled hea või halb laulmises või POKéMONides.

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
en: If you have the most fun, you win!
et: Kui sul on kõige lõbusam, sa võidad!

label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
en: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH! Take a look!
et: Ma püüdsin FIERY PATHIS tulikuumad POKéMONid! Vaata!

label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
en: What a bumpy ride that was!
et: Milline konarlik sõit see oli!

label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
en: I like the way you battle. It has a certain flair to it.
et: Mulle meeldib, kuidas sa võitled. Selles on teatud hõngu.

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
en: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER! Please, I need a romantic battle! I'm somewhat decent!
et: Oh, kas sa polegi armas TRAINER! Palun, ma vajan romantilist lahingut! Ma olen üsna korralik!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
en: Oh, how strong you are! You've given me quite a shock!
et: Oh, kui tugev sa oled! Sa oled mind päris ära vapustanud!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
en: Are you busy right now? I was thinking that maybe we can have a rematch right now… But it's all right if you're busy.
et: Kas sul on praegu kiire? Ma mõtlesin, et ehk saame kohe revanši pidada… Aga pole viga, kui sul on kiire.

label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
en: Can you guess why it's so cool around here?
et: Kas oskad arvata, miks siin kandis nii jahe on?

label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
en: Peeuuw! That stinks!
et: Ptüi! See haiseb!

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
en: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it doesn't get very warm.
et: Vulkaanituhk varjab päikest, nii et eriti soojaks ei lähe.

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
en: That's good for me--I can't stand heat!
et: See on minu jaoks hea – ma ei talu kuumust!

label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
en: The volcano's eruption is proof that the earth is alive.
et: Vulkaani purse on tõestus, et maa on elus.

label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
en: You're some kind of strong!
et: Sa oled mingit sorti tugev!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Ouch! Owww! I can't see! I got ashes in my eyelashes!
et: Ai! Auu! Ma ei näe! Mulle sai tuhka ripsmetesse!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Get it? Ashes and eyelashes?
et: Saad aru? Tuhk ja ripsmed?

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Okay, that was bad, sorry…
et: Olgu, see oli halb, vabandust…

label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
en: I use this parasol to ward off this filthy, yucky volcanic ash from my dear NUMEL.
et: Ma kasutan seda päikesevarju, et tõrjuda seda räpast, vastikut vulkaanituhka oma kallilt NUMELILT.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
en: Huff, huff… I am exhausted…
et: Ähh, ähh… Ma olen kurnatud…

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
en: You're very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
et: Sa oled selles väga hea. Ma pean ütlema, et olen muljet avaldatud!

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
en: Here, slide under my parasol. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Siin, libise mu päikesevarju alla. Lase mul sind oma POKéNAVi registreerida.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
en: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while? May I invite you to battle?
et: Oh, tere, kas pole tükk aega möödas? Kas tohin sind lahingule kutsuda?

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
en: Oh, how super!
et: Oh, kui super!

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
en: You've remained very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
et: Sa oled selles väga heaks jäänud. Ma pean ütlema, et olen muljet avaldatud!

label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
en: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
et: Tuhast ma hüppan! Hijaa! Ma esitan sulle väljakutse!

label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
en: With honor I admit defeat!
et: Auga tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
en: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
et: Ma pean lihvima peitmise kunsti. Ma jätan sinuga hüvasti.

label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
en: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja technique of POKéNAV registration!
et: Jiiijaah! Ole tunnistajaks muistsele nindža-tehnikale POKéNAVi registreerimisel!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
en: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
et: Tuhast ma hüppan! Hijaa! Ma esitan sulle väljakutse!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
en: With honor I admit defeat!
et: Auga tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
en: My flawless concealment was let down by my immature battle skills…
et: Mu laitmatu peitumine sai lüüa mu ebaküpse lahinguoskuse tõttu…

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
en: I bid thee farewell.
et: Ma jätan sinuga hüvasti.

label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
en: Thanks for finding me! But we still have to battle!
et: Aitäh, et mind leidsid! Aga me peame ikka võitlema!

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
en: I'll use my ninjutsu on you… “VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!
et: Ma kasutan sinu peal oma nindžutsut… „VULKAANITUHA KEERIS-KEEP”!

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
en: …What? It's already over?
et: …Mida? Kas juba läbi?

label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
en: You know what's crummy about hiding? It's lonely if no one comes along.
et: Kas tead, mis on peitmise juures vilets? On üksildane, kui keegi ei tule.

label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
en: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.
et: TORI: Me mõlemad kogume tuhka. Me võitleme ka POKéMONidega.

label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
en: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going to get some more ashes.
et: TORI: Me kaotasime… On igav, nii et ma lähen hangin veel tuhka.

label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
en: TORI: How much ash do we have? Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.
et: TORI: Kui palju tuhka meil on? Piisavalt WHITE FLUTE'i jaoks, ma loodan.

label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
en: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we didn't, we would lose!
et: TORI: Me tahame võidelda 2-vastu-2. Kui me ei teeks, me kaotaksime!

label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
en: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.
et: TIA: Me mõlemad kogume tuhka. Me võitleme ka POKéMONidega.

label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
en: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring, so I'm getting some more ashes.
et: TIA: Me ei suutnud võita… On igav, nii et ma hangin veel tuhka.

label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
en: TIA: We have a lot of ashes! I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!
et: TIA: Meil on palju tuhka! Ma arvan, et piisavalt WHITE FLUTE'i jaoks!

label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
en: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we don't, we won't win!
et: TIA: Me tahame võidelda 2-vastu-2. Kui me ei tee, siis me ei võida!

label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
en: Pfft, with these wings I can flick you away!
et: Pff, nende tiibadega ma pühin su minema!

label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
en: A… What?
et: Üks… Mida?

label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
en: I don't know what to say when I get beaten so easily…
et: Ma ei tea, mida öelda, kui mind nii kergesti võidetakse…

label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
en: The warmth here is making me drowsy. Battle with me so I can stay awake.
et: Siinne soojus teeb mind uniseks. Võitle minuga, et ma ärkvel püsiksin.

label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
en: This is a dream. I'm sure of it…
et: See on unenägu. Ma olen selles kindel…

label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
en: Losing burns me up… I'm just going to sleep right here! Zzz!
et: Kaotamine ajab mind marru… Ma lähen lihtsalt siinsamas magama! Zzz!

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
en: Were you maybe in the middle of gathering volcanic ashes?
et: Kas sa olid ehk keset vulkaanituha kogumist?

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
en: Ehehe. We got beaten cleanly.
et: Ehehe. Meid võideti puhtalt.

label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
en: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.
et: Ma peaksin ka tuha alla peitu pugema.

label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
en: Y-you want to battle with me? Even though I just caught my POKéMON?
et: S-sa tahad minuga võidelda? Kuigi ma just püüdsin oma POKéMONi?

label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
en: Y-you're all happy to win? Even though it's only me?
et: S-sul on hea meel võita? Kuigi see on ainult mina?

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
en: Oh, so now you want to say a word to the loser?
et: Oh, nii et nüüd sa tahad kaotajale sõna öelda?

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
en: Aren't you just the coolest? Humph!
et: Kas sa polegi kõige lahedam? Hmpf!

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
en: Yodelayhihoo!
et: Jodelaihihuu!

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
en: You're supposed to shout “yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't echo here!
et: Sa pead hüüdma „jodelaihihuu”, sest siin ei kaja!

label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
en: Yodelayhihoo!
et: Jodelaihihuu!

label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
en: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there was someone copying me and shouting back, “Yodelayhihoo.”
et: Kui ma väike põnn olin, uskusin ma, et keegi matkib mind ja karjub vastu: „Jodelaihihuu.”

label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
en: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't be up in the mountains!
et: Kui sa pole valmis, ei tohiks sa mägedes olla!

label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
en: The mountains are unforgiving…
et: Mäed on andestamatud…

label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
en: In the winter, mountains turn deadly with blizzards and avalanches.
et: Talvel muutuvad mäed surmavaks lumetormide ja laviinidega.

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
en: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast marshmallows, and tell spooky stories!
et: Telkimine on lõbus! Sa saad kalastada, vahukomme röstida ja jubedaid lugusid rääkida!

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
en: But the best of all are the POKéMON battles!
et: Aga kõige parimad on POKéMON-lahingud!

label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
en: Way too strong!
et: Palju liiga tugev!

label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
en: I think it's great that I can go camping with my POKéMON.
et: Ma arvan, et on suurepärane, et ma saan oma POKéMONidega telkima minna.

label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
en: I need to exercise after a meal. Let's have a match!
et: Ma pean pärast einet trenni tegema. Peame matši!

label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
en: Oh, no!
et: Oh, ei!

label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
en: I just had a tasty meal. I'm getting drowsy…
et: Ma just sõin maitsva eine. Ma lähen uniseks…

label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
en: Ufufufufufu… Want to battle against my POKéMON?
et: Ufufufufufu… Tahad võidelda mu POKéMONi vastu?

label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
en: M-My POKéMON…
et: M-mu POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
en: A big body that's all lumpy and hard, enormous horns, and vicious fangs…
et: Suur keha, mis on üleni muhklik ja kõva, tohutud sarved ja õelad kihvad…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
en: Ufufufufu… I wish I had a POKéMON like that…
et: Ufufufufu… Ma sooviksin, et mul oleks selline POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
en: Don't forget what you've done to me! I'll make it so you can't forget!
et: Ära unusta, mida sa mulle teinud oled! Ma teen nii, et sa ei saa unustada!

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
en: Ufufufufufu… Come on, battle my POKéMON…
et: Ufufufufufu… No kuule, võitle mu POKéMONiga…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
en: I feel so lucky getting to see your POKéMON…
et: Ma tunnen end nii õnnelikuna, saades näha su POKéMONi…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
en: Ufufufufufu…
et: Ufufufufufu…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
en: When I see POKéMON battling, I get all shivery and shaky…
et: Kui ma näen POKéMONe võitlemas, lähen ma üleni värisema ja judisema…

label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
en: If you're lighting a campfire, make sure you have water handy.
et: Kui teed lõkketuld, veendu, et sul oleks vesi käepärast.

label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
en: Thanks for dousing my fire!
et: Aitäh, et mu tule kustutasid!

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
en: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.
et: Sa pead tõesti olema ettevaatlik igasuguse tulega metsas.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
en: Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
et: Ära kunagi alahinda tule jõudu.

label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
en: You set my spirit on fire. Let's register each other!
et: Sa süütasid mu hinge põlema. Registreerigem teineteise!

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
en: Have you learned to keep water handy for campfires?
et: Kas oled õppinud hoidma vett käepärast lõkkete jaoks?

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
en: I got hosed down before I could flare up, I guess.
et: Mind kasteti maha, enne kui ma lõkkele lüüa jõudsin, ma vist.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
en: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.
et: Sa pead tõesti olema ettevaatlik igasuguse tulega metsas.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
en: Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
et: Ära kunagi alahinda tule jõudu.

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
en: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand a chance against me. So, bring on your POKéMON!
et: Kui me kalastaksime, poleks sul minu vastu mingit šanssi. Nii et too oma POKéMONid!

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
en: If we were fishing, I would've won…
et: Kui me kalastaksime, ma oleksin võitnud…

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
en: I think I'll try my luck at landing a big one at METEOR FALLS.
et: Ma vist proovin õnne suure kala püüdmisega METEOR FALLSIS.

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
en: There has to be something in there. I just know it.
et: Seal peab midagi olema. Ma lihtsalt tean seda.

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
en: I like to fish. But I also like to battle!
et: Mulle meeldib kalastada. Aga mulle meeldib ka võidelda!

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
en: If anyone challenges me, I'm there, even if I'm fishing.
et: Kui keegi mulle väljakutse esitab, olen ma kohal, isegi kui ma kalastan.

label: Route114_Text_NolanDefeat
en: I like to battle, but that doesn't mean I'm good at it…
et: Mulle meeldib võidelda, aga see ei tähenda, et olen selles hea…

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
en: This time I'll do it!
et: Seekord ma teen ära!

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
en: I always think that, so I can't walk away from fishing or POKéMON.
et: Ma mõtlen alati nii, nii et ma ei suuda kalastamisest ega POKéMONidest eemale kõndida.

label: Route114_Text_TyraIntro
en: TYRA: Well, sure. I'm in the mood for it. I'll teach you a little about POKéMON.
et: TYRA: Noh, muidugi. Mul on tuju. Ma õpetan sulle veidi POKéMONidest.

label: Route114_Text_TyraDefeat
en: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!
et: TYRA: Milline hämmastav võitlusstiil!

label: Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle
en: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY about POKéMON.
et: TYRA: Ma õpetasin oma noorematele IVYLE POKéMONidest.

label: Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
en: TYRA: Giggle… If you want to battle with us, just one POKéMON isn't enough!
et: TYRA: Kihi… Kui tahad meiega võidelda, ei piisa vaid ühest POKéMONist!

label: Route114_Text_IvyIntro
en: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?
et: IVY: Kes õpetas sulle POKéMONidest?

label: Route114_Text_IvyDefeat
en: IVY: What an amazing battle style!
et: IVY: Milline hämmastav võitlusstiil!

label: Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle
en: IVY: I started training POKéMON because TYRA, my student mentor, taught me!
et: IVY: Ma hakkasin POKéMONe treenima, sest TYRA, mu õpilasjuhendaja, õpetas mind!

label: Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons
en: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON? I think it must feel lonesome.
et: IVY: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Ma arvan, et tal peab olema üksildane.

label: Route114_Text_KaiIntro
en: I landed a big one! A huge one, I tell you!
et: Ma püüdsin suure! Tohutu, ma ütlen sulle!

label: Route114_Text_KaiDefeat
en: What was that about? Did mine lose in size?
et: Millest see oli? Kas minu oma kaotas suuruses?

label: Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle
en: Okay! I'll just fish me a bigger one!
et: Olgu! Ma püüan endale lihtsalt suurema!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro
en: Me! I'm not just a pretty face!
et: Mina! Ma pole lihtsalt kena nägu!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat
en: That wasn't cute in the least!
et: See polnud vähimalgi määral armas!

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
en: I don't want a POKéMON that's just cute.
et: Ma ei taha POKéMONi, kes on lihtsalt armas.

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
en: I adore cute ones that have a quirk or two!
et: Ma jumaldan armsaid, kellel on üks-kaks veidrust!

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro
en: Have you made your POKéMON evolve very much?
et: Kas oled oma POKéMONe palju arenema pannud?

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat
en: Oh, I see. That's good to know.
et: Oh, ma näen. Seda on hea teada.

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle
en: Some POKéMON change so much when they evolve, it's startling!
et: Mõned POKéMONid muutuvad arenedes nii palju, et see on jahmatav!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyIntro
en: Hm… You seem rather capable… Let me keep you company!
et: Hm… Sa näid päris võimekas olevat… Lase mul sulle seltsi hoida!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
en: You're much stronger than I'd imagined!
et: Sa oled palju tugevam, kui ma ette kujutasin!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle
en: There is no such thing as a born genius. It all depends on effort! That is what I believe…
et: Sellist asja nagu sündinud geenius pole olemas. Kõik sõltub vaevast! Seda ma usun…

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
en: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been a distant memory.
et: Hmm… Nii põhjalik kaotus on olnud kauge mälestus.

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
en: If you would allow it, I wish for another opportunity to do battle.
et: Kui sa lubaksid, ma sooviksin veel üht võimalust võidelda.

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro
en: Hm… As always, your agility speaks for itself. Come, keep me company!
et: Hm… Nagu ikka, su väledus räägib enda eest. Tule, hoia mulle seltsi!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchDefeat
en: As strong as ever!
et: Sama tugev kui alati!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
en: All it takes is effort!
et: Kõik, mida on vaja, on vaeva!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
en: I lost because I haven't put in enough effort!
et: Ma kaotasin, sest ma pole piisavalt vaeva näinud!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: You!
et: Sina!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: My MACHOP!
et: Mu MACHOP!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: Demand a battle!
et: Nõua lahingut!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiDefeat
en: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
et: Ai, ai, ai!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
en: My MACHOP crew!
et: Mu MACHOP-kamp!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
en: So long as they seek power, I will grow strong with them!
et: Niikaua kui nad jõudu otsivad, saan ma nendega koos tugevaks!

label: Route115_Text_NobIntro
en: My strongest skill is busting bricks with my forehead!
et: Mu tugevaim oskus on telliste lõhkumine oma otsaesisega!

label: Route115_Text_NobDefeat
en: Ugwaaaah! My head is busted!
et: Ugvaaaah! Mu pea on lõhki!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
en: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.
et: Ma olen oma POKéMONidele karatet õpetanud.

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
en: It looks like they'll get a lot better than me. I'm excited about that.
et: Näib, et nad saavad minust palju paremaks. Ma olen selle üle põnevil.

label: Route115_Text_NobRegister
en: You impress me! Give me a rematch after I redo my training!
et: Sa avaldad mulle muljet! Anna mulle revanš pärast seda, kui oma treeningu uuesti läbi teen!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro
en: After you beat me, we trained hard to improve our skills. Come on, give us a rematch!
et: Pärast seda, kui sa mind võitsid, treenisime me kõvasti oma oskusi parandades. No kuule, anna meile revanš!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchDefeat
en: Ugwaaah! We lost again!
et: Ugvaaah! Me kaotasime jälle!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostRematch
en: My POKéMON will grow stronger! I'll redouble my training!
et: Mu POKéMON saab tugevamaks! Ma kahekordistan oma treeningut!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyIntro
en: This beach is my secret training spot! Don't come butting in!
et: See rand on mu salajane treeningpaik! Ära tule vahele trügima!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyDefeat
en: I haven't trained enough!
et: Ma pole piisavalt treeninud!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle
en: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce impact and prevent injury. This is the perfect place to train.
et: Liiv toimib padjana, et vähendada põrutust ja vältida vigastusi. See on ideaalne koht treenimiseks.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRegister
en: Okay, fine, you're free to come here. In return, I'd like to battle you again.
et: Olgu, hea küll, sa võid vabalt siia tulla. Vastutasuks tahaksin sinuga jälle võidelda.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
en: Okay, let's get this battle on!
et: Olgu, alustagem seda lahingut!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat
en: I can battle but my POKéMON…
et: Ma oskan võidelda, aga mu POKéMON…

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch
en: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it. It must be that I love POKéMON.
et: Isegi kui ma kaotan, saan ma sellest ikka veidi naudingut. See peab olema, et ma armastan POKéMONe.

label: Route115_Text_HectorIntro
en: I have a rare POKéMON! Would you like me to show you?
et: Mul on haruldane POKéMON! Kas sooviksid, et ma sulle näitaksin?

label: Route115_Text_HectorDefeat
en: You… You want my POKéMON, don't you?
et: Sina… Sa tahad mu POKéMONi, kas pole?

label: Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle
en: I have this rare POKéMON. It's enough to keep me satisfied.
et: Mul on see haruldane POKéMON. Sellest piisab mulle rahulolu jaoks.

label: Route115_Text_KyraIntro
en: I'll battle while I'm running! Try to keep up with me!
et: Ma võitlen, kui ma jooksen! Püüa minuga sammu pidada!

label: Route115_Text_KyraDefeat
en: Gasp, gasp…
et: Ähh, ähh…

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
en: I made the mistake of trying to battle while running!
et: Ma tegin vea, üritades joostes võidelda!

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
en: I should take a run to calm down…
et: Ma peaksin jooksma minema, et maha rahuneda…

label: Route115_Text_JaidenIntro
en: Take that! Ultra POKéMON ninja attack!
et: Võta seda! Ultra POKéMONi nindža-rünnak!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenDefeat
en: Waaah! Our strategy failed!
et: Vaaah! Meie strateegia vedas alt!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle
en: But my POKéMON were ultra, weren't they?
et: Aga mu POKéMONid olid ultra, kas polnud?

label: Route115_Text_HeleneIntro
en: My POKéMON have black belt-level strength!
et: Mu POKéMONidel on musta vöö tasemel jõud!

label: Route115_Text_HeleneDefeat
en: This is too humiliating!
et: See on liiga alandav!

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
en: I rarely meet anyone who's better than me…
et: Ma kohtan harva kedagi, kes on minust parem…

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
en: I get it now! You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?
et: Ma saan nüüd aru! Sa oled SAALI JUHT, kas pole?

label: Route115_Text_AlixIntro
en: Our eyes met! There's no getting away now!
et: Meie pilgud kohtusid! Nüüd pole enam pääsu!

label: Route115_Text_AlixDefeat
en: Gah! Not bad!
et: Gah! Pole paha!

label: Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle
en: Oh, well. I think I will TELEPORT home.
et: Oh, hea küll. Ma vist TELEPORTin koju.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneIntro
en: You've disturbed my meditation… You'll be punished for it.
et: Sa oled häirinud mu meditatsiooni… Sind karistatakse selle eest.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneDefeat
en: You've broken my concentration!
et: Sa oled mu keskendumise katkestanud!

label: Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle
en: I was meditating with my POKéMON. But this place isn't very peaceful…
et: Ma mediteerisin oma POKéMONiga. Aga see koht pole eriti rahulik…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkIntro
en: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then I'll just go over the top.
et: Kui tunnel läbi ei lähe, siis ma lihtsalt lähen üle tipu.

label: Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat
en: Gasp… Gasp… Losing made me tired…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Kaotamine tegi mind väsinuks…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle
en: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel. To a HIKER, mountains are roads!
et: Pole midagi hullu, kui tunnelit pole. MATKAJALE on mäed teed!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyIntro
en: My POKéMON rule! Check them out!
et: Mu POKéMONid on parimad! Vaata neid!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat
en: Ouch! A scrape! I have to put on a bandage!
et: Ai! Marraskil! Ma pean sideme peale panema!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle
en: Bandages are signs of toughness! I've got another one!
et: Sidemed on kõvaduse märgid! Mul on veel üks!

label: Route116_Text_JoseIntro
en: My BUG POKéMON are tough! Let's battle!
et: Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid on kõvad! Võitleme!

label: Route116_Text_JoseDefeat
en: I lost! I thought I had you!
et: Ma kaotasin! Ma arvasin, et sa oled käes!

label: Route116_Text_JosePostBattle
en: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. So they get strong quickly, too.
et: PUTUKA-POKéMONid arenevad kiiresti. Nii saavad nad ka kiiresti tugevaks.

label: Route116_Text_JaniceIntro
en: Let me teach you how strong my adorable POKéMON is!
et: Lase mul õpetada sulle, kui tugev mu armas POKéMON on!

label: Route116_Text_JaniceDefeat
en: You're a notch above me…
et: Sa oled minust astme võrra üle…

label: Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle
en: POKéMON that possess cuteness and power, that's ideal, I think.
et: POKéMONid, kel on armsus ja jõud, see on ideaalne, ma arvan.

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
en: We learn all sorts of things at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
et: Me õpime TRAINERI KOOLIS igasuguseid asju.

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
en: I want to test things out for real!
et: Ma tahan asju päriselt katsetada!

label: Route116_Text_JerryDefeat
en: I slacked off in school… That's why I lost.
et: Ma logelesin koolis… Just seepärast ma kaotasin.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle
en: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
et: Ma pean TRAINERI KOOLIS mõned kursused uuesti läbi tegema. Kui ma ei tee, on ROXANNE vihane.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
en: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.
et: Ma õppisin TRAINERI KOOLIS, et POKéNAV saab TRAINEREID registreerida.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
en: I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
et: Ma päris ei saa aru, mida see tähendab, nii et kas ma võin seda lihtsalt proovida?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
en: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.
et: Ma õppisin TRAINERI KOOLIS, et POKéNAV saab TRAINEREID registreerida.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
en: I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
et: Ma päris ei saa aru, mida see tähendab, nii et kas ma võin seda lihtsalt proovida?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro
en: I've been studying seriously at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. I won't lose like I did last time.
et: Ma olen TRAINERI KOOLIS tõsiselt õppinud. Ma ei kaota nagu eelmisel korral.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchDefeat
en: Hunh? I studied diligently.
et: Häh? Ma õppisin usinasti.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch
en: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
et: Ma pean TRAINERI KOOLIS mõned kursused uuesti läbi tegema. Kui ma ei tee, on ROXANNE vihane.

label: Route116_Text_KarenIntro
en: I study at school, and I study on the way home, too!
et: Ma õpin koolis ja ma õpin ka teel koju!

label: Route116_Text_KarenDefeat
en: I'm in shock--I lost?
et: Ma olen šokis – ma kaotasin?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle
en: Awww, I'll never become an elegant TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
et: Ohh, ma ei saa niimoodi kunagi elegantseks TRAINERIKS nagu ROXANNE!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister1
en: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
et: Oh, ohoo! Kas pole see POKéNAV? Mul on ka! Palun registreeri mind!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister2
en: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
et: Oh, ohoo! Kas pole see POKéNAV? Mul on ka! Palun registreeri mind!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro
en: I studied a whole lot since I saw you. You must see my achievements!
et: Ma õppisin terve hulga, kuna ma sind nägin. Sa pead nägema mu saavutusi!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat
en: I'm in shock. I lost again?
et: Ma olen šokis. Ma kaotasin jälle?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch
en: You've beaten ROXANNE? I can't beat you, then. Not yet.
et: Sa oled ROXANNE võitnud? Siis ma ei suuda sind võita. Veel mitte.

label: Route116_Text_SarahIntro
en: Just so you know, I've never once been bested by anyone at anything.
et: Igaks juhuks tead, mind pole kordagi keegi milleski ületanud.

label: Route116_Text_SarahDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. This is a new experience for me.
et: Oh, heldeke. See on mulle uus kogemus.

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
en: My life of luxury affords me all that I could possibly desire.
et: Mu luksuselu võimaldab mulle kõik, mida ma iial soovida saan.

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
en: However, when it comes to POKéMON, my wealth has no meaning.
et: Ent kui asi puudutab POKéMONe, pole mu rikkusel mingit tähendust.

label: Route116_Text_DawsonIntro
en: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's gorgeous fur, their beauty will render you helpless!
et: Kui su silmad langevad mu POKéMONide toredale karvale, teeb nende ilu su abituks!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat
en: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!
et: Oh, kullake, ütle, et see pole nii!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle
en: Oh, no, no, no! You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur! You've ruined my hairdo, too! I'll have to call my stylist now!
et: Oh, ei, ei, ei! Sa sassisid mu POKéMONi karva! Sa rikkusid ka mu soengu! Ma pean nüüd oma stilisti kutsuma!

label: Route116_Text_DevanIntro
en: We'll rock you hard!
et: Me raputame sind kõvasti!

label: Route116_Text_DevanDefeat
en: Aiyiyi! No contest at all!
et: Aijaij! Üldse mitte mingi konkurents!

label: Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle
en: I should try different POKéMON types, that's what I ought to do.
et: Ma peaksin proovima erinevaid POKéMONi tüüpe, seda ma peaksingi tegema.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro
en: It's a dead end up here. I'm bored, so can we battle?
et: Siin üleval on ummiktee. Mul on igav, nii et kas võitleme?

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat
en: That was fun even though I lost.
et: See oli lõbus, kuigi ma kaotasin.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
en: Want to stay here and keep me company?
et: Tahad siia jääda ja mulle seltsi hoida?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacIntro
en: Listen, could I get you to battle the POKéMON I'm raising?
et: Kuula, kas saaksin panna sind võitlema POKéMONidega, keda ma kasvatan?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacDefeat
en: You've raised yours superbly…
et: Sa oled oma omad suurepäraselt kasvatanud…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
en: POKéMON isn't all about power.
et: POKéMONid pole ainult jõu asi.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
en: Polishing a unique aspect of one's character is another way of enjoying POKéMON.
et: Oma iseloomu ainulaadse külje lihvimine on veel üks viis POKéMONide nautimiseks.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRegister
en: I'm going to redouble my training. Would you come look in on us?
et: Ma kavatsen oma treeningut kahekordistada. Kas tuleksid meid vaatama?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
en: The POKéMON I've been raising are looking good, just like before.
et: POKéMONid, keda ma kasvatanud olen, näevad head välja, just nagu enne.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat
en: You know how to raise them properly. You might have DAY CARE skills…
et: Sa oskad neid õigesti kasvatada. Sul võivad olla PÄEVAHOIU oskused…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch
en: Your POKéMON are growing good! You should enter them in CONTESTS.
et: Su POKéMONid kasvavad hästi! Sa peaksid panema nad KONKURSSIDELE.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaIntro
en: Please, allow me to evaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.
et: Palun luba mul hinnata, kas oled oma POKéMONe õigesti kasvatanud.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaDefeat
en: Yes, they are growing properly.
et: Jah, nad kasvavad õigesti.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle
en: Try raising POKéMON with more attention to their character traits.
et: Proovi kasvatada POKéMONe rohkema tähelepanuga nende iseloomuomadustele.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRegister
en: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you. I hope to see you again.
et: Mul on hea meel, et kohtasin sinus suurepärast TRAINERit. Ma loodan sind jälle näha.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro
en: Allow me to reevaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.
et: Luba mul uuesti hinnata, kas oled oma POKéMONe õigesti kasvatanud.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchDefeat
en: They are growing admirably.
et: Nad kasvavad imetlusväärselt.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
en: POKéMON seem to like different kinds of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.
et: Näib, et POKéMONidele meeldivad erinevad {POKEBLOCK}id, sõltuvalt nende loomusest.

label: Route117_Text_DylanIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, whatever, let's have a battle!
et: Ma olen keset triatloni, aga, ükskõik, peame lahingu!

label: Route117_Text_DylanDefeat
en: I ran out of energy!
et: Mul sai energia otsa!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
en: I may have blown it…
et: Ma võisin selle untsu ajada…

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
en: I might have dropped to last during that battle…
et: Ma võisin selle lahingu ajal viimaseks langeda…

label: Route117_Text_DylanRegister
en: POKéMON have to be strong, too? I'd like you to train me!
et: POKéMONid peavad ka tugevad olema? Ma tahaksin, et sa mind treeniksid!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro
en: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm comfortably ahead. Let's make this a quick battle!
et: Ma olen keset triatloni, aga ma olen mugavalt ees. Peame sellest kiire lahingu!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat
en: I ran out of energy again!
et: Mul sai jälle energia otsa!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch
en: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but I'm not quite that confident with POKéMON yet.
et: Ma olin ujumises ja rattasõidus tipus, aga POKéMONide osas pole ma veel päris nii kindel.

label: Route117_Text_MariaIntro
en: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON, so I'm pretty confident about my speed.
et: Ma teen oma triatloni treeningut POKéMONidega, nii et olen oma kiiruses üsna kindel.

label: Route117_Text_MariaDefeat
en: I need to get more practices in, I guess.
et: Ma pean vist rohkem harjutama.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
en: Training is meaningful only if you keep it up regularly.
et: Treening on tähendusrikas ainult siis, kui seda regulaarselt jätkad.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
en: Okay! I'll resume my training! Tomorrow!
et: Olgu! Ma jätkan oma treeningut! Homme!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRegister
en: You appear to be training properly… If you'd like, I'll battle you later!
et: Näib, et sa treenid õigesti… Kui soovid, ma võitlen sinuga hiljem!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro
en: Are you keeping up with your training? I sure am! Let me show you the evidence!
et: Kas pead treeninguga järge? Mina küll! Lase mul näidata tõestust!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat
en: I need to get more practices in, I guess.
et: Ma pean vist rohkem harjutama.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch
en: I'll resume training tomorrow. Let's battle again sometime!
et: Ma jätkan homme treeningut. Võitleme kunagi jälle!

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
en: Once a BUG CATCHER! And now a BUG MANIAC!
et: Kunagine PUTUKAPÜÜDJA! Ja nüüd PUTUKAMAANIK!

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
en: But my love for POKéMON remains unchanged!
et: Aga mu armastus POKéMONide vastu jääb muutumatuks!

label: Route117_Text_DerekDefeat
en: My ineptitude also remains unchanged…
et: Mu saamatus jääb samuti muutumatuks…

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
en: All I did was follow my heart, and now they call me a BUG MANIAC…
et: Ma tegin vaid seda, mida süda käskis, ja nüüd nad kutsuvad mind PUTUKAMAANIKUKS…

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
en: Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON, so it's only natural that they call me a BUG MANIAC.
et: Ometi olen ma PUTUKA-POKéMONide ekspert, nii et on loomulik, et nad kutsuvad mind PUTUKAMAANIKUKS.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaIntro
en: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner. I have to do good!
et: ANNA: Ma olen oma kena noorema õpilaspartneriga. Ma pean hästi läbi lööma!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat
en: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner! Let me win!
et: ANNA: Ma olen oma kena noorema õpilaspartneriga! Lase mul võita!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
en: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.
et: ANNA: Su POKéMONidel on mõned head kombinatsioonid.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
en: I'd say you're second only to us!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa jääd alla ainult meile!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister
en: ANNA: We can't take this lying down! You will come back, won't you?
et: ANNA: Me ei lepi sellega niisama! Sa tuled ju tagasi, kas pole?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons
en: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.
et: ANNA: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, too kaks POKéMONi kaasa.

label: Route117_Text_MegIntro
en: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super senior student partner and beat you!
et: MEG: Ma löön käed kokku oma superkõrgema õpilaspartneriga ja võidan sind!

label: Route117_Text_MegDefeat
en: MEG: Oh, no! I'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…
et: MEG: Oh, ei! Vabandust, ANNA! Ma vedasin sind alt…

label: Route117_Text_MegPostBattle
en: MEG: I dragged ANNA down… If I didn't, she would have won!
et: MEG: Ma vedasin ANNA alla… Kui ma poleks, oleks ta võitnud!

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
en: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then.
et: MEG: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me ei saa sinuga võidelda.

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
en: We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
et: Me tahame pidada 2-vastu-2 lahingu.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro
en: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of my junior partner, right?
et: ANNA: Ma ei saa oma noorema partneri ees aina kaotada, eks?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat
en: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.
et: ANNA: Ma ei saanud hoogu sisse.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
en: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.
et: ANNA: Su POKéMONidel on mõned head kombinatsioonid.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
en: I'd say you're second only to us!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa jääd alla ainult meile!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons
en: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.
et: ANNA: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, too kaks POKéMONi kaasa.

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro
en: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my senior partner and win this time!
et: MEG: Ma löön käed kokku oma vanema partneriga ja võidan seekord!

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchDefeat
en: MEG: Too strong!
et: MEG: Liiga tugev!

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
en: MEG: I battled together with my senior partner, but we lost…
et: MEG: Ma võitlesin koos oma vanema partneriga, aga me kaotasime…

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
en: That's so discouraging…
et: See on nii heidutav…

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
en: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then.
et: MEG: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me ei saa sinuga võidelda.

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
en: We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
et: Me tahame pidada 2-vastu-2 lahingu.

label: Route117_Text_MelinaIntro
en: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking at pretty flowers?
et: Kas pole tore? Võidelda, vaadates samal ajal ilusaid lilli?

label: Route117_Text_MelinaDefeat
en: Oh, that's quite impressive!
et: Oh, see on päris muljetavaldav!

label: Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle
en: It feels wonderful to go for a jog while looking at flowers.
et: On imeline tunne sörkida, vaadates samal ajal lilli.

label: Route117_Text_BrandiIntro
en: Let me demonstrate the power hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!
et: Lase mul demonstreerida jõudu, mis on peidus PSÜÜHILISES POKéMONis!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiDefeat
en: Astonishing!
et: Hämmastav!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle
en: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex. You should try catching some.
et: PSÜÜHILISED POKéMONid on keerulised. Sa peaksid proovima mõne püüda.

label: Route117_Text_AishaIntro
en: Concentrate on getting the win. That's how I battle!
et: Keskendu võidu saamisele. Nii ma võitlen!

label: Route117_Text_AishaDefeat
en: I don't waste any time being angry over a loss--I would rather train.
et: Ma ei raiska aega kaotuse pärast vihastades – ma pigem treeniks.

label: Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle
en: I think that if you worry about losing, you're more likely to lose.
et: Ma arvan, et kui muretsed kaotamise pärast, on suurem tõenäosus, et kaotad.

label: Route118_Text_RoseIntro
en: The aroma of flowers has a magical power. It cleanses us body and soul.
et: Lillede aroomil on maagiline jõud. See puhastab meid keha ja hinge poolest.

label: Route118_Text_RoseDefeat
en: Oh, dear me. I seem to have lost.
et: Oh, heldeke. Näib, et ma kaotasin.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
en: Flowers, POKéMON… I love whatever smells nice.
et: Lilled, POKéMONid… Ma armastan kõike, mis hästi lõhnab.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
en: Stinky things… I'll pass.
et: Haisvad asjad… Ma jätan vahele.

label: Route118_Text_RoseRegister
en: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV! We must register each other!
et: Nuhh… See lõhn – see on POKéNAV! Me peame teineteise registreerima!

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro
en: Were you drawn here by the sweet aroma?
et: Kas sind tõmbas siia magus aroom?

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat
en: The power of aroma… It didn't seem to do much.
et: Aroomi jõud… Näis, et see ei teinud eriti midagi.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostRematch
en: If you use a sweet aroma properly, POKéMON will be attracted by it.
et: Kui kasutad magusat aroomi õigesti, tõmbab see POKéMONe ligi.

label: Route118_Text_PerryIntro
en: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in the sky… They're the best!
et: LINNU-POKéMONid, kes LENDAVAD taevas elegantselt… Nad on parimad!

label: Route118_Text_PerryDefeat
en: Urgh… I crashed…
et: Urgh… Ma kukkusin…

label: Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle
en: You've got great POKéMON. I'll have to train mine better.
et: Sul on suurepärased POKéMONid. Ma pean oma omi paremini treenima.

label: Route118_Text_ChesterIntro
en: Take flight! My BIRD POKéMON!
et: Tõuse õhku! Mu LINNU-POKéMON!

label: Route118_Text_ChesterDefeat
en: They did take flight…
et: Nad tõusid küll õhku…

label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
en: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able to fly more freely…
et: Kui nad tugevamaks saaksid, suudaksid nad vabamalt lennata…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
en: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER. I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.
et: Ma olen KALUR, aga ka TRAINER. Ma kasvatan POKéMONe, keda püüdsin.

label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
en: I thought I was doing okay in my training…
et: Ma arvasin, et mul läheb treeningus okei…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
en: I couldn't win by training POKéMON while I fished…
et: Ma ei suutnud võita, kasvatades POKéMONe kalastades…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
en: Was I doing things in half measures?
et: Kas ma tegin asju poole vinnaga?

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
en: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.
et: KALURITE jaoks on varustus võtmetähtsusega.

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
en: But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients are POKéMON and heart, of course!
et: Aga TRAINERITE jaoks on võtmekoostisosad muidugi POKéMONid ja süda!

label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
en: I was beaten in heart?
et: Mind võideti südames?

label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
en: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.
et: Kui järele mõelda, on kalastamine lahing KALURI ja POKéMONi vahel.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
en: Let my melody rock your soul!
et: Las mu meloodia raputab su hinge!

label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
en: La-lalala…
et: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
en: An electric guitar doesn't always have to be noisy…
et: Elektrikitarr ei pea alati lärmakas olema…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
en: It can be strummed to squeeze out this heart-stirring melody…
et: Seda saab näppida, et pigistada välja seda südant liigutavat meloodiat…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
en: When I compose better melodies, you have to come listen, okay?
et: Kui ma paremaid meloodiaid loon, pead tulema kuulama, eks?

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
en: A melody from my POKéMON and me… Let us deliver it to your soul.
et: Meloodia mu POKéMONilt ja minult… Lubage meil see su hingeni tuua.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
en: La-lalala…
et: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
en: When I play, my emotions should reach you through my electric guitar…
et: Kui ma mängin, peaksid mu emotsioonid jõudma sinuni läbi mu elektrikitarri…

label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
en: Go, go, go! POKéMON 1, 2, and 3!
et: Anna minna, minna, minna! POKéMON 1, 2 ja 3!

label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
en: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay? POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!
et: Tulge sisse, POKéMONid! Kas kõik on korras? POKéMON 1, 2 ja 3?!

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
en: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON battle team?
et: Kas pole lahe, et mul on POKéMON-lahingu meeskond?

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
en: You can copy me--I don't mind!
et: Sa võid mind matkida – ma ei pane pahaks!

label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
en: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! We MIMIC what you do!
et: Me oleme MIMIC CIRCLE! Me MATKIME seda, mida sa teed!

label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
en: Whoopsie! I lost!
et: Uupsakauu! Ma kaotasin!

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
en: What's so good about mimicry?
et: Mis on matkimise juures nii head?

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
en: Fufufu… You'll never understand…
et: Fufufu… Sa ei mõista seda kunagi…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
en: So, we finally meet! My BUG POKéMON will keep you company!
et: Nii et me lõpuks kohtume! Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid hoiavad sulle seltsi!

label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
en: I wish we'd never met…
et: Ma sooviksin, et me poleks kunagi kohtunud…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
en: I want to MIMIC you some more. Can you hurry up and move?
et: Ma tahan sind veel MATKIDA. Kas saad kähku ja liikuda?

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
en: If you step forward, we step forward.
et: Kui sa astud ette, astume meie ette.

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
en: If you turn right, we turn, too…
et: Kui sa pöörad paremale, pöörame meiegi…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
en: But if you win, I lose…
et: Aga kui sina võidad, siis mina kaotan…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
en: I can't MIMIC you winning the match. That's just impossible… It's burning me up…
et: Ma ei suuda MATKIDA sind matši võitmas. See on lihtsalt võimatu… See ajab mind marru…

label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
en: Yep, you've finally caught me! Or were you trying to avoid me?
et: Jah, sa lõpuks tabasid mind! Või üritasid sa mind vältida?

label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
en: Whoop, that was a great match!
et: Ohoo, see oli suurepärane matš!

label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
en: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! I hope you enjoyed our performance.
et: Me oleme MIMIC CIRCLE! Ma loodan, et nautisid meie etendust.

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
en: You don't know who I am, do you?
et: Sa ei tea, kes ma olen, kas pole?

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
en: But, I also don't know you. So, we'll battle!
et: Aga ma ei tunne ka sind. Nii et me võitleme!

label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
en: You're pretty strong!
et: Sa oled päris tugev!

label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
en: Until you go away somewhere, we'll keep on mimicking your every move.
et: Kuni sa kuhugi ära ei lähe, jätkame me su iga võtte matkimist.

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
en: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people who like to MIMIC.
et: MIMIC CIRCLE'i moodustasid inimesed, kellele meeldib MATKIDA.

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
en: A battle starts the instant we meet!
et: Lahing algab silmapilgul, mil me kohtume!

label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
en: I give up!
et: Ma annan alla!

label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
en: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?
et: Kas sa ei liituks meie MIMIC CIRCLE'iga?

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
en: Who has the knowledge and the technique for survival?
et: Kellel on teadmised ja tehnika ellujäämiseks?

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
en: POKéMON RANGERS, that's who!
et: POKéMON RANGERID, seda küll!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
en: I didn't have enough POKéMON know-how…
et: Mul polnud piisavalt POKéMONide oskusteavet…

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
en: To break away from civilization and awaken the wild spirit within!
et: Murda tsivilisatsioonist lahti ja äratada endas metsik vaim!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
en: That's our vision.
et: See on meie nägemus.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
en: I hope you'll give me a rematch without mocking my lack of knowledge.
et: Ma loodan, et annad mulle revanši, ilma mu teadmiste puudumist pilkamata.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
en: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by being together with POKéMON.
et: Ma taastan oma metsiku vaimu, olles koos POKéMONidega.
