label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
en: You've remained strong!
et: Sa oled tugevaks jäänud!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
en: Believe in your POKéMON. Believe in yourself.
et: Usu oma POKéMONidesse. Usu iseendasse.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
en: The road will reveal itself to you.
et: Tee paljastab end sulle.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
en: Oh? Look at you.
et: Oh? Vaata sind.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
en: For someone on an adventure, you're traveling awfully light.
et: Seiklusel oleva kohta reisid sa kohutavalt kerge koormaga.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
en: Accidents happen when you're not prepared!
et: Õnnetused juhtuvad, kui sa pole valmis!

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
en: You're traveling light but you have everything you need.
et: Sa reisid kergelt, aga sul on kõik, mida vajad.

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
en: You're on top of things mentally and physically, too.
et: Sa oled asjadega järjel nii vaimselt kui füüsiliselt.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
en: Do you have a POKéNAV? It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.
et: Kas sul on POKéNAV? See on igale TRAINERILE kohustuslik tööriist.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
en: Oh, you do have one! Let's register each other, then!
et: Oh, sul on üks olemas! Registreerigem siis teineteise!

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
en: How's your journey with POKéMON going?
et: Kuidas su teekond POKéMONidega läheb?

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
en: I'm still missing something…
et: Mul on ikka veel midagi puudu…

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
en: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER, rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON rely on you.
et: Samamoodi nagu sina, TRAINERINA, loodad oma POKéMONidele, loodavad su POKéMONid sinule.

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
en: The vast sky holds untold promise!
et: Avar taevas hoiab ütlematut lubadust!

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
en: Nothing can compare to the sheer exhilaration of flight!
et: Miski ei võrdu lendamise puhta erutusega!

label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
en: Down and out!
et: Pikali ja väljas!

label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
en: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of flying come true!
et: Mu LINNU-POKéMON tegi mu lendamisunistused teoks!

label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
en: I'll show you the true potential of me and my BIRD POKéMON!
et: Ma näitan sulle enda ja mu LINNU-POKéMONi tõelist potentsiaali!

label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
en: We lacked potential…
et: Meil nappis potentsiaali…

label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
en: Ever since I was a little kid, I always admired BIRD POKéMON…
et: Juba väikesest lapsest saati olen ma alati imetlenud LINNU-POKéMONe…

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
en: To lurk in shadows, and live in darkness… That is my destiny.
et: Varitseda varjudes ja elada pimeduses… See on mu saatus.

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
en: I emerge to challenge you!
et: Ma ilmun välja, et sulle väljakutse esitada!

label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
en: I admit defeat!
et: Ma tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
en: Those defeated in battle withdraw quietly back into the shadows. That, too, is destiny…
et: Need, kes lahingus lüüa saavad, taanduvad vaikselt tagasi varjudesse. Ka see on saatus…

label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
en: If you're not on your guard, you're in for some pain!
et: Kui sa pole valvel, ootab sind valu!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
en: You're surprisingly good!
et: Sa oled üllatavalt hea!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
en: My surprise attack ended in failure…
et: Mu üllatusrünnak lõppes läbikukkumisega…

label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
en: To hide a tree, use a forest!
et: Puu peitmiseks kasuta metsa!

label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
en: I bow to your superiority.
et: Ma kummardan su üleoleku ees.

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
en: To hide a tree, use a forest! To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!
et: Puu peitmiseks kasuta metsa! POKéMONi peitmiseks kasuta POKéMONi!

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
en: There is no deep, hidden meaning to that.
et: Sellel pole sügavat, varjatud tähendust.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
en: You spoke to me… So you want to challenge me!
et: Sa rääkisid minuga… Nii et sa tahad mulle väljakutse esitada!

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
en: Sure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught while SURFING!
et: Muidugi! Ma proovin POKéMONe, keda ma SURFIDES püüdsin!

label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
en: I don't have a clue about what it takes to win.
et: Mul pole aimugi, mida on vaja võiduks.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…
et: Mine oma POKéMONiga SURFI…

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: Then fish off its back…
et: Siis kalasta ta seljalt…

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: It's an indescribably luxuriant moment!
et: See on kirjeldamatult luksuslik hetk!

label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
en: Hit me with a power chord! Victory is mine! It's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!
et: Taba mind võimsa akordiga! Võit on minu! On meie aeg särada, ohoo, jah!

label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
en: You showed me who's the boss! We'll have to take the loss, oh, no!
et: Sa näitasid mulle, kes on boss! Me peame kaotusega leppima, oh, ei!

label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
en: Hit me with another power chord! Leave me alone! Your win you have to atone!
et: Taba mind veel ühe võimsa akordiga! Jäta mind rahule! Oma võit pead sa lunastama!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
en: Hohoho! I like kid TRAINERS! Let's have a good one!
et: Hohoho! Mulle meeldivad laps-TRAINERID! Peame ühe hea!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
en: You're pretty amazing! Hohoho!
et: Sa oled päris hämmastav! Hohoho!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
en: Hohoho! I'll try emulating the pep of kid TRAINERS like you!
et: Hohoho! Ma proovin jäljendada sinusuguste laps-TRAINERITE hoogu!

label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
en: Wherever and whenever I may be, I always have my parasol in hand.
et: Kus ja millal iganes ma ka poleksin, on mul alati päikesevari käes.

label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
en: Oh, but… That's not fair.
et: Oh, aga… See pole aus.

label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
en: You're asking if my parasol is heavy? Your BAG is filled with more junk than I ever carry around.
et: Sa küsid, kas mu päikesevari on raske? Su KOTT on rohkem rämpsu täis, kui ma iial kaasas kannan.

label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
en: Do you have any moves that can strike a flying POKéMON?
et: Kas sul on mõni võte, mis suudab tabada lendavat POKéMONi?

label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
en: You soared above me!
et: Sa hõljusid minust üle!

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
en: The move FLY is convenient, don't you think?
et: Võte FLY on mugav, kas sa ei arva?

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
en: While the POKéMON is flying, almost no moves can strike it.
et: Sel ajal, kui POKéMON lendab, ei suuda peaaegu ükski võte teda tabada.

label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
en: My POKéMON is strong! How about yours?
et: Mu POKéMON on tugev! Kuidas sinu omaga on?

label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
en: Your POKéMON were stronger…
et: Su POKéMONid olid tugevamad…

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
en: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.
et: POKéMON, kes pidevalt kasvab, on selline, kelle peale saab loota.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
en: You can be counted on to get better. I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!
et: Sinu peale saab loota, et sa paremaks saad. Ma tahaksin sind oma POKéNAVi registreerida!

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
en: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.
et: POKéMON, kes pidevalt kasvab, on selline, kelle peale saab loota.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
en: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.
et: Su POKéMONid on tõsiselt tugevad.

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
en: My POKéMON are growing stronger. I have to grow stronger, too.
et: Mu POKéMONid saavad tugevamaks. Ma pean ka tugevamaks saama.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
en: I'll check your POKéMON and see if they're fit for the outdoors.
et: Ma kontrollin su POKéMONe ja vaatan, kas nad on õueoluks vormis.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
en: With POKéMON that strong, you're in no danger of needing rescue!
et: Nii tugevate POKéMONidega pole sul mingit ohtu, et vajaksid päästmist!

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
en: To travel wherever your heart desires with POKéMON… That's the joy of being a TRAINER.
et: Rännata POKéMONidega kuhu iganes su süda ihkab… See on TRAINERIKS olemise rõõm.

label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
en: How's your physical fitness? If you're not fit, you could have a rough time in critical situations.
et: Kuidas su füüsiline vorm on? Kui sa pole vormis, võib sul kriitilistes olukordades raske olla.

label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
en: I'm totally fit, but…
et: Ma olen täiesti vormis, aga…

label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
en: Fitness training is in my routine. I always run with my POKéMON.
et: Vormitreening on mu rutiinis. Ma jooksen alati oma POKéMONiga.

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Tahad võidelda?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin selle…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder…
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Ma pingutan rohkem…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Do you have a POKéNAV…?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Kas sul on POKéNAV…?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle again?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Tahad jälle võidelda?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
en: … … … … … … I lost again…
et: … … … … … … Ma kaotasin jälle…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder… For my precious BUG POKéMON…
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Ma pingutan rohkem… Oma kalli PUTUKA-POKéMONi nimel…

label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
en: POKéMON have many special abilities. If you want to become a first-class TRAINER, learn about them.
et: POKéMONidel on palju erivõimeid. Kui tahad esimese klassi TRAINERIKS saada, õpi neist.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
en: You're obviously thinking.
et: Sa ilmselgelt mõtled.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
en: The special abilities of POKéMON will make battle styles change.
et: POKéMONide erivõimed panevad võitlusstiilid muutuma.

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
en: Who might you be?
et: Kes sina olla võiksid?

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
en: Are you perhaps searching for ancient ruins that are rumored to possibly exist according to legend?
et: Kas sa otsid ehk muistseid varemeid, mis legendi järgi väidetavalt olemas olla võivad?

label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
en: What a disgraceful setback…
et: Milline häbiväärne tagasilöök…

label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
en: That giant rock… I would like to believe it may indeed contain ancient ruins. But I see no entrance.
et: See hiiglaslik kivi… Ma tahaksin uskuda, et see tõesti muistseid varemeid sisaldab. Aga ma ei näe sissepääsu.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
en: Why am I carrying this parasol?
et: Miks ma seda päikesevarju kannan?

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
en: I'll tell you if you can win against me.
et: Ma ütlen sulle, kui suudad minu vastu võita.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
en: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON attacks…
et: Päikesevari ei suuda POKéMONide rünnakuid tõrjuda…

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
en: I don't think strong sunlight is good for my POKéMON. So I shield them with my parasol.
et: Ma ei arva, et tugev päikesevalgus on mu POKéMONidele hea. Nii et ma varjan neid oma päikesevarjuga.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
en: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…
et: Mina, POKéMON ja mu päikesevari…

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
en: If any one of them is missing, the picture of beauty will be ruined.
et: Kui üks neist puudub, on ilu pilt rikutud.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
en: You've completely ruined my beauty…
et: Sa oled mu ilu täielikult rikkunud…

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
en: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.
et: Päikesevari ei sobiks sulle sugugi.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
en: Why, something like this would only get in your way.
et: No selline asi ainult segaks sind.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
en: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON and create new ninja techniques.
et: Ma võtan omaks POKéMONide võtted ja loon uusi nindža-tehnikaid.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
en: The creation of new ninja techniques is but a distant dream…
et: Uute nindža-tehnikate loomine on vaid kauge unistus…

label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
en: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under a ninja sensei.
et: Ehk peaksin õpipoisiks hakkama mõne nindža-sensei juures.

label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
en: We ninja conceal ourselves under our camouflage cloaks. I bet you didn't know where I was!
et: Meie, nindžad, peidame end oma kamuflaažkeepide alla. Vean kihla, et sa ei teadnud, kus ma olin!

label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
en: I lost! I should camouflage my shame!
et: Ma kaotasin! Ma peaksin oma häbi kamuflaažiga varjama!

label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
en: Our camouflage cloaks are all handmade.
et: Meie kamuflaažkeebid on kõik käsitsi tehtud.

label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
en: If you don't pay attention, you could get hurt!
et: Kui sa ei pööra tähelepanu, võid viga saada!

label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
en: Ouch! I was the one to get hurt.
et: Ai! Mina olin see, kes viga sai.

label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
en: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON? They're cute the way they are, though.
et: Huvitav… Kas ma peaksin oma POKéMONe arendama? Nad on siiski armsad sellisena, nagu on.

label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
en: Your party POKéMON… Do you have different types?
et: Su seltskonna POKéMONid… Kas sul on erinevaid tüüpe?

label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
en: I've seen your policy in action!
et: Ma olen näinud su põhimõtet tegevuses!

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
en: I think it's awesome you're so strong battling with your favorite POKéMON.
et: Ma arvan, et on äge, et sa oled nii tugev, võideldes oma lemmik-POKéMONidega.

label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
en: Will you play with my delightfully pretty POKéMON?
et: Kas mängid mu veetlevalt kena POKéMONiga?

label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
en: This isn't what I meant!
et: Ma ei mõelnud seda!

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
en: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.
et: Ma lähen KONKURSILE LILYCOVE'is.

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
en: My POKéMON should have no problem sweeping the MASTER CLASS.
et: Mu POKéMONil ei tohiks olla mingit probleemi MASTER CLASSi pühkimisega.

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
en: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners.
et: Oma POKéMONiga olen ma rännanud maailma nelja nurka.

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
en: You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.
et: Sa võiksid öelda, et mul on oma võimetesse veidi usku.

label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
en: Ah, well played.
et: Ah, hästi mängitud.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
en: I would like to circle the globe once again with my POKéMON.
et: Ma tahaksin oma POKéMONiga veel kord ümber maakera tiirutada.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
en: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable. Allow me to register you as a memento.
et: Su POKéMON-osavus on tähelepanuväärne. Luba mul sind mälestuseks registreerida.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
en: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners.
et: Oma POKéMONiga olen ma rännanud maailma nelja nurka.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
en: You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.
et: Sa võiksid öelda, et mul on oma võimetesse veidi usku.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
en: Ah, well played.
et: Ah, hästi mängitud.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
en: Your POKéMON and you…
et: Su POKéMON ja sina…

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
en: Your prowess together will be considered strong, even overseas.
et: Teie ühist osavust peetakse tugevaks isegi välismaal.

label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
en: There are powers beyond our understanding in the world…
et: Maailmas on jõude, mis on väljaspool meie mõistmist…

label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
en: I have lost…
et: Ma olen kaotanud…

label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
en: MT. PYRE… There is a mysterious power at work there…
et: MT. PYRE… Seal on tegevuses salapärane jõud…

label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
en: KATE: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
et: KATE: Koos oleme me kartmatud! Me näitame, kui kõvad me oleme!

label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
en: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior student partner…
et: KATE: Ma vussisin oma noorema õpilaspartneri ees…

label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
en: KATE: When someone's relying on me, I get this urge to look cool in front of them…
et: KATE: Kui keegi loodab minu peale, tekib mul tung nende ees lahe välja näha…

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
en: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON, we can't battle with you.
et: KATE: Kui sul on ainult üks POKéMON, me ei saa sinuga võidelda.

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
en: That would be bullying.
et: See oleks kiusamine.

label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
en: JOY: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
et: JOY: Koos oleme me kartmatud! Me näitame, kui kõvad me oleme!

label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
en: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!
et: JOY: Palun andesta mulle, KATE!

label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
en: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE, my senior student partner, again.
et: JOY: Ehehe, ma pean jälle KATEGA, oma vanema õpilaspartneriga, treenima.

label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
en: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON if you're going to challenge us!
et: JOY: Sul on vaja vähemalt kahte POKéMONi, kui kavatsed meile väljakutse esitada!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
en: Stop! Have a good look at my precious POKéMON!
et: Peatu! Vaata mu kallist POKéMONi hoolega!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
en: Oh, how dare you! Don't take it so seriously!
et: Oh, kuidas sa julged! Ära võta seda nii tõsiselt!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
en: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
et: Ehk lähen ma SAFARIST rohkem POKéMONe püüdma.

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
en: I took it easy on you this time! It won't be that way the next time!
et: Ma olin seekord sinuga leebe! Järgmine kord ei ole nii!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
en: My precious POKéMON grew! Have a good look!
et: Mu kallis POKéMON kasvas! Vaata hoolega!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
en: Oh, how dare you! You still won't take it easy!
et: Oh, kuidas sa julged! Sa ikka ei ole leebe!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
en: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
et: Ehk lähen ma SAFARIST rohkem POKéMONe püüdma.

label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
en: I have this routine. Defeat five TRAINERS a day. Guess what? You're number five!
et: Mul on selline rutiin. Alistan viis TRAINERit päevas. Kujuta ette? Sa oled number viis!

label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
en: No! You're horrid!
et: Ei! Sa oled kohutav!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
en: I didn't expect to lose this easily… I'll win next time!
et: Ma ei oodanud, et nii kergesti kaotan… Ma võidan järgmine kord!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
en: That was total humiliation! I won't forget you… Hand over your POKéNAV!
et: See oli täielik alandus! Ma ei unusta sind… Anna oma POKéNAV siia!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
en: I have this new routine. Defeat ten TRAINERS a day. Guess what? You're number ten!
et: Mul on see uus rutiin. Alistan kümme TRAINERit päevas. Kujuta ette? Sa oled number kümme!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
en: Wait! That's nasty! I demand a rematch!
et: Oota! See on jälk! Ma nõuan revanši!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
en: An opponent I just can't beat… Snivel… I can't believe this is happening…
et: Vastane, keda ma lihtsalt ei suuda võita… Nuuks… Ma ei suuda uskuda, et see toimub…

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
en: Can't you see that I have all this stuff with me?
et: Kas sa ei näe, et mul on kogu see kraam kaasas?

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
en: Despite that, you still insist that we battle?
et: Sellest hoolimata sa ikka nõuad, et me võitleksime?

label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
en: Of course I lost! I'm holding stuff in both hands!
et: Muidugi ma kaotasin! Ma hoian asju mõlemas käes!

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
en: I bought too much stuff at the LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.
et: Ma ostsin LILYCOVE KAUBAMAJAS liiga palju kraami.

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
en: It's up the road from here. I wish I had a BAG like yours.
et: See on siit ülalpool teed. Ma sooviksin, et mul oleks sinusugune KOTT.

label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
en: There's nothing I love more than checking out other people's POKéMON!
et: Pole midagi, mida ma rohkem armastan, kui teiste inimeste POKéMONide vaatamist!

label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
en: Super awesome!
et: Ülimalt äge!

label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
en: They're great, your POKéMON! How do you raise them?
et: Nad on suurepärased, su POKéMONid! Kuidas sa neid kasvatad?

label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
en: I want everybody to see the POKéMON I've raised!
et: Ma tahan, et kõik näeksid POKéMONe, keda ma kasvatanud olen!

label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
en: Wow! Spectacular!
et: Ohoo! Vapustav!

label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
en: I raise every POKéMON with the same love and care--I don't pick favorites.
et: Ma kasvatan iga POKéMONi sama armastuse ja hoolega – ma ei vali lemmikuid.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
en: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat! On their next win, I'm entering them in CONTESTS.
et: Mu POKéMONid pole kunagi lüüasaamist maitsnud! Nende järgmise võiduga panen ma nad KONKURSSIDELE.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
en: Oh, now what happened here?
et: Oh, mis nüüd siin juhtus?

label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
en: I may have to train my gang some more before entering any CONTEST.
et: Ma pean ehk oma kampa veel treenima, enne kui ühelegi KONKURSILE astun.

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
en: Want to determine how strong you are? I'll be the test!
et: Tahad kindlaks teha, kui tugev sa oled? Mina olen katse!

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
en: You passed with flying colors!
et: Sa läbisid säravalt!

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
en: To best even me… Your strength is marvelous!
et: Ületada isegi mind… Su jõud on suurepärane!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
en: You seem to have a big collection of GYM BADGES.
et: Näib, et sul on suur kogu SAALI MÄRKE.

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
en: Let me see if you're actually worthy of those BADGES!
et: Lase mul näha, kas sa tegelikult neid MÄRKE väärid!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
en: Oh, you're worthy, all right!
et: Oh, sa oled väärt küll!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
en: You did your BADGES proud in that match!
et: Sa tegid oma MÄRKIDELE selles matšis au!

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
en: They say that good times are filled with good aromas.
et: Öeldakse, et head ajad on täis häid aroome.

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
en: Oh… I smell the bitter scent of misery…
et: Oh… Ma tunnen viletsuse kibedat lõhna…

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
en: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled with uplifting fragrances.
et: BERRY MASTERI aed on täis ülendavaid lõhnu.

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
en: Being a psychic is about willpower.
et: Psüühik olemine seisneb tahtejõus.

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
en: I've willed myself not to lose to anyone. That makes me strong!
et: Ma olen tahtnud, et ei kaotaks kellelegi. See teeb mind tugevaks!

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
en: I feel sad…
et: Ma tunnen end kurvana…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
en: Being a psychic is about willpower. I thought I wouldn't lose to you…
et: Psüühik olemine seisneb tahtejõus. Ma arvasin, et ma sulle ei kaota…

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
en: I sense it! You and I shall battle again! I can't tell if I'll win, though…
et: Ma aiman seda! Sina ja mina võitleme veel! Ma ei oska küll öelda, kas ma võidan…

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
en: Let's see your POKéNAV.
et: Lase näha su POKéNAVi.

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
en: I've convinced myself that I won't lose anymore. That makes me strong!
et: Ma olen end veennud, et ma enam ei kaota. See teeb mind tugevaks!

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
en: I feel sad…
et: Ma tunnen end kurvana…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
en: I should train at MT. PYRE… I'll never beat you this way…
et: Ma peaksin MT. PYRES treenima… Ma ei võida sind kunagi niimoodi…

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
en: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON develop psychic powers.
et: Ära ole liiga õnnelik, kui su POKéMONid arendavad psüühilisi jõude.

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
en: You need to refine those powers to make them really useful.
et: Sa pead neid jõude lihvima, et need tõesti kasulikuks teha.

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
en: Overwhelmed!
et: Purustatud!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
en: We all have psychic powers. We've just forgotten how to use them.
et: Meil kõigil on psüühilised jõud. Me oleme lihtsalt unustanud, kuidas neid kasutada.

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
en: I would like to face you again. Is that okay with you?
et: Ma tahaksin sinuga jälle silmitsi seista. Kas see sobib sulle?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
en: Have you awoken the psychic powers within you?
et: Kas oled äratanud psüühilised jõud endas?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
en: Astounding!
et: Hämmastav!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
en: Your power with POKéMON… That could be a psychic power, too.
et: Su jõud POKéMONidega… See võib olla ka psüühiline jõud.

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
en: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your POKéMON won't cry when they lose.
et: MIU: Tere, TRAINER. Ma loodan, et su POKéMONid ei nuta, kui kaotavad.

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
en: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: MIU: Oh-oo, me kaotasime.

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
en: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are strong because you are friends.
et: MIU: TRAINER, su POKéMONid on tugevad, sest te olete sõbrad.

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
en: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
et: MIU: Pole lõbus võidelda, kui sul pole kahte POKéMONi.

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
en: YUKI: Okay! We're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!
et: YUKI: Olgu! Me võidame TRAINERI POKéMONe!

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
en: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: YUKI: Oh-oo, me kaotasime.

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
en: YUKI: Why are you so strong? We've never lost before.
et: YUKI: Miks sa nii tugev oled? Me pole kunagi varem kaotanud.

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
en: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
et: YUKI: Pole lõbus võidelda, kui sul pole kahte POKéMONi.

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
en: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep… Will your POKéMON sleep?
et: MT. PYRE… Kus POKéMONide vaimud magavad… Kas su POKéMONid magama jäävad?

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
en: Overflowing with vitality…
et: Elujõust üle voolamas…

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
en: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep…
et: MT. PYRE… Kus POKéMONide vaimud magavad…

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
en: It must overflow with a power that soothes spirits…
et: See peab üle voolama jõust, mis vaime rahustab…

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
en: I'll turn your lights out while I rip through this tune!
et: Ma kustutan su tuled, kui ma sellest viisist läbi tuiskan!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
en: Hey, hold it! I was still playing the intro!
et: Hei, pea kinni! Ma mängisin veel sissejuhatust!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
en: You're rock steady. I'd like to write a tune about you.
et: Sa oled rokk-kindel. Ma tahaksin sinust viisi kirjutada.

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
en: The next time, lend your ears to the full tune, will you?
et: Järgmine kord tee kõrvad lahti kogu viisile, eks?

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
en: Today's the day I'm going to do it! I'll turn out your lights before I finish singing my song!
et: Täna on päev, mil ma teen seda ära! Ma kustutan su tuled, enne kui oma laulu lõpuni laulan!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
en: Hey, hold it! I haven't even hit the chorus!
et: Hei, pea kinni! Ma pole isegi refräänini jõudnud!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
en: I thought you'd be so enthralled by my tune, you'd lose.
et: Ma arvasin, et sa oled mu viisist nii lummatud, et kaotad.

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
en: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON! My big brother got it for me.
et: See on mu äge PUTUKA-POKéMON! Mu suur vend hankis selle mulle.

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
en: Waaaah! You meanie!
et: Vaaaah! Sa õel!

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
en: Don't tell my brother I lost. You have to keep it a secret!
et: Ära ütle mu vennale, et ma kaotasin. Sa pead seda saladuses hoidma!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
en: My confidence will get a boost by beating someone obviously strong!
et: Mu enesekindlus saab hoogu, alistades kellegi ilmselgelt tugeva!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
en: There goes my confidence…
et: Seal läheb mu enesekindlus…

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
en: They say that you can't judge a person by their appearance.
et: Öeldakse, et inimest ei saa hinnata tema välimuse järgi.

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
en: But often, their looks don't lie…
et: Aga tihti nende välimus ei valeta…

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
en: Hello, child! Can you spare some time?
et: Tere, laps! Kas saad veidi aega loovutada?

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
en: Ah, a mighty capable child! Let me contribute to your allowance.
et: Ah, üks vägeva võimekusega laps! Lase mul su taskurahasse panustada.

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
en: Contribute to your allowance? Wasn't the prize money enough?
et: Su taskurahasse panustada? Kas auhinnarahast ei piisanud?

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
en: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON are my obsession!
et: Ma pean sulle ütlema, et LINNU-POKéMONid on mu kinnisidee!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
en: Birds are cool! They're the best!
et: Linnud on lahedad! Nad on parimad!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
en: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!
et: Isegi lüüasaamises on LINNU-POKéMONid lahedad!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
en: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that scatter during battles.
et: Ma kogun LINNU-POKéMONide sulgi, mis lahingute ajal laiali pudenevad.

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
en: I'm going to make a hat with BIRD POKéMON feathers.
et: Ma kavatsen teha LINNU-POKéMONide sulgedest mütsi.

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
en: When there are no TRAINERS around, I let my POKéMON battle each other. I watch them.
et: Kui ühtki TRAINERit läheduses pole, lasen ma oma POKéMONidel üksteisega võidelda. Ma jälgin neid.

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
en: I kind of like your POKéMON.
et: Su POKéMON mulle kuidagi meeldib.

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
en: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas! I think they'll make me better.
et: Hehe, ma näppan su võitlemise ideid! Ma arvan, et need teevad mind paremaks.

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
en: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has landed in my trap!
et: Ma lamasin varitsuses ja üks TRAINER maandus mu lõksu!

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
en: If you don't lose, how am I supposed to have fun playing ninja?
et: Kui sa ei kaota, kuidas ma peaksin nindžat mängides lõbutsema?

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
en: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking TRAINER next time.
et: Ma varitsen järgmine kord nõrgema väljanägemisega TRAINERit.

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
en: I just bought this parasol. My cuteness should be up by a third!
et: Ma just ostsin selle päikesevarju. Mu armsus peaks kolmandiku võrra tõusma!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
en: You're better than me by about five times!
et: Sa oled minust umbes viis korda parem!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
en: Using accessories effectively is the secret behind fashion appeal.
et: Aksessuaaride tõhus kasutamine on moe köitvuse saladus.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
en: Hey, are you lost at sea?
et: Hei, kas oled merel ära eksinud?

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
en: If you can beat my POKéMON, I can serve as your pilot.
et: Kui suudad mu POKéMONi võita, võin ma olla su tüürimees.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
en: I lost my bearings in battle!
et: Ma kaotasin lahingus suunataju!

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
en: Many people lose their bearings at sea.
et: Paljud inimesed kaotavad merel suunataju.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
en: If you're that sort, you should refer to the POKéNAV's MAP.
et: Kui oled seda sorti, peaksid vaatama POKéNAVi KAARTI.

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
en: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead of swimming yourself…
et: Hm! Sa sõidad POKéMONi seljas, selle asemel et ise ujuda…

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
en: I am envious!
et: Ma olen kade!

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
en: Oh! I can't…
et: Oh! Ma ei saa…

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
en: I'm getting chilled… I've been in the water too long…
et: Mul hakkab külm… Ma olen vees liiga kaua olnud…

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
en: I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…
et: Ma sooviksin, et saaksin POKéMONi seljas sõita nagu sina…

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
en: If you just float in the sea like this, POKéMON come around to play.
et: Kui lihtsalt niimoodi meres hõljud, tulevad POKéMONid ümber mängima.

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
en: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.
et: Oh, pagan. Ma läksin ja kaotasin.

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
en: While swimming, I noticed that some POKéMON attack, and some just watch.
et: Ujudes märkasin, et mõned POKéMONid ründavad ja mõned lihtsalt vaatavad.

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
en: I guess POKéMON have personalities of their own.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMONidel on oma iseloomud.

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
en: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get you to register me in your POKéNAV.
et: See on ainult tuju ajel, aga ehk panen ma sind mind oma POKéNAVi registreerima.

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
en: If you just float in the sea like this, TRAINERS challenge you!
et: Kui lihtsalt niimoodi meres hõljud, esitavad TRAINERID sulle väljakutse!

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
en: That's strange… I lost again…
et: See on kummaline… Ma kaotasin jälle…

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
en: This has nothing to do with anything, but maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.
et: Sellel pole millegagi mingit pistmist, aga ehk külastan ma TRICK HOUSE'i.

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
en: I'm growing bored of swimming… How about a battle?
et: Mul hakkab ujumisest igav… Kuidas oleks lahinguga?

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
en: I had no idea that you were this strong!
et: Mul polnud aimu, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
en: All the effort you put in must have made you this strong.
et: Kogu vaev, mille sisse panid, pidi tegema sind nii tugevaks.

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
en: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater to go deep under cover. Plumbing the depths is where I excel!
et: Fufufufu… Ma sukeldun sügavale vee alla, et minna sügavale peitu. Sügavuste läbimine on see, milles ma särangi!

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
en: Glub, glub, glub… I'm sinking…
et: Glub, glub, glub… Ma vajun…

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
en: I have it on good authority that there's a DIVE spot around here.
et: Mul on usaldusväärsest allikast, et siin kandis on DIVE-koht.

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
en: It gives me the urge to go deep again…
et: See tekitab mus tungi taas sügavale minna…

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother!
et: Siin ma olen meres, aga kes on minuga? Mu väike vend!

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on that!
et: Võitleme, et ma ei peaks sellel juurdlema!

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
en: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost! You're in for it later!
et: LILA: ROY! See on sinu süü, et me kaotasime! Sa saad selle eest hiljem!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
en: If only it wasn't my little brother next to me, but a nice boyfriend…
et: Kui vaid poleks mu kõrval mu väike vend, vaid kena poiss-sõber…

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
en: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.
et: LILA: Sa kavatsed meiega võidelda? Mitte enne, kui sul on kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
en: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on POKéMONides kõva!

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
en: Don't cry when you lose!
et: Ära nuta, kui kaotad!

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
en: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out…
et: ROY: Oh-oo… Mu suur õde sõimab mu läbi…

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
en: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on tõesti hirmus, kui ta vihaseks saab.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
en: That's why she doesn't have a boyfriend.
et: Just seepärast pole tal poiss-sõpra.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
en: ROY: Will you battle with us again? But take it easy next time, okay?
et: ROY: Kas võitled meiega jälle? Aga võta järgmine kord rahulikult, eks?

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
en: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.
et: ROY: Kas tahtsid meiega võidelda? Too siis kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother!
et: Siin ma olen meres, aga kes on minuga? Mu väike vend!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: Oh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on things!
et: Oh, tere, on tükk aega möödas. Võitleme, et ma ei peaks asjadel juurdlema!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
en: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost again!
et: LILA: ROY! See on sinu süü, et me jälle kaotasime!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
en: We're having a training session later!
et: Meil on hiljem treening!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
en: If I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat anyone with lovely combinations…
et: Kui mul oleks kena poiss-sõber, me võidaksime igaühe armsate kombinatsioonidega…

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
en: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.
et: LILA: Sa kavatsed meiega võidelda? Mitte enne, kui sul on kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
en: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck. I'm going to go totally all out!
et: ROY: Kui me kaotame, saan ma sõimata. Ma kavatsen anda täiesti kõik!

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
en: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out again.
et: ROY: Oh-oo… Mu suur õde sõimab mu jälle läbi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
en: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on tõesti hirmus, kui ta vihaseks saab.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
en: She's going to make me train really hard with POKéMON later…
et: Ta paneb mind hiljem POKéMONidega tõesti kõvasti treenima…

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
en: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.
et: ROY: Kas tahtsid meiega võidelda? Too siis kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
en: Here I am swimming by my lonesome on this wide, beautiful sea.
et: Siin ma olen, ujumas omapäi sellel avaral, ilusal merel.

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
en: There's no other word for it. This is pathetic!
et: Selle jaoks pole muud sõna. See on haletsusväärne!

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
en: I'm feeling blue. Blue as the sky…
et: Ma olen masenduses. Sinine nagu taevas…

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
en: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS and invite them on a long swim.
et: Ma peaksin prouast SWIMMERITELE juttu tegema ja neid pikale ujumisele kutsuma.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
en: I'm not going to lose to some surfer TRAINER.
et: Ma ei kavatse mõnele surfar-TRAINERILE kaotada.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
en: I've only got sweat in my eyes! I am not crying!
et: Mul on lihtsalt higi silmis! Ma ei nuta!

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
en: You can find pretty colored shards of things around here.
et: Siin kandis leiab ilusaid värvilisi asjade kilde.

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
en: I heard you approaching, so I hung around for you!
et: Ma kuulsin su lähenemist, nii et ma hängisin sinu jaoks ringi!

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
en: I surrender!
et: Ma alistun!

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
en: Sound travels faster in water than it does through air.
et: Heli liigub vees kiiremini kui õhus.

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
en: Hey, there! Check out my sweet POKéMON!
et: Hei seal! Vaata mu armast POKéMONi!

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
en: I floundered…
et: Ma siplesin…

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
en: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm, so I started swimming, too.
et: HORSEA võlu pühkis mind jalust, nii et ma hakkasin ka ujuma.

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
en: I'm tired of swimming. Are you up for a battle with me?
et: Mul on ujumisest väsinud. Kas oled valmis minuga võitlema?

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
en: You're too much!
et: Sa oled liiast!

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
en: Whew… Which way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?
et: Uhh… Kummaltpoolt on MOSSDEEP CITY?

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
en: How would you like to take on the WATER-type POKéMON I raised?
et: Kuidas sulle meeldiks jõudu katsuda VEE-tüüpi POKéMONidega, keda ma kasvatasin?

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin selle…

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
en: Your power… You're the real deal. I'm amazed!
et: Su jõud… Sa oled ehtne asi. Ma olen hämmastunud!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
en: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR! I've braved the world's seas!
et: Ahoi! Ma olen tugev, kõva MADRUS! Ma olen trotsinud maailma meresid!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
en: Gwrroooar! I couldn't win!
et: Gvrroooar! Ma ei suutnud võita!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
en: The tide ebbs and flows inside the SHOAL CAVE.
et: Mõõn ja tõus vahelduvad SHOAL CAVE'i sees.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
en: By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Did you know?
et: Muide, tõusust mõõnani läheb umbes kuus tundi. Kas teadsid?

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
en: Register me in your POKéNAV, and I'll tell you something good.
et: Registreeri mind oma POKéNAVi ja ma ütlen sulle midagi head.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
en: It's high time I get my payback from you! Come on, we're battling!
et: On ülim aeg, et ma sult kättemaksu saan! No kuule, me võitleme!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
en: I couldn't win! I flat out couldn't win!
et: Ma ei suutnud võita! Ma lihtsalt ei suutnud võita!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: The SHOAL CAVE…
et: SHOAL CAVE…

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: There are places you can and can't get to depending on the rise and fall of the tide.
et: On kohti, kuhu saad ja ei saa, sõltuvalt mõõna tõusust ja langusest.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Don't forget!
et: Muide, tõusust mõõnani läheb umbes kuus tundi. Ära unusta!

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
en: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE. Someone told me. Are you going to see him, too?
et: KIM: SHOAL CAVE'is elab üks naljakas vanamees. Keegi rääkis mulle. Kas sinagi lähed teda vaatama?

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
en: KIM: I thought we would win.
et: KIM: Ma arvasin, et me võidame.

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
en: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?
et: KIM: SHOAL CAVE'is elab naljakas vanamees, kas pole?

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
en: Let's go see him, IRIS!
et: Lähme teda vaatama, IRIS!

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
en: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON, or it's just no good!
et: KIM: Ei, ei, ei! Sul on vaja kahte POKéMONi, muidu see lihtsalt ei sobi!

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
en: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're looking for out here?
et: IRIS: KIM, kas sa oskad öelda, mida me siin väljas otsime?

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
en: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.
et: IRIS: Oh, me jõudsime kuidagi lähedale.

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
en: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into the SHOAL CAVE? We'll get all wet.
et: IRIS: KIM, kas me tõesti läheme SHOAL CAVE'i? Me saame üleni märjaks.

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
en: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do anything like a 2-on-1 battle.
et: IRIS: Oh, me ei suudaks kunagi-iial midagi nagu 2-vastu-1 lahingut teha.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
en: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me come out to the sea?
et: Miks minusugune LINNUHOIDJA merele tuleks?

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
en: Okay. I'll tell you why I'm here.
et: Olgu. Ma ütlen sulle, miks ma siin olen.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
en: I put a message in a bottle and put it out to sea.
et: Ma panin sõnumi pudelisse ja lasin selle merre.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
en: I'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will find it!
et: Ma olen kindel, et üks prouast SWIMMER selle leiab!

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
en: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage into the sea?
et: Hei! Kas see olid sina, kes prügi merre viskas?

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
en: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into the sea.
et: Oh, sa ei visanud prahti merre.

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
en: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing in the waves earlier.
et: Ma leidsin varem inetu pudeli lainetes hüplemas.

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
en: It angers me that someone would pollute the sea!
et: Mind ajab vihaseks, et keegi merd reostaks!

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
en: Swimming is a full-body workout! You will get fit!
et: Ujumine on kogu keha treening! Sa saad vormi!

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
en: I admit it! You win!
et: Ma tunnistan seda! Sina võidad!

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
en: Thanks to my daily swimming routine… Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!
et: Tänu oma igapäevasele ujumisrutiinile… Vaata! Naudi silmailu sellest kehaehitusest!

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
en: This towering white mountain of rock is SOOTOPOLIS CITY.
et: See kõrguv valge kaljumägi on SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
en: I was done in?
et: Kas mind tehti läbi?

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
en: I can't find the entrance to SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?
et: Ma ei leia SOOTOPOLISE sissepääsu. Kus see küll olla võiks?

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
en: Ufufufufu! I'm a mermaid!
et: Ufufufufu! Ma olen merineitsi!

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
en: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble! Blub, blub, blub…
et: Mu fantaasia lõhkes, justkui oleks see mull! Blub, blub, blub…

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
en: You thrashed me… I want to disappear in a wave of despair…
et: Sa tuupisid mind… Ma tahan kaduda meeleheite laine sisse…

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
en: Hello, kiddo! Want a battle with me?
et: Tere, plikake! Tahad minuga lahingut?

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
en: Oh, noooooh!
et: Oh, eiiiii!

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
en: I love frolicking with POKéMON in the sea like this!
et: Ma armastan niimoodi POKéMONidega meres hullamist!

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
en: Check out this sculpted body! I'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!
et: Vaata seda voolitud keha! Ma olen lõikelisem kui BLACK BELT!

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
en: Whoops! Too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!
et: Uups! Liiga tugev! Pole paha! Pole üldse paha!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
en: Losing to you stimulated my senses! I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!
et: Sulle kaotamine ergutas mu meeli! Ma treenin end ja POKéMONe kõvemini!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
en: Yep, you're not bad at all! I'd like to get to know you more!
et: Jah, sa pole üldse paha! Ma tahaksin sind rohkem tundma õppida!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
en: Check out this beautiful body! I'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!
et: Vaata seda ilusat keha! Ma olen voluptsem kui SWIMMER!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
en: Whoops! Really too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!
et: Uups! Tõesti liiga tugev! Pole paha! Pole üldse paha!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
en: I'm going to train even harder! You're a great motivator! You have to come back again!
et: Ma treenin veelgi kõvemini! Sa oled suurepärane motiveerija! Sa pead tagasi tulema!

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
en: I couldn't even swim last year, but now I'm a decent SWIMMER.
et: Ma ei osanud eelmisel aastal isegi ujuda, aga nüüd olen ma korralik SWIMMER.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
en: I think I'm capable of anything now.
et: Ma arvan, et olen nüüd kõigeks võimeline.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
en: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do a thing for me.
et: Iuu, ahneks minemine ei aidanud mind mitte üks põrm.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
en: If you practice at something, you will get better at it.
et: Kui midagi harjutad, lähed selles paremaks.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
en: You're young--don't be afraid to try all sorts of things!
et: Sa oled noor – ära karda proovida igasuguseid asju!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
en: If seawater gets up your nose, doesn't it feel terrible?
et: Kui merevesi ninna satub, kas pole see kohutav tunne?

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
en: Ack! Why, you… Glub!
et: Ah! No sina… Glub!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
en: Ooh, I choked on some water! It's bitter! It's salty!!
et: Ooh, ma tõmbasin vett kurku! See on mõru! See on soolane!!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
en: I'm throwing my whole heart into this!
et: Ma panen sellesse kogu oma südame!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
en: You had more heart!
et: Sul oli rohkem südant!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
en: I need to cool down now… I think I'll go for a dive.
et: Ma pean nüüd maha jahtuma… Ma vist lähen sukelduma.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
en: I can see it in your face. You want to challenge me.
et: Ma näen seda su näost. Sa tahad mulle väljakutse esitada.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
en: Awawawawawa…
et: Avavavavava…

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
en: A well-played match leaves me feeling refreshed and serene.
et: Hästi mängitud matš jätab mind värske ja rahulikuna.

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
en: Do you have a rival whom you just hate to lose against?
et: Kas sul on rivaal, kellele sa lihtsalt vihkad kaotada?

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
en: Arrrgh! I hate losing!
et: Arrrgh! Ma vihkan kaotamist!

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
en: If you have a rival, don't you get the feeling that you have to keep getting better?
et: Kui sul on rivaal, kas sul ei teki tunne, et pead aina paremaks saama?

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
en: Through fishing, I have attained a state of becalmed serenity…
et: Kalastuse kaudu olen saavutanud rahustatud vaikuse seisundi…

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
en: Please, allow me to demonstrate…
et: Palun, luba mul demonstreerida…

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
en: Though I have lost, my heart remains calm…
et: Kuigi ma olen kaotanud, jääb mu süda rahulikuks…

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
en: It matters not that I catch nothing. The line remains in the water…
et: Pole tähtis, et ma midagi ei püüa. Nöör jääb vette…

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
en: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged a SURFING POKéMON?
et: Uups! Ära ütle, et ma haakisin SURFIVA POKéMONi?

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
en: I can't keep up!
et: Ma ei suuda järge pidada!

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
en: It'd be a handful if I hooked your tough POKéMON!
et: Oleks omajagu tegemist, kui haakiksin su kõva POKéMONi!

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
en: Well, hey! This is a match between a POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!
et: Noh, hei! See on matš POKéMONi-fänni ja kalastushuvilise vahel!

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
en: No! My line's all tangled! The party's over!
et: Ei! Mu nöör on sassis! Pidu on läbi!

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
en: My fishing line's doing a dance! The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!
et: Mu õngenöör tantsib! Sasitango! Hahaha, sõlm!

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
en: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision. They spot prey from great heights.
et: LINNU-POKéMONidel on suurepärane nägemine. Nad märkavad saaki suurelt kõrguselt.

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
en: Whew… I give up.
et: Uhh… Ma annan alla.

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
en: There're lots of diving spots in the sea around here.
et: Siin kandi meres on palju sukeldumiskohti.

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
en: You can spot them easily from the sky because of their darker color.
et: Sa märkad neid kergesti taevast nende tumedama värvi tõttu.

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
en: Run in your bare feet. That will toughen up your soles!
et: Jookse paljajalu. See karastab su jalataldu!

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
en: Yowch! I got a pebble under a toenail!
et: Auu! Mulle sattus küüne alla kivike!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
en: Going barefoot feels great. But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.
et: Paljajalu käimine tundub suurepärane. Aga su RUNNING SHOES on ka lahedad.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
en: This is what I do to people who beat me! I hope we can do this again.
et: Seda ma teen inimestele, kes mind võidavad! Ma loodan, et saame seda jälle teha.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
en: I still run in my bare feet daily. My soles are tough!
et: Ma jooksen ikka veel iga päev paljajalu. Mu jalatallad on kõvad!

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
en: Yowch! Pebbles dug into my arches!
et: Auu! Kivikesed kaevusid mu jalavõlvidesse!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
en: Want to go barefoot for a while? So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?
et: Tahad mõneks ajaks paljajalu käia? Et ma saaksin su RUNNING SHOES'e proovida?

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
en: We should have a slow and methodical match.
et: Me peaksime pidama aeglase ja metoodilise matši.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
en: You didn't give me the chance to do any strategizing.
et: Sa ei andnud mulle võimalust mingit strateegiat teha.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
en: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea and sky, it feels as if time slows down.
et: Kui mind ümbritsevad sinine meri ja taevas, tundub, nagu aeg aeglustuks.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
en: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways away…
et: EVER GRANDE CITY on ikka veel pika maa kaugusel…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
en: My first victory seems to be far away, too…
et: Näib, et ka mu esimene võit on kaugel…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
en: My whole life has been about losing, but I will never give up!
et: Kogu mu elu on olnud kaotamisest, aga ma ei anna kunagi alla!

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
en: I know I'm not good now, but I think I can win eventually.
et: Ma tean, et ma pole praegu hea, aga ma arvan, et suudan lõpuks võita.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
en: Please register me in your POKéNAV.
et: Palun registreeri mind oma POKéNAVi.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
en: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on swimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.
et: Ma tunnen end ikka hästi. Ma ujun edasi EVER GRANDE CITYSSE.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
en: I've yet to taste my first victory…
et: Ma pole veel oma esimest võitu maitsnud…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
en: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY where I can eventually win…
et: Ma jõuan lõpuks EVER GRANDE CITYSSE, kus ma lõpuks võita saan…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
en: You have to swim, cycle, and then run a marathon in a triathlon.
et: Triatlonis pead ujuma, rattaga sõitma ja siis maratoni jooksma.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
en: It's a grueling race that consists of three events.
et: See on kurnav võistlus, mis koosneb kolmest alast.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
en: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…
et: POKéMON-lahing on ka kurnav…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
en: I have to ride a BIKE next, but… I'm about to throw in the towel…
et: Ma pean järgmisena rattaga sõitma, aga… Ma olen käsna viskamas…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
en: Well, I may as well make the best of this. I'd like a rematch sometime.
et: Noh, ma võin sama hästi sellest parima võtta. Ma tahaksin kunagi revanši.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
en: A triathlon is long. But I guess the road to become the POKéMON CHAMPION is also a long and grueling one.
et: Triatlon on pikk. Aga ma arvan, et tee POKéMON MEISTRIKS saamiseks on samuti pikk ja kurnav.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
en: A POKéMON battle really is harsh and unforgiving…
et: POKéMON-lahing on tõesti karm ja andestamatu…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
en: You should give serious thought to challenges on VICTORY ROAD.
et: Sa peaksid tõsiselt mõtlema väljakutsetele VICTORY ROADIL.

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
en: We've been working so hard to mount a POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…
et: Me oleme nii kõvasti tööd teinud, et POKéMON LEAGUE väljakutse ette valmistada…

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
en: We can't afford to lose now!
et: Me ei saa endale nüüd kaotust lubada!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
en: Oh! How could this happen?!
et: Oh! Kuidas see juhtuda sai?!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
en: After all I've done to get here, I won't give up after one setback.
et: Pärast kõike, mida ma siia jõudmiseks teinud olen, ma ei anna ühe tagasilöögi järel alla.

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
en: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!
et: Pole tugevamat TRAINERit kui mina!

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
en: This can't be!
et: See ei saa olla!

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
en: There probably is no stronger TRAINER than you!
et: Tõenäoliselt pole tugevamat TRAINERit kui sina!

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
en: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I caught myself a POKéMON that knows the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.
et: Ma tahan külastada EVER GRANDE'i, nii et ma püüdsin endale POKéMONi, kes oskab võtet WATERFALL, et koskedest üles pääseda.

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
en: I'm crestfallen!
et: Ma olen norgus!

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
en: Awww, phooey!
et: Ohh, pläh!

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
en: My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
et: Mu POKéMON oskab WATERFALLi, aga mul pole SOOTOPOLIS SAALI MÄRKI!

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
en: You're looking awfully tough. I wonder if I can win?
et: Sa näed kohutavalt kõva välja. Huvitav, kas ma suudan võita?

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
en: Ouch! I guess it was impossible to win.
et: Ai! Ma vist ei suutnudki võita.

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
en: There are tough TRAINERS galore around EVER GRANDE.
et: EVER GRANDE ümbruses on kõvasid TRAINEREID küllaga.

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
en: Do you think I may be out of my league?
et: Kas arvad, et ma olen ehk oma klassist väljas?

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
en: The sunlight seems to be more harsh in this area.
et: Näib, et päikesevalgus on selles kandis karmim.

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
en: I couldn't see very well because of the sun's glare.
et: Ma ei näinud eriti hästi päikese pimestuse tõttu.

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
en: I should go back soon. I need to reapply my sunscreen.
et: Ma peaksin varsti tagasi minema. Ma pean oma päikesekaitset uuesti peale panema.

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
en: This is my first triathlon. I'm all tense and nervous!
et: See on mu esimene triatlon. Ma olen üleni pinges ja närvis!

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
en: Wroooaaar! I failed to win!
et: Vrooaaar! Mul ei õnnestunud võita!

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
en: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to give it my all.
et: Kui ma olen üleni pinges, ei suuda ma anda kõike.

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, sure, why don't we battle?
et: Ma olen keset triatloni, aga muidugi, miks me ei võitle?

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
en: I was sure I'd win!
et: Ma olin kindel, et võidan!

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
en: Do you know what's the greatest thing about triathlons?
et: Kas tead, mis on triatlonide juures kõige suurepärasem?

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
en: Testing the limits of your own strength and endurance against Mother Nature!
et: Katsuda oma jõu ja vastupidavuse piire loodusema vastu!

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
en: Say hey, hey! Let's get on with it!
et: Kuule, hei! Hakkame pihta!

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
en: Beat, I'm beaten. That's it, done!
et: Alistatud, ma olen alistatud. Aitab, valmis!

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
en: There's nothing for a loser. Time for me to beat it home.
et: Kaotajale pole midagi. Aeg mul kähku koju kaduda.

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
en: What's the hurry? Let's take it slow and easy.
et: Milleks kiirustada? Võtame aeglaselt ja rahulikult.

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
en: Oh, my. I wanted to relax a little more…
et: Oh, heldeke. Ma tahtsin veidi rohkem lõõgastuda…

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
en: Don't you hate making mistakes when you're in a rush?
et: Kas sa ei vihka vigade tegemist, kui sul on kiire?

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
en: That's why I try to take things slowly.
et: Just seepärast ma püüan asju aeglaselt võtta.

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
en: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems, isn't that right?
et: Surfimine pole nii kerge, kui paistab, kas pole nii?

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
en: Winning sure isn't easy.
et: Võitmine pole tõesti kerge.

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
en: You have your sights on the POKéMON LEAGUE? Keep at it!
et: Sul on pilk POKéMON LEAGUE'il? Jätka!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
en: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see a TRAINER out in the sea.
et: Milline üllatus! Ma ei oodanud, et näen TRAINERit merel väljas.

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
en: I think we should battle!
et: Ma arvan, et me peaksime võitlema!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
en: This kid's awfully tough…
et: See laps on kohutavalt kõva…

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
en: Your eyes have that look of someone who's experienced harsh challenges and won. It suits you well!
et: Su silmis on see pilk, mis on kellelgi, kes on kogenud karme väljakutseid ja võitnud. See sobib sulle hästi!

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
en: In the deep blue sea, my shattered blue heart finds comfort among waves.
et: Sügavsinises meres leiab mu purustatud sinine süda lainete seas lohutust.

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
en: Like the vast blue sea, the world of POKéMON spans depths beyond belief.
et: Nagu avar sinine meri, ulatub POKéMONide maailm uskumatute sügavusteni.

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
en: The world's children dream of one day becoming the POKéMON CHAMPION.
et: Maailma lapsed unistavad, et saada ühel päeval POKéMON MEISTRIKS.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
en: Floating on the open sea like this… It's peaceful.
et: Niimoodi avamerel hõljumine… See on rahulik.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
en: I needed to be a little less peaceful!
et: Ma oleksin pidanud olema veidi vähem rahulik!

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
en: Swimming and battling like this… I'm one happy guy…
et: Niimoodi ujuda ja võidelda… Ma olen üks õnnelik sell…

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
en: The sea is teeming with POKéMON. It's not easy swimming, I tell you.
et: Meri kubiseb POKéMONidest. Pole kerge ujuda, ma ütlen sulle.

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
en: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are seriously tough…
et: TRAINERITE kasvatatud POKéMONid on tõsiselt kõvad…

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: Gasp… Gasp… I'm wiped out…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Ma olen läbi…

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: The going's easy. It's the leaving that's the hard part.
et: Minek on kerge. Lahkumine on see raske osa.

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: Will I have any energy left to make the return trip?
et: Kas mul jääb üldse energiat tagasireisiks?

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
en: The sea… The sea… The sea… The sea as far as these eyes can see! I'm sick and tired of the sea!
et: Meri… Meri… Meri… Meri nii kaugele kui need silmad näevad! Mul on merest kõrini!

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
en: Bleah!
et: Ptüi!

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
en: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.
et: Merest mul on igav, aga ujuma pean.

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
en: I'm a born swimmer! That's what I am.
et: Ma olen sündinud ujuja! Seda ma olen.

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
en: Hi, sweetie, wait! We should battle, you and I!
et: Tere, kullake, oota! Me peaksime võitlema, sina ja mina!

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
en: You're tough in spite of the way you look!
et: Sa oled kõva, hoolimata sellest, kuidas välja näed!

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
en: Did you see a guy over there who whines that he's bored of the sea?
et: Kas nägid seal tüüpi, kes viriseb, et tal on merest igav?

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
en: That's all talk. He's hopelessly in love with the sea!
et: See on kõik jutt. Ta on lootusetult merre armunud!

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
en: Why do men love bathing suits so much?
et: Miks mehed nii väga ujumistrikoosid armastavad?

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
en: They all ogle me!
et: Nad kõik jõllitavad mind!

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
en: I'm out of my depth!
et: Ma olen üle pea vees!

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
en: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that makes men look. It must be my beauty!
et: Ehk pole see mu ujumistrikoo, mis paneb mehed vaatama. See peab olema mu ilu!

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
en: RELI: We'll work together as siblings to take you on!
et: RELI: Me töötame koos õdede-vendadena, et sinuga jõudu katsuda!

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
en: RELI: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
et: RELI: Me ei suutnud võita, kuigi töötasime koos…

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
en: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are together with the sea and POKéMON from the time they are born.
et: RELI: PACIFIDLOGI inimesed on koos mere ja POKéMONidega ajast, mil nad sünnivad.

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
en: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON? We can't enjoy a battle, then.
et: RELI: Sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Siis me ei saa lahingut nautida.

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
en: IAN: I'm doing my best together with my sis!
et: IAN: Ma annan endast parima koos oma õega!

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
en: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but we still couldn't win…
et: IAN: Ma andsin oma õega endast parima, aga me ikka ei suutnud võita…

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
en: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is a floating town?
et: IAN: Tead ju, kuidas PACIFIDLOG on hõljuv linn?

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
en: So, wherever there is the sea, that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!
et: Nii et kus iganes on meri, see on osa PACIFIDLOGIST!

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
en: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll take you on!
et: IAN: Kui sul on kaks POKéMONi, me katsume sinuga jõudu!

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I'll give you some great information!
et: Kui suudad mind võita, ma annan sulle suurepärast teavet!

label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
en: Oh? Did I lose?
et: Oh? Kas ma kaotasin?

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
en: There is an odd place nearby. There's a huge tower there. Why don't you go take a look?
et: Läheduses on veider koht. Seal on hiiglaslik torn. Miks sa ei lähe vaatama?

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
en: The people of PACIFIDLOG are a peaceful bunch.
et: PACIFIDLOGI inimesed on rahulik kamp.

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
en: They never get angry. That goes for me, too.
et: Nad ei saa kunagi vihaseks. See kehtib ka minu kohta.

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
en: Tch! …Oh, wait. I'm not angry. Honestly!
et: Tsc! …Oh, oota. Ma pole vihane. Ausõna!

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
en: But, boy, you're strong! Hahaha!
et: Aga, poiss, sa oled tugev! Hahahaa!

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
en: I used to catch colds all the time as a kid, but I became totally fit after I started swimming.
et: Ma sain lapsena kogu aeg külmetusi, aga pärast ujuma hakkamist sain täiesti vormi.

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
en: I crave more power…
et: Ma ihkan rohkem jõudu…

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
en: TRAINERS travel the fields and mountains, so they must be fit, too.
et: TRAINERID rändavad välju ja mägesid, nii et nemadki peavad vormis olema.

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
en: I try not to swim where the currents are too strong.
et: Ma püüan mitte ujuda seal, kus vool on liiga tugev.

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
en: Oh, please, no!
et: Oh, palun, ei!

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
en: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my sense of place…
et: Kui mind minema uhutakse, ma kaotan kogu oma paigataju…

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
en: Win or lose, you'll never know until you try!
et: Võit või kaotus, sa ei tea kunagi, enne kui proovid!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
en: Waah! I sank in defeat!
et: Vaah! Ma vajusin lüüasaamisse!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
en: I never battle when I know I'll win. I like to battle at the razor's edge of victory and defeat!
et: Ma ei võitle kunagi, kui tean, et võidan. Mulle meeldib võidelda võidu ja kaotuse habemenoa teral!

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
en: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. How could you possibly beat me?
et: Ma mõtisklen POKéMONide üle 24 tundi ööpäevas. Kuidas sa saaksid mind võita?

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
en: I lose. I will concede defeat.
et: Ma kaotan. Ma tunnistan lüüasaamist.

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
en: Urggh… You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?
et: Urggh… Sa oled POKéMONi-fanaatik, kas pole?

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
en: You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day, don't you?
et: Sa pead mõtisklema POKéMONide üle 24 tundi ööpäevas, kas pole?

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
en: I'm always with my husband, but I can win even without him.
et: Ma olen alati oma abikaasaga, aga ma suudan võita isegi ilma temata.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
en: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.
et: Oh, ma vist polnud piisavalt hea.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
en: That young man over there looks just like my husband when he was young.
et: See noormees seal näeb välja täpselt nagu mu abikaasa, kui ta noor oli.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
en: He's making me blush!
et: Ta paneb mind punastama!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
en: Someone's been watching me intently. Was it you?
et: Keegi on mind tähelepanelikult jälginud. Kas see olid sina?

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
en: Wow! That's pretty strong, all right!
et: Ohoo! See on päris tugev küll!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
en: I can't shake this feeling that someone's watching me.
et: Ma ei saa lahti tundest, et keegi mind jälgib.

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
en: I can't concentrate!
et: Ma ei suuda keskenduda!

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
en: Now where could my wife have gone? I'm always with her. I wonder if I can win on my own.
et: Nüüd, kuhu mu naine küll läks? Ma olen alati temaga. Huvitav, kas ma suudan omal jõul võita.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
en: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage to win on my own after all.
et: Ah, ma näen, et ma ei suutnudki lõpuks omal jõul võita.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
en: My wife must be looking for me. I'd best go find her right away.
et: Mu naine peab mind otsima. Ma parem lähen ta kohe üles.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
en: I liked training here by myself. It's awful that all these people came!
et: Mulle meeldis siin omapäi treenida. On kohutav, et kõik need inimesed tulid!

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
en: Okay! I won't complain about other people being here.
et: Olgu! Ma ei kurda selle üle, et teised inimesed siin on.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
en: I suppose I can partner up with that old man and challenge that other team.
et: Ma vist saan selle vanamehega paari lüüa ja teisele meeskonnale väljakutse esitada.

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
en: Did the currents carry you here, too? This must have been fated. Let's battle!
et: Kas voolud kandsid sinugi siia? See pidi olema määratud. Võitleme!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
en: Strong! Too much so!
et: Tugev! Liiga palju!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
en: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER like you would drift here… I must be cursed…
et: See on lihtsalt mu õnn, et sinusugune kõva TRAINER siia triiviks… Ma pean olema needuse all…

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
en: I've led a life of woe and misery… I've been cast away, and this is where I've drifted…
et: Ma olen elanud häda ja viletsuse elu… Mind on kõrvale heidetud ja siia ma olen triivinud…

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
en: Another loss…
et: Veel üks kaotus…

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
en: A life adrift… I don't want it anymore!
et: Triiviv elu… Ma ei taha seda enam!

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
en: Welcome! I've been expecting you!
et: Tere tulemast! Ma olen sind oodanud!

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
en: No! Please!
et: Ei! Palun!

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
en: A strong child TRAINER… That's so annoying!
et: Tugev laps-TRAINER… See on nii tüütu!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
en: I want to win like everyone else, but I won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.
et: Ma tahan võita nagu kõik teised, aga ma ei kasvata POKéMONe nagu kõik teised.

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
en: Darn it! My way is still too slack!
et: Neetud! Mu moodus on ikka liiga lodev!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
en: It's way more fun to do things the way I want than to be like everybody else. I mean, that's obvious!
et: On palju lõbusam teha asju nii, nagu ma tahan, kui olla nagu kõik teised. Ma mõtlen, see on ilmselge!

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
en: I came all the way out here with my BIRD POKéMON.
et: Ma tulin kogu selle tee siia oma LINNU-POKéMONiga.

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
en: You… You're stunningly cool!
et: Sa… Sa oled jahmatavalt lahe!

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
en: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've grown to like this place, too.
et: Ma tahaksin FORTREESSE tagasi minna, aga ma olen ka selle koha armsaks saanud.

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
en: I must have battled thousands of times. I've lost count.
et: Ma pean olema võidelnud tuhandeid kordi. Ma olen arvet kaotanud.

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
en: I may have lost thousands of times, but a loss still stings.
et: Ma võin olla kaotanud tuhandeid kordi, aga kaotus torgib ikka.

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
en: Keep at this, youngster. So you can become like my husband and me.
et: Jätka seda, nooruke. Et saaksid minu ja mu abikaasa sarnaseks.

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
en: Young people are too happy to go with the flow. They're without direction.
et: Noored inimesed lasevad end liiga meelsasti vooluga kaasa viia. Nad on ilma suunata.

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
en: You have a firm sense of purpose.
et: Sul on kindel eesmärgitunne.

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
en: Don't let others lead you astray. Don't lose direction as you grow older.
et: Ära lase teistel end eksiteele viia. Ära kaota suunda, kui vanemaks saad.

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
en: Even those POKéMON that can swim are carried along by the rapid currents.
et: Isegi need POKéMONid, kes oskavad ujuda, kannavad kiired voolud kaasa.

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
en: Aiyeeeeh!
et: Aiiiih!

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
en: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running currents around these parts.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMONid naudivad siinkandi kiireid voole.

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
en: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun match. Will you join us?
et: Mu LUVDISC otsivad lõbusat matši. Kas liitud meiega?

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
en: Oopsie!
et: Uupsuke!

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
en: There's a collector who's after the SCALES of LUVDISC.
et: On üks kollektsionäär, kes jahib LUVDISCi SOOMUSEID.

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
en: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang! It's time for a match!
et: Olgu-olgu! Piisavalt puhkust, kamp! On aeg matšiks!

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
en: Tuckered out again…
et: Jälle läbi…

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
en: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after a long flight…
et: Mu LINNU-POKéMONid väsivad pärast pikka lendu kiiresti…

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER. No need for words. We battle now.
et: Sa oled POKéMON TRAINER. Pole vaja sõnu. Me võitleme nüüd.

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
en: It was I who challenged you, and yet I lost. I am deeply shamed…
et: See olin mina, kes sulle väljakutse esitas, ja ometi ma kaotasin. Mul on sügavalt häbi…

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
en: The savage tide in this area serves to make us stronger than ever.
et: Selle kandi metsik mõõn teeb meid tugevamaks kui iial varem.

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
en: I willingly concede defeat.
et: Ma tunnistan lüüasaamist meelsasti.

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
en: We will return for more training at METEOR FALLS.
et: Me naaseme METEOR FALLSISSE veel treenima.

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
en: If you'd like, you should go, too. It will definitely toughen you up!
et: Kui soovid, peaksid sinagi minema. See karastab sind kindlasti!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
en: O-our boat! The tide carried it away!
et: M-meie paat! Mõõn kandis selle minema!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
en: Awawawawah! Please, stop! Please!
et: Avavavavah! Palun, lõpeta! Palun!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
en: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed to get home?
et: Kui me ei saa SURFida, kuidas me koju peaksime saama?

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
en: Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON can still SURF, but it feels wrong.
et: Tegelikult ma tean, et minestanud POKéMON saab ikka SURFida, aga see tundub vale.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
en: Can your POKéMON dodge our lightning-quick attacks?
et: Kas su POKéMON suudab vältida meie välkkiireid rünnakuid?

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
en: I never knew such a technique existed! You've defeated us thoroughly.
et: Ma ei teadnud kunagi, et selline tehnika olemas on! Sa oled meid põhjalikult alistanud.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
en: I haven't lost my passion for speed. I will try harder.
et: Ma pole kaotanud oma kirge kiiruse vastu. Ma pingutan rohkem.

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
en: My POKéMON can't be taken down easily!
et: Mu POKéMONi ei saa kergesti maha võtta!
