label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
en: You're kidding! Explain how I lost!
et: Sa teed nalja! Seleta, kuidas ma kaotasin!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
en: Haha! You won, all right!
et: Haha! Sa võitsid küll!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
en: I'll work my way back up by taking on TRAINERS I happen to meet!
et: Ma töötan end tagasi üles, katsudes jõudu TRAINERITEGA, keda juhtun kohtama!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
en: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR around here?
et: Kuula, kas oled näinud siin kandis mõnda teist MADRUST?

label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
en: Now, that's something!
et: Nüüd, see on miski!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
en: Our boat drifted out to sea.
et: Meie paat triivis merele.

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
en: My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm worried about him.
et: Mu semu on arglik sell, nii et ma muretsen tema pärast.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON CONTEST, weren't you? It's easy to tell from your POKéMON.
et: Oh, tere! Sa olid POKéMON KONKURSIL, kas pole? Su POKéMONi järgi on seda kerge öelda.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: I'm a reporter. I'm working on a story on POKéMON CONTESTS.
et: Ma olen reporter. Ma teen lugu POKéMON KONKURSSIDEST.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: If I may, would you be willing to answer a few questions?
et: Kui tohin, kas oleksid nõus paarile küsimusele vastama?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
en: Oh, you will? Thank you.
et: Oh, kas teed? Aitäh.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
en: Briefly, how would you describe the CONTEST you just entered?
et: Lühidalt, kuidas sa kirjeldaksid KONKURSSI, kuhu just astusid?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: Ah, I see. That's a very edifying comment.
et: Ah, ma näen. See on väga õpetlik kommentaar.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: You get a good feel for what the CONTEST was like.
et: Sa saad hea ettekujutuse sellest, milline KONKURSS oli.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: I've got one last question.
et: Mul on üks viimane küsimus.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: When you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},” what image do you get?
et: Kui kuuled sõna „{STR_VAR_2}”, milline kujutluspilt sul tekib?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: I see!
et: Ma näen!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: So that's how you imagine the concept of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.
et: Nii et niimoodi sa kujutad ette mõistet „{STR_VAR_2}”.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: Thank you! You've given me some good ideas.
et: Aitäh! Sa oled mulle mõned head ideed andnud.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: I think I can write a good story on POKéMON CONTESTS now.
et: Ma arvan, et suudan nüüd kirjutada hea loo POKéMON KONKURSSIDEST.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: Maybe, just maybe, this story will even make it to television. I hope you'll look forward to it!
et: Ehk, ehk jõuab see lugu isegi telekasse. Ma loodan, et ootad seda!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
en: Oh, too bad…
et: Oh, kahju…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
en: Well, if you come across a good story, please do share it with me.
et: Noh, kui satud hea loo otsa, palun jaga seda kindlasti minuga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextContest
en: I'll be looking forward to your next POKéMON CONTEST.
et: Ma ootan su järgmist POKéMON KONKURSSI.

label: gTVBravoTrainerText00
en: Yeah! It's BRAVO TRAINER time!
et: Jah! On BRAVO TRAINERI aeg!

label: gTVBravoTrainerText00

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInterviewAgain
en: The last time we battled, we managed to look respectable.
et: Eelmisel korral, kui me võitlesime, suutsime väärikad välja näha.

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInterviewAgain
en: Anyway, what do you think? Do you want to be interviewed again?
et: Igatahes, mida sa arvad? Kas tahad end taas intervjueerida lasta?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain
en: Anyway, what do you think? Do you want to be interviewed again?
et: Igatahes, mida sa arvad? Kas tahad end taas intervjueerida lasta?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings
en: You will? Thank you!
et: Kas teed? Aitäh!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings
en: Okay, I need you to describe your feelings about our battle, but it has to be short and sweet. Go!
et: Olgu, ma vajan, et kirjeldaksid oma tundeid meie lahingu kohta, aga see peab olema lühike ja magus. Anna minna!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
en: GABBY: Mmm, yeah! That's the perfect clincher!
et: GABBY: Mmm, jah! See on täiuslik lõpuakord!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
en: I get the feeling that this will make a great TV show.
et: Mul on tunne, et sellest saab suurepärane telesaade.

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
en: There's a chance that they'll air this on TV, so make sure to look for us!
et: On võimalus, et nad näitavad seda telekas, nii et otsi meid kindlasti!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
en: Okay! We'll be seeing you!
et: Olgu! Näeme!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut
en: GABBY: Oh…
et: GABBY: Oh…

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut
en: Okay, but don't give up! We'll be keeping an eye out for you!
et: Olgu, aga ära anna alla! Me hoiame sul silma peal!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou
en: GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out for you!
et: GABBY: Me hoiame sul silma peal!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons
en: GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER anywhere with a lot of POKéMON?
et: GABBY: Kas on kuskil tugev TRAINER paljude POKéMONidega?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
en: GABBY: Wow, you are something!
et: GABBY: Ohoo, sa oled miski!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
en: You've gotten a lot stronger--a lot-since we last battled.
et: Sa oled palju tugevamaks saanud – palju – kuna me viimati võitlesime.

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
en: We were right about you when we spotted you as a hot TRAINER.
et: Meil oli sinu kohta õigus, kui märkasime sind tulise TRAINERINA.

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
en: So, anyway, what do you think? Are you willing to give us an interview this time?
et: Nii et igatahes, mida sa arvad? Kas oled nõus meile seekord intervjuu andma?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat
en: GABBY: That was an intense battle! Did you get all that on camera?
et: GABBY: See oli intensiivne lahing! Kas said selle kõik kaamerasse?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle
en: TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking TRAINER here, of all places! Camera's rolling!
et: TY: Hei, näe siia! Kõva väljanägemisega TRAINER siin, kõigist kohtadest! Kaamera käib!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro
en: TY: Hey, lookie here! I remember you!
et: TY: Hei, näe siia! Ma mäletan sind!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro
en: I'll get this battle all on this here camera!
et: Ma saan selle lahingu kõik sellesse siinsesse kaamerasse!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle
en: TY: You're a natural! Got me some prime footage right here!
et: TY: Sa oled loomutalent! Sain endale siin priimakaadrid!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons
en: TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON and that's it?
et: TY: Kas sul on ainult see üks POKéMON ja ongi kõik?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons
en: If you had more POKéMON, it'd make for better footage, but…
et: Kui sul oleks rohkem POKéMONe, tuleks parem kaadrimaterjal, aga…

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime
en: TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER. This is a huge scoop for us!
et: TY: Jah, me märkasime kindlasti tulise TRAINERI. See on meile tohutu skoop!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat
en: TY: Yep, I got it all. That whole battle's on camera.
et: TY: Jah, ma sain kõik. Kogu see lahing on kaameras.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
en: IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…
et: TRAINEREID OTSIMAS…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
en: GABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area near {STR_VAR_1}.
et: GABBY: Tere! Täna külastan ma {STR_VAR_1} lähedast ala.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
en: We're trying to spot some up-andcoming new talent in the field.
et: Me üritame märgata mõnda tõusvat uut talenti sellel alal.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
en: Today, we turned our lens on the TRAINER {PLAYER}.
et: Täna suuname me oma objektiivi TRAINERILE {PLAYER}.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
en: There's something about this TRAINER that piqued our interest.
et: Selle TRAINERI juures on midagi, mis meie huvi äratas.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
en: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we can attest that the TRAINER has most definitely improved from before.
et: Me oleme {PLAYER}-ga varem võidelnud, aga võime tõendada, et TRAINER on kindlasti endisest paremaks saanud.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
en: I knew we were onto someone special when we spotted this TRAINER!
et: Ma teadsin, et me oleme kellegi erilise jälil, kui seda TRAINERit märkasime!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: The best way to determine how strong a TRAINER is…
et: Parim viis kindlaks teha, kui tugev TRAINER on…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: Well, the fastest way is to battle. And so we began our investigation!
et: Noh, kiireim viis on võidelda. Ja nii algas meie uurimine!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: That's how we ended up in battle with {PLAYER}.
et: Nii sattusime me lahingusse {PLAYER}-ga.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: In a dominating performance, we were flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!
et: Ülekaaluka soorituse käigus lamedaks löödud, kokku rullitud ja kõrvale visatud!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: {PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…
et: {PLAYER} on halastamatult tugev…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
en: Here's our impressions after having battled our featured TRAINER.
et: Siin on meie muljed pärast oma esiletõstetud TRAINERIGA võitlemist.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_3} was divine!
et: Kombinatsioon {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_3} oli jumalik!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: The sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting each other in the thick of battle…
et: Vaatepilt neist – {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_3} – ennastsalgavalt teineteist lahingu tulipunktis toetamas…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: It was a marvelous sight to behold!
et: See oli imeline vaatepilt!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: {STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER used last in our battle.
et: {STR_VAR_2} oli võte, mida TRAINER meie lahingus viimasena kasutas.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: The move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!
et: Võte {STR_VAR_2} on {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_3} sõpruse märk!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: …I lost confidence in myself as a result of our encounter.
et: …Ma kaotasin meie kohtumise tulemusena usu iseendasse.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: We were beaten before we could launch a single attack. Ohhh… Snivel…
et: Meid võideti, enne kui me ühtki rünnakut käivitada jõudsime. Ohhh… Nuuks…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: In spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles are worth seeing.
et: Sellest hoolimata on {PLAYER} lahinguid tasub näha.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: I recommend confident TRAINERS to challenge {PLAYER}.
et: Ma soovitan enesekindlatel TRAINERITEL {PLAYER}-le väljakutse esitada.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: There's only one thing to be said. Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during a TRAINER battle!
et: On vaid üks asi öelda. Ära julge TRAINERI-lahingu ajal POKé BALLi visata!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: {PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has no clue about the basic rules.
et: {PLAYER} on kindlasti tugev, aga tal pole aimugi põhireeglitest.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: To our TV audience, I have a request.
et: Meie TV-publikule on mul palve.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: If you see {PLAYER}, please caution the TRAINER!
et: Kui näed {PLAYER}, palun hoiata seda TRAINERit!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
en: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the opponent's actions.
et: {PLAYER} on osav vastase tegude ette lugemises.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
en: The timing of item usage was remarkably effective!
et: Esemete kasutamise ajastus oli tähelepanuväärselt tõhus!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: Honestly speaking, I thought that I might even be pretty good.
et: Ausalt öeldes ma arvasin, et ma võin isegi päris hea olla.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: While we did end up losing, we did have a hotly contested battle.
et: Kuigi me lõpuks kaotasime, oli meil tuliselt vaieldud lahing.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: But if you're struggling against me, you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!
et: Aga kui sa minu vastu jännis oled, on sul omajagu minna, {PLAYER}!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for a succinct summary.
et: Pärast meie lahingut palusime {PLAYER}-lt lühikest kokkuvõtet.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: The TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”
et: TRAINER vastas: „{STR_VAR_1}.”

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: {PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3}… And “{STR_VAR_1}”…
et: {PLAYER} POKéMONid {STR_VAR_2} ja {STR_VAR_3}… Ja „{STR_VAR_1}”…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: Mmm! That's deep! There's deep significance behind that quote!
et: Mmm! See on sügav! Selle tsitaadi taga on sügav tähendus!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: It's no surprise--a good TRAINER has good things to say.
et: Pole üllatus – heal TRAINERIL on häid asju öelda.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: That's all for today! See you again on our next broadcast!
et: See on tänaseks kõik! Näeme jälle meie järgmises saates!

et: „POKéMON KONKURSI OTSEUUENDUSED!”

en: May I congratulate you on your win?
et: Kas tohin sind võidu puhul õnnitleda?

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Won
en: What was the key factor in today's stunning victory?
et: Mis oli tänase jahmatava võidu võtmetegur?

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Won
en: BEAUTY: We gave it our best effort today, my {STR_VAR_2} and I!
et: BEAUTY: Me andsime täna endast parima, mina ja mu {STR_VAR_2}!

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Won
en: But I'm sure we wouldn't have made it if it weren't for all the help we received leading up to the CONTEST!
et: Aga ma olen kindel, et me poleks hakkama saanud, kui poleks kogu abi, mida saime enne KONKURSSI!

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Won
en: MC: Do you have a special someone with whom you'd like to share your joy? Let's hear it live!
et: MC: Kas on keegi eriline, kellega sa tahaksid oma rõõmu jagada? Kuulakem seda otse!

en: BEAUTY: Hey, out there!
et: BEAUTY: Hei, seal väljas!

en: {STR_VAR_3}! Are you watching? We did it! Thank you!
et: {STR_VAR_3}! Kas sa vaatad? Me tegime seda! Aitäh!

en: MC: Excuse me! Thanks for joining us on live TV!
et: MC: Vabandust! Aitäh, et liitusite meiega otsetelevisioonis!

en: You must be disappointed by that turn of events. Do you have any comments?
et: Sa pead olema sellest sündmuste pöördest pettunud. Kas sul on kommentaare?

en: BEAUTY: It's heartbreaking… My {STR_VAR_2} and I, we did our best…
et: BEAUTY: See on südantlõhestav… Mina ja mu {STR_VAR_2}, me andsime endast parima…

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost
en: But I feel like I've let down everyone who has supported us through this.
et: Aga ma tunnen, nagu oleksin alt vedanud kõiki, kes on meid selle jooksul toetanud.

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost
en: MC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's coloration is a little wanting.
et: MC: Mul on vastumeelt seda öelda, aga POKéMONi värvus jätab veidi soovida.

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost
en: BEAUTY: {STR_VAR_3}, I'm so sorry… I'll do better next time, I swear… …Sniff… Waaaaah!
et: BEAUTY: {STR_VAR_3}, mul on nii kahju… Ma teen järgmine kord paremini, ma vannun… …Nuuks… Vaaaaah!

et: Pealtvaatajad: Kas nägite seda? Vaene tüdruk!

et: MC: Öö… Oh-oo…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeCorridor_Text_YourChallengeHasBegun
en: Your Battle Choice challenge has now begun…
et: Su Battle Choice väljakutse on nüüd alanud…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
et: WATTSON, MAUVILLE GYMi JUHT, kasutab ELEKTRI-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you challenge him with WATER-type POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!
et: Kui kutsud ta välja VEE-tüüpi POKéMONidega, ta kõrvetab neid! Bzzt!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And, he's put in switch-controlled doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!
et: Ja ta on pannud üle kogu SAALI lülititega juhitavad uksed! Ekstsentriline!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, go for it!
et: Hei, anna minna!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoa, you're electrifying! You've powered the door open!
et: Ohoo, sa oled elektriseeriv! Sa lülitasid ukse lahti!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
en: My electric soul, it'll shatter your dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
et: Mu elektrihing, see purustab su unistused tervelt, ohoo-jeeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
en: That was plugged in, amped up, over-driven electric, man!
et: See oli sisse pistetud, võimendatud, ülekuumendatud elekter, mees!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
en: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart, whoa-yeah!
et: POKéMONid ja rokk, kõik seisneb südames, ohoo-jeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
en: I trained under WATTSON! There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
et: Ma treenisin WATTSONI käe all! Pole võimalik, et ma kergesti kaotan!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
en: Unplugged and turned off…
et: Vooluvõrgust lahti ja välja lülitatud…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been around for a long, long time.
et: WATTSON, meie SAALI JUHT, on kaua-kaua aega tegutsenud.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: He was battling even before your daddy was born, that tough coot.
et: Ta võitles juba enne, kui su vanaisa sündis, see sitke tegelane.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
en: This GYM's got puzzles! Isn't it fun?
et: Sellel SAALIL on mõistatused! Kas pole lõbus?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
en: It's no fun to lose…
et: Kaotada pole lõbus…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
en: WATTSON says he likes setting up little traps with switches.
et: WATTSON ütleb, et talle meeldib lülititega väikeseid lõkse üles seada.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
en: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves, you'll be shocked!
et: Mu võlu ja mu POKéMONide võtetega saad sa šoki!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
en: I'm shocked by your power!
et: Ma olen su jõust šokeeritud!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded by WATTSON.
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et MAUVILLE'i rajas WATTSON.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: He was a TRAINER long before we became TRAINERS. He must know all sorts of things!
et: Ta oli TRAINER ammu enne, kui meie TRAINERiteks saime. Ta peab teadma igasuguseid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
en: I love shiny things!
et: Ma armastan läikivaid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
en: Oh… My eyes are frazzled…
et: Oh… Mu silmad on kurnatud…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
en: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny forehead. It makes me happy!
et: MAUVILLE GYMi WATTSONIL on läikiv laup. See teeb mind õnnelikuks!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: I've given up on my plans to convert the city, I have.
et: Ma olen loobunud oma plaanidest linna ümber teha, olen küll.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: And so, I put my time into making door traps in my GYM.
et: Ja nii panen ma oma aja oma SAALIS uksekelkude tegemisse.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Oh? Now, what are you doing here?
et: Oh? Nüüd, mida sa siin teed?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: What's that? You say you've gotten past all my rigged doors?
et: Mis see on? Sa ütled, et said mööda kõigist mu manipuleeritud ustest?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing!
et: Vahahahaa! Nüüd, see on lõbus!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
et: Siis mina, WATTSON, MAUVILLE GYMi JUHT, elektriseerin sind!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost!
et: Vahahahaa! Hüva, ma kaotasin!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this BADGE!
et: Sa suutsid mulle põnevust pakkuda! Võta see MÄRK!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE from WATTSON.
et: {PLAYER} sai WATTSONILT DYNAMO BADGE'i.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can use ROCK SMASH out of battle.
et: DYNAMO BADGE'iga saavad POKéMONid kasutada võtet ROCK SMASH väljaspool lahingut.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: And, it will make your POKéMON a little bit faster, too.
et: Ja see teeb su POKéMONid ka veidi kiiremaks.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: Hmm… You should take this, too!
et: Hmm… Sa peaksid ka selle võtma!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.
et: See TM34 seal sisaldab võtet SHOCK WAVE.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: It's a trustworthy move that never misses! You can count on it!
et: See on usaldusväärne võte, mis kunagi mööda ei lähe! Sa võid sellele loota!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson

et: SAALI JUHT WATTSON registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
en: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising young TRAINER like you!
et: Ma pakatan optimismist, nähes sinusugust paljutõotavat noort TRAINERit!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
en: Wahahahah! Go forth and endeavor, youngster!
et: Vahahahaa! Mine edasi ja pingutu, nooruke!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
en: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON!
et: WATTSON: Ahaa! Lõpuks siin! Ma tean, mida sa tahad. Sa tahad võidelda mu POKéMONidega!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
en: Wahahahaha!
et: Vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
en: I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
et: Ma panen sinust sädemeid lendama! Ära ütle, et ma sind ei hoiatanud!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchDefeat
en: Oof… Our batteries ran dry…
et: Uhh… Meie akud said tühjaks…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our batteries again.
et: WATTSON: Me peame oma akud taas laadima.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: When we're fully charged up, we'll gladly accept your challenge.
et: Kui oleme täielikult laetud, võtame su väljakutse hea meelega vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
en: So, come back again sometime, won't you?
et: Nii et tule kunagi jälle, eks?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! I know what you want. You want to battle my POKéMON!
et: WATTSON: Ahaa! Lõpuks siin! Ma tean, mida sa tahad. Sa tahad võidelda mu POKéMONidega!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Wahahahaha!
et: Vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oops! Wait! You've only one POKéMON with you!
et: Uups! Oota! Sul on kaasas vaid üks POKéMON!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Come see me with two or more POKéMON, all right?
et: Tule mind vaatama kahe või enama POKéMONiga, olgu?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PlayerStepForward

en: Your POKéMON will be restored to full health.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
en: Next up, your second opponent! Are you ready to move on?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent

et: Järgmisena su viies vastane! Kas oled valmis edasi minema?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
en: Next up, your seventh opponent! Are you ready to move on?
et: Järgmisena su seitsmes vastane! Kas oled valmis edasi minema?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndShutDown
en: Would you like to save the game and shut down now?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja nüüd sulgeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Set KO Tourney challenge?
et: Kas soovid loobuda oma Set KO turniiri väljakutsest?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
en: I am saving your game data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan su mänguandmeid. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastBattle
en: Would you like to record your last battle on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase lahingu FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: Your skill level is truly astounding!
et: Sinu oskuste tase on tõesti hämmastav!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
en: We now would like you to face our leader, the ARENA TYCOON!
et: Nüüd sooviksime, et astuksid vastu meie juhile, ARENA TÜKOONILE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon
en: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON! Are you prepared?
et: Lahing ARENA TÜKOONIGA! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta
en: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON! Make way for GRETA!
et: KOHTUNIK: ARENA TÜKOON! Tehke teed GRETALE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!
et: GRETA: Hei! Tervist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
en: …Wait, are you the challenger?
et: …Oot, kas sina oled väljakutsuja?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
en: Is that right? Hmm… Hmhm…
et: On või? Hmm… Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: I don't know how to say it, but… To put it bluntly, you look pretty weak. Are you sure you're up for me?
et: Ma ei tea, kuidas seda öelda, aga… Otse öeldes näed sa üsna nõrk välja. Kas sa oled kindel, et saad minuga hakkama?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Well, all right! We'll take things easy to start with!
et: No hüva! Alustame rahulikult!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
en: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
et: Olgu! Näita, kuidas süütad mu võitluskire!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: GRETA: Ow, wait a second! You are tough after all!
et: GRETA: Oi, oota hetk! Sa oled ikkagi sitke!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: I like you! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: Sa meeldid mulle! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
en: The Guts Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Guts-sümbol pressiti FRONTIER PASSile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: It's going to be fun the next time! I'm looking forward to it!
et: Järgmine kord tuleb lõbus! Ma ootan seda!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy! You finally won your way up to me!
et: GRETA: Hei! Tervist! Sa lõpuks võitlesid end minuni!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: I was getting worried waiting for you! I was really looking forward to seeing you again!
et: Ma juba muretsesin sind oodates! Ma tõesti ootasin sinuga taaskohtumist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
en: … … … So, are you ready?
et: … … … Niisiis, kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
en: I won't allow a halfhearted effort! Be ready for a thrashing!
et: Ma ei luba poolikut pingutust! Ole valmis keretäieks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
en: Come on, REFEREE! Let's get this started!
et: Tule, KOHTUNIK! Alustame!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
en: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS!
et: GRETA: Ahh! Minema paisatud! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Guts Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Guts-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: Arrrgh! This is so infuriating!
et: Ahh! See on nii ärritav!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: If we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
et: Kui me kunagi taas võitleme, ma ei kaota! Ära seda unusta! Hüvasti!

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC… He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…
et: Mu suur vend on FOSSIILIMAANIK… Ta on tore sell, kes armastab FOSSIILE…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: He loves digging holes, too… He dug this hole by himself…
et: Talle meeldib ka auke kaevata… Ta kaevas selle augu ise…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: You can have this, so you can DIG holes just like my big brother…
et: Sa võid selle saada, nii et saad KAEVATA auke just nagu mu suur vend…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
en: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a cave, you're returned to the entrance…
et: Kui paned POKéMONi koopas KAEVAMA, viiakse sind sissepääsu juurde tagasi…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
en: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the display case…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
en: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA… HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND… STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls
en: Oh, they're so nice! I wish I had them! Cute cushions! Big plush DOLLS! Little plush DOLLS! I wish I had them all!

et: Jäta see oma emme hooleks!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
en: If it's anything you want, I'll go through anything to get it, honey!
et: Kui see on midagi, mida sa tahad, teen ma kõike, et see saada, kullake!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher

en: A TOTODILE DOLL. Place it on a mat or a desk.

en: A large DOLL. Place it on a mat or a desk.
et: Suur NUKK. Aseta see matile või lauale.

en: Raises the stat ATTACK of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_CalciumDesc
en: Raises the stat SP. ATK of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi ER. RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_IronDesc
en: Raises the stat DEFENSE of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ZincDesc
en: Raises the stat SP. DEF of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi ER. KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_CarbosDesc
en: Raises the stat SPEED of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi KIIRUST.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_HPUpDesc
en: Raises the HP of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi elupunkte.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_LeftoversDesc
en: A hold item that gradually restores HP in battle.
et: Hoitav ese, mis taastab lahingus tasapisi elupunkte.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WhiteHerbDesc
en: A hold item that restores any lowered stat.
et: Hoitav ese, mis taastab iga langenud näitaja.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_QuickClawDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally allows the first strike.
et: Hoitav ese, mis vahel lubab esimese löögi.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MentalHerbDesc
en: A hold item that snaps POKéMON out of infatuation.
et: Hoitav ese, mis toob POKéMONi armumisest välja.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_BrightpowderDesc
en: A hold item that casts a glare to reduce accuracy.
et: Hoitav ese, mis heidab pilgu, et vähendada täpsust.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ChoiceBandDesc
en: Raises a move's power, but permits only that move.
et: Tõstab ühe võtte jõudu, kuid lubab kasutada vaid seda.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_KingsRockDesc
en: A hold item that may cause flinching when the foe is hit.
et: Hoitav ese, mis võib vaenlast tabades panna võpatama.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_FocusBandDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally prevents fainting.
et: Hoitav ese, mis vahel hoiab ära minestamise.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ScopeLensDesc
en: A hold item that raises the critical-hit rate.
et: Hoitav ese, mis tõstab kriitiliste tabamuste määra.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Jou, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: FORTREE GYMi SAALI JUHT WINONA on LENDAV-tüüpi POKéMONide meister.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting at the back of this GYM, behind the rotating doors.
et: Ta ootab selle SAALI tagaosas, pöörlevate uste taga.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting for new challengers who are trying to take wing!
et: Ta ootab uusi väljakutsujaid, kes üritavad lendu tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Okay, go for it!
et: Olgu, anna minna!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: You did it! You've achieved liftoff!
et: Sa tegid ära! Sa tõusid õhku!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
en: Behold the elegant battle style of BIRD POKéMON!
et: Vaata LINNU-POKéMONide elegantset võitlusstiili!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
en: You… You're strong…
et: Sa… Sa oled tugev…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep up with unexpected turns of events.
et: TRAINER peab olema nutikas, et pidada sammu ootamatute sündmuste pööretega.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: Do you have the smarts to get to our LEADER?
et: Kas sul on nutti meie JUHINI jõuda?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire to join this GYM.
et: LINNU-POKéMONide armastajad ihkavad selle SAALIGA liituda.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: As a member of the FORTREE GYM, I'm not allowed to lose!
et: FORTREE GYMi liikmena ei tohi ma kaotada!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
en: It was too much of a load for me to bear…
et: See oli mulle liiga suur koorem kanda…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: The world is huge, and there are countless tough TRAINERS.
et: Maailm on tohutu ja seal on lugematult sitkeid TRAINEReid.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: I'm going to keep training and make myself even stronger.
et: Ma jätkan treenimist ja teen end veelgi tugevamaks.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM LEADER, to deal with you!
et: Pole vaja, et WINONA, meie SAALI JUHT, sinuga tegeleks!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: I'm plenty good enough for you!
et: Mina olen sinu jaoks küllalt hea!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
en: WINONA, I… I lost!
et: WINONA, ma… ma kaotasin!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: WINONA is cute and she's strong. She's the ultimate LEADER!
et: WINONA on nunnu ja ta on tugev. Ta on ülim JUHT!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: Blush…
et: Punastan…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
en: WINONA taught me personally! You can't beat me easily!
et: WINONA õpetas mind isiklikult! Sa ei võida mind kergesti!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Mind võideti…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
en: Thanks to WINONA, the people of FORTREE can live without fear.
et: Tänu WINONALE saavad FORTREE inimesed elada ilma hirmuta.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
en: When WINONA takes to battle, her face shines with beautiful determination…
et: Kui WINONA lahingusse astub, särab ta nägu kaunist sihikindlusest…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
en: I'm not letting you witness that lovely sight!
et: Ma ei lase sul seda armsat vaatepilti näha!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
en: Urk! I couldn't stop you.
et: Ürk! Ma ei suutnud sind peatada.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
en: You'd better watch it! Don't get distracted staring at WINONA or you'll go crashing down in a heap!
et: Parem ole valvas! Ära lase end WINONA vahtimisest häirida, muidu kukud virna maha!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You'd better know that there are all sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: Parem tea, et on igasuguseid LENDAV-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You do know that, right?
et: Sa tead seda, eks?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
en: You seem to know your stuff!
et: Sa näidki oma asja tundvat!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
en: Sure, you beat me all right. But you'd better watch it! Our LEADER WINONA's POKéMON are all business.
et: Muidugi, sa võitsid mu ausalt. Aga parem ole valvas! Meie JUHT WINONA POKéMONid on täieline äri.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.
et: Ma olen WINONA. Ma olen FORTREE POKéMON GYMi JUHT.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I have become one with BIRD POKéMON and have soared the skies…
et: Ma olen saanud LINNU-POKéMONidega üheks ja hõljunud taevas…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: However grueling the battle, we have triumphed with grace…
et: Kui kurnav lahing ka poleks, oleme triumfeerinud graatsiaga…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: Witness the elegant choreography of BIRD POKéMON and I!
et: Vaata LINNU-POKéMONide ja minu elegantset koreograafiat!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: Never before have I seen a TRAINER command POKéMON with more grace than I…
et: Ma pole kunagi näinud TRAINERit, kes juhiks POKéMONe suurema graatsiaga kui mina…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this GYM BADGE.
et: Su võimekuse tunnustuseks kingin sulle selle GYM BADGE'i.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE from WINONA.
et: {PLAYER} sai WINONALT FEATHER BADGE'i.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up to LV 70, even those received through trades, will obey your every command.
et: FEATHER BADGE'iga kuuletuvad kõik POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 70, isegi need, keda saad kaubeldes, sinu igale käsule.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: You will also be able to use the HM move FLY outside of battle.
et: Sa saad ka kasutada HM-võtet FLY väljaspool lahingut.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: And this… This is a gift from me.
et: Ja see… See on kingitus minult.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.
et: TM40 sisaldab võtet AERIAL ACE.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: Its speed… No POKéMON should be able to avoid it.
et: Selle kiirus… Ükski POKéMON ei tohiks suuta seda vältida.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
en: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT WINONA registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
en: Though I fell to you, I will remain devoted to BIRD POKéMON.
et: Kuigi ma langesin sulle, jään ma LINNU-POKéMONidele truuks.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: WINONA SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse kunagi raskusjõu tõmbest maapinnal.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Aga täiuslikkuse poole püüeldes on meil jõud lennata!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Sa oled tõusnud tippu kui valitsev MEISTER.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, luba mul näha su jõudu täies lennus!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
en: I failed to reach your height again…
et: Ma ei suutnud jälle su kõrgusele jõuda…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: WINONA: Even though I have lost, the wings of my heart remain unbroken.
et: WINONA: Kuigi ma kaotasin, jäävad mu südame tiivad murdmata.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I can rise and soar again and yet again.
et: Ma saan tõusta ja hõljuda taas ja jälle.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I am convinced of it!
et: Ma olen selles veendunud!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse kunagi raskusjõu tõmbest maapinnal.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Aga täiuslikkuse poole püüeldes on meil jõud lennata!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Sa oled tõusnud tippu kui valitsev MEISTER.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, luba mul näha su jõudu täies lennus!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh, no… Do you have but one POKéMON with you?
et: Oh ei… Kas sul on kaasas vaid üks POKéMON?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please return with two POKéMON at the very least.
et: Palun tule tagasi vähemalt kahe POKéMONiga.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
en: This is our special exhibit hall.
et: See on meie eriline näitusesaal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: As you can plainly see, there is not a single painting on exhibit.
et: Nagu selgelt näed, pole väljas ainustki maali.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of so-called classical art.
et: Siin ma ei soovi eksponeerida nn klassikalise kunsti teoseid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Such classical works you can see on our ground floor.
et: Selliseid klassikalisi töid näed meie alumisel korrusel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: I wish to exhibit work that is far different from the classics.
et: Ma soovin eksponeerida tööd, mis on klassikast täiesti erinev.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Art, after all, is not restricted to old, famous works!
et: Kunst pole ju piiratud vanade kuulsate töödega!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…
et: Selle näitusesaali soovin täita…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Modern and vibrant artworks of POKéMON seemingly ready to spring forth into glorious life!
et: Kaasaegsete ja elavate POKéMONi kunstiteostega, mis näivad valmis olevat hiilgavasse ellu ärkama!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: I beg your pardon. I didn't intend to monopolize the conversation.
et: Vabandust. Ma ei kavatsenud vestlust monopoliseerida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: Now, as you are young, and yet obviously well traveled…
et: Nüüd, kuna sa oled noor ja ometi ilmselgelt palju rännanud…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: You must encounter lively POKéMON and works of art depicting them.
et: Sa pead kohtama elavaid POKéMONe ja neid kujutavaid kunstiteoseid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: If you were to come across such a painting, may we ask you to obtain the artist's permission to exhibit it here?
et: Kui sa juhtuksid sellise maali otsa sattuma, kas võime paluda sul hankida kunstniku luba selle siin eksponeerimiseks?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
en: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with modern and vibrant paintings of POKéMON.
et: Ma soovin täita selle näitusesaali kaasaegsete ja elavate POKéMONi maalidega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thanks to you, we've added a new painting to our collection!
et: Tänu sinule lisasime oma kollektsiooni uue maali!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: I've heard it depicts your POKéMON. Truly magnificent!
et: Ma kuulsin, et see kujutab sinu POKéMONi. Tõeliselt suurejooneline!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thank you so very, very much!
et: Suur, suur tänu sulle!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
en: Ah! It's you! {PLAYER}!
et: Ah! Sina! {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Isn't this marvelous? This collection of paintings!
et: Kas pole imeline? See maalide kollektsioon!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Each one of them flawless! None better than another!
et: Iga üksik neist laitmatu! Ükski pole teisest parem!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: These paintings have attracted more guests to our ART MUSEUM.
et: Need maalid on meelitanud rohkem külalisi meie ART MUSEUMisse.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}. This is my dream come true!
et: Siiralt, ma tänan sind, {PLAYER}. See on mu unistuse täitumine!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
en: This is merely a token of my gratitude.
et: See on lihtsalt mu tänu märk.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
en: I will keep this for you until we meet again.
et: Ma hoian seda sinu jaoks, kuni me taas kohtume.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!
et: Ah, nii tore sind näha, {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: It's an honor to have you visit us on your busy journeys.
et: On au, et sa meid oma kiirete rännakute jooksul külastad.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Please, relax and do enjoy your visit with us.
et: Palun, lõõgastu ja naudi oma külaskäiku meile.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with pink-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam roosat värvi kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with yellow-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam kollast värvi kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with blue-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam sinist värvi kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with red-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam punast värvi kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with green-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam rohelist värvi kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
en: It's a painting of POKéMON.
et: See on maal POKéMONidest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I've been away awhile, so the new paintings up here surprised me.
et: Ma olen mõnda aega eemal olnud, nii et need uued maalid siin üleval üllatasid mind.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I wish someone would paint my POKéMON this pretty.
et: Ma sooviksin, et keegi maaliks mu POKéMONi nii ilusaks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: Well… So this is where they show the topical POKéMON paintings.
et: Noh… Nii et siin näidatakse päevakajalisi POKéMONi maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: I see, these new paintings are indeed rather amusing.
et: Ma näen, need uued maalid on tõesti üsna lõbusad.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Wow, is that right? These paintings are of your POKéMON.
et: Ohoo, on või? Need maalid on sinu POKéMONidest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Isn't that just the ultimate joy for a TRAINER?
et: Kas pole see TRAINERile ülim rõõm?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: What a TRAINER needs…
et: Mida TRAINER vajab…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability…
et: Teadmisi… Strateegiat… Õnne… Julgust… Vaimu… Vaprust… Ja võimekust…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building!
et: Noh, mina olen igas mõttes valmis! Ma olen igas hoones peatamatu!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Huh? POKéMON? What's that?
et: Ää? POKéMON? Mis see on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS?
et: Kas tead FRONTIER BRAINSist?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Nii kutsub SCOTT seitset erilist TRAINERit, kes juhivad BATTLE FRONTIERi seitset rajatist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling!
et: BATTLE TOWERis ütles üks vanem tüdruk mulle, et mul on võitlemises palju annet!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I like POKéMON CONTESTS more!
et: Mulle meeldivad POKéMON VÕISTLUSED rohkem!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: But I'm no good at CONTESTS!
et: Aga ma pole VÕISTLUSTES hea!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.
et: Vist pole ande omamine ja millegi meeldimine sama asi.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Uh… Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.
et: Äh… Oh, jah, ma olen MOVE DELETER.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: I can make POKéMON forget their moves.
et: Ma saan panna POKéMONid oma võtteid unustama.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Would you like me to do that?
et: Kas sooviksid, et ma seda teeksin?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
en: Which POKéMON should forget a move?
et: Milline POKéMON peaks võtte unustama?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Which move should be forgotten?
et: Milline võte tuleks unustada?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move so it can't be forgotten…
et: {STR_VAR_1} oskab vaid ühte võtet, nii et seda ei saa unustada…

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? That move should be forgotten?
et: Hm! {STR_VAR_1} võte {STR_VAR_2}? Kas see võte tuleks unustada?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: It worked to perfection!
et: See toimis täiuslikult!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} has forgotten {STR_VAR_2} completely.
et: {STR_VAR_1} on võtte {STR_VAR_2} täielikult unustanud.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
en: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
et: Tule jälle, kui on võtteid, mida vaja unustada.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
en: What? No EGG should know any moves.
et: Mis? Ükski MUNA ei tohiks ühtki võtet osata.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Hm!
et: Hm!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Your {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing to forget SURF.
et: Su {STR_VAR_1} ei näi olevat nõus SURFi unustama.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out and cycle as fast as you'd like.
et: JALGRATTATEEL saad anda kõik ja sõita nii kiiresti kui tahad.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: It feels great to go that fast, but try not to crash into anyone!
et: On suurepärane tunne nii kiiresti kihutada, aga püüa mitte kellelegi otsa sõita!

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING ROAD. It's too dangerous.
et: Vabandust, sa ei saa JALGRATTATEEL kõndida. See on liiga ohtlik.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Please come back with a BIKE.
et: Palun tule tagasi JALGRATTAGA.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
en: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.
et: ARCHIE: Pea sealsamas kinni.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu… So it was you, after all.
et: ARCHIE: Fufufu… Nii et see olidki sina, lõppude lõpuks.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: ARCHIE: Behold!
et: ARCHIE: Ennäe!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: See how beautiful it is, the sleeping form of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!
et: Vaata, kui ilus see on, muistse POKéMONi KYOGRE magav kuju!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: I have waited so long for this day to come…
et: Ma olen nii kaua oodanud selle päeva saabumist…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've managed to chase me here.
et: ARCHIE: Mind üllatab, kuidas sa suutsid mind siia taga ajada.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: But that's all over now.
et: Aga see kõik on nüüd läbi.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: For the realization of my dream, you must disappear now!
et: Minu unistuse teostumise nimel pead sa nüüd kaduma!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
en: What?! I lost to a mere child like you?!
et: Mida?! Ma kaotasin sinusugusele lihtsale lapsele?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu…
et: ARCHIE: Fufufu…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: I commend you. I must recognize that you are truly gifted.
et: Ma kiidan sind. Ma pean tunnistama, et sa oled tõeliselt andekas.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: But! I have this in my possession!
et: Aga! Mul on see oma valduses!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: With this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…
et: Selle RED ORBIGA saan ma teha KYOGRE…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
en: The RED ORB suddenly began shining by itself!
et: RED ORB hakkas järsku iseenesest helendama!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: ARCHIE: What?!
et: ARCHIE: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: I didn't do anything. Why did the RED ORB…
et: Ma ei teinud midagi. Miks küll RED ORB…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: Where did KYOGRE go?
et: Kuhu KYOGRE läks?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
en: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our members outside…
et: ARCHIE: Hm? See on sõnum meie väljas olevatelt liikmetelt…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?
et: ARCHIE: Jah, mis on?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hm… It's raining heavily?
et: Hm… Sajab tugevalt?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Good… That should have happened. That is why we awakened KYOGRE, to realize TEAM AQUA's vision of expanding the sea.
et: Hea… Nii pidigi juhtuma. Just seepärast me äratasime KYOGRE, et teostada TEAM AQUA nägemus mere laiendamisest.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: It's raining far harder than we envisioned? You're in danger?
et: Sajab palju tugevamini, kui me ette nägime? Sa oled ohus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: That can't be… That's just not possible…
et: See ei saa olla… See lihtsalt pole võimalik…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hold your position and monitor the situation!
et: Hoia oma positsiooni ja jälgi olukorda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…
et: ARCHIE: Midagi on valesti…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: The RED ORB is supposed to awaken and control KYOGRE…
et: RED ORB peaks KYOGRE äratama ja juhtima…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: But… Why? Why did KYOGRE disappear?
et: Aga… Miks? Miks KYOGRE kadus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: Why?!
et: Miks?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: MAXIE: What have you wrought?
et: MAXIE: Mille sa oled korda saatnud?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: ARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE, haven't you?
et: ARCHIE… Sa oled lõpuks KYOGRE äratanud, kas pole?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: What will happen to the world if this downpour continues for all eternity?
et: Mis juhtub maailmaga, kui see paduvihm igavesti jätkub?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: The world's landmass will drown in the deepening sea…
et: Maailma maismaa upub aina süvenevasse merre…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: ARCHIE: W-what?! Don't get all high and mighty with me!
et: ARCHIE: M-mida?! Ära ole minu vastu nii üleolev!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: Wasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that infuriated GROUDON?
et: Kas polnud see mitte sina, TEAM MAGMA, kes GROUDONI raevu ajas?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: So long as I have this RED ORB, I should be able to control KYOGRE…
et: Niikaua kui mul on see RED ORB, peaksin ma suutma KYOGRET juhtida…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: I should be able to control it…
et: Ma peaksin suutma seda juhtida…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: MAXIE: We don't have the time to argue about it here!
et: MAXIE: Meil pole aega siin selle üle vaielda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: Get outside and see for yourself!
et: Mine välja ja vaata ise!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: See if what you've wrought is the world that we desired!
et: Vaata, kas see, mille sa oled korda saatnud, on maailm, mida me soovisime!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have to get out of here, too!
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, kuule, sinagi pead siit välja saama!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: My papa told me.
et: Mu papa rääkis mulle.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: He says this tunnel is full of timid POKéMON.
et: Ta ütleb, et see tunnel on täis arglikke POKéMONe.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: They get all scared of loud noise and make a big uproar.
et: Nad ehmuvad valjust mürast ja tekitavad suure möllu.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: So they had to stop the big tunnel project.
et: Nii et nad pidid suure tunneliprojekti peatama.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: But there's one man. He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!
et: Aga on üks mees. Ta üritab tunnelit üksinda kaevata!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: There was a man who dug a tunnel for a lady he loved.
et: Oli üks mees, kes kaevas tunneli naise jaoks, keda ta armastas.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: I don't really get it, but hey!
et: Ma päris ei saa aru, aga no mis siis!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction.
et: Nii nagu tuuled puhuvad, ei kanta vulkaanituhka kunagi siia suunda.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The air is clean and delicious here. Living here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.
et: Õhk on siin puhas ja maitsev. Siin elamine peaks imet tegema isegi nõrkade ja põdurate inimeste jaoks.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding a hot winning streak.
et: Mina ja mu POKéMONid, meil on olnud tuline võiduseeria.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT debut in this town.
et: Nii et ma otsustasin teha oma BATTLE TENT debüüdi selles linnas.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: Did you see the cave next to the POKéMON MART?
et: Kas nägid koobast POKéMON MARTi kõrval?

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: There's a guy in there who's trying to bust up boulders so he can bust out through to the other side.
et: Seal sees on üks tüüp, kes üritab rahne lõhkuda, et teisele poole läbi murda.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: It'd be great if we could go through… It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.
et: Oleks suurepärane, kui saaksime läbi minna… See teeb RUSTBORO külastamise kergeks.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: That cave next to the POKéMON MART is now a tunnel to the other side.
et: See koobas POKéMON MARTi kõrval on nüüd tunnel teisele poole.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: It's great--it's easy to go shop for new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.
et: See on suurepärane – nüüd on kerge minna RUSTBOROSSE uusi DEVONI tooteid ostma.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: VERDANTURF TOWN
et: VERDANTURF TOWN

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: “The windswept highlands with the sweet fragrance of grass.”
et: „Tuulepealsed mägismaad rohu magusa lõhnaga.”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
en: WANDA'S HOUSE
et: WANDA MAJA

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”
et: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURFI PAIK „Naudi silmailu lahingutest!”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL „Ühendab RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURFI”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: „Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud.”

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: That PC in the corner there is for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.
et: See PC seal nurgas on igale POKéMON TRAINERile kasutamiseks.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: Naturally, that means you're welcome to use it, too.
et: Loomulikult tähendab see, et ka sina oled teretulnud seda kasutama.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: POKéMON CENTERS are great!
et: POKéMON CENTERID on suurepärased!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: You can use their services as much as you like, and it's all for free. You never have to worry!
et: Sa saad nende teenuseid kasutada nii palju kui tahad, ja kõik on tasuta. Sa ei pea kunagi muretsema!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisel korrusel olev POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB ehitati hiljuti.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: But they say they're still making adjustments.
et: Aga nad ütlevad, et nad teevad veel häälestusi.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisel korrusel olev POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB ehitati hiljuti.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: I traded POKéMON right away.
et: Ma vahetasin kohe POKéMONe.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Ma olen HR. STONE, DEVON CORPORATIONI PRESIDENT.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'd just got word about you!
et: Ma just sain sinust teada!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: You saved our staff not just once, but twice!
et: Sa päästsid meie töötaja mitte üks, vaid kaks korda!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I have a favor to ask of an amazing person like you.
et: Mul on palve sinusugusele hämmastavale inimesele.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I understand that you're delivering a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.
et: Ma saan aru, et sa toimetad paki SLATEPORTI LAEVATEHASESSE.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: Well, on the way, could you stop off in DEWFORD TOWN?
et: Noh, kas sa saaksid teel peatuda DEWFORD TOWNIS?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I was hoping that you'd deliver a LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa toimetaksid KIRJA STEVENILE DEWFORDIS.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that I am a great PRESIDENT.
et: HR. STONE: Nüüd, sa peaksid teadma, et ma olen suurepärane PRESIDENT.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: So, I'd never be so cheap as to ask a favor for nothing in return.
et: Nii et ma poleks kunagi nii ihne, et paluksin teenet ilma millegita vastu.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: That's why I want you to have this!
et: Just seepärast tahan, et sa saaksid selle!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
en: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER} sai POKéNAVi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: MR. STONE: That device…
et: HR. STONE: See seade…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV for short.
et: See on POKéMON NAVIGATOR ehk lühidalt POKéNAV.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's an indispensable tool for any TRAINER on an adventure.
et: See on asendamatu tööriist igale seiklema läinud TRAINERILE.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It has a map of the HOENN region.
et: Sel on HOENNI piirkonna kaart.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: You can check the locations of DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!
et: Sa saad hõlpsalt kontrollida DEWFORDI ja SLATEPORTI asukohti!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: By the way, I've heard that sinister criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe-have been making trouble far and wide.
et: Muide, ma olen kuulnud, et kurjad kurjategijad – MAGMA ja AQUA, ma usun – on laialdaselt pahandust teinud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: I think it would be best if you rested up before you go on your way.
et: Ma arvan, et oleks kõige parem, kui sa enne edasiminekut välja puhkaksid.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
en: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN}, go with caution and care!
et: HR. STONE: Noh, siis, {PLAYER}{KUN}, mine ettevaatlikult ja hoolikalt!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
en: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!
et: HR. STONE: Ma loodan sinu peale!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER? Thank you kindly!
et: HR. STONE: Sa toimetasid mu KIRJA kohale? Suur tänu sulle!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: This is my way of thanking you. It should help you, a TRAINER.
et: See on minu viis sind tänada. See peaks sind, TRAINERit, aitama.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that EXP. SHARE will be given some of the EXP Points from battle.
et: HR. STONE: POKéMONile, kes hoiab seda EXP. SHARE'i, antakse osa lahingu EXP punktidest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: It will get EXP Points even if it didn't actually battle.
et: Ta saab EXP punkte, isegi kui ta tegelikult ei võidelnud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: I would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful for raising weak POKéMON.
et: Ma ütleksin, et EXP. SHARE on üsna kasulik nõrkade POKéMONide kasvatamiseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed myself in work.
et: HR. STONE: Nooruspõlvest saati olen ma töösse süvenenud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: Consequently, I'm not familiar with trends and that sort of thing.
et: Seetõttu ei tunne ma trende ega selliseid asju.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: But do young people all want to be TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?
et: Aga kas kõik noored tahavad saada TRAINERITEKS POKéMON LEAGUE'is?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: This is the DEVON CORPORATION's third floor.
et: See on DEVON CORPORATIONI kolmas korrus.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on this floor.
et: Meie PRESIDENDI KABINET on sellel korrusel.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm grateful for what you've done.
et: Igatahes, ma ei suuda öelda, kui tänulik ma olen selle eest, mida sa teinud oled.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Um… By the way, that parcel you got back for us…
et: Öö… Muide, see pakk, mille sa meile tagasi said…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Could I get you to deliver that to the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?
et: Kas saaksin panna sind selle toimetama SLATEPORTI LAEVATEHASESSE?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: It would be awful if those robbers tried to take it again.
et: Oleks kohutav, kui need röövlid üritaksid seda uuesti võtta.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count on you to do that for me?
et: Öö… Hehehe, nii et, öö, kas ma saaksin sinu peale selles loota?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Oh, that's right. Could you wait here a second?
et: Oh, õige. Kas sa saaksid siin hetkeks oodata?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Our PRESIDENT would like to have a word with you.
et: Meie PRESIDENT sooviks sinuga paar sõna vahetada.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Please come with me.
et: Palun tule minuga kaasa.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
en: Please, go ahead.
et: Palun, mine aga.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
en: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, you should go see CAPT. STERN.
et: Kui külastad SLATEPORTI LAEVATEHAST, peaksid minema KAPTEN STERNI vaatama.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
en: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL and TIMER BALL, have become hugely popular among TRAINERS.
et: DEVONI uued tooted, REPEAT BALL ja TIMER BALL, on saanud TRAINERITE seas ülipopulaarseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
en: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
et: See on PRESIDENDI kokku pandud kogu haruldasi kive ja kivimeid.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: This place is full of cute DOLLS.
et: See koht on täis nunnusid NUKKE.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: I should buy some for me, instead of just for my children.
et: Ma peaksin mõned ka endale ostma, mitte ainult lastele.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
en: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON, so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.
et: Ma pole piisavalt suur, et POKéMONe kasvatada, nii et võtan selle asemel nunnu NUKU.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: They sell many cute MATS here.
et: Nad müüvad siin palju nunnusid MATTE.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: I wonder which one I should get? Maybe I'll buy them all…
et: Huvitav, millise ma peaksin võtma? Võib-olla ostan need kõik…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
en: I think they closed the rooftop because the weather is wild today.
et: Ma arvan, et nad sulgesid katuse, sest ilm on täna metsik.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands FIGHTING-type POKéMON.
et: DEWFORDI SAALI JUHT BRAWLY juhib KAKLUS-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Going against him with NORMAL-type POKéMON is asking for trouble.
et: Tema vastu TAVA-tüüpi POKéMONidega minek otsib pahandust.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious smack down on NORMAL POKéMON, so be careful!
et: KAKLUS-POKéMONid annavad TAVA-POKéMONidele tõsise keretäie, nii et ole ettevaatlik!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: What's worse, the GYM is as dark as the ocean floor.
et: Mis veelgi hullem, SAAL on pime nagu ookeanipõhi.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: But it will get brighter after defeating the TRAINERS in your way.
et: Aga see läheb heledamaks pärast teele jäävate TRAINERite alistamist.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, okay, go for it!
et: Hei, olgu, anna minna!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!
et: Ohoo! Siin läks liiga heledaks!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Your future is bright, too!
et: Ka su tulevik on helge!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
en: Might is right! Come on!
et: Jõud on õigus! Anna tulla!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
en: Not enough power…
et: Pole piisavalt jõudu…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
en: Your skill overcame my strength! Your technique is commendable!
et: Su oskus ületas mu jõu! Su tehnika on kiiduväärt!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: There's no need for BRAWLY to be involved!
et: Pole vaja, et BRAWLY oleks segatud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: I'll crush you!
et: Ma purustan su!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
en: But… How? How could I lose so easily?
et: Aga… Kuidas? Kuidas ma sain nii kergesti kaotada?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: I'm not going to waste this loss. I'll use it to motivate me to train!
et: Ma ei raiska seda kaotust. Ma kasutan seda, et motiveerida end treenima!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: One day I'll become a GYM LEADER…
et: Ühel päeval saan ma SAALI JUHIKS…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: No, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!
et: Ei, ma saan POKéMON LEAGUE MEISTRIKS!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
en: Don't you dare brush me off! It's not my fault if you cry!
et: Ära julge mind kõrvale heita! Pole minu süü, kui sa nutad!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
en: Waaaaaaah! I lost!
et: Ojoooo! Ma kaotasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: I battle in the dark to make my heart stronger.
et: Ma võitlen pimeduses, et teha oma süda tugevamaks.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: But because it's so dark, I can never see BRAWLY's face…
et: Aga kuna on nii pime, ei näe ma kunagi BRAWLY nägu…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
en: Ufufu… Are you stumbling around in the dark?
et: Ufufu… Kas sa koperdad pimeduses ringi?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
en: Oh, you… I don't want to know you!
et: Oh, sina… Ma ei taha sind tunda!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
en: You deserve to stay lost and end up back at the entrance again!
et: Sa väärid eksinuks jäämist ja taas sissepääsu juures otsa jõudmist!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
en: I'll show you the gumption of a sailing man!
et: Ma näitan sulle meremehe indu!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
en: How'd this happen? It's not like me to lose this way!
et: Kuidas see juhtus? Pole minu moodi niimoodi kaotada!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
en: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing our GYM LEADER.
et: Oh, jaa! Sa oled väärt meie SAALI JUHTI nägema.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
en: If you mean to pass, it has to be through me!
et: Kui kavatsed mööduda, peab see olema minust läbi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
en: Grrrrr! Vastly overpowered!
et: Grrrrr! Rängalt üle jõu käiv!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
en: You win! Go after that BADGE!
et: Sa võitsid! Mine selle MÄRGI järele!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I'm BRAWLY! DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!
et: Ma olen BRAWLY! DEWFORDI SAALI JUHT!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I've been churned in the rough waves of these parts, and I've grown tough in the pitch-black cave!
