et: Mind on segatud nende kandi karmides lainetes ja ma olen karastunud sudimustas koopas!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: So you wanted to challenge me? Let me see what you're made of!
et: Nii et sa tahtsid mind välja kutsuda? Lase mul näha, millest sa tehtud oled!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected!
et: Ohoo, ohoo! Sa tegid palju suurema laksu, kui ma ootasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: You swamped me!
et: Sa uputasid mu üle!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Okay, you've got me. Take this GYM BADGE!
et: Olgu, sa said mu kätte. Võta see GYM BADGE!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE from BRAWLY.
et: {PLAYER} sai BRAWLYLT KNUCKLE BADGE'i.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON up to Level 30, even those you get in trades, obey without question.
et: KNUCKLE BADGE paneb kõik POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 30, isegi need, keda saad kaubeldes, ilma küsimusteta kuuletuma.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: And, you'll be able to use the HM move FLASH outside of battle.
et: Ja sa saad kasutada HM-võtet FLASH väljaspool lahingut.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: If you'd like, use this TECHNICAL MACHINE, too.
et: Kui soovid, kasuta ka seda TEHNILIST MASINAT.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: That TM08 contains BULK UP.
et: See TM08 sisaldab võtet BULK UP.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: It's a move that raises both ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
et: See on võte, mis tõstab nii RÜNNAKU kui KAITSE näitajat.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
en: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT BRAWLY registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
en: I can see your talent becoming a giant wave to cause a storm of astonishment among TRAINERS one day!
et: Ma näen, kuidas su anne saab ühel päeval hiiglaslikuks laineks, mis tekitab TRAINERite seas hämmastuse tormi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD TOWNi POKéMON GYM

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD TOWNi POKéMON GYM

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: BRAWLY SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib taanduda, aga see naaseb alati kaldale.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusugune hiiglaslik ande laine… Ma teadsin, et sa naased!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: Show me how much higher you've gone!
et: Näita mulle, kui palju kõrgemale oled jõudnud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
en: Wow! Swamped again!
et: Ohoo! Jälle üle ujutatud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
en: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. You can't see the bottom. It's just like the sea of HOENN!
et: BRAWLY: Võitlemine on avar ja sügav. Sa ei näe põhja. See on nagu HOENNi meri!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib taanduda, aga see naaseb alati kaldale.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusugune hiiglaslik ande laine… Ma teadsin, et sa naased!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh? You only have one POKéMON that can battle.
et: Oh? Sul on ainult üks POKéMON, kes suudab võidelda.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back with at least two POKéMON.
et: Vabandust, aga ma sooviksin, et tuleksid tagasi vähemalt kahe POKéMONiga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}. Do you know it? It's quite cute and rather nice.
et: Mu POKéMON on {STR_VAR_2}. Kas tunned teda? Ta on üsna nunnu ja päris tore.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: This little one, I could trade with pride!
et: Selle väiksega saaksin uhkusega kaubelda!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: Would you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}?
et: Kas sooviksid mulle vahetada {STR_VAR_1} mu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh, it's adorable! Thank you! I promise I'll be good to it!
et: Oh, see on armas! Aitäh! Ma luban, et olen selle vastu hea!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh! I hope you'll be good to my {STR_VAR_2}, too!
et: Oh! Loodan, et sinagi oled mu {STR_VAR_2} vastu hea!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
en: Oh, I'm sorry! I don't intend to trade for anything but a {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Oh, vabandust! Ma ei kavatse vahetada millegi muu kui {STR_VAR_1} vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
en: Oh, you won't? Well, that's fine, too. Please come visit us again.
et: Oh, sa ei taha? Noh, see on ka hea. Palun tule meid jälle vaatama.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
en: Giggle! A SKITTY is so much cuter than I had imagined. I'm delighted!
et: Kihi! SKITTY on palju nunnum, kui ma ette kujutasin. Ma olen vaimustuses!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: For 70 years I have raised POKéMON! I am the man they revere as the legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!
et: 70 aastat olen POKéMONe kasvatanud! Ma olen mees, keda austatakse legendaarse tipp-POKéMON BREEDERina!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: If you ever become as seasoned as me, you'll see the abilities of POKéMON at a glance.
et: Kui saad kunagi sama karastunuks kui mina, näed POKéMONide võimeid ühe pilguga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: You're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest you to know your own POKéMON's abilities?
et: Sa oled TRAINER. Kas sind ei huvita teada oma POKéMONide võimeid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: Here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Siin! Vaatame su POKéMONi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as being of average ability.
et: Seda kirjeldaksin üldiselt kui keskmise võimekusega.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as having better-than-average ability.
et: Seda kirjeldaksin üldiselt kui keskmisest paremat võimekust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is quite impressive in ability!
et: Seda ütleksin üldiselt üsna muljetavaldava võimekusega olevat!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is wonderfully outstanding in ability!
et: Seda ütleksin üldiselt imeliselt suurepärase võimekusega olevat!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its HP…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta ELUPUNKTID…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta RÜNNAK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta KAITSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta ERIRÜNNAK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta ERIKAITSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPEED…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu arvates ta KIIRUS…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood
en: That stat is relatively good. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on suhteliselt hea. …Hm… Nii ma ütlen.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive
en: That stat is quite impressive. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on üsna muljetavaldav. …Hm… Nii ma ütlen.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding
en: That stat is outstanding! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on suurepärane! …Hm… Nii ma ütlen.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless
en: It's flawless! A thing of perfection! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See on veatu! Täiuslikkuse tipp! …Hm… Nii ma ütlen.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: What? You have no time for my advice?
et: Mis? Sul pole aega mu nõuande jaoks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: You should always be eager to learn from the experiences of your elders!
et: Sa peaksid alati olema innukas õppima oma vanemate kogemustest!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: Yes, what is it now?
et: Jah, mis nüüd on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: I have business that needs tending! Save it for next time!
et: Mul on asja ajada! Hoia see järgmiseks korraks!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's abilities intrigue you?
et: Ah, nooruke! Kas su POKéMONide võimed köidavad sind?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Here, here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Siia, siia! Vaatame su POKéMONi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: An expert I am, but even I can't tell anything about an unhatched POKéMON!
et: Ekspert olen ma, aga isegi mina ei oska koorumata POKéMONi kohta midagi öelda!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: Show me a POKéMON! A POKéMON is what I need to see!
et: Näita mulle POKéMONi! POKéMONi ma pean nägema!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! I'm glad I raised it carefully!
et: Ta ütles, et mu POKéMON on suurepärane! Hea, et ma teda hoolikalt kasvatasin!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! But I didn't do anything special raising it…
et: Ta ütles, et mu POKéMON on suurepärane! Aga ma ei teinud teda kasvatades midagi erilist…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't know what it's good for.
et: Ma sain selle STEVENILT, aga ma ei tea, milleks see hea on.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I think it's called KING'S ROCK. Do you want it?
et: Ma arvan, et seda kutsutakse KING'S ROCKiks. Kas sa tahad seda?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: Why would you want it? You're weird.
et: Miks sa seda tahaksid? Sa oled veider.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: You can keep it, but keep it a secret from STEVEN.
et: Sa võid selle endale jätta, aga hoia seda STEVENI eest saladuses.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
en: STEVEN's house is right over there!
et: STEVENI maja on siinsamas seal!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
en: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you supposed to do with some weird rock?
et: Jah, sinagi arvad nii! Mida sa peaksid mingi veidra kiviga tegema?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild WAILMER.
et: MOSSDEEPI ümbruses näeb metsikuid WAILMEReid.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: It's called, uh… What was it now…
et: Seda nimetatakse, äh… Mis see nüüd oligi…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAI, WAI, WAI…
et: WAI, WAI, WAI…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAILMER watching!
et: WAILMERi vaatlus!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare SPACE CENTER on lasknud üles tohutuid rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: There's been some kind of an uproar over a letter they received recently.
et: On olnud mingi möll kirja pärast, mille nad hiljuti said.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare SPACE CENTER on lasknud üles tohutuid rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I heard from a SAILOR buddy that TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.
et: Ma kuulsin MADRUSEST sõbralt, et TEAM AQUA seadis LILYCOVE'is end sisse.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I also heard that someone came along and wiped the floor with them!
et: Ma kuulsin ka, et keegi tuli ja pühkis nendega põrandat!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted by that TEAM MAGMA.
et: Aga MOSSDEEP siin on saanud selle TEAM MAGMA sihtmärgiks.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: If you want to know what they're up to, go visit the SPACE CENTER.
et: Kui tahad teada, mida nad plaanivad, mine külasta SPACE CENTERIT.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously more important to me.
et: Ma olen MADRUS, nii et meri on mulle ilmselgelt tähtsam.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: But you know? When I get back on land after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
et: Aga tead? Kui ma pärast pikka merereisi maale naasen, tunnen ma tõesti kergendust!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: Wouldn't it be nice?
et: Kas poleks tore?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: If the whole world was covered in plants and flowers like this island?
et: Kui kogu maailm oleks kaetud taimede ja lilledega nagu see saar?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: All life needs the sea to live, even though it makes its home on the land.
et: Kogu elu vajab elamiseks merd, kuigi ta teeb koju maismaale.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Life, having run its course, becomes soil and returns to the land.
et: Elu, olles läbinud oma kulu, muutub pinnaseks ja naaseb maismaale.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: And the sea is always connected to the land.
et: Ja meri on alati maismaaga ühendatud.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Yes, like the very shoreline here.
et: Jah, nagu see rannajoon siin.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: A voyage on a ship is fine.
et: Reis laeval on tore.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: But crossing the sea with POKéMON using SURF…
et: Aga mere ületamine POKéMONidega SURFi kasutades…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: Now that's an exhilarating trip! Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
et: Nüüd see on põnev reis! Kas sa ei nõustuks, nooruke?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: This rock has a special meaning to the people at the SPACE CENTER.
et: Sellel kivil on SPACE CENTERI inimestele eriline tähendus.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: They put it here as their wish for their rockets to fly safely.
et: Nad panid selle siia oma sooviga, et nende raketid ohutult lendaksid.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: When you make a wish, what do you use? Do you wish upon a star?
et: Kui sa soovi ütled, mida sa kasutad? Kas soovid tähe pealt?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: I use a wish tag to make it happen. That's what I do.
et: Mina kasutan soovisilti, et see täituks. Nii ma teen.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
en: It's a white rock.
et: See on valge kivi.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
en: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM LEADERS: LIZA & TATE
et: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYMi SAALI JUHID: LIZA & TATE

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The mystic combination!”
et: „Müstiline kooslus!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
en: MOSSDEEP CITY “Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”
et: MOSSDEEP CITY „Meie moto: hoia POKéMONe!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
en: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER “The closest place to space.”
et: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER „Kosmosele lähim paik.”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great!
et: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, hea tunne? Mul läheb suurepäraselt!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself.
et: Ma kuulsin, et MOSSDEEPI SAALI JUHT on päris tugev, nii et otsustasin ise vaatama tulla.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: But there's something wrong about this town.
et: Aga selle linnaga on midagi valesti.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER…
et: Inimesed räägivad hoiatuskirjast ja SPACE CENTERIST…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.
et: Ma ei arva siiski, et see mind kuidagi puudutab.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Ahh… It feels great letting the waves wash over my feet…
et: Ahh… On suurepärane tunne lasta lainetel üle jalgade uhtuda…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Speaking of the waves, you know that island city SOOTOPOLIS?
et: Lainetest rääkides, kas tead seda saarelinna SOOTOPOLIS?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: I think the GYM there had a new LEADER come in.
et: Ma arvan, et sealsesse SAALI tuli uus JUHT.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: People tell me the new LEADER once mentored WALLACE.
et: Inimesed ütlevad mulle, et uus JUHT oli kunagi WALLACE'i mentor.

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: Something's happening, and I don't like it!
et: Midagi toimub ja mulle see ei meeldi!

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: I've seen shady characters wandering in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…
et: Ma olen näinud kahtlaseid tegelasi PROF. COZMO kodust sisse ja välja luusimas…

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: This region's been known for meteors since the olden days.
et: See piirkond on olnud meteooride poolest tuntud iidsetest aegadest.

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out by a falling meteorite long ago.
et: Öeldakse, et METEOR FALLS uuristati kaua aega tagasi langeva meteoriidi poolt välja.

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: See! Take a look! This is my precious AZURILL!
et: Vaata! Vaata seda! See on mu kallis AZURILL!

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!
et: See on sile ja pehme ja kohev ka!

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
en: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.
et: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: Have you already challenged FLANNERY, the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?
et: Kas oled juba välja kutsunud FLANNERY, LAVARIDGE GYMi JUHI?

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: The girl's grandfather was famous. He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the POKéMON LEAGUE at one point.
et: Tüdruku vanaisa oli kuulus. Ta oli ühel hetkel POKéMON LEAGUE'i ELITE FOURIST.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY become a great TRAINER in her own right.
et: Mind ei üllataks, kui FLANNERYST saaks omaette suurepärane TRAINER.

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE “May the Greatest Teams Gather!”
et: BATTLE TENT FALLARBORI KOHT „Kogunegu suurimad meeskonnad!”

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
en: FALLARBOR TOWN “A farm community with small gardens.”
et: FALLARBOR TOWN „Väikeste aedadega talukogukond.”

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
en: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE “New moves taught to POKéMON.”
et: MOVE TUTORI MAJA „POKéMONidele õpetatakse uusi võtteid.”

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.
et: Tere tulemast LILYCOVE MUSEUMisse.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Please take the time to enjoy our collection of fantastic artwork featuring POKéMON.
et: Palun võta aega ja naudi meie fantastilist POKéMONe kujutavat kunstikogu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of fine arts.
et: Ma olen selle kaunite kunstide MUUSEUMI KURAATOR.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: It's heartening to see someone so young as you in our MUSEUM.
et: On südantsoojendav näha meie MUUSEUMIS kedagi nii noort kui sina.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: Have you viewed our collection of paintings already?
et: Kas oled meie maalikogu juba vaadanud?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
en: Ah, then let me not disturb you. Please, do take your time.
et: Ah, siis ma ei sega sind. Palun, võta oma aeg.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Oh? I do believe that you seem to be a POKéMON TRAINER.
et: Oh? Ma usun, et sa näidki POKéMON TRAINER olevat.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Have you an interest in paintings, too?
et: Kas sindki huvitavad maalid?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I see…
et: Ma näen…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I'm honored that you would visit us in spite of that.
et: Mind austab, et sa meid sellest hoolimata külastaksid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Ah, excellent! You do like paintings!
et: Ah, suurepärane! Sulle meeldivad maalid!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Then, may I ask you to come with me?
et: Siis, kas võin paluda sind minuga kaasa tulla?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
en: It's a very old painting. The paint is peeling here and there.
et: See on väga vana maal. Värv koorub siin-seal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
en: It's an odd landscape with bizarre and fantastic scenery.
et: See on veider maastik veidra ja fantastilise vaatepildiga.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
en: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling woman with a POKéMON on her lap.
et: See on maal kaunist naeratavast naisest, kellel POKéMON süles.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON from long ago.
et: See on maal legendaarsest POKéMONist ammusest ajast.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: The artist painted this from imagination.
et: Kunstnik maalis selle kujutluse järgi.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON swaying in a breeze.
et: See on maal ROHU-POKéMONidest tuules õõtsumas.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: They appear to be enjoying the wind's gentle caress.
et: Nad näivad nautivat tuule õrna paitust.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: It's a delicious-looking painting of BERRIES.
et: See on isuäratav maal BERRYdest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: This painting could make you hungry!
et: See maal võib su näljaseks teha!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.
et: See on kuulsa skulptuuri koopia.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.
et: See kujutab iidset LINNU-POKéMONi.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It's a big POKé BALL carved from a black stone.
et: See on suur POKé BALL, mis on nikerdatud mustast kivist.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It was apparently used in festivals in the olden days.
et: Seda kasutati ilmselt vanasti pidustustel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
en: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed with POKéMON and dense text in the small characters of an ancient, unreadable language.
et: See on suur kivitahvel, millele on raiutud POKéMONid ja tihe tekst iidse loetamatu keele väikeste märkidega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
en: Hmmm… What works of great magnificence…
et: Hmmm… Millised suurejoonelised tööd…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: Battling with POKéMON is fun, I'll grant you that.
et: POKéMONidega võitlemine on lõbus, seda ma tunnistan.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: But one mustn't forget our love for the fine arts.
et: Aga ei tohi unustada meie armastust kaunite kunstide vastu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could see many fantastic paintings.
et: See ART MUSEUM… Noh, siin saab näha palju fantastilisi maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: And the CURATOR is a wonderful person.
et: Ja KURAATOR on imeline inimene.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM is an inspiration.
et: Minusuguste kunstnike seas on see MUUSEUM inspiratsioon.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
en: This lady is pretty! She's like Mommy!
et: See daam on kena! Ta on nagu emme!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
en: This POKéMON is adorable! Just like our little boy!
et: See POKéMON on armas! Just nagu meie väike poiss!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got in some new paintings.
et: Ma kuulsin, et see ART MUSEUM sai mõned uued maalid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: So, naturally I hurried over.
et: Nii et loomulikult ma kiirustasin siia.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: Are the new paintings up on the second floor?
et: Kas uued maalid on teisel korrusel?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: Lately, the CURATOR has been unusually cheerful.
et: Viimasel ajal on KURAATOR olnud ebatavaliselt rõõmus.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: I bet something good happened for him. Definitely.
et: Vean kihla, et temaga juhtus midagi head. Kindlasti.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I aim to see many great paintings here and learn from them.
et: Ma sihin näha siin palju suurepäraseid maale ja neist õppida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I have this dream of one day having my artwork exhibited here.
et: Mul on unistus, et ühel päeval on mu kunstiteosed siin väljas.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite tourist destination.
et: ART MUSEUM on saanud lemmik-turismisihtkohaks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: It's great for LILYCOVE… No, great for the HOENN region!
et: See on suurepärane LILYCOVE'ile… Ei, suurepärane HOENNi piirkonnale!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER procured all the paintings upstairs.
et: Seda ma kuulnud olen — üksik TRAINER hankis kõik ülakorruse maalid.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to SLATEPORT for some shopping.
et: Kui mul oleks JALGRATAS, oleks kerge SLATEPORTI ostlema sõita.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…
et: Ma saaksin osta HARBOR MAILi SLATEPORTI POKéMON MARTist…

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
en: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL? Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?
et: Oh! Sul on HARBOR MAIL? Kas vahetad selle COIN CASE'i vastu?

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
en: Oh, I'm so happy! Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!
et: Oh, ma olen nii õnnelik! Olgu, ma vahetan sulle COIN CASE'i!

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
en: That COIN CASE can be used at the GAME CORNER.
et: Seda COIN CASE'i saab kasutada GAME CORNERis.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: Oh, that's disappointing.
et: Oh, see on kahju.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: A COIN CASE is needed for the GAME CORNER.
et: COIN CASE'i on vaja GAME CORNERi jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is the RANKING HALL.
et: See on RANKING HALL.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is where we recognize the immortal TRAINERS who left great records in BATTLE FRONTIER events.
et: Siin tunnustame surematuid TRAINEReid, kes jätsid BATTLE FRONTIERi üritustesse suured rekordid.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
en: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE, and BATTLE FACTORY Records
et: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE ja BATTLE FACTORY rekordid

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
en: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA, and BATTLE PYRAMID Records
et: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA ja BATTLE PYRAMID rekordid

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
en: Hi, is your name on this list?
et: Tere, kas su nimi on selles nimekirjas?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
en: Wow, that's super! I'll have to try harder, too!
et: Ohoo, see on äge! Ma pean ka kõvemini pingutama!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: Oh, is that right?
et: Oh, on või?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: If you saw your friend's name up here, I bet it would make you work harder!
et: Kui sa näeksid siin oma sõbra nime, vean kihla, et see paneks sind kõvemini pingutama!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Hmm… My name's not up there…
et: Hmm… Mu nime seal pole…

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Well, it's only natural since I haven't taken any challenges yet.
et: Noh, see on loomulik, kuna ma pole veel ühtki väljakutset võtnud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
en: This is the BATTLE DOME! Your path to the invincible superstar!
et: See on BATTLE DOME! Su tee võitmatuks supertäheks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
en: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! Seek out the toughest POKéMON!
et: See on BATTLE FACTORY! Otsi üles sitkeimad POKéMONid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
en: This is the BATTLE PIKE! Choose one of three paths!
et: See on BATTLE PIKE! Vali üks kolmest teest!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER.
et: See on BATTLE TOWER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: TRAINERS bring their best-raised POKéMON for elimination-style matches.
et: TRAINERid toovad oma parimini kasvatatud POKéMONid väljalangemismatšideks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas oled praami pärast siin? Kas tohin näha su PILETIT?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER}-l pole PILETIT…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Praamile astumiseks peab sul olema PILET.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas PILETIT.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Suurepärane! Rohkem polegi vaja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu sa minna sooviksid?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
en: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!
et: SLATEPORT CITY siis!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: LILYCOVE CITY siis!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Palun purjeta meiega mõni teine kord!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astu praamile ja oota väljasõitu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna sooviksid?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
en: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!
et: Ma olen kõigist oma sõpradest parim. Aga siin… Ma olen olnud kasutu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER, but I can't find it even though I have a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma tahan BATTLE TOWERisse minna, aga ma ei leia seda üles, kuigi mul on BATTLE FRONTIERi kaart.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: This place is just too big!
et: See koht on lihtsalt liiga suur!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: I wanted to take a challenge as soon as I arrived here.
et: Ma tahtsin väljakutset võtta niipea, kui siia jõudsin.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: But on the way, I got seasick… Urrrrp…
et: Aga teel jäin merehaigeks… Urrrrp…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know?
et: Pole ju nii, et igaüks võib siia tulla, tead?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here.
et: Siia tuuakse ainult need TRAINERid, keda on tunnustatud kui sitkeid.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Sellepärast paljud TRAINERid ei teagi BATTLE FRONTIERist.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Hey, bro…
et: Hei, vend…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?
et: Oled sa kindel, et saame väljakutseid võtta, isegi kui meil pole POKéMONe?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: Uh… I'm sure it'll be okay.
et: Äh… Ma olen kindel, et kõik saab korda.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: I think…
et: Ma arvan…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: But remember that big scary guy? He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”
et: Aga kas mäletad seda suurt hirmsat tüüpi? Ta ütles: „Ma laenan sulle POKéMONe!”

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. You can rent strong POKéMON there.
et: See on BATTLE FACTORY. Seal saad rentida tugevaid POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: But it makes me wonder. Who's raising those rental POKéMON?
et: Aga see paneb mõtlema. Kes neid renditud POKéMONe kasvatab?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE PIKE because of SEVIPER…
et: Ma kardan BATTLE PIKE'i minna SEVIPERI pärast…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: B-but I came all the way here, so I will try to conquer everything! …Shudder…
et: A-aga ma tulin nii kaugele, nii et ma üritan kõik vallutada! …Judin…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
en: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three!
et: Mängime kivi, paberit, kääre! Üks, kaks, kolm!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
en: Yay! I won! I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
et: Jess! Ma võitsin! Ma võtan BATTLE PIKE väljakutse!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: Oh, no… I lost.
et: Oh ei… Ma kaotasin.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: I guess I'm not very lucky today. I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge until tomorrow.
et: Vist pole mul täna eriti õnne. Ma lükkan oma BATTLE PIKE väljakutse homseni edasi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: I believe I'm the only person here who, for some unknown reason, would choose fishing over battling.
et: Ma usun, et olen ainus inimene siin, kes mingil teadmata põhjusel eelistaks kalastamist võitlemisele.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: Huh? You can't catch anything here? That's disappointing…
et: Ää? Sa ei püüa siin midagi? See on kahju…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
en: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no matter what, until I get a Symbol.
et: Täna jätkan ma võitlemist, ükskõik mis, kuni saan Sümboli.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME?
et: Oh? Sa lähed BATTLE DOME'i välja kutsuma?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.
et: Ma soovin sulle parimat õnne. Võitkem mõlemad end üles ja kohtugem väljakutsetes.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
en: Grandpa, over here! The BATTLE DOME is here! Go get 'em, Grandpa!
et: Vanaisa, siiapoole! BATTLE DOME on siin! Näita neile, vanaisa!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!
et: Ah, nii et see siin on BATTLE DOME? Ma ei lase GENTLEMENIL end võita!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: But where is the entrance?
et: Aga kus on sissepääs?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: There used to be nothing here not all that long ago.
et: Mitte nii kaua aega tagasi polnud siin veel midagi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.
et: Aga vaata nüüd seda kohta! Hämmastav! Ma toon oma ema seda vaatama.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: Ma jõudsin lõpuks BATTLE FRONTIERisse!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!
et: Ma püüan kindlasti oma välimuse ja võimekusega tähelepanu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Mäts, mäts…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: It looks like this square's filled with tough people.
et: Näib, et see väljak on täis sitkeid inimesi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Mäts, mäts…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE.
et: Mõni aeg tagasi kohtasin BATTLE PIKE'is üht vanemat tüdrukut.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way.
et: Tal olid sellised silmad, mis olid tõeliselt tigedal moel hirmsad.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me.
et: Ta läks marru: „Kas sa lõpetad söömise!” Siis andis ta mulle keretäie.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough.
et: See oli tõesti judinaid tekitav hirmus kogemus.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing!
et: Ää? Kas sa kuulad iseennast? See pole midagi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!
et: Ohoo, viimati kui ma teda ergutasin, kohtusid meie pilgud ja sädemed lendasid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft!
et: Miiis?! Ptüi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you!
et: See juhtus ainult sellepärast, et ma juhtusin su kõrval istuma!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!
et: DOME ACE vaatas meie poole ainult sellepärast, et mu ergutamine oli nii vali!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: Oh, shush! Keep that racket down!
et: Oh, tss! Hoia see kära vaiksem!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER!
et: Teie, ilmaennustaja-fännid, peaksite jääma mõnda SAALI JUHTI ergutama!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!
et: DOME ACE on minu! Ainus iidol minu jaoks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Those people squabbling over there…
et: Need inimesed, kes seal nääklevad…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.
et: Raske uskuda, aga nad olid kunagi TRAINERid, ja veel head.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too.
et: Nad olid uskumatult sitked ja kuulsad ka.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament.
et: Aga nad hävitas üks kindel TRAINER turniiril.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER.
et: Nad said nii põhjaliku keretäie, et jäid sellesse TRAINERisse sisse.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every day now.
et: Nüüd on nad lihtsalt selle TRAINERi fännid. Nad käivad iga päev BATTLE DOME'is oma iidolit ergutamas.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma kuulsin kuuldust, et keegi nägi kuskil BATTLE FRONTIERis ebatavaliselt pika sabaga POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…
et: See peab olema armas. Ma olen selles kindel…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!
et: Oh, väljakutsed võivad oodata. Ma tunnen tungi see kütkestav olend üles leida!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: PP UP is great!
et: PP UP on suurepärane!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, of a POKéMON move.
et: See tõstab POKéMONi võtte JÕUPUNKTE, PP-d.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: What… What is happening?
et: Mis… Mis toimub?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: I really want to know, but it's too scary to go outside.
et: Ma tõesti tahan teada, aga on liiga hirmus välja minna.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Do you know FULL RESTORE?
et: Kas tead FULL RESTORE'i?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Full restoration of HP! Eradication of all status problems!
et: HP täielik taastamine! Kõigi olekumurede kaotamine!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: It's truly an item of your dreams!
et: See on tõesti su unistuste ese!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
en: This weather… Did something awaken?
et: See ilm… Kas midagi ärkas?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, like, I couldn't find myself any POKéMON that were, like, for me.
et: Nii et, nagu, ma ei leidnud endale ühtki POKéMONi, kes oleks, nagu, minu jaoks.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, I figured, like, hey, I should file a complaint to the guy there?
et: Nii et ma mõtlesin, nagu, hei, ma peaksin sellele tüübile seal kaebuse esitama?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja ta ei kuulanud mind ära, nagu, hei! Nii et, nagu, täielik jama, sõber!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Hei, nagu, sina! Pane suu kinni, tead? Lihtsalt, tead, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See on nagu, TM41, tead? Hei, see on TORMENT, kas sa kuuled mind?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu, see ei lase teisel tüübil sama võtet kaks korda järjest kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Hei, kuule nüüd, nagu, ma ei pane sulle piina peale!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: I don't really like BUG POKéMON, but maybe I'll try using some for a change of pace.
et: Mulle ei meeldi eriti PUTUKA-POKéMONid, aga ehk proovin mõnda kasutada vahelduseks.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: Who knows, I might even get to like them!
et: Kes teab, ma võin nad isegi armsaks saada!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
en: You can battle all you want here even if you don't have any tough POKéMON.
et: Sa võid siin võidelda nii palju kui tahad, isegi kui sul pole ühtki kõva POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
en: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of a selection?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui neil oleks rohkem valikut?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Well, well, what have we here? A most energetic customer!
et: Noh-noh, mis meil siin on? Ülimalt energiline klient!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Me? You may call me RYDEL. I'm the owner of this cycle shop.
et: Mina? Võid kutsuda mind RYDEL. Ma olen selle jalgrattapoe omanik.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES… They're awfully filthy.
et: RYDEL: Su RUNNING SHOES… Need on kohutavalt räpased.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: Did you come from far away?
et: Kas tulid kaugelt?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: RYDEL: Is that right?
et: RYDEL: On või?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: Then, I guess you have no need for any of my BIKES.
et: Siis vist pole sul mu JALGRATTAID vaja.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …
et: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: You're saying that you came all this way from LITTLEROOT?
et: Sa ütled, et tulid kogu selle tee LITTLEROOTIST?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: My goodness! That's ridiculously far!
et: Heldeke! See on naeruväärselt kaugel!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: If you had one of my BIKES, you could go anywhere easily while feeling the gentle caress of the wind!
et: Kui sul oleks üks mu JALGRATTAID, saaksid kergesti kõikjale minna, tundes tuule õrna paitust!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'll tell you what! I'll give you a BIKE!
et: Ütlen sulle mida! Ma annan sulle JALGRATTA!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Oh, wait a second!
et: Oh, oota hetk!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I forgot to tell you that there are two kinds of BIKES!
et: Ma unustasin sulle öelda, et on kaks liiki JALGRATTAID!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: They are the MACH BIKE and the ACRO BIKE!
et: Need on MACH BIKE ja ACRO BIKE!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want to feel the wind with their bodies!
et: MACH BIKE on jalgratturitele, kes tahavad tunda tuult oma kehaga!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: And an ACRO BIKE is for those who prefer technical rides!
et: Ja ACRO BIKE on neile, kes eelistavad tehnilisi sõite!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'm a real sweetheart, so you can have whichever one you like!
et: Ma olen tõeline kullapai, nii et sa võid saada ükskõik millise, mis sulle meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Which one will you choose?
et: Kumma sa valid?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis MACH BIKE'i.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis ACRO BIKE'i.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch BIKES, just come see me!
et: RYDEL: Kui sul tekib tung JALGRATTAID vahetada, tule lihtsalt mind vaatama!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about switching BIKES?
et: RYDEL: Oh? Kas mõtlesid JALGRATTAID vahetada?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Okay, no problem! I'll switch BIKES for you!
et: RYDEL: Olgu, pole probleemi! Ma vahetan sulle JALGRATTA!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
en: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged for an ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} vahetas MACH BIKE'i ACRO BIKE'i vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
en: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged for a MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} vahetas ACRO BIKE'i MACH BIKE'i vastu.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
en: RYDEL: Good, good! I'm happy that you like it!
et: RYDEL: Tubli, tubli! Mul on hea meel, et see sulle meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh? What happened to that BIKE I gave you?
et: Oh? Mis sai sellest JALGRATTAST, mille ma sulle andsin?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.
et: Oh, saan aru, sa hoiustasid selle oma PC-ga.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Well, take it out of PC storage, and I'll be happy to exchange it!
et: Noh, võta see PC hoiust välja ja ma vahetan hea meelega!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: May the wind always be at your back on your adventure!
et: Olgu tuul su seiklusel alati selja taga!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: I'm learning about BIKES while I work here.
et: Ma õpin JALGRATASTE kohta, kuni siin töötan.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: If you need advice on how to ride your BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in the back.
et: Kui vajad nõu, kuidas oma JALGRATTAGA sõita, on tagaruumis paar käsiraamatut.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.
et: See on käsiraamat MACH BIKE'i kohta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovid lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: A BIKE moves in the direction that the + Control Pad is pressed.
et: JALGRATAS liigub suunas, kuhu + Juhtnuppu vajutatakse.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: It will speed up once it gets rolling.
et: See kiireneb, kui veerema hakkab.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: To stop, release the + Control Pad. The BIKE will slow to a stop.
et: Peatumiseks vabasta + Juhtnupp. JALGRATAS aeglustub ja peatub.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't stop very quickly.
et: MACH BIKE on kiire, aga ei suuda väga kiiresti peatuda.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: It gets a little tricky to get around a corner.
et: Nurga taha saamine läheb veidi keeruliseks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Release the + Control Pad a little before the corner and slow down.
et: Vabasta + Juhtnupp veidi enne nurka ja aeglusta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: There are small sandy slopes throughout the HOENN region.
et: Üle kogu HOENNi piirkonna on väikeseid liivaseid nõlvasid.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: The loose, crumbly sand makes it impossible to climb normally.
et: Lahtise pudeneva liiva tõttu on võimatu tavapäraselt üles ronida.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can zip up a sandy slope.
et: Aga kui sul on MACH BIKE, saad liivase nõlva üles kihutada.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.
et: See on käsiraamat ACRO BIKE'i kohta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovid lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Press the B Button while riding, and the front wheel lifts up.
et: Vajuta sõites B-nuppu ja esiratas kerkib üles.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: You can zip around with the front wheel up using the + Control Pad.
et: Saad esiratas üleval + Juhtnupuga ringi kihutada.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: This technique is called a wheelie.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse tagarattasõiduks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Keeping the B Button pressed, your BIKE can hop on the spot.
et: Hoides B-nuppu all, saab su JALGRATAS paigal hüpelda.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: This technique is called a bunny hop.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse jäneshüppeks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: You can ride while hopping, too.
et: Saad sõita ka hüpeldes.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the B Button and the + Control Pad at the same time to jump.
et: Vajuta korraga B-nuppu ja + Juhtnuppu, et hüpata.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the + Control Pad to the side to jump sideways.
et: Vajuta + Juhtnuppu küljele, et hüpata külili.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press it backwards to make the BIKE change directions while jumping.
et: Vajuta seda tahapoole, et JALGRATAS hüpates suunda muudaks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER.
et: Praegust vaadates ei arvaks, aga ma olin kunagi üks sitke TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you!
et: Mul oli maine kui kõige sitkemal BEAUTYl siinkandis, ma ütlen sulle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: What is it now? You don't believe me.
et: Mis nüüd on? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented!
et: Ma pole nagu see suurustaja naine seal. Mina olen tegelikult andekas!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves.
et: Lase mul sulle tõestada. Ma oskan õpetada su POKéMONile erilisi ja seejuures nunnusid võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga mu tunnid pole tasuta. Kuidas oleks, kui maksaksid õpetatud võtete eest killukese Battle Pointidega?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?
et: Kas tulid tagasi õppima erilisi ja nunnusid POKéMON-võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
en: Fine, fine, look here! Which move should I teach?
et: Hüva, hüva, vaata siia! Millist võtet peaksin õpetama?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
en: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?
et: Võte {STR_VAR_1}, jah? See läheb {STR_VAR_2} Battle Pointi, olgu?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
en: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON I should teach the move to.
et: Hüva, hüva, nüüd vali POKéMON, kellele võte õpetada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
en: What the… You haven't got enough Battle Points!
et: Mida… Sul pole piisavalt Battle Pointe!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
en: Do you see how skilled I am now? I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!
et: Kas näed nüüd, kui osav ma olen? Ma võtan su Battle Pointid, aitäh!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: What's that? You don't want to…
et: Mis see on? Sa ei taha…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: If you want to see how skilled I am, you come see me anytime!
et: Kui tahad näha, kui osav ma olen, tule mind igal ajal vaatama!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER.
et: Ma tean, et praegu on raske uskuda, aga ma olin kunagi üks fantastiline TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!
et: Mul oli maine kui kõige võitmatumal SWIMMERil siinkandis, ma ütlen sulle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: What's wrong? You don't believe me.
et: Mis viga? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced!
et: Ma pole nagu see naljakas naine seal. Mina olen tegelikult kogenud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves.
et: Ma suudan sulle tõestada. Ma oskan õpetada su POKéMONile karme ja seejuures ilusaid võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga mu tunnid pole tasuta. Kuidas oleks, kui maksaksid õpetatud võtete eest killukese Battle Pointidega?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?
et: Kas tulid õppima karme ja ilusaid POKéMON-võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along.
et: Need daamid, viisi järgi, kuidas nad teineteist halvustavad, arvad sa ilmselt, et nad ei saa läbi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?
et: Aga kui see oleks tõsi, ei jääks nad siia koos, kas pole?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful.
et: Kui ma olin veel pisike YOUNGSTER, olid need daamid tugevad ja kaunid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: They were idols among us TRAINERS.
et: Nad olid meie, TRAINERite, iidolid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities.
et: Isegi praegu pole aeg nende võimeid nürindanud.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished.
et: Tegelikult on nende POKéMONi võtted muutunud veelgi lihvitumaks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this…
et: Aga… Mingil põhjusel ei saa ma jätta seda tundmata…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Time is so cruel…
et: Aeg on nii julm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
en: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.
et: Taastab kuni poole kasutaja maksimaalsetest elupunktidest.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
en: Inflicts damage identical to the user's level.
et: Teeb kahju, mis võrdub kasutaja tasemega.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
en: Recovers half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
et: Taastab poole magavale vaenlasele tehtud kahjust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
en: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.
et: Tugev rusikalöök uskumatu jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
en: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.
et: Äärmiselt võimas jalalöök tugeva jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
en: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
et: Kogu keha rünnak, mis võib põhjustada halvatuse.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
en: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.
et: Loobitakse suuri rahne. Võib panna võpatama.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
en: Retaliates any physical hit with double the power.
et: Vastab füüsilisele löögile topeltjõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
en: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe.
et: Nõrk elektrilöök, mis halvab vaenlase.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
en: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.
et: Võitlustants, mis tõstab järsult RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
en: Curls up to conceal weak spots and raise DEFENSE.
et: Keerdub kerra, et varjata nõrku kohti ja tõsta KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
en: A loud attack that can be used only while asleep.
et: Vali rünnak, mida saab kasutada vaid magades.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
en: Hurls mud in the foe's face to reduce its accuracy.
et: Loobib vaenlasele muda näkku, et vähendada täpsust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
en: Sprays starshaped rays that never miss.
et: Pihustab tähekujulisi kiiri, mis kunagi mööda ei lähe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
en: A chilling attack that lowers the foe's SPEED.
et: Külmutav rünnak, mis langetab vaenlase KIIRUST.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
en: Endures any attack for 1 turn, leaving 1HP.
et: Talub 1 käigu iga rünnakut, jättes 1 elupunkti.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
en: Copies the foe's effect(s) and gives to the user.
et: Kopeerib vaenlase mõjud ja annab kasutajale.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
en: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.
et: Jäine rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast külmutada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
en: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.
et: Elektriline rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast halvata.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
en: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.
et: Tuline rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast põletada.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: Huh? My POKéMON is cute? Sure, I knew that.
et: Huh? Mu POKéMON on armas? Muidugi, ma teadsin seda.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: But if you really want, I'm willing to trade it to you.
et: Aga kui sa tõesti tahad, olen valmis teda sulle vahetama.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.
et: Ma vahetan sulle oma {STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1} vastu, kui tahad.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
en: Eheheh… Please be good to my POKéMON.
et: Ehehee… Palun ole mu POKéMONi vastu hea.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
en: Huh? That doesn't look anything like a {STR_VAR_1} to me.
et: Huh? See ei näe mulle üldse {STR_VAR_1} moodi välja.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
en: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay. But my POKéMON is cute, you know…
et: Oh, kui sa ei taha, on see okei. Aga mu POKéMON on armas, tead küll…

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
en: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise it with care and kindness.
et: Iga POKéMON võib olla armas, kui kasvatad teda hoole ja lahkusega.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: In all sorts of places, there are all sorts of POKéMON and people.
et: Igasugustes kohtades on igasuguseid POKéMONe ja inimesi.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: I find that fascinating, so I go to all sorts of places.
et: Mind paelub see, nii et ma käin igasugustes kohtades.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We don't need a kid around! Go on home already!
et: Meil pole last vaja! Mine juba koju!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I want to go home…
et: Ma tahan koju…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: I want to get a promotion so I can boss around the GRUNTS…
et: Ma tahan edutamist, et saaksin REAMEESTELE käske jagada…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: That submarine… It's tiny inside. I'm sore all over!
et: See allveelaev… See on seest tilluke. Mul on üleni valus!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Losing makes me sore!
et: Kaotamine teeb mind pahaseks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: That submarine we jacked, man, it's brutal as a ride. It's way too tight in there!
et: See allveelaev, mille me kaaperdasime, sõber, on jõhker sõiduriist. Seal on lihtsalt liiga kitsas!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: You're the first TRAINER I've seen who deploys POKéMON so masterfully.
et: Sa oled esimene TRAINER, keda ma näinud olen, kes oma POKéMONe nii meisterlikult juhib.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: But, I should tell you--my son is stronger than you.
et: Aga ma pean sulle ütlema – mu poeg on sinust tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge, I'll have you know.
et: Ta võttis isegi POKéMON LEAGUE väljakutse vastu, tean ütelda.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: We use this MACHO BRACE to more effectively strengthen our POKéMON in training.
et: Me kasutame seda MACHO BRACE'i, et oma POKéMONe treeningus tõhusamalt tugevdada.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: Since you've beaten all of us here, I don't know if you need it, but we would like you to have our MACHO BRACE.
et: Kuna sa oled meid kõiki siin võitnud, ma ei tea, kas sa seda vajad, aga me tahaksime, et sa saaksid meie MACHO BRACE'i.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
en: When it comes to POKéMON battles, we tend to be pretty passionate.
et: Kui asi puudutab POKéMON-lahinguid, kaldume me olema päris kirglikud.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.
et: Emme on issist tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: I'm stronger than Mommy.
et: Mina olen emmest tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: And Grandma's stronger than me!
et: Ja vanaema on minust tugevam!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: But my big brother is even stronger than Grandma.
et: Aga mu suur vend on isegi vanaemast tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: There's no question that you're strong.
et: Pole kahtlust, et sa oled tugev.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: But if you were to battle my grandson, you'd end up crying in frustration.
et: Aga kui sa võitleksid mu pojapojaga, jääksid sa lõpuks pettumusest nutma.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He's much stronger than any TRAINER our family knows.
et: Ta on palju tugevam kui ükski TRAINER, keda meie pere teab.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Ta peab praeguseks esitama väljakutse POKéMON LEAGUE MEISTRILE.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Oma pojapoega tundes võib ta juba MEISTER olla!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: My grandson must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Mu pojapoeg peab praeguseks esitama väljakutse POKéMON LEAGUE MEISTRILE.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Oma pojapoega tundes võib ta juba MEISTER olla!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}? I've heard tales of your exploits.
et: Ah, nii et sina oled {PLAYER}{KUN}? Ma olen kuulnud lugusid su vägitegudest.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: My name is WALLACE.
et: Mu nimi on WALLACE.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: I was once the GYM LEADER of SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.
et: Ma olin kunagi SOOTOPOLISe SAALI JUHT, aga midagi tuli ette.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: So now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN with the GYM's operation.
et: Nii et nüüd olen usaldanud SAALI juhtimise oma mentorile JUANILE.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: GROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON wreaking havoc here, are considered to be super-ancient POKéMON.
et: GROUDONi ja KYOGRET, kaht POKéMONi, kes siin laastavad, peetakse super-iidseteks POKéMONideks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But there aren't just two superancient POKéMON.
et: Aga super-iidseid POKéMONe pole ainult kaks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: There is one more somewhere.
et: Kuskil on veel üks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Somewhere, there is a superancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.
et: Kuskil on super-iidne POKéMON nimega RAYQUAZA.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: It's said that it was RAYQUAZA that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.
et: Öeldakse, et just RAYQUAZA rahustas kaugminevikus kaks võitlejat.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But even I have no clue as to RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…
et: Aga isegi mul pole aimu, kus RAYQUAZA asub…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps know where RAYQUAZA is now?
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa ehk tead, kus RAYQUAZA praegu on?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: If you do, please tell me.
et: Kui tead, palun ütle mulle.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?
et: WALLACE: CAVE OF ORIGIN?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: But that's right here! I need you to do better than that!
et: Aga see on siinsamas! Ma vajan, et sa teeksid paremini!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: Please, I need you to think about where RAYQUAZA might be right now.
et: Palun, ma vajan, et sa mõtleksid, kus RAYQUAZA praegu võiks olla.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?
et: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: But when I met the old lady there earlier, she made no mention of it.
et: Aga kui ma varem sealse vanaprouaga kohtusin, ei maininud ta seda.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: I very much doubt that the old lady would try to hide something from me…
et: Ma väga kahtlen, et vanaproua üritaks minu eest midagi varjata…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this more carefully for me?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa mõtleksid selle üle minu jaoks hoolikamalt?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? Hmm… That's a problem…
et: WALLACE: Ää? Sa ei mäleta? Hmm… See on probleem…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: Can't you remember somehow?
et: Kas sa ei suuda kuidagi meenutada?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?
et: WALLACE: SKY PILLAR?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: That's it! It must be the SKY PILLAR!
et: See ongi! See peab olema SKY PILLAR!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose! We'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, pole hetkegi kaotada! Me suundume kohe SKY PILLARisse!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: The rich atmosphere of the mountain has elevated my psychic power!
et: Mäe rikkalik atmosfäär on tõstnud mu psüühilist väge!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: A mere child like you… You dream of winning?
et: Sinusugune lihtne laps… Sa unistad võitmisest?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
en: I drown in self-pity…
et: Ma uppun enesehaletsusse…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
en: My psychic powers have surely grown several times, but…
et: Mu psüühilised jõud on kindlasti mitu korda kasvanud, aga…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: This is no place for children, least of all you!
et: See pole koht lastele, kõige vähem sulle!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
en: I lost that cleanly…
et: Ma kaotasin selle puhtalt…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: This means my training is still not enough…
et: See tähendab, et mu treening pole veel piisav…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: I've got to keep working toward the summit…
et: Ma pean tippu poole edasi töötama…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: Go, me!
et: Anna minna, mina!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
en: Why have you come here?
et: Miks sa siia tulid?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
en: That was amazing! You're a very special TRAINER.
et: See oli hämmastav! Sa oled väga eriline TRAINER.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMONid, keda enam pole selles maailmas. POKéMONid, kes on nüüd sinuga.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja POKéMONid, keda kohtad tulevikus…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: They are all to be equally cherished. Please remember that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb võrdselt hellitada. Palun pea seda meeles.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: I would like to see your POKéMON when they grow up some more…
et: Ma tahaksin näha su POKéMONe, kui nad veidi rohkem kasvavad…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.
et: Palun, mul on vaja näha su POKéNAVi.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Oh, it's you…
et: Oh, see oled sina…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Have you come to show me your grown POKéMON?
et: Kas tulid mulle oma sirgunud POKéMONe näitama?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
en: How amazing! You are a special person.
et: Kui hämmastav! Sa oled eriline inimene.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMONid, keda enam pole selles maailmas. POKéMONid, kes on nüüd sinuga.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja POKéMONid, keda kohtad tulevikus…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: They are all to be equally cherished. I see that you've remembered that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb võrdselt hellitada. Ma näen, et oled seda meeles pidanud.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMON hide in tall grass like this, don't they?
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMONid peidavad end sellises kõrges rohus, kas pole?

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: Please watch me and see if I can catch one properly.
et: Palun vaata mind ja näe, kas ma suudan korralikult ühe püüda.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: …Whoa!
et: …Ohoo!

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
en: WALLY: I did it… It's my… My POKéMON!
et: WALLY: Ma tegin seda… See on minu… Minu POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
en: {PLAYER}, thank you! Let's go back to the GYM!
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh! Lähme tagasi SAALI!

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right into tall grass.
et: Ma… pole eriti pikk, nii et ma vajun otse kõrgesse rohtu sisse.

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: The grass goes up my nose and… Fwafwafwafwafwa…
et: Rohi läheb mulle ninna ja… Fvafvafvafvafva…

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: Fwatchoo!
et: Fvatšuu!

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
en: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of POKéMON!
et: Ma kavatsen püüda terve hunniku POKéMONe!

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
en: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
et: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
