label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: Elapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}
et: Kulunud aeg: {STR_VAR_2}

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…
et: PARIM REKORD SENIAJANI…

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: No one seems to have taken the challenge. There is no record…
et: Näib, et keegi pole väljakutset vastu võtnud. Rekordit pole…

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Imagine seeing you here!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mõelda vaid, et sind siin näen!

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: And where might my {RIVAL} be?
et: Ja kus mu {RIVAL} olla võiks?

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, I see! You two are running separately. Well, that's fine.
et: Oh, ma näen! Teie kaks jooksete eraldi. Noh, see on hea.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV had the MATCH CALL system installed.
et: Oh, jah, ma kuulsin, et su POKéNAVi oli paigaldatud MATCH CALL süsteem.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Well, then, I should register you in my POKéNAV as well.
et: Noh, siis ma peaksin sind ka oma POKéNAVi registreerima.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: That way, even when we're apart, I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.
et: Nii saan ma isegi siis, kui oleme lahus, su POKéDEXI igal ajal hinnata.

label: Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav
en: Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
et: PROF. BIRCH registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}. … … … … … …
et: Palun hoia mu {RIVAL}-i peal silma. … … … … … …

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Well, I had better get going. See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Noh, ma pean minema hakkama. Näeme jälle, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER! Keep the win streak as the toughest TRAINER!
et: See on BATTLE TOWER! Hoia võidusarja kui kõige sitkem TRAINER!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
en: This is the BATTLE PALACE! Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!
et: See on BATTLE PALACE! Hoia silm peal POKéMON-lahingutel!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
en: This is the BATTLE ARENA! Let the toughest teams gather!
et: See on BATTLE ARENA! Kogunegu sitkeimad meeskonnad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
en: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID! Advance through the Battle Quest!
et: See on BATTLE PYRAMID! Liigu edasi läbi Battle Questi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
en: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL Set your sights on new records!
et: BATTLE FRONTIERi RANKING HALL — sea sihiks uued rekordid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
en: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER Exchange your Battle Points!
et: BATTLE POINTide VAHETUSTEENUSE NURK — vaheta oma Battle Pointid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: Wow! It's huge!
et: Ohoo! See on hiiglaslik!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: The BATTLE TOWER feels special. It's different from the others.
et: BATTLE TOWER tundub eriline. See erineb teistest.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: My grand ambition is to conquer both the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Mu suur unistus on vallutada nii BATTLE FRONTIER kui POKéMON LEAGUE.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: And if my dream comes true…
et: Ja kui mu unistus täitub…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door if she will be friends with me!
et: Ma… ma küsin naabertüdrukult MIMILT, kas ta on minuga sõber!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! I just can't make it to the top!
et: BATTLE PYRAMID on liiga karm! Ma lihtsalt ei jõua tippu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: Since I'm out of options, maybe I can climb the outside…
et: Kuna mul pole valikuid, võib-olla ronin mööda välisseina…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: I thrive in darkness… Yes… What is worthy of me? None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…
et: Ma õitsen pimeduses… Jah… Mis on minu vääriline? Ei miski muu kui BATTLE PYRAMID…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: What say you to wandering in darkness and in utter and total desperation?
et: Mida ütled ekslemisele pimeduses ja täielikus meeleheites?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I didn't sleep for a week, but then I put together the ultimate team!
et: Ma ei maganud terve nädala, aga siis panin kokku ülima meeskonna!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I can't see myself losing, no joke. We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Ma ei suuda ette kujutada, et kaotan, ilma naljata. Me tormame BATTLE ARENALE!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: Did SCOTT bring you here, too? What is it with that guy?
et: Kas SCOTT tõi sinugi siia? Mis sellel tüübil viga on?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: It sounds like he really does know how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…
et: Tundub, et ta tõesti oskab andekaid TRAINEReid ära tunda, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: I've never seen him battling in person ever.
et: Ma pole teda kunagi ise võitlemas näinud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: ZIGG! I believe in you, little buddy!
et: ZIGG! Ma usun sinusse, väike sõber!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite tasty treats you like if you win!
et: Ma teen oma väikesele ZIGGile mis tahes lemmikmaiuse, mida tahad, kui võidad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
en: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…
et: ZIGZAGOON näeb tühjapilguline välja…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: People call me a busybody, but I can't help it.
et: Inimesed kutsuvad mind sekeldajaks, aga ma ei saa sinna midagi parata.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: Your hat's on crooked! Oh, no, trash on the ground! Oops, it's almost dinnertime!
et: Su müts on viltu! Oh ei, prügi maas! Uups, peagi on õhtusöögiaeg!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: I don't know if I can stand to just watch at the BATTLE PALACE…
et: Ma ei tea, kas suudan BATTLE PALACE'is lihtsalt pealt vaadata…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: I may not look that impressive now, but I once beat a GYM LEADER.
et: Ma ei pruugi praegu eriti muljetavaldav välja näha, aga ma alistasin kunagi SAALI JUHI.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: Who knows, maybe I should give it another shot at glory.
et: Kes teab, võib-olla peaksin veel korra hiilguse poole püüdlema.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for the way I battle, too.
et: Ma olen JALGRATTAL kiire, ja sama kehtib mu võitlemise kohta.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I win matches in the blink of an eye!
et: Ma võidan matše silmapilkselt!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
en: I'm better than my daddy at POKéMON.
et: Ma olen POKéMONides parem kui mu issi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: Go on, my baby sweetie! Go rack up some wins for Daddy!
et: Anna minna, mu kullapai! Mine korja issi jaoks võite!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: You're just like your mother, so you'll be dominating!
et: Sa oled täpselt nagu su ema, nii et sa domineerid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: It wasn't easy getting here, but I'd heard about this knockout pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Siia jõudmine polnud lihtne, aga ma olin kuulnud sellest löövast kaunist tüdrukust BATTLE ARENAS.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: Instead of her, do you know what I found?
et: Tema asemel, kas tead, mida ma leidsin?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: A whole teeming mob of sweaty, stinky, and primitive martial artists!
et: Terve kihav higine, haisev ja primitiivne võitluskunstnike mürakas!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: I sometimes see this really importantlooking old man going in there.
et: Ma näen vahel seda tõesti tähtsa väljanägemisega vanameest sinna sisse minemas.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: He has these really awesome POKéMON. He seems really nice, though.
et: Tal on need tõesti vägevad POKéMONid. Ta tundub siiski tõesti tore.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Do you know it? The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?
et: Kas tead seda? BATTLE PYRAMIDi legendi?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: When there comes a confident TRAINER reaching for the golden pinnacle, there shall appear a man among men.
et: Kui tuleb enesekindel TRAINER, kes küünitab kuldse tipu poole, ilmub mees meeste seas.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Don't know that legend? Well, of course not! I just made it up!
et: Ei tea seda legendi? Noh, muidugi mitte! Ma just mõtlesin selle välja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: What's it supposed to mean? That, my friend, I can't say!
et: Mida see peaks tähendama? Seda, mu sõber, ma öelda ei oska!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: Man! Oh man! I've never lost once before!
et: Mees! Oh mees! Ma pole kunagi varem kordagi kaotanud!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: But I got wiped out with no saving grace at all!
et: Aga mind pühiti minema ilma vähimatki päästvat armu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: And then I'm told I don't have any talent?! Man!
et: Ja siis öeldakse mulle, et mul pole mingit annet?! Mees!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: This guy ran into a horribly tough TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE TOWER challenge.
et: See tüüp sattus BATTLE TOWERi väljakutsel ülisitke TRAINERi otsa.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: Now look at him…
et: Nüüd vaata teda…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: You need to be cautious if you ever decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.
et: Sa pead olema ettevaatlik, kui kunagi otsustad BATTLE TOWERisse minna.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: Yes! I've finally got enough Battle Points!
et: Jah! Mul on lõpuks piisavalt Battle Pointe!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: I guess I'll trade for another giant plush DOLL!
et: Vist vahetan veel ühe hiiglasliku kaltsunuku vastu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: Oh, yeah, okay! So this is the RANKING HALL!
et: Oh, jaa, olgu! Nii et see on RANKING HALL!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: I'd like to go down in history as a super champ and have my name recorded here for posterity.
et: Ma sooviksin ajalukku minna kui supermeister ja lasta oma nimi siia järeltulevatele põlvedele jäädvustada.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
en: With you by my side, I can do anything.
et: Sinuga mu kõrval suudan ma kõike.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!
et: Ohh, kullake, sa oled nii imeline!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!
et: Ohh, ma ei suuda enam oodata!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM right this instant!
et: Lähme kohe sel hetkel MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, the power of our love will overcome everyone we meet.
et: Kui saame BATTLE SALONIS kokku, ületab meie armastuse jõud kõik, keda kohtame.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Why, before us, darling, everything will topple like dominoes!
et: Ohoo, meie ees, kullake, langeb kõik nagu doominokivid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively for tough TRAINERS.
et: BATTLE FRONTIER pole ainult sitkete TRAINERite jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: Many people with special abilities have been invited, it seems.
et: Näib, et kutsutud on palju erivõimetega inimesi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: That man SCOTT…
et: See mees SCOTT…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: He may have built this place to serve a bigger objective…
et: Ta võis selle koha ehitada suurema eesmärgi teenimiseks…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you good eyesight?
et: Vabandust, nooruke. Kas sul on hea nägemine?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: There is an odd tree past here, and to my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
et: Siit edasi on veider puu ja mu väsinud silmadele näib, et see vingerdab.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you a good memory?
et: Vabandust, nooruke. Kas sul on hea mälu?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: I have this feeling there once was an odd tree past here.
et: Mul on tunne, et kunagi oli siit edasi veider puu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: I… I saw it!
et: Ma… ma nägin seda!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON with a long tail up ahead!
et: Seal eespool oli üks kleepuv pika sabaga POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: It was hiding under a boulder, and it kept staring at me!
et: See peitis end rahnu all ja jõllitas mind pidevalt!

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.
et: Ma jätsin oma POKéMONi PÄEVAHOIDU.

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: When I got it back, it had a new move that I didn't teach it. I was really, really surprised.
et: Kui ma ta tagasi sain, oskas ta uut võtet, mida ma talle ei õpetanud. Ma olin tõesti-tõesti üllatunud.

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: What do you think? Aren't these flowers pretty?
et: Mis sa arvad? Kas need lilled pole ilusad?

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: I planted them all!
et: Ma istutasin nad kõik!

label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
en: The air is tasty here!
et: Õhk on siin maitsev!

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
en: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN
et: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
en: POKéMON DAY CARE “Let us raise your POKéMON.”
et: POKéMON PÄEVAHOID „Lubage meil teie POKéMONi kasvatada.”

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?
et: Sa oled POKéMON TRAINER, kas pole?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. Even more than his student WALLACE!
et: SOOTOPOLISE JUANIL on palju fänne. Isegi rohkem kui ta õpilasel WALLACEL!

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: Do you have any?
et: Kas sul on üldse?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
en: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.
et: Oh, siis sa pead olema päris tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome.
et: Oh, heldeke… See on veidi üksildane.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Try working a little harder to get a fan following.
et: Proovi veidi kõvemini pingutada, et fänniparve saada.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN.
et: Pühendunud fännid tulevad kohale isegi väljastpoolt HOENNI.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.
et: Oli tõesti metsik, kui ma läksin TRAINERI FÄNNIKLUBISSE LILYCOVES.

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: ARCHIE: What happened… What is this wretched scene…
et: ARCHIE: Mis juhtus… Mis õnnetu vaatepilt see on…

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: Did I…make a horrible mistake?
et: Kas ma… tegin kohutava vea?

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
en: I… I only wanted…
et: Ma… Ma tahtsin vaid…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: MAXIE: Do you understand now, ARCHIE?
et: MAXIE: Kas sa nüüd mõistad, ARCHIE?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: Do you finally see how disastrous your dream turned out to be?
et: Kas sa lõpuks näed, kui hukatuslikuks su unistus osutus?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: We have to hurry! We have to do something before the situation goes completely out of control!
et: Me peame kiirustama! Me peame midagi tegema, enne kui olukord täiesti kontrolli alt väljub!

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, ära ütle midagi.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: I know that I have no right to be critical of ARCHIE…
et: Ma tean, et mul pole õigust ARCHIET kritiseerida…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But the way things are now, I doubt that we humans will be capable of doing anything about it.
et: Aga nii nagu asjad praegu on, ma kahtlen, kas meie, inimesed, suudame sellega midagi ette võtta.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But neither can we stand by and just watch helplessly.
et: Aga me ei saa ka kõrvale jääda ja lihtsalt abitult pealt vaadata.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: The responsibility for putting an end to this falls to ARCHIE and me…
et: Vastutus sellele lõpu tegemise eest langeb ARCHIE ja minu õlule…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: MAXIE: This defies belief…
et: MAXIE: See ületab uskumise piirid…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Those super-ancient POKéMON…
et: Need ürgvanad POKéMONid…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Their power is unbelievable. They've upset the balance of nature…
et: Nende jõud on uskumatu. Nad on rikkunud looduse tasakaalu…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! What is happening?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mis toimub?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This is terrible…
et: See on kohutav…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: After the scorching heat wave ended, this deluge began.
et: Pärast kõrvetavat kuumalainet algas see uputus.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… No, the whole world will drown.
et: Kui see ei lakka, siis kogu HOENN… Ei, kogu maailm upub.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This huge rain cloud is spreading from above SOOTOPOLIS…
et: See tohutu vihmapilv levib SOOTOPOLISE kohalt…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: What in the world is taking place there?
et: Mis maailmas seal toimub?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: There's no point arguing here… SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…
et: Pole mõtet siin vaielda… SOOTOPOLIS võib vastuseid pakkuda…

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… I don't know what you intend to do, but don't do anything reckless.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Ma ei tea, mida sa kavatsed teha, aga ära tee midagi hoolimatut.

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: Okay. I'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Olgu. Ma lähen SOOTOPOLISESSE.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!
et: EMME: {PLAYER}, me oleme kohal, kullake!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It must be tiring riding with our things in the moving truck.
et: See pidi olema väsitav, sõites kolimisautos koos meie asjadega.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.
et: Noh, see on LITTLEROOT TOWN.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: How do you like it? This is our new home!
et: Kuidas sulle meeldib? See on meie uus kodu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be an easy place to live, don't you think?
et: Sellel on omapärane hõng, aga näib olevat lihtne koht elamiseks, kas sa ei arva?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! Let's go inside.
et: Ja sa saad oma toa, {PLAYER}! Läki sisse.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
en: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!
et: EMME: Oota, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
et: EMME: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Kas sa tutvustasid end PROF. BIRCHILE?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!
et: Oh! Milline armas POKéMON! Sa said selle PROF. BIRCHILT. Kui tore!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON!
et: Sa oled ikka oma isa laps. Sa näed POKéMONiga koos hea välja!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.
et: Siin, kullake! Kui lähed seiklema, kanna neid RUNNING SHOESE.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: They'll put a zip in your step!
et: Need panevad su sammu vilkaks!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
en: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.
et: {PLAYER} vahetas jalatsid RUNNING SHOESE vastu.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with instructions.
et: EMME: {PLAYER}, nende jalatsitega tuli kaasa juhend.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Press the B Button while wearing these RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!
et: „Vajuta B-nuppu, kui kannad neid RUNNING SHOESE, et joosta eriti kiiresti!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race in the great outdoors!”
et: „Libista jalga need RUNNING SHOES ja kihuta suures looduses!”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: To think that you have your very own POKéMON now… Your father will be overjoyed.
et: Kui mõelda, et sul on nüüd oma POKéMON… Su isa on ülirõõmus.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: …But please be careful. If anything happens, you can come home.
et: …Aga palun ole ettevaatlik. Kui midagi juhtub, võid koju tulla.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: Go on, go get them, honey!
et: Anna minna, näita neile, kullake!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: If you use a PC, you can store items and POKéMON.
et: Kui kasutad PC-d, saad hoiustada esemeid ja POKéMONe.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: The power of science is staggering!
et: Teaduse jõud on jahmatav!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB studying, then he'll suddenly go out in the wild to do more research…
et: PROF. BIRCH veedab päevi oma LABORIS uurides, siis läheb ta ootamatult loodusesse veel uurima…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: When does PROF. BIRCH spend time at home?
et: Millal PROF. BIRCH kodus aega veedab?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: Um, um, um!
et: Öö, öö, öö!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: If you go outside and go in the grass, wild POKéMON will jump out!
et: Kui lähed välja ja lähed rohtu, hüppavad metsikud POKéMONid välja!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
en: It's dangerous if you don't have your own POKéMON.
et: On ohtlik, kui sul pole oma POKéMONi.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Um, hi!
et: Öö, tere!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: There are scary POKéMON outside! I can hear their cries!
et: Väljas on hirmsaid POKéMONe! Ma kuulen nende kisa!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: I want to go see what's going on, but I don't have any POKéMON…
et: Ma tahan minna vaatama, mis toimub, aga mul pole ühtki POKéMONi…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Can you go see what's happening for me?
et: Kas saaksid minu eest vaatama minna, mis toimub?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
en: You saved PROF. BIRCH! I'm so glad!
et: Sa päästsid PROF. BIRCHI! Ma olen nii rõõmus!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
en: Are you going to catch POKéMON? Good luck!
et: Kas lähed POKéMONe püüdma? Edu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
en: LITTLEROOT TOWN “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”
et: LITTLEROOT TOWN „Linn, mida ei saa ühtki värvi varjundada.”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
en: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB
et: PROF. BIRCHI POKéMON LABOR

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
en: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE
et: {PLAYER} MAJA

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
en: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE
et: PROF. BIRCHI MAJA

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! That was good work out there!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Noh-noh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See oli seal hea töö!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I knew there was something special about you when I first saw you, but I never expected this.
et: Ma teadsin, et sinus on midagi erilist, kui sind esimest korda nägin, aga ma ei oodanud seda.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX I gave you?
et: Oh, jah. Kas su POKéDEX, mille ma sulle andsin, on veel alles?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I have something to show you. Let's go to my LAB.
et: Mul on sulle midagi näidata. Läki mu LABORISSE.

en: Your BATTLE ROOM challenge will be canceled.
et: Su BATTLE ROOMi väljakutse tühistatakse.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: Where has our WALLY gone?
et: Kuhu meie WALLY on läinud?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN very soon…
et: Me peame väga varsti VERDANTURF TOWNI poole teele asuma…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Hiya! Are you maybe… A rookie TRAINER?
et: Tere! Kas sa oled äkki… algaja TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS do when they reach a new town?
et: Kas tead, mida POKéMON TRAINERID teevad, kui nad uude linna jõuavad?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: They first check what kind of GYM is in the town.
et: Nad kontrollivad kõigepealt, milline SAAL linnas on.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
en: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.
et: Näed? See on PETALBURG CITY SAAL.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
en: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it whenever you're looking for a GYM.
et: See on SAALI silt. Otsi seda, kui SAALI otsid.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: My face is reflected in the water.
et: Mu nägu peegeldub vees.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: It's a shining grin full of hope…
et: See on särav naeratus, täis lootust…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: Or it could be a look of somber silence struggling with fear…
et: Või võib see olla sünge vaikuse ilme, mis hirmuga heitleb…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: What do you see reflected in your face?
et: Mida sina näed oma näos peegeldumas?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: Let's say you have six POKéMON. If you catch another one…
et: Oletame, et sul on kuus POKéMONi. Kui püüad veel ühe…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: It is automatically sent to a STORAGE BOX over a PC connection.
et: See saadetakse automaatselt PC-ühenduse kaudu HOIUKASTI.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: NORMAN “A man in pursuit of power!”
et: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYMi JUHT: NORMAN „Mees jõu poole püüdlemas!”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
en: PETALBURG CITY “Where people mingle with nature.”
et: PETALBURG CITY „Kus inimesed suhtlevad loodusega.”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
en: WALLY'S HOUSE
et: WALLY MAJA

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Excuse me!
et: Vabandust!

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Let me guess, from the way you're dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?
et: Las ma arvan, su riietuse järgi, kas sa oled POKéMON TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: Well, maybe not. Your clothes aren't all that dirty.
et: Noh, võib-olla mitte. Su riided pole sugugi nii mustad.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: You're either a rookie TRAINER, or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.
et: Sa oled kas algaja TRAINER või siis lihtsalt tavaline laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm roaming the land in search of talented TRAINERS.
et: Ma rändan mööda maad andekaid TRAINEReid otsides.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm sorry to have taken your time.
et: Vabandust, et sinu aja võtsin.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC.
et: Kaup, mille siit ostad, saadetakse su enda PC-sse.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: That's fantastic! I wish they could also deliver me home like that.
et: See on fantastiline! Ma sooviksin, et nad saaksid ka mind niimoodi koju toimetada.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it.
et: Ma ostan ilusa laua ja panen sellele oma nunnud NUKUD.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: If I don't, when I decorate my SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get dirty or poked with splinters.
et: Kui ma seda ei tee, määrduvad mu NUKUD või saavad SALAKORTERIT kaunistades pindusid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
en: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
et: Ma näitan sulle ülevaid tehnikaid, mille õppisin meie JUHILT JUANILT!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
en: Please forgive me, JUAN…
et: Palun andesta mulle, JUAN…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
en: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.
et: Vaata, mis juhtub, kui kõik põrandaplaadid ära mõranetad.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN.
et: Sa tulid kogu selle tee siia, aga sa ei saa JUANI näha.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: Not if you lose to me, you won't!
et: Ei saa, kui sa mulle kaotad!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
en: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!
et: Sa oled tugev! Mind pettis su armas välimus!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
en: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.
et: Sa võid olla piisavalt hea, et vältida JUANILT ühe löögiga tapmist.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle…
et: Vaatepilt JUANIST lahingut juhtimas…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.
et: Ainuüksi selle ilu sundis mind TRAINERIKS hakkama.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
en: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…
et: Sa võitlesid suurema iluga, kui mina kokku suutsin võtta…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous.
et: Graatsia, mille sa lahingusse tood, on vapustav.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.
et: Oh… Mul on nii vedanud, et olen POKéMONid leidnud.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
en: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.
et: Ma peaksin sulle õpetama, kui karmid lahingud olla saavad.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
en: Oh. You're strong.
et: Oh. Sa oled tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: I'll tell you something good.
et: Ma ütlen sulle midagi head.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.
et: Kui tahad JUANI juurde jõuda, pead igal põrandaplaadil kord kõndima.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region…
et: HOENNI piirkonna kõige kõrgema taseme POKéMON SAAL…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.
et: See on SOOTOPOLIS SAAL.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
en: What a high level you are!
et: Millisel kõrgel tasemel sa oled!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
en: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.
et: Selle asemel, et olla rahul tugevas SAALIS olemisega, ma kujutan ette, et mujal treenimine teeb sind tugevamaks. Aga eelkõige näib see lõbusam.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN.
et: Ma treenin oma POKéMONe koos JUANIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: Don't think I'm a pushover.
et: Ära arva, et ma olen lonus.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Mind võideti…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
en: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?
et: Ma arvan, et sul on potentsiaali. Miks sa ei jää ja treeni meiega?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines…
et: Graatsiline liuglemine üle jää, ühtki joont ületamata…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!
et: TRAINER, kes seda etendust esitab, oleks elegantselt ilus!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
en: Well, excuse me?!
et: Noh, vabandust väga?!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
en: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.
et: See on tõesti ilmselge, aga kui tugev sa TRAINERINA oled, ei ole midagi pistmist sellega, kui noor või vana sa oled.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
en: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
et: Kui ma olen oma POKéMONidega, lendab aeg mööda, enne kui jõuad öelda „Uups!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
en: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”
et: Ma sooviksin, et suudaksin lootusetud asjad unustada, enne kui jõuan öelda „Uups!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
en: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.
et: Ma võin võidelda tõesti haruldaste POKéMONidega, kui soovid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
en: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?
et: Oh, no vaat! Kas sa vaatasid mu POKéMONi hoolega?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON.
et: Ma tulin sellesse SAALI, sest JUAN kiitis mind mu kallite POKéMONide eest.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…
et: Oh, kui ma vaid oleksin JUANIGA kohtunud aastaid tagasi, kui olin noorem…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
en: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.
et: Kihi… Su sünge ilme on nii võluv.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
en: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.
et: Oh, heldeke. Ma läksin sinuga palju liiga leebeks.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
en: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…
et: Sa ei suudaks JUANILE sõrmegi külge panna, ma olen kindel. Kihi…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: POKéMON are partners to people. They aren't our tools.
et: POKéMONid on inimeste partnerid. Nad pole meie tööriistad.

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: Unfortunately, there are some people who fail to understand that…
et: Kahjuks on mõned inimesed, kes ei suuda seda mõista…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
en: KECLEON: Ruroro?
et: KECLEON: Ruroro?

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
en: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…
et: Äratatud RAYQUAZA lendas minema…

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
en: When POKéMON battle, they eventually level up and become stronger.
et: Kui POKéMONid võitlevad, tõusevad nad lõpuks tasemel ja muutuvad tugevamaks.

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
en: If the POKéMON with you become stronger, you'll be able to go farther away from here.
et: Kui su POKéMONid tugevamaks muutuvad, saad siit kaugemale minna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERite võitlusvaim!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE ARENASSE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht Set KO turniirile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
en: Now, do you wish to take the BATTLE ARENA challenge?
et: Nüüd, kas soovid võtta vastu BATTLE ARENA väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame su väljakutset mõnel teisel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake the Set KO Tourney.
et: BATTLE ARENAS peame Set KO turniiri.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: All participants enter with a team of three POKéMON.
et: Kõik osalejad astuvad üles kolme POKéMONi meeskonnaga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: The three POKéMON must be lined up in the order in which they are to appear.
et: Kolm POKéMONi tuleb reastada järjekorras, milles nad esinema hakkavad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: During battle, the POKéMON will appear one at a time in the preset order.
et: Lahingu ajal ilmuvad POKéMONid ükshaaval etteantud järjekorras.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must remain out until the match is decided.
et: Kui POKéMON on lahingusse astunud, peab ta väljas püsima, kuni matš on otsustatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If a match remains undecided in three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui matš jääb kolme käiguga otsustamata, läheb see hindamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you wish to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui soovid oma väljakutse katkestada, palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will not be able to continue with your challenge.
et: Kui sa ei salvesta, ei saa sa väljakutset jätkata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you pull off the feat of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui suudad alistada seitse TRAINERit järjest, kingime sulle Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
en: Before showing you to the BATTLE ARENA, you must save. Is that okay?
et: Enne kui sind BATTLE ARENASSE juhatan, pead salvestama. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?
et: BATTLE ARENA pakub kahte raskusastet: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumb on sinu valik?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very well, now select your three POKéMON, please.
et: Väga hea, nüüd vali oma kolm POKéMONi, palun.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Sul pole sisenemiseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Kvalifitseerumiseks pead tooma kolm erinevat liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled ettevalmistused teinud, palun tule tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Sul pole sisenemiseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Kvalifitseerumiseks pead tooma kolm erinevat liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: The three different POKéMON must all be Level 50 or lower.
et: Kõik kolm erinevat POKéMONi peavad olema tasemel 50 või madalamal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled ettevalmistused teinud, palun tule tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
en: I shall now guide you to the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Ma juhatan sind nüüd BATTLE ARENASSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You did not save the game before shutting down, did you?
et: Sa ei salvestanud mängu enne sulgemist, ega ju?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: It is unfortunate, but that has resulted in your disqualification from your challenge.
et: Kahju, aga see tõi kaasa su väljakutsest diskvalifitseerimise.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You may, of course, start with a fresh challenge.
et: Muidugi võid alustada värske väljakutsega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
en: We congratulate you for your splendid string of wins over seven TRAINERS!
et: Õnnitleme sind suurepärase võidusarja puhul seitsme TRAINERi üle!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
en: Your achievement will be recorded. Please wait while I save the game.
et: Sinu saavutus salvestatakse. Palun oota, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
en: In commemoration of your 7-win streak, we present you with this prize.
et: Sinu 7-võidusarja mälestuseks kingime sulle selle auhinna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: Oh? Your BAG seems to be full.
et: Oh? Su KOTT näib olevat täis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: I urge you to clear space and return for your prize.
et: Ma soovitan teha ruumi ja tulla oma auhinna järele tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Thank you so much for participating!
et: Suur tänu osalemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Please wait while I save the game.
et: Palun oota, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame su väljakutset mõnel teisel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival.
et: Me oleme sinu saabumist oodanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: Before I show you to the BATTLE ARENA, I must save the game. Please wait.
et: Enne kui sind BATTLE ARENASSE juhatan, pean mängu salvestama. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas salvestada su viimane BATTLE ARENA matš FRONTIER PASSile?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…
et: Ma kaotasin KOHTUNIKU otsusega…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I don't think it was a good idea to only use defensive moves and not attack…
et: Ma ei arva, et oli hea mõte kasutada ainult kaitsevõtteid ja mitte rünnata…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: I won in judging!
et: Ma võitsin hindamisel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: Landing hits consistently on the opponent's POKéMON worked!
et: Vastase POKéMONi järjekindel tabamine toimis!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: Our match was declared a draw.
et: Meie matš kuulutati viigiks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: When we ran out of time, both my POKéMON and the opponent's had about the same amount of HP left.
et: Kui aeg otsa sai, oli nii minu kui vastase POKéMONil umbes sama palju elupunkte alles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of POKéMON is totally important.
et: BATTLE ARENAS on POKéMONide järjekord ülimalt oluline.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: For example, if your first POKéMON has certain type disadvantages, try making your second POKéMON one with moves that are super effective against the first one.
et: Näiteks kui su esimesel POKéMONil on teatud tüübi puudused, proovi teha oma teiseks POKéMONiks selline, kelle võtted on esimese vastu ülitõhusad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: I think that will be a good way of making an effective team.
et: Ma arvan, et see on hea viis tõhusa meeskonna loomiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.
et: Set KO turniiri reeglid on loetletud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles.
et: Set KO turniiril on erireeglid, erinevalt tavalistest lahingutest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: First, one battle lasts only three turns.
et: Esiteks, üks lahing kestab vaid kolm käiku.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui kolme käiguga tulemus ei selgu, läheb see hindamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled.
et: KOHTUNIK valib võitja selle põhjal, kuidas POKéMONid võitlesid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.
et: Samuti ei saa POKéMONi välja vahetada enne, kui ta lahingu tulemus on selgunud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were.
et: Esimene hindamistegur on „Vaim”. See tegur hindab, kui agressiivsed võitlejad olid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.
et: Hindamine põhineb sellel, kui tihti TRAINERid käskisid kasutada ründevõtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used.
et: Teine hindamistegur on „Oskus”. See tegur hindab, kui tõhusalt POKéMONi võtteid kasutati.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up.
et: Kui võte õnnestus, tõuseb Oskuse hinnang.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered.
et: Kui võte ebaõnnestus, langeb Oskuse hinnang.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.”
et: Kui see oli ründevõte, tõuseb Oskuse hinnang, kui võte oli „ülitõhus”, ja langeb, kui see oli „mitte eriti tõhus”.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.
et: Oskuse hinnang ei tõuse võtete puhul nagu PROTECT ja DETECT.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.
et: Kui vastane kasutas PROTECTi või DETECTi ja su POKéMON ei suutnud võttega tabada, ei lange ta Oskuse hinnang.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle.
et: Kolmas hindamistegur on „Keha”. See tegur põhineb sellel, kui palju elupunkte lahingu lõpuks alles jäi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.
et: Hinnang võtab arvesse, kui palju elupunkte POKéMONil lahingu alguses oli ja mis lõpuks alles jäi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: A victory snatched from the ARENA TYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!
et: Võit napsatud ARENA TÜKOONILT ja seitsme TRAINERi puhaslüüa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: We congratulate you on your most splendid challenge!
et: Õnnitleme sind kõige suurepärasema väljakutse puhul!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints
en: My dear challenger, in recognition of your indefatigable spirit, please accept these Battle Point(s).
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja, sinu väsimatu vaimu tunnustuseks palun võta vastu need Battle Pointid.

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
en: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD
et: SISENED VICTORY ROADILE
