en: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE CENTER GATE
et: SISENED POKéMON LEAGUE'i KESKUSEVÄRAVASSE

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: EVER GRANDE CITY
et: EVER GRANDE CITY

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The paradise of flowers, the sea, and POKéMON.”
et: „Lillede, mere ja POKéMONide paradiis.”

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: MT. PYRE…
et: MT. PYRE…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?
et: Selle tipus on kaks orbi kõrvuti asetatud. Kas teadsid?

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: Yes, two orbs side by side…
et: Jah, kaks orbi kõrvuti…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…
et: Vaatepilt neist koos… See on kuidagi rahustav…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
en: Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…
et: On või nii? Ehk peaksid külastama ja vaatama…

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Ohhh, what am I to do?
et: Ohhh, mida ma tegema pean?

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when we were jumped by an odd thug…
et: Me olime jalutuskäigul, PEEKO ja mina, kui üks veider suli meile kallale kargas…

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: The scoundrel made off with my darling PEEKO!
et: See lurjus jooksis minema mu kallis PEEKOGA!

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!
et: Rrrrooooaaar! PEEKO!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn… Rõõk!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: I want to dig that tunnel!
et: Ma tahan seda tunnelit kaevata!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: Nnn… Roar! What's going on?
et: Nnn… Rõõk! Mis toimub?

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I was digging the tunnel without any tools when some goon ordered me out!
et: Ma kaevasin tunnelit ilma tööriistadeta, kui mingi suli käskis mind välja!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That tunnel's filled with POKéMON that react badly to loud noises. They could cause an uproar.
et: See tunnel on täis POKéMONe, kes reageerivad valjudele helidele halvasti. Nad võivad möllu tekitada.

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That's why we stopped using heavy equipment for tunneling…
et: Just seepärast me lõpetasime tunneli kaevamiseks raske tehnika kasutamise…

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I'm worried that the goon will do something stupid and startle the POKéMON into an uproar.
et: Ma kardan, et suli teeb midagi rumalat ja ehmatab POKéMONid möllama.

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn… Rõõk!

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: That goofy goon hightailed it out of the tunnel! I can go back to digging!
et: See lollakas suli lasi tunnelist sabaga vehkides jalga! Ma saan kaevamise juurde tagasi minna!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Oh! It's you!
et: Oh! See oled sina!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: You're that person who not only helped me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got back my stolen package and then even graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!
et: Sina oled see isik, kes mitte üksnes ei aidanud mind PETALBURG WOODSis, vaid tõi tagasi ka mu varastatud paki ja seejärel toimetas selle isegi lahkelt SLATEPORTI!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: CAPT. STERN informed us that the package arrived, too!
et: KAPTEN STERN teatas meile, et pakk jõudis samuti kohale!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: I thank you very, very much!
et: Ma tänan sind väga-väga palju!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would shower you with gratitude and hail you as a hero!
et: No kui ma oleksin vihmapilv, ma kastaksin sind tänuga ja ülistaksin sind kangelasena!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: For you, the most wonderful TRAINER, I bear good news!
et: Sinule, kõige imelisemale TRAINERILE, ma toon häid uudiseid!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Recently, our company developed a new kind of POKé BALL.
et: Hiljuti töötas meie firma välja uut sorti POKé BALLi.

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation, this is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!
et: Meie tänu märgiks, see on meie kink meie imelisele TRAINERILE!

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Our new POKé BALL will be available at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.
et: Meie uus POKé BALL tuleb müügile RUSTBORO POKéMON MARTIS.

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Please do try it out! Thank you and bye-bye!
et: Palun proovi seda kindlasti! Aitäh ja head aega!

label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
en: Your BAG is jam-packed. I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.
et: Su KOTT on puupüsti täis. Ma ei saa sulle seda REPEAT BALLi anda.

label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation for your delivering our package, I have a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our most wonderful TRAINER!
et: Meie tänu märgiks meie paki toimetamise eest on mul uut sorti POKé BALLi kink meie kõige imelisemale TRAINERILE!

label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses
en: I dropped my glasses… Can you help me find them?
et: Ma pillasin oma prillid maha… Kas aitad mul neid leida?

label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses
en: Those glasses! May I see them for a second?
et: Need prillid! Kas tohin neid hetkeks näha?

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm… Need on BLACKGLASSES. Nad pole see, mida ma otsin…

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Maybe my glasses aren't around here…
et: Ehk pole mu prillid siin kandis…

label: Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere
en: Hmm… I can't find my glasses anywhere… Maybe they're not around here…
et: Hmm… Ma ei leia oma prille kusagilt… Ehk pole nad siin kandis…

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm… Need on BLACKGLASSES. Nad pole see, mida ma otsin…

label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
en: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
et: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL „Ühendab RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURFI”

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: „Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud.”

label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
en: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE
et: TUNNELIKAEVAJA PUHKEMAJA

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: If you want to stop a POKéMON from evolving, press the B Button while it is trying to evolve. The startled POKéMON will stop.
et: Kui tahad takistada POKéMONi arenemast, vajuta B-nuppu sel ajal, kui ta üritab areneda. Ehmunud POKéMON peatub.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: This is called an evolution cancel.
et: Seda nimetatakse arengu tühistamiseks.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Your BAG has several POCKETS.
et: Su KOTIL on mitu TASKUT.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Items you obtain are automatically placed in the appropriate POCKETS.
et: Esemed, mis sa saad, paigutatakse automaatselt sobivatesse TASKUTESSE.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: No TRAINER can afford to be without a BAG of their own.
et: Ükski TRAINER ei saa endale lubada olla ilma oma KOTITA.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Umm… If this goes here, and that goes over there…
et: Ömm… Kui see läheb siia ja too sinna…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Then where does this thing go? And what about that doohickey?
et: Siis kuhu see asi läheb? Ja mis saab tollest vidinast?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails of this!
et: Aaargh! Ma ei saa sellest pead ega saba!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Hm? Hi, I'm DOCK.
et: Hm? Tere, ma olen DOCK.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN commissioned me to design a ferry.
et: KAPTEN STERN tellis minult praami kavandi.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Oh! That there… Are they DEVON GOODS?
et: Oh! See seal… Kas need on DEVONI KAUP?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: But, hmm… This won't do…
et: Aga, hmm… See ei sobi…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN went off somewhere. He said he had some work to do.
et: KAPTEN STERN läks kuhugi ära. Ta ütles, et tal on veidi tööd teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Could I get you to go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that to him?
et: Kas saaksin panna sind KAPTEN STERNI otsima ja selle talle toimetama?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have gone off to?
et: DOCK: Kuhu KAPTEN STERN küll ära läks?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: Could you go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that parcel to him?
et: Kas saaksid minna KAPTEN STERNI otsima ja selle paki talle toimetada?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.
et: DOCK: Laevaehitus on kunst.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating.
et: Paljusid asju ei saa lihtsalt arvutades välja mõelda.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…
et: Mul kuluks tõesti ära nõu kogenult, kes mered tunneb…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help.
et: DOCK: Tere! HR. BRINEY on meiega liitunud, et meid abistada.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.
et: Tänu kogenud madrusele saab praam pidevalt valmimas.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!
et: DOCK: Praam on lõpuks valmis!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel of technology!
et: Uus S.S. TIDAL on tõeline tehnikaime!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: But, I get the feeling that we can make something even better.
et: Aga mul on tunne, et me suudame teha midagi veelgi paremat.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: You know, there's never an end to technology's march.
et: Tead, tehnika edasimarsil pole kunagi lõppu.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long!
et: HR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! On liiga kaua aega möödas!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky!
et: Jah, kuna ma sind kohtasin, on see vana merekaru end nooruslikuna tundnud!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry.
et: Nii et ma otsustasin aidata DOCKIL praami teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people.
et: Jah, lõppude lõpuks suudaks praam palju inimesi vedada.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: But, you know, that DOCK is really something special.
et: Aga, tead, see DOCK on tõesti miski eriline.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!
et: Tema tehnikavaistuga ja minu kogemusega olen ma kindel, et me suudame ehitada ühe suurepärase laeva, jah!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: The seasons, the weather, where the moon sits in the sky…
et: Aastaajad, ilm, kus kuu taevas asub…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: These and other conditions make the sea change its expression.
et: Need ja teised tingimused panevad mere oma ilmet muutma.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: That's right! The sea is like a living thing!
et: Just nii! Meri on nagu elusolend!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
en: I get seasick real easily. So I get to help out here instead.
et: Ma jään tõesti kergesti merehaigeks. Nii et ma saan siin selle asemel abiks olla.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Hey! I remember your face!
et: Hei! Ma mäletan su nägu!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: If you're here, it must mean that you're about to mess with us again!
et: Kui sa siin oled, peab see tähendama, et kavatsed meiega jälle jamada!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune plika, kas sa tõesti arvad, et suudad TEAM AQUAGA jõudu katsuda?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa oled umbes triljon aastat liiga vara!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Sa sobid ideaalselt TEAM MAGMA seltskonda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: TEAM MAGMAST rääkides, ma kuulen, et neid nähti MOSSDEEPI lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See kamp sulisid, nad tõesti ei näe mere ääres hea välja!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune plika, kas sa tõesti arvad, et suudad TEAM AQUAGA jõudu katsuda?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa oled umbes triljon aastat liiga vara!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Sa sobid ideaalselt TEAM MAGMA seltskonda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: TEAM MAGMAST rääkides, ma kuulen, et neid nähti MOSSDEEPI lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See kamp sulisid, nad tõesti ei näe mere ääres hea välja!

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.
et: Tere! Ma järeldan, et sa oled rändur.

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: How's this? What do you say to taking on our family of four in a series of POKéMON battles?
et: Kuidas oleks? Mida sa ütled meie nelja-liikmelise perega jõudu katsumisele reas POKéMON-lahinguid?

label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
en: Is that so? Drop in, if you change your mind!
et: On või nii? Astu sisse, kui meelt muudad!

label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
en: That's the spirit! I like you!
et: Just selline vaim! Sa meeldid mulle!

label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
en: Aiyah! You're a lot tougher than I expected!
et: Aiah! Sa oled palju kõvem, kui ma ootasin!

label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
en: Hey, all! I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
et: Hei, kõik! Ma leidsin päris tugeva TRAINERI!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?
et: Oh, heldeke! Kas sa polegi noor?

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: You must be quite the TRAINER to beat my husband, though.
et: Sa pead küll päris korralik TRAINER olema, et mu abikaasat võitsid.

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: It's my turn to battle now!
et: Nüüd on minu kord võidelda!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
en: Oh, gosh! I can't get over how strong you are!
et: Oh, heldeke! Ma ei jõua ära imestada, kui tugev sa oled!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
en: There's a strong TRAINER here! This one's really strong!
et: Siin on tugev TRAINER! See üks on tõesti tugev!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!
et: Sa oled emmest tugevam? Ohoo!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: But I'm strong, too! Really! Honestly!
et: Aga minagi olen tugev! Tõesti! Ausõna!

label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
en: Huh? Did I just lose?
et: Huh? Kas ma just kaotasin?

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: This stinks…
et: See on jälk…

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: …Snivel… Grandma!
et: …Nuuks… Vanaema!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: How dare you make my granddaughter cry!
et: Kuidas sa julged mu lapselast nutma panna!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: For that, I'm going to smack you! Prepare to lose!
et: Selle eest ma virutan sulle! Valmistu kaotama!

label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
en: Kwah! You are strong… My granddaughter was right…
et: Kvaah! Sa oled tugev… Mu lapselaps oli õigel jäljel…

label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
en: If you're not in any hurry, visit with us awhile.
et: Kui sul kiiret pole, veeda meiega veidi aega.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: If you don't raise your POKéMON some more, it could be tough to keep winning up through the ranks.
et: Kui sa oma POKéMONe veel veidi ei kasvata, võib olla raske järjest edasi võita, aina kõrgemale.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR are far stronger than any GYM LEADER.
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et POKéMON LEAGUE'i ELITE FOUR on palju tugevam kui ükski SAALI JUHT.

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
en: I challenged the WINSTRATE family, but four matches in a row is tough going… They destroyed me.
et: Ma esitasin WINSTRATE'i perele väljakutse, aga neli matši järjest on raske ettevõtmine… Nad hävitasid mu.

label: Route111_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign
en: “Our family's hearts beat as one!” THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE
et: „Meie pere südamed löövad üheskoos!” WINSTRATE'IDE MAJA

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign112
en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112
et: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign113
en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113
et: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113

label: Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign
en: OLD LADY'S REST STOP “Come in and rest your tired bones.”
et: VANAPROUA PUHKEPEATUS „Tule sisse ja anna oma väsinud kontidele puhkust.”

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: One of the indicators of a POKéMON's powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for “SPECIAL ATTACK.”
et: Üks POKéMONi vägevuse näitajaid on ER. RÜNNAK. See tähendab „ERILINE RÜNNAK.”

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL DEFENSE.”
et: Samamoodi tähendab ER. KAITSE „ERILINE KAITSE.”

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: There should be a tower made of sand around here somewhere.
et: Siin kandis kuskil peaks olema liivast tehtud torn.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: But for some reason, it can be seen sometimes, and sometimes not.
et: Aga millegipärast on seda vahel näha ja vahel mitte.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.
et: Just seepärast ma nimetan seda MIRAGE TOWERIKS.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I see it! The tower of sand!
et: Ma näen seda! Liivatorn!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: The sand tower they called a mirage is clearly visible!
et: Liivatorn, mida nad miraažiks nimetasid, on selgelt näha!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: But it looks so fragile… It could crumble away anytime…
et: Aga see näeb nii habras välja… See võiks iga hetk kokku variseda…

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I want to go inside it, but I can't get my courage up for it…
et: Ma tahan sinna sisse minna, aga ma ei suuda selleks julgust koguda…

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Whoa… That was shocking.
et: Ohoo… See oli vapustav.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Sand rained down in chunks all of a sudden.
et: Järsku sadas liiva tükkidena alla.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: What was it like inside? Were there sandy ghosts and such?
et: Milline oli seal sees? Kas seal oli liivaseid tonte ja muud?

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand hasn't been seen.
et: Sellest ajast, kui ma sinuga rääkisin, pole liivatorni näha olnud.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Perhaps it really was the MIRAGE TOWER…
et: Ehk oligi see tõesti MIRAGE TOWER…

label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
en: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: CLAW FOSSIL kadus liiva sisse…

label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
en: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: ROOT FOSSIL kadus liiva sisse…

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: Oh, no!
et: Oh, ei!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to ROUTE 111!
et: Mu onu MAUVILLES käskis mul ROCK SMASH kaasa võtta, kui ROUTE 111-le lähen!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle? He lives across from the bike shop in MAUVILLE.
et: Mu onu? Ta elab MAUVILLES rattapoe vastas.

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL SISSEPÄÄS

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: “Scale the heights, you hot-blooded TRAINERS!”
et: „Vallutage kõrgused, teie tulise verega TRAINERID!”

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: There appears to be some connection between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.
et: Näib, et SOOTOPOLISE ja MT. PYRE vahel on mingi seos.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: My friends and I did some research on it at the lab where I used to work.
et: Mina ja mu sõbrad tegime selle kohta veidi uurimistööd laboris, kus ma kunagi töötasin.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
en: My big brother used to study the sea.
et: Mu suur vend õppis kunagi merd.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: Even if a POKéMON is weak now, it will grow stronger.
et: Isegi kui POKéMON on praegu nõrk, saab ta tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: The most important thing is love! Love for your POKéMON!
et: Kõige tähtsam on armastus! Armastus su POKéMONi vastu!

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
en: Do you use REPEL? It keeps POKéMON away, so it's useful when you're in a hurry.
et: Kas kasutad REPELi? See hoiab POKéMONe eemal, nii et see on kasulik, kui sul on kiire.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with you?
et: Kas sul on kaasas ANTIDOTE'e?

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: If you walk around with a poisoned POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints. Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
et: Kui käid ringi mürgitatud POKéMONiga, kaotab ta HP-d kuni minestamiseni. Võta ANTIDOTE'e kaasa.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
en: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS always bring our POKéMON. How about a quick battle?
et: Kui me merele läheme, võtame meie, MADRUSED, alati POKéMONid kaasa. Kuidas oleks kiire lahinguga?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
en: Whoops, I'm sunk!
et: Uups, ma läksin põhja!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: The ship's bottom has sunk into the depths.
et: Laeva põhi on vajunud sügavustesse.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: If a POKéMON knew how to go underwater, we might make some progress…
et: Kui mõni POKéMON oskaks vee alla minna, võiksime edu saavutada…

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
en: Yay! It's a ship!
et: Jess! See on laev!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: “STORAGE” is painted on the door.
et: Uksele on maalitud „LADU”.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the STORAGE KEY.
et: {PLAYER} pistis LAOVÕTME sisse ja keeras.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: The inserted KEY stuck fast, but the door opened.
et: Sissepistetud VÕTI jäi kinni, aga uks avanes.

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
en: The door is open.
et: Uks on avatud.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: STEVEN: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It's me, STEVEN! We met in the cave near DEWFORD.
et: See olen mina, STEVEN! Me kohtusime koopas DEWFORDI lähedal.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Have you met many kinds of POKéMON since I last saw you?
et: Kas oled kohanud palju liiki POKéMONe, kuna sind viimati nägin?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: There are many, many kinds of POKéMON in this wide world of ours.
et: Selles meie avaras maailmas on väga-väga palju liiki POKéMONe.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: If you wanted to raise only your favorites, that's fine.
et: Kui sa tahaksid kasvatada ainult oma lemmikuid, see on hea.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Perhaps you find it more fun to raise all sorts of POKéMON.
et: Ehk leiad, et lõbusam on kasvatada igasuguseid POKéMONe.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: As a TRAINER of POKéMON, what do you think?
et: POKéMONide TRAINERina, mida sina arvad?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Of course, it's not any of my business.
et: Muidugi pole see üldse minu asi.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It would be nice if we were to meet again somewhere.
et: Oleks tore, kui me kunagi kuskil jälle kohtuksime.

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Hmm! A GOOD ROD is really good!
et: Hmm! GOOD ROD on tõesti hea!

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Wouldn't you agree?
et: Kas sa ei nõustu?

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! We're of identical minds!
et: Hmm! Me oleme ühte meelt!

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! Take this GOOD ROD!
et: Hmm! Võta see GOOD ROD!

label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
en: Wherever there's water, try your luck at fishing.
et: Kus iganes on vett, proovi kalaõnne.

label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
en: Don't you like to fish?
et: Kas sulle ei meeldi kalastada?

label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
en: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON with your GOOD ROD.
et: Proovi püüda igasuguseid POKéMONe oma GOOD RODiga.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: Even if there isn't a boat, you can cross rivers and the sea if you have a POKéMON that knows SURF.
et: Isegi kui paati pole, saad ületada jõgesid ja merd, kui sul on POKéMON, kes oskab SURFi.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: POKéMON can be counted on to do so much!
et: POKéMONidele saab loota, et nad teevad nii palju!

label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY

label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
en: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119
et: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted on the hull.
et: „SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” on kere peale maalitud.

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: This is the submarine TEAM AQUA stole in SLATEPORT!
et: See on allveelaev, mille TEAM AQUA SLATEPORTIS varastas!

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: TEAM AQUA must have gone ashore here.
et: TEAM AQUA pidi siin kaldale minema.

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!
et: Ma olen SUKELDUV AARDEKÜTT!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the awesome dude who makes deep-sea dives to gather treasures resting at the bottom.
et: Ma olen see äge sell, kes teeb süvamere sukeldumisi, et koguda põhjas puhkavaid aardeid.

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
en: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of tools made in ancient times?
et: Ütle mulle, kas oled näinud mõnda muistsel ajal tehtud tööriistade KILDU?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: You haven't got any treasures for me…
et: Sul pole mulle mingeid aardeid…

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: If you see any SHARDS, like the RED SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!
et: Kui näed mõnda KILDU, näiteks PUNAST KILDU, pead selle minuga vahetama!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, hey! That… That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!
et: Oh, hei! See… See on KILD! Ma otsingi selliseid!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, man, you've got to trade that with me! I'll give you something good!
et: Oh, sõber, sa pead selle minuga vahetama! Ma annan sulle midagi head!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
en: What do you want to trade?
et: Mida sa tahad vahetada?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
en: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
et: Sa vahetad siis oma {STR_VAR_1} mu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
en: It's a done deal! Use that wisely!
et: Asi klaar! Kasuta seda targalt!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
en: Do you want to trade something else?
et: Kas tahad midagi muud vahetada?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
en: Whoops, your BAG's full. Get rid of some items, friend!
et: Uups, su KOTT on täis. Vabane mõnest esemest, sõber!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
en: No? That's a downer. Well, if you change your mind, come back.
et: Ei? See on kurb. Noh, kui meelt muudad, tule tagasi.

et: {CLEAR_TO 10} Soovitud ese{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade ese {CLEAR_TO 15}RED SHARD3{LEFT_ARROW}5{CLEAR_TO 123}FIRE STONE{CLEAR_TO 200}

en: {CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item {CLEAR_TO 6}YELLOW SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 115}THUNDERSTONE{CLEAR_TO 200}

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. It's been a while.
et: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, tere. On tükk aega möödas.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: There's something here that you can't see, right?
et: Siin on midagi, mida sa ei näe, eks?

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: Now, if I were to use this device on the invisible obstacle…
et: Nüüd, kui ma kasutaksin seda seadet nähtamatul takistusel…

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: No, no. Rather than describing it, I should just show you. That would be more fun.
et: Ei, ei. Selle kirjeldamise asemel peaksin sulle lihtsalt näitama. See oleks lõbusam.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas su POKéMONid on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: STEVEN: No?
et: STEVEN: Ei?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: I'll wait here, so you can get ready.
et: Ma ootan siin, nii et sa saad valmistuda.

label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas su POKéMONid on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true power as a TRAINER!
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näita mulle oma tõelist jõudu TRAINERina!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: STEVEN kasutas DEVON SCOPE'i.

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: The startled POKéMON attacked!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON ründas!

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: STEVEN: I see… Your battle style is intriguing.
et: STEVEN: Ma näen… Su võitlusstiil on paeluv.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Your POKéMON have obviously grown since I first met you in DEWFORD.
et: Su POKéMONid on ilmselgelt kasvanud, kuna sind DEWFORDIS esimest korda kohtasin.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: I'd like you to have this DEVON SCOPE.
et: Ma tahaksin, et sa saaksid selle DEVON SCOPE'i.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Who knows, there may be other concealed POKéMON.
et: Kes teab, ehk on veel varjatud POKéMONe.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS who strive together.
et: Mulle meeldib näha POKéMONe ja TRAINEREID, kes koos pingutavad.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I think you're doing great.
et: Ma arvan, et sul läheb suurepäraselt.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: Well, let's meet again somewhere.
et: Noh, kohtume kuskil jälle.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: The generator is radiating heat that can be felt even at a distance.
et: Generaator kiirgab kuumust, mida tunneb isegi eemalt.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: It looks like it should be turned off as soon as possible.
et: Näib, et see tuleks nii kiiresti kui võimalik välja lülitada.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
en: The generator quieted down.
et: Generaator vaibus.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: You're… Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
et: Sa oled… Ah, sa pead olema {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: Thank you for playing with WALLY a little while ago.
et: Aitäh, et WALLYGA veidi aega tagasi mängisid.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: He's been frail and sickly ever since he was a baby.
et: Ta on olnud nõrk ja põdur juba beebist saati.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: We've sent him to stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.
et: Me saatsime ta mõneks ajaks minu sugulaste juurde VERDANTURF TOWNI.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: The air is a lot cleaner there than it is here.
et: Õhk on seal palju puhtam kui siin.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: What's that? Where's WALLY? He's already left, our WALLY.
et: Mis see on? Kus on WALLY? Ta on juba lahkunud, meie WALLY.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: I wonder where he could have gotten by now?
et: Huvitav, kuhu ta praeguseks jõudnud on?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
en: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?
et: Huvitav, kuidas meie WALLYL läheb?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for dragging you here this way.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Vabanda, et me su siia nõnda vedasime.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: But our WALLY's become very healthy since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.
et: Aga meie WALLY on väga terveks saanud, kuna ta VERDANTURF TOWNI läks.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: We owe it all to you!
et: Me võlgneme selle kõik sinule!

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: When WALLY left town, you helped him catch a POKéMON, right?
et: Kui WALLY linnast lahkus, aitasid sa tal POKéMONi püüda, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: I think that made WALLY really happy.
et: Ma arvan, et see tegi WALLY tõesti õnnelikuks.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Actually, not just WALLY. It made me, his father, happy too.
et: Tegelikult mitte ainult WALLY. See tegi ka mind, tema isa, õnnelikuks.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Happy that he's gained such a great friend as you.
et: Õnnelikuks, et ta on saanud nii suurepärase sõbra kui sina.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: This isn't a bribe or anything, but I'd really like you to have this.
et: See pole altkäemaks ega midagi, aga ma tõesti tahaksin, et sa selle saaksid.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
en: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be able to go to all sorts of places.
et: Kui su POKéMON oskab SURFida, saad minna igasugustesse kohtadesse.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
en: WALLY's coming home soon. I'm looking forward to that.
et: WALLY tuleb varsti koju. Ma ootan seda.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY?
et: Oh? Sa kohtasid WALLYT EVER GRANDE CITYS?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.
et: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ära ole rumal.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: He may have gotten healthy, but he can't go somewhere far away like that all by himself.
et: Ta võib olla terveks saanud, aga ta ei saa nii kaugele omapäi minna.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: WALLY was really happy when he told us that he caught a POKéMON.
et: WALLY oli tõesti õnnelik, kui ta meile rääkis, et püüdis POKéMONi.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: It's been ages since I've seen him smile like that.
et: On möödunud terve igavik, kui ma teda nõnda naeratamas nägin.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I want you to keep this a secret from my husband…
et: Ma tahan, et hoiaksid seda mu abikaasa eest saladuses…

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN without telling anyone.
et: Aga meie WALLY lahkus VERDANTURF TOWNIST kellelegi ütlemata.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: You know, WALLY is frail, but he's surprisingly strong-willed.
et: Tead, WALLY on nõrk, aga ta on üllatavalt tugeva tahtega.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I'm sure that he'll come back safe and sound one day!
et: Ma olen kindel, et ta tuleb ühel päeval terve ja tervena tagasi!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: WALLACE: Tere tulemast, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: That incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY… That was superb work, putting an end to that crisis all by yourself.
et: See vahejuhtum SOOTOPOLIS CITYs… See oli suurepärane töö, tehes sellele kriisile üksinda lõpu.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: It wouldn't be fair to say that you alone ended the crisis.
et: Poleks aus öelda, et sina üksi kriisi lõpetasid.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: You overcame that difficult situation by working as one with your POKéMON.
et: Sa ületasid selle raske olukorra, töötades oma POKéMONidega ühena.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: We TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving them items and by teaching them new techniques for battle.
et: Meie, TRAINERid, kasvatame POKéMONe, andes neile esemeid ja õpetades neile uusi lahingutehnikaid.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: But we ourselves also learn many things from POKéMON.
et: Aga me ise õpime samuti POKéMONidelt palju.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: And this is where your achievements are put to the test against what others like you have achieved.
et: Ja siin pannakse su saavutused proovile selle vastu, mida teised sinusugused on saavutanud.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Now!
et: Nüüd!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Who can most elegantly dance with their POKéMON in HOENN?
et: Kes suudab HOENNis oma POKéMONidega kõige elegantsemalt tantsida?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Show me right here and now!
et: Näita mulle siin ja praegu!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…
et: Mina, MEISTER, langen kaotusse…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious!
et: See oli imeline töö. Sa olid elegantne, ärritavalt elegantne. Ja seejuures oli see täiesti suurejooneline!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Kudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Au sulle, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: You are a truly noble POKéMON TRAINER!
et: Sa oled tõeliselt üllas POKéMON TRAINER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into battle…
et: WALLACE: POKéMONid, keda sa lahingusse saatsid…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: At times they danced like a spring breeze, and at times they struck like lightning.
et: Vahel tantsisid nad nagu kevadtuul ja vahel lõid nad nagu välk.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: It was with light, yet surefooted, elegance that you led your POKéMON.
et: Sa juhtisid oma POKéMONe kerge, kuid kindla elegantsiga.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Even I felt bedazzled by your masterful performance!
et: Isegi mina olin su meisterlikust esitusest pimestatud!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You now stand at the glorious peak of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Sa seisad nüüd POKéMON LEAGUE'i hiilgaval tipul.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: I now proclaim you to be the new HOENN region…
et: Ma kuulutan sind nüüd uueks HOENNi piirkonna…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
en: Here's some advice before you challenge the CHAMPION…
et: Siin on natuke nõu, enne kui MEISTRI välja kutsud…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
en: MAY: Huh? What, what, what?
et: MAY: Ää? Mida, mida, mida?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Could it be that… It's already over?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Kas võib olla, et… See on juba läbi?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
en: How would you like some advice before you challenge the CHAMPION?…
et: Kuidas oleks natuke nõuga, enne kui MEISTRI välja kutsud?…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
en: Are you trying to tell me… You've beaten the CHAMPION?
et: Kas sa üritad mulle öelda… Sa alistasid MEISTRI?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: PROF. BIRCH: See? What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?
et: PROF. BIRCH: Näed? Mida ma sulle ütlesin, {RIVAL}?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Didn't I tell you that you don't need to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Kas ma ei öelnud, et sa ei pea {PLAYER}{KUN} pärast muretsema?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.
et: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa lõpuks tegid ära.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: When I heard that you defeated your own father at the PETALBURG GYM, I thought perhaps you had a chance…
et: Kui ma kuulsin, et sa alistasid PETALBURG GYMis oma isa, mõtlesin, et võib-olla sul on lootust…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: But to think you've actually become the CHAMPION!
et: Aga et sa oled tegelikult MEISTRIKS saanud!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: Ah, yes!
et: Ah, jah!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: What became of your POKéDEX? Here, let me see.
et: Mis su POKéDEXist sai? Siin, lase mul näha.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways, congratulations!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Igatahes, palju õnne!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
en: Now, go proudly into the final room!
et: Nüüd mine uhkelt viimasesse ruumi!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: No, let me rephrase that properly.
et: Ei, lubage mul see korralikult ümber sõnastada.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: The new CHAMPION!
et: Uus MEISTER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
en: Come with me.
et: Tule minuga.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…
et: WALLACE: Vabandust, aga…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: From here on, only those TRAINERS who have become CHAMPIONS may enter.
et: Siit alates võivad siseneda vaid need TRAINERid, kellest on saanud MEISTRID.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
en: You'll have to wait outside with PROF. BIRCH.
et: Sa pead väljas ootama koos PROF. BIRCHIGA.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: MAY: Groan…
et: MAY: Ohh…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: I'm just joking! That's okay! That's the rule!
et: Ma ainult naljatan! See on hea! Selline on reegel!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ausalt, palju õnne!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … … … … … … … … … …
et: BRENDAN: Miiis?! … … … … … … … … … … … … …

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: It can't be helped if that's the rule.
et: Sinna pole midagi parata, kui selline on reegel.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
en: {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!
et: {PLAYER}, tublisti! Palju õnne!

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
en: Er-hem!
et: Ehem!

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
en: I am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most important person, the CHAIRMAN's younger brother.
et: Ma olen POKéMON FAN CLUBi kõige tähtsam isik, ESIMEHE noorem vend.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
en: I'm here enjoying my vacation with POKéMON, yes, indeed.
et: Ma naudin siin oma puhkust POKéMONidega, jah, tõesti.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AhYourPokemon
en: Ah! Your POKéMON…
et: Ah! Su POKéMON…

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
en: It clearly likes you very much.
et: Talle ilmselgelt väga meeldid.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
en: A POKéMON that adoring and adorable deserves a TM like this, no?
et: Nii armastav ja armas POKéMON väärib sellist TM-i, kas pole?

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
en: Hmm… It's not bad, but it's also not good.
et: Hmm… See pole halb, aga see pole ka hea.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
en: You, as the TRAINER, need to put in some more effort.
et: Sina, TRAINERina, pead veidi rohkem pingutama.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
en: It has a vicious look to it.
et: Sel on õel ilme.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
en: A frightening POKéMON like that deserves a TM like this.
et: Selline hirmuäratav POKéMON väärib sellist TM-i.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
en: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's power is enhanced.
et: Kui POKéMONile sa väga meeldid, on RETURNi jõud võimendatud.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
en: If it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's power goes up.
et: Kui sa talle ei meeldi, tõuseb FRUSTRATIONi jõud.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXDays
en: Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days, I should be getting a good TM or two.
et: Oh, jah. Umbes {STR_VAR_1} päeva pärast peaksin saama hea TM-i või paar.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXDays
en: You should come see me then. I'll give you a TM that's suitable for your POKéMON.
et: Sa peaksid tulema siis mind vaatama. Ma annan sulle TM-i, mis su POKéMONile sobib.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rurii
en: AZURILL: Rurii.
et: AZURILL: Rurii.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyWithTrainer
en: It appears to be very friendly with the TRAINER.
et: Näib, et see on TRAINERiga väga sõbralik.

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rururi
en: AZURILL: Rururi!
et: AZURILL: Rururi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?
et: Jou, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.
et: Siinsed SAALI JUHID kasutavad PSÜÜHILIST tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!
et: Kui lähed neile vastu VÕITLUS- või MÜRK-tüüpi POKéMONidega, teevad nad kohutavat kahju!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.
et: Pealegi tulevad nad su peale suurepäraste kombinatsioonirünnakutega.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!
et: Kui tahad võita, pead neile näitama, kui tihe on side sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel. Anna minna!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory

et: Vau, sa oled hämmastav! Sa oled üks suurepärane TRAINER!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat

et: Ma kaotasin! Ma pean oma vaimu taas karastama!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle

et: Kõhklejad kaotavad. See on mu hoiatus sulle.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: If there are prodigies in the world, then our GYM LEADERS are them!
et: Kui maailmas on imelapsi, siis meie SAALI JUHID on seda!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: However, you may be even more talented than them…
et: Kuid sina võid olla neist veelgi andekam…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé BALL telekinetically!
et: Fufufufu… Vaata, kuidas ma POKé BALLi telekineetiliselt hõljutan!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …
et: Vroooooooaaar! … … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Sometimes, I'm out of sync…
et: Vahel ma pole vormis…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
en: My POKéMON battling skills are out of sync, too!
et: Ka minu POKéMON-lahingu oskused pole vormis!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift psychically. But this dust bunny…
et: POKé BALL oli liiga raske, et vaimselt tõsta. Aga see tolmupuru…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: Whoooooooooooooooh! … … … … … …
et: Vuuuuuuuuuuuh! … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: No, I'm not cheating! I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
et: Ei, ma ei peta! Ma ei puhunud sellele! Ausalt!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: When you lose to me, don't be too hard on yourself.
et: Kui mulle kaotad, ära ole enda vastu liiga karm.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: It's not that you're weak--I'm just too strong!
et: Asi pole selles, et sa nõrk oled – ma olen lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
en: You're just too strong!
et: Sa oled lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: I'm not going to get down on myself for losing. I just need to train harder.
et: Ma ei hakka enda üle kaotuse pärast norutama. Ma pean lihtsalt kõvemini treenima.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: Positive thinking--that's my strong point!
et: Positiivne mõtlemine – see on minu tugev külg!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: I see it… I see your future…
et: Ma näen seda… Ma näen su tulevikku…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!
et: Kui suudad mind võita, ütlen sulle su tuleviku!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
en: I surrender!
et: Ma alistun!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: You will wage a terrifically intense battle with our GYM LEADERS…
et: Sa pead meie SAALI JUHTIDEGA ülimalt ägeda lahingu…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: The result… You won't hear it from me!
et: Tulemus… Seda sa minult ei kuule!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…
et: Teed, mida oled rännanud… Mida oled kogenud…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: Come at me with everything you've learned!
et: Tule mu peale kõigega, mida oled õppinud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
en: You've traveled a path of greatness!
et: Sa oled läbinud suursuguse teekonna!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: A bright future awaits those who have worked diligently.
et: Helge tulevik ootab neid, kes on usinasti töötanud.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: For those who lazed idly, there is only despair at the end.
et: Neile, kes jõude logelesid, ootab lõpus vaid meeleheide.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: What goes around comes around…
et: Kuidas külvad, nõnda lõikad…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
en: Even at the risk of life, I will win this battle!
et: Isegi elu hinnaga võidan ma selle lahingu!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
en: What you do… It horrifies me…
et: Mida sa teed… See paneb mind õudusest värisema…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: How dare you beat me…
et: Kuidas sa julged mind võita…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: It won't be my fault if something horrible befalls you…
et: See pole minu süü, kui sinuga midagi kohutavat juhtub…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: Hohoho.
et: Hohoho.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: You need me to show you how tenacious the PSYCHIC type can be.
et: Mul on vaja sulle näidata, kui sitke PSÜÜHILINE tüüp olla saab.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
en: Oh! My, my! Your battle style is fantastic!
et: Oh! Vaat kus lugu! Su võitlusstiil on fantastiline!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
en: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me, however b-badly.
et: Ma… Ma ei lase kaotusel end häirida, ükskõik kui r-rängalt.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
en: Let me show you a perfectly awful, horrifying time!
et: Las ma näitan sulle täiuslikult jubedat, õudust täis aega!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
en: N-nooooo!
et: E-eiiii!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
en: Your vitality is contagious! Get away from me quickly!
et: Su elujõud on nakkav! Kao minust kiiresti eemale!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
en: I may be past my prime, but I suggest you not patronize me.
et: Ma võin oma parimatest aastatest möödas olla, aga soovitan sul mind mitte alahinnata.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
en: Ah, you overflow with the power of youth!
et: Ah, sa pakatad nooruse jõust!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
en: It seems that I could not overcome your youthful energy.
et: Näib, et ma ei suutnud su noorusliku energia üle jõu saada.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
en: You're not getting through to the end! Not if I can help it!
et: Sa ei jõua lõpuni! Mitte kui minust sõltub!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
en: How could you be so ludicrously strong?
et: Kuidas sa saad nii naeruväärselt tugev olla?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: Humph! You may be strong, but you're not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!
et: Hmpf! Sa võid tugev olla, aga sa ei sobi PSÜÜHILISELE tüübile!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: The way you battle is somehow brutal!
et: Su võitlusviis on kuidagi jõhker!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
en: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super POKéMON hard-battling power!
et: Vrooar! Maitse minu super POKéMON kõva-lahingu väge!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
en: Oh! Done in!
et: Oh! Läbi saanud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
en: All right! I think I'll develop a special invincible POKéMON power next.
et: Hea küll! Ma arvan, et arendan järgmisena erilise võitmatu POKéMON-väe.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
et: TATE: Hehehe… Kas olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?
et: LIZA: Fufufu… Kas olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS? LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
et: TATE: Et SAALI JUHTE on kaks? LIZA: Et SAALI JUHTE on kaks?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We're twins! LIZA: We're twins!
et: TATE: Me oleme kaksikud! LIZA: Me oleme kaksikud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We don't need to talk because… LIZA: We can each determine what…
et: TATE: Meil pole vaja rääkida, sest… LIZA: Me mõlemad taipame, mida…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: The other is thinking… LIZA: All in our minds!
et: TATE: teine mõtleb… LIZA: Kõik meie peas!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: This combination of ours… LIZA: Can you beat it?
et: TATE: Seda meie kombinatsiooni… LIZA: Kas suudad selle võita?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: What?! Our combination… LIZA: Was shattered!
et: TATE: Mida?! Meie kombinatsioon… LIZA: Purustati!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: It can't be helped. You've won… LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
et: TATE: Pole midagi teha. Sa võitsid… LIZA: Nii et tunnustuseks võta see.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE from TATE and LIZA.
et: {PLAYER} sai TATELT ja LIZALT MIND BADGE'i.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.
et: TATE: MIND BADGE võimendab POKéMONide ER. RÜNNAKUT ja ER. KAITSET.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: LIZA: It also lets you use the HM move DIVE outside of battle.
et: LIZA: See laseb sul kasutada ka HM-võtet DIVE väljaspool lahingut.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: TATE: You should also take this, too.
et: TATE: Sa peaksid ka selle võtma.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: That TM04 contains… LIZA: CALM MIND!
et: TATE: See TM04 sisaldab… LIZA: võtet CALM MIND!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: It raises SP. ATK and… LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!
et: TATE: See tõstab ER. RÜNNAKUT ja… LIZA: See tõstab ER. KAITSET!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: It's a move that's perfect… LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!
et: TATE: See on võte, mis sobib ideaalselt… LIZA: PSÜÜHILISTELE POKéMONidele!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndLiza
en: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHID TATE & LIZA registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
en: TATE: Looks like the bond between you and your POKéMON is far stronger than the bond that we share as twins.
et: TATE: Näib, et side sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel on palju tugevam kui side, mida meie kaksikutena jagame.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
en: LIZA: You will become even stronger! We've battled you, so we know.
et: LIZA: Sa saad veelgi tugevamaks! Me võitlesime sinuga, nii et me teame.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
et: TATE: Hehehe… Kas olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
en: LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
et: LIZA: Et SAALI JUHTE on kaks?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: Oops, you have only one… LIZA: POKéMON that can battle.
et: TATE: Ups, sul on vaid üks… LIZA: POKéMON, kes suudab võidelda.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: We can't battle that way!
et: TATE: Nii me ei saa võidelda!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
en: LIZA: If you want to challenge us, bring some more POKéMON.
et: LIZA: Kui tahad meile väljakutse esitada, too rohkem POKéMONe.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
et: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
et: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: LIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: LIZA JA TATE SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
en: TATE: POKéMON… LIZA: POKéMON…
et: TATE: POKéMON… LIZA: POKéMON…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
en: TATE: By changing the party's mix… LIZA: The battle style changes.
et: TATE: Muutes seltskonna koosseisu… LIZA: muutub võitlusstiil.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
en: TATE: But me… LIZA: But me…
et: TATE: Aga mina… LIZA: Aga mina…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
en: TATE: I'll always be with LIZA! LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!
et: TATE: Ma olen alati LIZAGA! LIZA: Ma olen alati TATEGA!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
en: TATE: Our combination… LIZA: We'll show you again and again!
et: TATE: Meie kombinatsiooni… LIZA: Me näitame sulle ikka ja jälle!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchDefeat
en: TATE: You and your POKéMON… LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!
et: TATE: Sina ja su POKéMONid… LIZA: See on justkui oleksite õed-vennad!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRematch
en: TATE: You can knock us down, but we'll never stay down!
et: TATE: Sa võid meid pikali lüüa, aga me ei jää iial maha!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRematch
en: LIZA: Because the two of us, we always support each other!
et: LIZA: Sest meie kaks, me toetame alati teineteist!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: You're back again… LIZA: You're back again…
et: TATE: Sa oled jälle tagasi… LIZA: Sa oled jälle tagasi…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: To give us a rematch. LIZA: To give us a rematch.
et: TATE: et anda meile revanš. LIZA: et anda meile revanš.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: But… LIZA: For our match…
et: TATE: Aga… LIZA: meie matši jaoks…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: You brought just one POKéMON! LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!
et: TATE: Sa tõid vaid ühe POKéMONi! LIZA: Sa tõid vaid ühe POKéMONi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: TATE: We need you to bring at least… LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.
et: TATE: Sa pead tooma vähemalt… LIZA: kaks POKéMONi, kui tagasi tuled.

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
en: I'm investigating this ship on behalf of CAPT. STERN.
et: Ma uurin seda laeva KAPT. STERNi nimel.

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
en: He also asked me to find a SCANNER, but I haven't had any success…
et: Ta palus mul ka leida SCANNER, aga mul pole vedanud…

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
en: Oh! That's a SCANNER!
et: Oh! See on SCANNER!

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
en: Listen, can I get you to deliver that to CAPT. STERN?
et: Kuule, kas saaksin sind panna seda KAPT. STERNile viima?

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
en: I want to investigate this ship a little more.
et: Ma tahan seda laeva veel veidi uurida.

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIsSSCactus
en: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS. It seems to be from an earlier era.
et: Seda laeva kutsutakse S.S. CACTUS. Tundub, et see on varasemast ajastust.

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
en: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.
et: {PLAYER} leidis ROOT FOSSILi.

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
en: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.
et: {PLAYER} leidis CLAW FOSSILi.

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHerbShop
en: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of effective and inexpensive medicine!
et: Tere tulemast HERB SHOPI, tõhusa ja odava rohu koju!

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
en: You've come to look at herbal medicine in LAVARIDGE?
et: Sa tulid LAVARIDGES ravimtaimede rohtu vaatama?

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
en: That's rather commendable.
et: See on üsna kiiduväärt.

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
en: I like you! Take this!
et: Sa meeldid mulle! Võta see!

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharcoal
en: That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used for making herbal medicine.
et: See CHARCOAL, mille ma sulle andsin, seda kasutatakse ravimtaimede rohu tegemiseks.

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharcoal
en: It also does wonders when held by a POKéMON.
et: See teeb ka imesid, kui POKéMON seda hoiab.

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharcoal
en: It intensifies the power of FIRE-type moves.
et: See võimendab TULE-tüüpi võtete jõudu.

label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedicineWorksButMonWillDislike
en: Herbal medicine works impressively well. But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. It must be horribly bitter!
et: Ravimtaimede rohi toimib muljetavaldavalt hästi. Aga su POKéMON ei salli sind selle eest. See peab olema kohutavalt mõru!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_PleaseFindPartner
en: Please find a partner from out of the TRAINERS gathered here.
et: Palun leia partner siia kogunenud TRAINERite seast.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_QuitLookingForPartner
en: {PLAYER}, you have not found a partner for your tag team.
et: {PLAYER}, sa pole oma paarismeeskonnale partnerit leidnud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_QuitLookingForPartner
en: Would you like to quit looking and return to the reception counter?
et: Kas soovid otsimise lõpetada ja registreerimislaua juurde naasta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_PleaseFindPartner2
en: Then, please find a partner from the TRAINERS gathered here.
et: Siis palun leia partner siia kogunenud TRAINERite seast.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_ThankYouForChoosingPartner
en: Thank you for choosing a partner.
et: Aitäh partneri valimise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_ThankYouForChoosingPartner
en: I will now show you to your MULTI BATTLE ROOM.
et: Ma juhatan sind nüüd su MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Intro
en: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice. You can call me {STR_VAR_3}!
et: Ma olen {STR_VAR_1} nr {STR_VAR_2} õpipoiss. Võid kutsuda mind {STR_VAR_3}!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Mon1
en: On {STR_VAR_1}'s advice, I brought one {STR_VAR_3} with {STR_VAR_2} and
et: {STR_VAR_1} nõuandel tõin ühe {STR_VAR_3} võttega {STR_VAR_2} ja

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Mon2Ask
en: one {STR_VAR_2} with {STR_VAR_1}.
et: üks {STR_VAR_2} võttega {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Mon2Ask
en: Please, let me join you as a tag team.
et: Palun, lase mul sinuga paarismeeskonda liituda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Accept
en: Thank you! I'll go register right now.
et: Aitäh! Ma lähen kohe registreerin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice1Reject
en: I really wanted to form a tag team with you, {PLAYER}…
et: Ma tõesti tahtsin sinuga paarismeeskonda moodustada, {PLAYER}…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Intro
en: I am {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice. My name is {STR_VAR_3}.
et: Ma olen {STR_VAR_1} nr {STR_VAR_2} õpipoiss. Mu nimi on {STR_VAR_3}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Mon1
en: I got advice from {STR_VAR_1} and chose one {STR_VAR_3} with {STR_VAR_2} and
et: Sain nõu {STR_VAR_1} käest ja valisin ühe {STR_VAR_3} võttega {STR_VAR_2} ja

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Mon2Ask
en: one {STR_VAR_2} with {STR_VAR_1}.
et: üks {STR_VAR_2} võttega {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Mon2Ask
en: Please, let's form a tag team!
et: Palun, moodustame paarismeeskonna!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Accept
en: Thank you very much! I'll be done with registration quickly!
et: Suur tänu! Ma teen registreerimise kiiresti ära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_UnusedApprentice2Reject
en: {PLAYER}, I was hoping that I could partner up with you…
et: {PLAYER}, ma lootsin, et saan sinuga paarduda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_Apprentice1Intro
en: Um, my name's {STR_VAR_3}, and I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.
et: Öö, mu nimi on {STR_VAR_3}, ja ma olen {STR_VAR_1} nr {STR_VAR_2} õpipoiss.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_Apprentice1Intro
en: Snivel…
et: Nuuks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_Apprentice1Intro
en: I'm sorry! This tension is making me cry…
et: Vabandust! See pinge ajab mu nutma…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_Apprentice1Mon1
en: {STR_VAR_3} advised me, so I have one {STR_VAR_2} with {STR_VAR_1} and
