et: Lukk klõpsatas lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntro
en: It's too much bother to think this out. I only wanted to battle!
et: On liiga tüütu seda välja mõelda. Ma tahtsin lihtsalt võidelda!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefeat
en: Even though I lost, I still like battling the best!
et: Kuigi ma kaotasin, mulle ikka meeldib võitlemine kõige rohkem!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPostBattle
en: Wouldn't you agree? You would go anywhere if TRAINERS were there.
et: Kas sa ei nõustu? Sa läheksid kuhu iganes, kui seal oleksid TRAINERID.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntro
en: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush aside with one finger!
et: Heh! Selliseid rahne pühin ma ühe sõrmega kõrvale!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefeat
en: I can push boulders, but I can't solve the puzzle…
et: Ma oskan rahne lükata, aga ma ei oska mõistatust lahendada…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPostBattle
en: It's not good enough to be brawny… You have to use your head. Be brainy!
et: Ainuüksi jõukas olemisest ei piisa… Sa pead pead kasutama. Ole nutikas!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaIntro
en: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier, isn't it?
et: TRICK HOUSE muutub aina trikilisemaks, kas pole?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaDefeat
en: Aaak!
et: Aaak!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPostBattle
en: Has anyone made it to the end?
et: Kas keegi on lõppu jõudnud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaCorridor_Text_PleaseStepIn
en: Your battles shall be waged in the next room. Please step in!
et: Sinu lahingud peetakse järgmises ruumis. Palun astu sisse!

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHere
en: Oh, dear, dear. Aren't your POKéMON exhausted?
et: Oh, heldeke, heldeke. Kas su POKéMONid pole kurnatud?

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHere
en: If you'd like, rest up here. That's a fine idea! You should do that.
et: Kui soovid, puhka siin. See on suurepärane mõte! Sa peaksid seda tegema.

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourTimeRestUp
en: That's right. Take your time and rest up!
et: Just nii. Võta aega ja puhka välja!

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTiredTakeAnotherRest
en: Oh, dear, dear. Are your POKéMON still tired?
et: Oh, heldeke, heldeke. Kas su POKéMONid on ikka veel väsinud?

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTiredTakeAnotherRest
en: You should take another rest here. That's a fine idea. You should do that.
et: Sa peaksid siin veel puhkama. See on suurepärane mõte. Sa peaksid seda tegema.

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedToBeShy
en: Is that so? You don't need to be shy about it.
et: On või nii? Sa ei pea seda häbenema.

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
en: Hey there, TRAINER! A SUPER ROD really is super!
et: Hei seal, TRAINER! SUPER ROD on tõesti super!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
en: Say all you want, but this baby can catch POKéMON off the seafloor!
et: Räägi mis tahad, aga see maimuke püüab POKéMONe merepõhjast!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
en: What do you think? You want it, don't you?
et: Mida sa arvad? Sa tahad seda, kas pole?

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper
en: You bet, you bet! After all, a SUPER ROD is really super!
et: Just nimelt! Lõppude lõpuks on SUPER ROD tõesti super!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodInWater
en: If there's any water, try dropping in your ROD and see what bites!
et: Kui kuskil on vett, proovi oma RODi sisse lasta ja vaata, mis hammustab!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
en: Hunh? Don't you like to fish?
et: Häh? Kas sulle ei meeldi kalastada?

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloorPokemon
en: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with your SUPER ROD.
et: Mine merepõhja POKéMONide järele oma SUPER RODiga.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
en: Hmmm… Not a one to be found…
et: Hmmm… Mitte ühtki leida…

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
en: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON called SHROOMISH around here?
et: Tere, kas oled näinud siin kandis mõnda POKéMONi nimega SHROOMISH?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
en: I really love that POKéMON.
et: Ma tõesti armastan seda POKéMONi.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
en: I was going to ambush you, but you had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS forever, didn't you?
et: Ma kavatsesin sulle varitsuse teha, aga sa pidid ju PETALBURG WOODSis igavesti aega viitma, kas polnud?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
en: I got sick of waiting, so here I am!
et: Ma tüdinesin ootamast, nii et siin ma olen!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
en: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!
et: Sina! DEVONI UURIJA!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
en: Hand over those papers!
et: Anna need paberid siia!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
en: Aiyeeeh!
et: Aiiih!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you? You've got to help me, please!
et: Sa oled POKéMON TRAINER, kas pole? Sa pead mind aitama, palun!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
en: Hunh? What do you think you're doing? What, you're going to protect him?
et: Häh? Mida sa arvad, et teed? Mis, sa kavatsed teda kaitsta?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
en: No one who crosses TEAM AQUA gets any mercy, not even a kid!
et: Keegi, kes TEAM AQUALE risti ette astub, ei saa mingit halastust, isegi mitte laps!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
en: Come on and battle me!
et: Tule ja võitle minuga!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
en: You're kidding me! You're tough!
et: Sa teed nalja! Sa oled kõva!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
en: Grrr… You've got some nerve meddling with TEAM AQUA! Come on and battle me again!
et: Grrr… Sul on jultumust TEAM AQUAGA jännata! Tule ja võitle minuga uuesti!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
en: I wish I could say that, but I'm out of POKéMON…
et: Ma sooviksin seda öelda, aga mul on POKéMONid otsas…

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
en: And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also after something in RUSTBORO.
et: Ja, hei, meiegi, TEAM AQUA, jahime midagi RUSTBOROS.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
en: I'll let you go today!
et: Ma lasen su täna minna!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
en: Whew… That was awfully close!
et: Uhh… See oli kohutavalt napp!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
en: Thanks to you, he didn't rob me of these important papers.
et: Tänu sinule ei röövinud ta minult neid tähtsaid pabereid.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
en: I know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as my thanks!
et: Ma tean, ma annan sulle tänuks GREAT BALLi!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
en: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say they were after something in RUSTBORO, too?
et: Kas see TEAM AQUA suli ei öelnud, et nemadki jahivad midagi RUSTBOROS?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
en: Uh-oh! It's a crisis! I can't be wasting time!
et: Oh-oo! On kriis! Ma ei saa aega raisata!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
en: You're loaded with items. I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
et: Sa oled esemeid täis. Ma ei saa sulle seda GREAT BALLi anda.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
en: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!
et: Ma püüdsin terve hunniku POKéMONe!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
en: Go, go, go! My BUG POKéMON team!
et: Anna minna, minna, minna! Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONide meeskond!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
en: I have all these POKéMON, but I couldn't win…
et: Mul on kõik need POKéMONid, aga ma ei suutnud võita…

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
en: I caught a bunch of POKéMON. Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.
et: Ma püüdsin hulga POKéMONe. Nüüd on mul POKé BALLid otsas.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
en: If you take BUG POKéMON to school, you get to be instantly popular!
et: Kui viia PUTUKA-POKéMONid kooli, saad kohe populaarseks!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
en: I can't be popular if I lose.
et: Ma ei saa populaarne olla, kui kaotan.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
en: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, people respect you for it.
et: Kui sul on suur PUTUKA-POKéMON, austavad inimesed sind selle eest.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
en: I want a rematch when my BUG POKéMON grow up!
et: Ma tahan revanši, kui mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid suureks saavad!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
en: I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
et: Ma registreerin sind oma POKéNAVi!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
en: I want a rematch when my BUG POKéMON grow up!
et: Ma tahan revanši, kui mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid suureks saavad!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
en: I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
et: Ma registreerin sind oma POKéNAVi!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
en: My BUG POKéMON have grown. I'll be popular again.
et: Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid on kasvanud. Ma saan jälle populaarseks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
en: I can't be popular if I lose.
et: Ma ei saa populaarne olla, kui kaotan.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
en: You get to be popular if you have strong POKéMON, right? So, I've been training hard.
et: Sa saad populaarseks, kui sul on tugevad POKéMONid, eks? Nii et ma olen kõvasti treeninud.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: Yo, there! Your POKéMON doing okay?
et: Jou, seal! Kas su POKéMONidel läheb hästi?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.
et: Kui su POKéMONid on nõrgad ja tahad lahinguid vältida, peaksid kõrgest rohust eemale hoidma.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: Sometimes, there are things on the ground even if you can't see them.
et: Vahel on maapinnal asju, isegi kui sa neid ei näe.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: That's why I always check where I'm walking.
et: Just seepärast ma kontrollin alati, kus ma kõnnin.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: Oh, neat! That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!
et: Oh, tore! See on MÄRK RUSTBORO SAALIST!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: You must be a TRAINER. You should try using this item.
et: Sa pead olema TRAINER. Sa peaksid proovima seda eset kasutada.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: It's a MIRACLE SEED. If a POKéMON holds that item, its GRASS-type moves become stronger.
et: See on MIRACLE SEED. Kui POKéMON hoiab seda eset, muutuvad ta ROHU-tüüpi võtted tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are other convenient items for POKéMON to hold.
et: Peale MIRACLE SEEDi arvan, et POKéMONidele on ka teisi mugavaid esemeid hoida.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: Any POKéMON that appears even once in a battle is awarded EXP Points.
et: Iga POKéMON, kes lahingus kas või korra ilmub, saab EXP punkte.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the left of the team list.
et: Nõrga POKéMONi kasvatamiseks pane ta meeskonna nimekirjas vasakule.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: As soon as a battle starts, switch it out. It will earn EXP Points without being exposed to any harm.
et: Niipea kui lahing algab, vaheta ta välja. Ta teenib EXP punkte, ilma et satuks mingisse ohtu.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON have Power Points (PP) that are used to make moves during battle.
et: Lisaks Elupunktidele (HP) on POKéMONidel Jõupunktid (PP), mida kasutatakse lahingus võtete tegemiseks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
et: Kui POKéMONil saavad PP-d otsa, tuleb ta viia POKéMON CENTERISSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomFinal_Text_CongratsThisWayPlease
en: Congratulations… Now, this way, please…
et: Palju õnne… Nüüd, siiapoole, palun…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
en: The door is closed.
et: Uks on kinni.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!
et: WALLACE: Oh, heldeke, mul on kohutavalt kahju!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: In my haste, I didn't notice that I'd left you behind!
et: Oma kiiruses ma ei märganud, et olin su maha jätnud!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: I've opened the locked door of the SKY PILLAR.
et: Ma olen avanud SKY PILLARi lukustatud ukse.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, asugem teele!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!
et: WALLACE: See on maavärin!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: There's not a moment to waste! We've got to hurry!
et: Pole hetkegi raisata! Me peame kiirustama!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
en: WALLACE: Hmm… The situation is getting worse…
et: WALLACE: Hmm… Olukord läheb aina hullemaks…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: WALLACE: This isn't good…
et: WALLACE: See pole hea…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: The weather distortion is spreading even here…
et: Ilmastikuhäire levib isegi siia…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: RAYQUAZA should be farther up from here.
et: RAYQUAZA peaks olema siit kõrgemal.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: I'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS. I've got to go back.
et: Ma muretsen SOOTOPOLISE pärast. Ma pean tagasi minema.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: Everything is in your hands now. Don't fail us!
et: Kõik on nüüd sinu kätes. Ära vea meid alt!

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: NORMAN became our town's new GYM LEADER.
et: NORMAN sai meie linna uueks SAALI JUHIKS.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: I think he called his family over from somewhere far away.
et: Ma arvan, et ta kutsus oma pere kuskilt kaugelt siia.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, he was way too strong.
et: Ma võitlesin kord NORMANIGA, aga, uhh, ta oli lihtsalt liiga tugev.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: How would I put it?
et: Kuidas ma seda ütleksin?

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I just got the feeling that he lives for POKéMON.
et: Mul lihtsalt tekkis tunne, et ta elab POKéMONide nimel.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.
et: Tere tulemast LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE'i.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
en: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT STORE, I always end up buying all sorts of things because it's so fun.
et: Iga kord, kui ma DEPARTMENT STORE'i tulen, ostan alati igasuguseid asju, sest siin on nii lõbus.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
en: Today, my mom is going to buy me some nice furniture.
et: Täna ostab mu ema mulle mõned toredad mööblitükid.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
en: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL as a reward for winning a CONTEST.
et: Ma ostan oma AZUMARILLile midagi tasuks VÕISTLUSE võitmise eest.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!
et: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER LOTTERY CORNER
et: 1. KORRUS: TEENINDUSLETT LOTERII NURK

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 2F: TRAINER'S ZONE
et: 2. KORRUS: TRAINERI TSOON

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 3F: BATTLE COLLECTION
et: 3. KORRUS: LAHINGUKOGU

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 4F: TM CORNER
et: 4. KORRUS: TM NURK

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR
et: 5. KORRUS: POKé NUKU KORRUS

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA
et: KATUS: KATUSEPLATS

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: Wireless Communication is a lot of fun, isn't it?
et: Juhtmevaba Side on väga lõbus, kas pole?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it lets you do things that weren't possible before.
et: Ma arvan, et see laseb teha asju, mis varem võimatud olid.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: For instance, you can now trade with people you couldn't before.
et: Näiteks saad nüüd kaubelda inimestega, kellega varem ei saanud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it's going to be exciting!
et: Ma arvan, et sellest tuleb põnev!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
en: I want to spread the word about how fun Wireless Communication can be.
et: Ma tahan levitada sõna, kui lõbus võib Juhtmevaba Side olla.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… When I get engrossed in research, things end up this way…
et: Vabandust, et kõik nii segamini on… Kui ma uurimistöösse süvenen, lähevad asjad selliseks…

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: This is embarrassing… Please keep this a secret in exchange for this.
et: See on piinlik… Palun hoia see saladuses selle vastu.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System?
et: Kas tohin anda nõu oma POKéMONide Hoiusüsteemi kohta?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.
et: Sa peaksid oma KASTID korraldama nii, et näed, millised POKéMONid neis on.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES.
et: Need on LANETTE uurimismärkmed. Seal on teavet KASTIDE kohta.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.
et: Kavanda KASTID nii, et igaüks mahutab 30 POKéMONi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system.
et: Iga TRAINER peaks saama PC-süsteemis hoida 420 POKéMONi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Keep reading?
et: Loed edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize.
et: Tuleks lisada tähistussüsteem, et POKéMONe oleks lihtsam korraldada.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON.
et: Iga KASTI nimi ja tapeedikujundus tehakse muudetavaks, et hoitud POKéMONile meeldida.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: Keep reading?
et: Loed edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last.
et: POKéMONi hoiule pannes tuleks ta saata KASTI, mida viimati vaadati.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.
et: Kui see KAST on täis, hoitakse vastuvõetud POKéMONi järgmises KASTIS.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.
et: Teisisõnu, kui KASTI uuritakse, valitakse see automaatselt KASTIKS, kuhu POKéMONid saadetakse.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
en: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.
et: {PLAYER} sulges märkmiku.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: There's an e-mail from someone on the PC.
et: PC-s on kelleltki e-kiri.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Your Storage System offers more convenience than mine.
et: „Sinu Hoiusüsteem pakub rohkem mugavust kui minu oma.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It has a lot of user-friendly features that make it fun and useful, too.
et: „Sel on palju kasutajasõbralikke funktsioone, mis teevad selle ka lõbusaks ja kasulikuks.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It makes me proud that I played a part in its development.
et: „See teeb mind uhkeks, et ma selle arendamises oma osa mängisin.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Here's hoping that you'll continue research in Storage Systems.
et: „Loodetavasti jätkad sa Hoiusüsteemide uurimist.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “From BILL … … … … … … … …”
et: „BILLILT … … … … … … … …”

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
en: My little brother says he likes to go find people's SECRET BASES.
et: Mu väike vend ütleb, et talle meeldib inimeste SALABAASE üles otsida.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
en: My little brother says he likes to visit people's SECRET BASES and have POKéMON battles.
et: Mu väike vend ütleb, et talle meeldib inimeste SALABAASE külastada ja POKéMON-lahinguid pidada.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
en: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas see olid sina, kes tegi SALABAASI {STR_VAR_1} lähedale?

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
en: You should make a SECRET BASE somewhere. I'll go find it!
et: Sa peaksid kuskile SALABAASI tegema. Ma lähen otsin selle üles!

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Miyaan?
et: SKITTY: Miaan?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Want a tasty little bit of advice for CONTESTS?
et: Tahad maitsvat väikest nõuannet KONKURSSIDE jaoks?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Using a certain move after another certain kind of move sometimes gets you extra attention.
et: Teatud võtte kasutamine pärast teist teatud liiki võtet köidab vahel lisatähelepanu.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: If you know what you're doing, you can score big in appeal.
et: Kui tead, mida teed, saad sära poolest suurelt punkte koguda.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Of course, your opponents might try disrupting your POKéMON's showing.
et: Muidugi võivad su vastased üritada su POKéMONi esitust häirida.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.
et: Mu papa, ta on KONKURSI KOHTUNIK.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: I wonder what I should be when I grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?
et: Huvitav, kelleks ma peaksin suureks saades hakkama, KOHTUNIKUKS või SAALI JUHIKS?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed, you know. Like, you know, I just wanted to know why my POKéMON never won, you know, like, hey?
et: Hei, sõber, ma olen nagu ikka päris pahur, tead. Nagu, tead, ma tahtsin lihtsalt teada, miks mu POKéMON kunagi ei võitnud, tead, nagu, hei?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two cents, you know, they're free.
et: Nii et, nagu, ma andsin KOHTUNIKULE oma arvamuse, tead, see on tasuta.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja ta ei kuulanud mind ära, nagu, hei! Nii et, nagu, täielik jama, sõber!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Hei, nagu, sina! Pane suu kinni, tead? Lihtsalt, tead, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See on nagu, TM41, tead? Hei, see on TORMENT, kas sa kuuled mind?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu, see ei lase teisel tüübil sama võtet kaks korda järjest kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Hei, kuule nüüd, nagu, ma ei pane sulle piina peale!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: MC: Oh, my, my! Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?
et: MC: Oh, heldeke! Kas pole see üks tore POKéMON?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: Please! Do step right up and take part in our splendid CONTESTS!
et: Palun! Astu ligi ja võta osa meie suurepärastest KONKURSSIDEST!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: You'll do well! I'm sure of it! My eyes have never failed me!
et: Sul läheb hästi! Ma olen selles kindel! Mu silmad pole mind kunagi alt vedanud!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: JUDGE: Well, hello there! I see that you're a TRAINER!
et: KOHTUNIK: Noh, tere seal! Ma näen, et sa oled TRAINER!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Then, it just wouldn't do for you to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!
et: Siis ei sobiks sul küll POKéMON KONKURSIST ilma jääda!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF CITY and enter anytime!
et: Hangi CONTEST PASS VERDANTURF CITYS ja astu igal ajal sisse!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
en: It's appeal time! What should I lead with?
et: On sära aeg! Millega ma peaksin alustama?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: They didn't pay much attention to my POKéMON's appeal…
et: Nad ei pööranud mu POKéMONi särale eriti tähelepanu…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know a good thing when he sees it.
et: Hmpf, see KOHTUNIK, ta ei tunne head asja ära, kui seda näeb.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get this close to the action.
et: Oh, tere! Sa pead olema tõsine fänn, et nii lähedale tegevusele pääseda.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: I'll reward your enthusiasm with this sage advice.
et: Ma tasun su innukuse eest selle targa nõuandega.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: If a move goes over really well, the audience will get excited.
et: Kui võte läheb tõesti hästi peale, saab publik elevile.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: The POKéMON that makes its appeal right when everyone's excited…
et: POKéMON, kes esitab oma sära just siis, kui kõik on elevil…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Well, you'd think something good has to happen!
et: Noh, arvaks küll, et midagi head peab juhtuma!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out than my POKéMON.
et: Ma ei suuda seda! Ma olen rohkem paanikas kui mu POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I'm shivering and my heart is racing!
et: Ma värisen ja mu süda peksleb!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the same, but they are alike, too.
et: Lahing ja KONKURSS pole sama asi, aga nad on ka sarnased.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: You need to work hard and believe in the POKéMON you've raised.
et: Sa pead kõvasti pingutama ja uskuma POKéMONidesse, keda oled kasvatanud.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: That POKéMON looks like it's on top of its game, huh?
et: See POKéMON näeb välja, nagu oleks ta hoos, mis?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: A POKéMON that does good in the secondary judging seems to be more relaxed when it's doing appeals.
et: POKéMON, kes teisejärgulisel hindamisel hästi läbi lööb, näib säras olles lõdvestunum olevat.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Will you look at that sorry sight?
et: Kas vaataksid seda haledat vaatepilti?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better than that lot!
et: Heh, mu POKéMON on kindlasti sellest kambast parem!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
en: Don't you get the urge to move with POKéMON if they're putting on an energetic appeal?
et: Kas sul ei teki tung POKéMONidega liikuda, kui nad esitavad energilise sära?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON KONKURSSIDE HYPER RANGI LAVA!

et: Järgmisena su 1. vooru matš. Kas oled valmis?

en: Your 2nd-round match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su 2. vooru matš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSemifinals

et: Järgmisena su poolfinaalmatš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForFinals
en: Your final match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su finaalmatš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ChooseTwoMons
en: Please choose the two POKéMON that are to appear in battle.
et: Palun vali kaks POKéMONi, kes lahingus esinevad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
en: Right this way, please.
et: Palun siiapoole.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
en: Thank you for competing!
et: Aitäh võistlemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth

et: Ma taastan su POKéMONid täieliku tervise juurde.

et: Kõik 1. vooru matšid on lõpetatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round1Complete

et: Need on meeskonnad, kes edasi pääsesid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2
en: Congratulations for getting through the 1st round.
et: Palju õnne esimesest voorust läbisaamise puhul.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2
en: The 2nd round is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 2. voor. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals

et: Selles voorus kohtuvad neli parimat meeskonda. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: Congratulations for advancing to the final match.
et: Palju õnne finaalmatši jõudmise puhul.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: You're one win from the championship. Are you ready?
et: Sa oled ühe võidu kaugusel meistritiitlist. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_PlayersNextOpponentIsTrainer
en: {PLAYER}'s next opponent is this TRAINER.
et: {PLAYER} järgmine vastane on see TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound1
en: The tournament is in the 1st round.
et: Turniir on 1. voorus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound2

et: Turniir on 2. voorus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInSemifinals

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInFinals

en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja sulgeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RetireYourChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Battle Tournament challenge?
et: Kas soovid loobuda oma lahinguturniiri väljakutsest?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
en: I am saving your data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan su andmeid. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Should I record your last match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas salvestada su viimane matš FRONTIER PASSile?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver

et: Palju õnne finaalmatši jõudmise puhul.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, hello. You are?
et: Oh, tere. Sina oled?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}. I can see that you're a TRAINER.
et: Olgu, su nimi on {PLAYER}{KUN}. Ma näen, et sa oled TRAINER.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: So that means you use the POKéMON Storage System I developed.
et: Nii et see tähendab, et sa kasutad POKéMONi hoiusüsteemi, mille mina välja töötasin.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: How I arrived at that conclusion is a simple deductive process.
et: Kuidas ma sellele järeldusele jõudsin, on lihtne loogiline protsess.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: You spoke to me because you wanted to access something on this PC.
et: Sa rääkisid minuga, sest tahtsid sellel PC-l millelegi ligi pääseda.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.
et: Oh, vabandust. Ma olen LANETTE.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's great you're using the Storage System.
et: Ausalt, mul on hea meel sinuga kohtuda — tore, et kasutad hoiusüsteemi.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: If you could, please visit me at home. My house is on ROUTE 114.
et: Kui saaksid, palun külasta mind kodus. Mu maja on ROUTE 114 peal.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: I wonder what POKéMON looked like long, long ago?
et: Huvitav, milline POKéMON kaua-kaua aega tagasi välja nägi?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge of town will know.
et: Võib-olla teab FOSSIL MANIAC linna serval.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
en: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant seedlings of hardy trees that thrive even in volcanic ash.
et: FALLARBORI põldudel istutame vastupidavate puude seemikuid, mis õitsevad isegi vulkaanilises tuhas.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and ANTIDOTES.
et: Ma ostan mõned PARLYZ HEALid ja ANTIDOTE'd.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: Just in case I run into SHROOMISH in PETALBURG WOODS.
et: Igaks juhuks, kui satun PETALBURG WOODSis SHROOMISHi otsa.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: My POKéMON evolved. It has a lot of HP now.
et: Mu POKéMON arenes. Tal on nüüd palju HP-d.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it instead of ordinary POTIONS.
et: Ma peaksin talle tavaliste POTIONite asemel SUPER POTIONeid ostma.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in case I get lost in a cave.
et: Ma võtan ESCAPE ROPE'i igaks juhuks, kui koopas ära eksin.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I just need to use it to get back to the entrance.
et: Ma pean seda lihtsalt kasutama, et sissepääsu juurde tagasi saada.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: This is a perfect place to go exploring! It's exciting here!
et: See on täiuslik koht uurimiseks! Siin on põnev!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: I bet there're amazing treasures on board.
et: Vean kihla, et pardal on hämmastavaid aardeid.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before.
et: See POKéMON võitis siin varem BEAUTY VÕISTLUSE.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!
et: Noh, arva mis? Täna panin ma ta võitma SMARTNESS VÕISTLUSE!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: My abilities scare even me…
et: Mu võimed hirmutavad isegi mind…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work.
et: Ma olen mitmele VÕISTLUSELE astunud, nii et näen, kuidas asjad käivad.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals.
et: Kui oled COOLNESS VÕISTLUSEL, lähevad lahedad võtted etendustena peale.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.
et: Aga nutikad võtted ja nunnud võtted ei lähe näiteks hästi peale.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Sel noormehel, kes varem võitis, oli terve hunnik eri {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: Can you win if you had that many of those things?
et: Kas suudad võita, kui sul on nii palju neid asju?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!
et: Ohoo, kas pole see koht hiiglaslik!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.
et: Pinge õhus… See pole nagu kolka VÕISTLUSSAAL.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their TRAINERS, are you ready?!
et: MC: Olgu, NUTIKAD POKéMONid ja teie TRAINERid, kas olete valmis?!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: Give it your best showing! Let's appeal!
et: Anna endast parim! Etendame!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?
et: KOHTUNIK: Kas naudid seda VÕISTLUST?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!
et: Tule tagasi kolme sõbraga ja te kõik võite VÕISTLUSELE astuda!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST.
et: Ai-jai-jai-jai… Ma astusin valele VÕISTLUSELE.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST…
et: Ma panin selle sitke POKéMONi SMARTNESS VÕISTLUSELE…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.
et: Anna tulla, hämmasta neid nutika ROCK SMASHiga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart.
et: Ma olen kulutanud palju aastaid ja kogu oma tarkuse, et kasvatada see POKéMON nutikaks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON.
et: Teda ei alista kergesti mõne noore jõnglase POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: My dear wife, are you seeing this?
et: Mu kallis naine, kas sa näed seda?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: There it is!
et: Sealsamas!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!
et: Kui mu POKéMON teeb järgmisena nutika võtte, saavutab publiku elevus haripunkti!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: Oh, dear, no!
et: Oh, heldeke, ei!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over!
et: Mu armsa ZUBATI LEECH LIFE on nii nunnu, et ma kasutasin seda ikka ja jälle!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!
et: Aga need õelad inimesed ei oska seda üldse hinnata!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
en: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!
et: Kijaaah! Sa oled kaunis, vanaisa!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals.
et: Isegi kui TRAINERid panevad üles sama liiki POKéMONi, näivad nad kõik etendusteks eri võtteid kasutavat.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.
et: See on täpselt nagu see, kuidas inimestel on võitlemiseks eri stiilid.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
en: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMONid näevad nutikamad välja kui nende TRAINERid. Palju.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS.
et: Kui kõik on öeldud ja tehtud, armastan ma ikkagi SMARTNESS VÕISTLUSI.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.
et: See intellektuaalne roheline värv… See on nii… Nii… Lahe.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
en: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!
et: MC: Kas sinagi astud BEAUTY VÕISTLUSELE? Edu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty!
et: KOHTUNIK: Ah, iga POKéMON siin on laitmatu ilu eeskuju!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: Why, I almost forgot to score them!
et: Ohoo, ma peaaegu unustasin neid hinnata!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it.
et: Nii kaunis POKéMON… Teist sellist pole.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.
et: Kõigi silmad on liimitud mu ilule.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: Waaaah!
et: Ojoooo!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: I brushed and groomed my POKéMON carefully for this CONTEST…
et: Ma harjasin ja sugesin oma POKéMONi hoolikalt selle VÕISTLUSE jaoks…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: But I overdid it… My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…
et: Aga ma pingutasin üle… Mu POKéMONi karv läks üleni sassi…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: What should I do?
et: Mida ma peaksin tegema?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it.
et: See AURORA BEAM on nii pimestav, et KOHTUNIK ei suuda seda näha.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!
et: Äh, oota hetk… See on siis mõttetu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger.
et: See kaunis POKéMON näeb välja täpselt nagu mina nooruses.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking.
et: Just kui ma seda ütlesin, purskas mu abikaasa kohvi, mida jõi, välja.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Did I say something funny?
et: Kas ma ütlesin midagi naljakat?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
en: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.
et: Tead, kui ma võidan BEAUTY VÕISTLUSE, siis kindlasti teeb see mind õnnelikuks. Rohkem kui tavaliselt igatahes.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Wahahahah!
et: Vahahahaa!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Will you take a gander at all those pretty POKéMON! I just love this sort of glitz!
et: Kas vaataksid kõiki neid kauneid POKéMONe! Ma lihtsalt armastan sellist glamuuri!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You can't always win on just beauty alone.
et: Alati ei võida ainult ilu põhjal.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.
et: Sa pead oma POKéMONi sugema, nii et ta on kena ja läikiv nagu minu oma.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: MC: Uh-oh! Hello! We're in the middle of a CONTEST!
et: MC: Oih! Tere! Me oleme keset VÕISTLUST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: Please enter at our registration counter and come out, okay?
et: Palun astu meie registreerimislaua juures sisse ja tule välja, olgu?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals!
et: KOHTUNIK: Oh, sellised võluvad ja nunnud etendused!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!
et: Oh, heldeke! Milline täiuslikult armas WATER SPORT etendus!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
en: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was distracted by another POKéMON.
et: Oh ei… Mu armas AZURILLi tähelepanu hajutas teine POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
en: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, but put it in a CONTEST and look out!
et: Mu POKéMON pole kunagi lahingus võitnud, aga pane ta VÕISTLUSELE ja hoia end!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance.
et: Mu POKéMONi PETAL DANCE on elegantsi ime.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: I won't let anyone disturb its performance.
et: Ma ei lase kellelgi selle etendust häirida.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.
et: Kõigi POKéMONid on väga nunnud.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: However, if my POKéMON were to make a cute appeal…
et: Kuid kui mu POKéMON teeks nunnu etenduse…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: I'm sure that it would be so much cuter than the others.
et: Olen kindel, et see oleks palju nunnum kui teised.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
en: My child is in this CONTEST.
et: Mu laps on sellel VÕISTLUSEL.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
en: Come on, dear. Go for it! Your POKéMON is the best!
et: Anna minna, kallis. Anna tulla! Su POKéMON on parim!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
en: I think that girl over there is the cutest of the lot.
et: Ma arvan, et see tüdruk seal on kõigist nunnum.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
en: What's that? They're judging POKéMON by their looks?
et: Mis see on? Nad hindavad POKéMONe nende välimuse järgi?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
en: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, they make we want to get my own!
et: Ohh, kõiki neid nunnusid POKéMONe nähes tahan ma endale ka ühe saada!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
en: I'm going to go catch some!
et: Ma lähen mõned püüan!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
en: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!
et: BEAUTY VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END LUMMATA KAUNITEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
en: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!
et: CUTENESS VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END VÕLUDA NUNNUDEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
en: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!
et: SMARTNESS VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END MULJETADA NUTIKATEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
en: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.
et: Karbile on trükitud POKéMONi logo.

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
en: It's a POKéMON brand moving and delivery service.
et: See on POKéMON brändi kolimis- ja kättetoimetusteenus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom1
en: You are currently in the 1st room…
et: Sa oled praegu 1. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom3
en: You are currently in the 3rd room…
et: Sa oled praegu 3. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom5
en: You are currently in the 5th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 5. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom7
en: You are currently in the 7th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 7. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom9
en: You are currently in the 9th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 9. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom11
en: You are currently in the 11th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 11. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom13
en: You are currently in the 13th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 13. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_ContinueWithChallenge
en: Will you continue with your challenge?
et: Kas jätkad oma väljakutset?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SaveChallengeAndQuit
en: Would you like to save your challenge and quit the game for now?
et: Kas soovid oma väljakutse salvestada ja mängu esialgu sulgeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Do you wish to retire from your Battle Choice challenge?
et: Kas soovid loobuda oma Battle Choice väljakutsest?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AwaitingReturnSaveBeforeResume
en: We've been awaiting your return…
et: Me oleme su tagasitulekut oodanud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AwaitingReturnSaveBeforeResume
en: Before resuming your Battle Choice challenge, let me save the game…
et: Enne su Battle Choice väljakutse jätkamist lase mul mäng salvestada…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PleaseEnjoyChallenge
en: Please do enjoy your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Palun naudi oma Battle Choice väljakutset…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SavingYourData
en: I am saving your data… A little time, please…
et: Ma salvestan su andmeid… Veidi aega, palun…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePike_Text_PathBlockedNoTurningBack
en: The path is blocked! And there is no turning back…
et: Tee on blokeeritud! Ja tagasiteed ei ole…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_FindingItDifficultToChoose
en: I beg your pardon, but…
et: Palun vabandust, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_FindingItDifficultToChoose
en: Are you perhaps finding it difficult to choose your path?
et: Kas sul on ehk raske teed valida?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_ApologizeForImpertinence
en: I see… I apologize for my impertinence…
et: Ma näen… Vabandan oma jultumuse pärast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutRightPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path on the right…
et: Ah, lase vaadata… Parempoolses tees on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutCenterPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path in the center…
et: Ah, lase vaadata… Keskmises tees on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutLeftPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path on the left…
et: Ah, lase vaadata… Vasakpoolses tees on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AromaOfPokemon
en: It seems to have the distinct aroma of POKéMON wafting around it…
et: Näib, et selle ümber hõljub selge POKéMONi aroom…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PresenceOfPeople
en: Is it… A TRAINER? I sense the presence of people…
et: Kas see on… TRAINER? Ma tajun inimeste kohalolu…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_HeardWhispering
en: I seem to have heard something… It may have been whispering…
et: Ma justkui kuulsin midagi… See võis olla sosin…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_WaveOfNostaliga
en: For some odd reason, I felt a wave of nostalgia coming from it…
et: Mingil imelikul põhjusel tundsin ma sellest nostalgialainet…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: I am sorry to say…
et: Mul on kahju öelda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: A terrifying event, yes, a horrible one, is about to befall you…
et: Õudne sündmus, jah, kohutav sündmus on sind tabamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: I urge you to pay the utmost care and prepare for the worst…
et: Ma soovitan sul olla ülimalt hoolikas ja valmistuda halvimaks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_DreadfulPresence
en: From every path I sense a dreadful presence…
et: Igast teest tajun ma õudset kohalolu…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
en: The blackboard lists status changes that may affect POKéMON in battle.
et: Tahvel loetleb olekumuutusi, mis võivad lahingus POKéMONe mõjutada.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
en: Which topic do you want to read?
et: Millist teemat sa lugeda tahad?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will steadily lose HP.
et: Kui POKéMON on mürgitatud, kaotab ta pidevalt HP-d.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: The effects of poison remain after a battle.
et: Mürgi mõju püsib pärast lahingut.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: A poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop while it is traveling.
et: Mürgitatud POKéMONi HP langeb, kui ta ringi rändab.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: Heal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.
et: Ravi mürgitus ANTIDOTE'i kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed, its SPEED drops.
et: Kui POKéMON halvatakse, langeb ta KIIRUS.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: It may also not be able to move while it is in battle.
et: Ta ei pruugi ka lahingus olles liikuda saada.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: Paralysis remains after battle. Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.
et: Halvatus püsib pärast lahingut. Ravi see PARLYZ HEALi kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be unable to attack.
et: Kui POKéMON uinub, ei suuda ta rünnata.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: A POKéMON may wake up on its own, but if a battle ends while it is sleeping, it will stay asleep.
et: POKéMON võib ise ärgata, aga kui lahing lõpeb, kui ta magab, jääb ta magama.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: Wake it up using an AWAKENING.
et: Ärata ta üles AWAKENINGut kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
en: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it steadily reduces the victim's HP.
et: Põletushaav vähendab RÜNNAKU jõudu ja vähendab pidevalt ohvri HP-d.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
en: A burn lingers after battle. Cure a burn using a BURN HEAL.
et: Põletushaav püsib pärast lahingut. Ravi põletushaava BURN HEALi kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
en: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes completely helpless.
et: Kui POKéMON on külmunud, muutub ta täiesti abituks.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
en: It will remain frozen after battle. Thaw it out using an ICE HEAL.
et: Ta jääb pärast lahingut külmunuks. Sulata ta üles ICE HEALi kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
en: Students who don't study get a little taste of my QUICK CLAW.
et: Õpilased, kes ei õpi, saavad väikese maigu mu QUICK CLAW'st.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
en: Whether or not you are a good student will be evident from the way you use this item.
et: See, kas oled hea õpilane või mitte, saab selgeks sellest, kuidas seda eset kasutad.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will occasionally speed up and get to move before its opponent.
et: POKéMON, kes hoiab QUICK CLAW'd, kiireneb vahel ja saab liikuda enne oma vastast.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: There are many other items that are meant to be held by POKéMON.
et: On palju teisi esemeid, mis on mõeldud POKéMONidel hoidmiseks.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: Just those alone will give you many topics to study!
et: Juba ainuüksi need annavad sulle palju õpitavaid teemasid!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
en: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend right now.
et: Ma vahetan praegu oma sõbraga POKéMONe.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
en: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and I'm finally getting one!
et: Ma tahtsin alati SEEDOTi ja lõpuks ma saangi ühe!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
en: POKéMON can hold items, but they don't know what to do with man-made items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
et: POKéMONid saavad esemeid hoida, aga nad ei tea, mida teha inimtehtud esemetega nagu POTION ja ANTIDOTE.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: You know how some POKéMON moves can confuse a POKéMON?
et: Tead ju, kuidas mõned POKéMONi võtted võivad POKéMONi segadusse ajada?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: A confused POKéMON will sometimes attack itself without meaning to.
et: Segaduses POKéMON võib vahel iseennast tahtmatult rünnata.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: But once it leaves battle, it will return to normal.
et: Aga kui ta lahingust lahkub, naaseb ta normaalseks.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal itself…
et: POKéMON, kes hoiab BERRY-t, ravib end ise…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: There are many kinds of items that POKéMON can hold…
et: On palju liiki esemeid, mida POKéMONid saavad hoida…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: Boy, it sure is hard taking notes down…
et: Poiss, märkmete tegemine on ikka raske…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: It's this student's notebook…
et: See on selle õpilase märkmik…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: POKéMON are to be caught using POKé BALLS.
et: POKéMONe püütakse POKé BALLe kasutades.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: Up to six POKéMON can accompany a TRAINER.
et: TRAINERIGA saab kaasas käia kuni kuus POKéMONi.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: A TRAINER is someone who catches POKéMON, raises them, and battles with them.
et: TRAINER on keegi, kes püüab POKéMONe, kasvatab neid ja võitleb nendega.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: A TRAINER's mission is to defeat the strong TRAINERS who await challengers in POKéMON GYMS.
et: TRAINERI ülesanne on alistada tugevad TRAINERID, kes ootavad väljakutsujaid POKéMON SAALIDES.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: Hello? Didn't we meet before? I think back in PETALBURG CITY.
et: Tere? Kas me ei kohtunud varem? Ma arvan, et tookord PETALBURG CITYS.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: Let me introduce myself. My name's SCOTT.
et: Lase mul end tutvustada. Mu nimi on SCOTT.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding TRAINERS.
et: Ma olen rännanud kõikjal silmapaistvaid TRAINEREID otsides.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: More specifically, I'm looking for POKéMON battle experts.
et: Täpsemalt otsin ma POKéMON-lahingu eksperte.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: So, what brings you to this SCHOOL? Are you a TRAINER, too?
et: Nii et mis toob sind sellesse KOOLI? Kas sinagi oled TRAINER?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
