label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
en: It took me all night to make the maze…
et: Mul kulus terve öö labürindi tegemiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four, five places!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt peaaegu võrdne ühe, kahe, kolme, nelja, viie koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
en: It took me all night to prepare the wall panels…
et: Mul kulus terve öö seinapaneelide ettevalmistamiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four places!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt peaaegu võrdne ühe, kahe, kolme, nelja koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
en: It took me all night to shove in those boulders…
et: Mul kulus terve öö nende rahnude sissesurumiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three places!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt peaaegu võrdne ühe, kahe, kolme koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
en: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS and another to think up the quiz…
et: Mul kulus terve öö MECHADOLLIDE tegemiseks ja teine viktoriini väljamõtlemiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two places!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt peaaegu võrdne ühe, kahe koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: It took me all night to install the doors…
et: Mul kulus terve öö uste paigaldamiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: You're almost my equal in greatness!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt peaaegu võrdne!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: It took me all night setting up arrows…
et: Mul kulus terve öö noolte üles seadmiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: You're my equal in greatness!
et: Sa oled mulle suursuguselt võrdne!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: It took me all night polishing floors…
et: Mul kulus terve öö põrandate poleerimiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: You're above me in greatness! Possibly…
et: Sa oled minust suursugusem! Võib-olla…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Wh-what should I do? My fountain of ideas for tricks has run dry…
et: M-mida ma peaksin tegema? Mu ideedeallikas trikkide jaoks on kuivaks jäänud…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Perhaps it is time I toured the country on a quest to devise new tricks…
et: Ehk on aeg mul rännata mööda maad, otsingul uute trikkide väljamõtlemiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: I hate to admit defeat, but you have bested me!
et: Ma vihkan kaotust tunnistada, aga sa oled mind ületanud!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Still, you must have been reeled in by my charisma for you to visit me again and again. Yes, you must have!
et: Sellegipoolest pidi mu karisma sind ligi tõmbama, et sa mind ikka ja jälle külastad. Jah, kindlasti pidi!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: But that has nothing to do with my losing!
et: Aga sel pole midagi pistmist minu kaotamisega!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: In recognition of the friendship between you, the driven, and the genius that is myself, I demand that you take this keepsake!
et: Tunnustuseks sõprusele sinu, sihikindla, ja geeniuse, kes olen mina, vahel, ma nõuan, et võtaksid selle mälestuseseme!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Actually there are two-a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT. Which do you prefer?
et: Tegelikult on neid kaks – PUNANE TELK ja SININE TELK. Kumba eelistad?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: What? No room in your PC? What am I to make of that?
et: Mida? Su PC-s pole ruumi? Mida ma sellest arvama pean?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I wish I could say that, but I am much too kind and caring, so come back later!
et: Ma sooviksin seda öelda, aga ma olen palju liiga lahke ja hooliv, nii et tule hiljem tagasi!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I am leaving on a journey of discovery. A quest in search of new tricks.
et: Ma asun avastusreisile. Otsingule uute trikkide järele.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I wish that you will one day visit and entertain me again.
et: Ma soovin, et sa mind ühel päeval külastad ja jälle lõbustad.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: And now, farewell!
et: Ja nüüd, hüvasti!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
en: Fine! You have earned this reward!
et: Hea küll! Sa oled selle tasu ära teeninud!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: What? Have you no room for this? What manner of items do you carry?
et: Mida? Kas sul pole selle jaoks ruumi? Missuguseid esemeid sa kannad?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: But fine, since you've reached me, your reward will be with me till later.
et: Aga hea küll, kuna sa jõudsid minuni, ootab su tasu minu juures hilisema ajani.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Scrub that smug smirk from your face! It's much too early to think you've won!
et: Kraabi see enesekas naeratus oma näolt! On palju liiga vara arvata, et oled võitnud!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will. You may mock me only when you're done.
et: Ma teen uusi trikke, et sind kimbatusse ajada, kindlasti. Sa võid mind pilgata alles siis, kui oled valmis.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Come back for the next exciting installment!
et: Tule tagasi järgmise põneva osa jaoks!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
en: Now, now! You're ignoring me now? Now that, I consider heartbreaking!
et: No kuule! Sa eirad mind nüüd? Seda küll pean ma südantlõhestavaks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Who are you? Where did you come in from?
et: Kes sa oled? Kust sina sisse tulid?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin selle…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I can't find the way out!
et: Ma ei leia väljapääsu!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!
et: Ma ei karda. Ära saa minust valesti aru!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Who are you? Where do you think you're going?
et: Kes sa oled? Kuhu sa arvad, et lähed?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: I failed to win!
et: Mul ei õnnestunud võita!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: My partner forgot the map in that submarine!
et: Mu partner unustas kaardi sellesse allveelaeva!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How's that for being useless?
et: Kuidas see nüüd kasutuks jäämise poolest on?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: Urrrrppp…
et: Urrrrpp…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: I'm getting queasy just being aboard this ship…
et: Mul hakkab paha juba sellel laeval olemisest…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: It's not even moving, but…
et: See isegi ei liigu, aga…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: How did you manage to get here without a submarine? What an impressive child!
et: Kuidas sa suutsid siia ilma allveelaevata jõuda? Milline muljetavaldav laps!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: But… It won't do to have you meddling about here.
et: Aga… Ei sobi, et sa siin ringi jändaksid.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: And, I do want payback for what happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…
et: Ja ma tahan küll kättemaksu selle eest, mis WEATHER INSTITUTE'is juhtus…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: I'm going to give you a little taste of pain! Resign yourself to it!
et: Ma annan sulle väikese maigu valust! Lepi sellega!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ouch!
et: Ai!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: Ahahahaha! You're so darn strong.
et: Ahahahaa! Sa oled ikka kuradi tugev.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: It's terribly disappointing that you're not a TEAM AQUA member.
et: On kohutavalt kahju, et sa pole TEAM AQUA liige.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: You could have enjoyed the fabulous world our BOSS has promised as one of us…
et: Sa oleksid võinud ühena meist nautida seda vapustavat maailma, mille meie BOSS on lubanud…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: For our dream to become real, we need the power of POKéMON.
et: Et meie unistus tõeks saaks, vajame me POKéMONide jõudu.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: But meddlers like you use the power of POKéMON to mess with us even at a place like this!
et: Aga sinusugused tüütud jändajad kasutavad POKéMONide jõudu, et meiega jamada isegi sellises paigas!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Life just doesn't work the way we need it to!
et: Elu lihtsalt ei toimi nii, nagu meil vaja on!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Gwah!
et: Gvah!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: You know, we don't dare question the motives of our leader.
et: Tead, me ei julge oma juhi ajendeid kahtluse alla seada.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: But here you are, just some punk, going up against our BOSS.
et: Aga siin sa oled, lihtsalt mingi plika, kes meie BOSSIGA jõudu katsub.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Maybe… You must be something…
et: Ehk… Sa pead küll miski olema…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!
et: Raketi start on lähedal!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Rakett startis ohutult! See on edukas start nr. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…
et: Ma tean, et asjad on praegu veidi segamini, aga…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!
et: Raketi start on lähedal!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…
et: Ma tean, et asjad on praegu veidi segamini, aga…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Rakett startis ohutult! See on edukas start nr. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: A rocket launch demands perfection. Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.
et: Raketistart nõuab täiuslikkust. Isegi 1% eksimist ei lubata.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing is useless if 1% happens to be no good.
et: Isegi kui 99% on korras, on kogu asi kasutu, kui juhtub, et 1% ei kõlba.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Despite that, we never stop trying. Why? It's a dream that never ends.
et: Sellest hoolimata me ei lakka kunagi püüdmast. Miks? See on unistus, mis ei lõpe kunagi.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights set on our SPACE CENTER.
et: Need MAGMA sulid on oma pilgu meie SPACE CENTERile seadnud.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: But we can't allow anything that minor to interfere with our rocket launch!
et: Aga me ei saa lubada millelgi nii tühisel meie raketistarti segada!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: I was taking a stroll down the beach when I found this.
et: Ma jalutasin mööda randa, kui selle leidsin.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: It's not anything I need, so you can have it.
et: See pole midagi, mida ma vajaksin, nii et võta see endale.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
en: The HOENN region has been famous for its meteor showers for a long time.
et: HOENNI piirkond on olnud oma meteoorisadude poolest kuulus juba pikka aega.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal the rocket fuel.
et: TEAM MAGMAL ei tohi lasta raketikütust varastada.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: Oh, by the way, you can have this stone I found on the beach.
et: Oh, muide, sa võid saada selle kivi, mille ma rannast leidsin.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
en: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess strolls on the beach aren't safe.
et: TEAM MAGMAGA ringi tiirlemas, ma vist ei saa rannas ohutult jalutada.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
en: Some people claim that POKéMON came from space. Could it be true?
et: Mõned inimesed väidavad, et POKéMONid tulid kosmosest. Kas see saab tõsi olla?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: TEAM AQUA should take care of TEAM MAGMA!
et: TEAM AQUA peaks TEAM MAGMAGA tegelema!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will become bold and brazen, won't they?
et: Aga kui nad seda teeksid, muutuks TEAM AQUA julgeks ja häbematuks, kas pole?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…
et: Hiiglaslik metallitükk paiskub läbi taeva ja lendab kosmosesse…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: It boggles my mind!
et: See paneb mu mõistuse pahupidi!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…
et: Hiiglaslik metallitükk paiskub läbi taeva ja lendab kosmosesse…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil that dream of mine!
et: Aga TEAM MAGMA tahab selle mu unistuse rikkuda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: I'm not having any of that!
et: Ma ei kavatse seda taluda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that proclamation already?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas oled seda kuulutust juba lugenud?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket fuel on this island.
et: TEAM MAGMA tuleb sellel saarel raketikütuse järele.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I don't know what they'd need it for, but they can't be allowed to take it.
et: Ma ei tea, milleks nad seda vajaksid, aga neil ei tohi lasta seda võtta.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I'll keep an eye on things for a while longer.
et: Ma hoian veel veidi aega asjadel silma peal.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: In the meantime, why don't you go check out the town?
et: Vahepeal, mine miks sa ei uuri linna?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: As promised, we've come for the rocket fuel!
et: Nagu lubatud, oleme tulnud raketikütuse järele!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Ran out of fuel…
et: Kütus sai otsa…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Don't think you're on a roll just because you've beaten me!
et: Ära arva, et sul läheb hästi, lihtsalt sellepärast, et mind võitsid!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We gave you fair warning! There's nothing sneaky about us!
et: Me andsime sulle ausa hoiatuse! Meis pole midagi salakavalat!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Grrr… We should've used sneaky treachery…
et: Grrr… Me oleksime pidanud kavalat reetlikkust kasutama…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Okay, I get it already! The next time, we'll come unannounced.
et: Olgu, ma juba saan aru! Järgmine kord tuleme ette teatamata.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has in storage--that's what we're after.
et: Raketikütus, mida SPACE CENTER laos hoiab – seda me tahamegi.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: We mean to take every last bit of it!
et: Me kavatseme selle viimse tilgani võtta!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Please, can you spare some fuel? Even a chintzy cup will do!
et: Palun, kas saad veidi kütust loovutada? Isegi kehv tass ajaks asja ära!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: What are we going to do with the rocket fuel?
et: Mida me raketikütusega peale hakkame?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How would I know? Ask our leader upstairs!
et: Kust mina tean? Küsi meie juhilt ülakorrusel!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Our leader said no one, but no one, gets past me!
et: Meie juht ütles, et keegi, aga keegi ei pääse minust mööda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Ack! Ack! Aaack!
et: Ah! Ah! Aaah!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Please, tell our leader that I never abandoned my post. That I stayed to the bitter end…
et: Palun, ütle meie juhile, et ma ei hüljanud kunagi oma posti. Et ma jäin kibeda lõpuni…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: This is… An intent-to-steal notice?
et: See on… Kavatsus-varastada-teade?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “To the staff of the SPACE CENTER: How are you? We are doing fine.
et: „SPACE CENTERI töötajatele: Kuidas läheb? Meil läheb hästi.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “We will soon visit you to take your rocket fuel.
et: „Me külastame teid varsti, et võtta teie raketikütus.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Please don't try to stop us. We will take the fuel no matter what.
et: „Palun ärge püüdke meid takistada. Me võtame kütuse, ükskõik mis.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Let there be more land! TEAM MAGMA”
et: „Olgu rohkem maismaad! TEAM MAGMA”

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGreeting
en: Ehehe! I can tell what POKéMON are thinking!
et: Ehehe! Ma oskan öelda, mida POKéMONid mõtlevad!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGreeting
en: Please! Can I see your POKéMON?
et: Palun! Kas ma tohin su POKéMONi näha?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNoneShown
en: Boo! Cheapie!
et: Ää! Ihnus!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlHardy
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlHardy
en: This one says it likes to battle! It will battle even if it has a lot of ouchies!
et: See ütleb, et talle meeldib võidelda! Ta võitleb isegi siis, kui tal on palju valukohti!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlLonely
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlLonely
en: This one says it likes to be sneaky! But if it gets enough ouchies, it will hit back!
et: See ütleb, et talle meeldib salakaval olla! Aga kui ta saab piisavalt valukohti, lööb ta vastu!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlBrave
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlBrave
en: This one says it likes to battle! But if it gets enough ouchies, it will worry about itself!
et: See ütleb, et talle meeldib võidelda! Aga kui ta saab piisavalt valukohti, hakkab ta enda pärast muretsema!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAdamant
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAdamant
en: This one says it likes to battle! It will battle even if it has a lot of ouchies!
et: See ütleb, et talle meeldib võidelda! Ta võitleb isegi siis, kui tal on palju valukohti!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNaughty
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNaughty
en: This one says it looks after itself! But if it gets enough ouchies, it will hit back!
et: See ütleb, et ta hoolitseb enda eest! Aga kui ta saab piisavalt valukohti, lööb ta vastu!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlBold
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlBold

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound
en: I have this feeling that the little girl is saying something profound.
et: Mul on tunne, et see väike tüdruk räägib midagi sügavamõttelist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
en: I know something!
et: Ma tean midagi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
en: That little girl plays at the red house a lot!
et: See väike tüdruk mängib palju punase maja juures!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
en: For my own POKéMON, I give them perfectly suited nicknames!
et: Oma POKéMONidele annan ma täiuslikult sobivad hüüdnimed!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
en: It's my expression of, uh… originality, yes, that's it!
et: See on minu väljendus, öö… originaalsusest, jah, just see!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
en: But giving the name PEKACHU to a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.
et: Aga anda nimi PEKACHU ühele PIKACHULE? See tundub mõttetu.

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
en: I suppose it is good to use a name that's easy to understand, but…
et: Ma arvan, et on hea kasutada kergesti mõistetavat nime, aga…

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
en: PEKACHU: Peka!
et: PEKACHU: Peka!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
en: That man over there, he says weird things!
et: See mees seal, ta räägib veidraid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
en: He's funny in a weird way. I doubt I'll forget about him!
et: Ta on veidral moel naljakas. Ma kahtlen, et ta unustan!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
en: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER, the data for what's hot in DEWFORD got updated.
et: Kui ma RECORD CORNERisse ühendusin, uuenesid andmed selle kohta, mis DEWFORDIS moes on.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
en: Now that bit of data is the same as my friend's!
et: Nüüd on see andmekild sama mis mu sõbral!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
en: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in the POKéMON CENTER.
et: POKéMON CENTERis avanes üleval RECORD CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
en: I don't know what it's about, but it sounds fun. I'll go check it out!
et: Ma ei tea, millest see on, aga see kõlab lõbus. Ma lähen uurin!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Where the hearts of TRAINERS are put to the test.
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERite südamed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE PALACESSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I accept challenges to the SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: Ma võtan vastu väljakutseid ÜKSIKLAHINGU SAALIDESSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
en: Do you wish to take the SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?
et: Kas soovid võtta vastu ÜKSIKLAHINGU SAALI väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: In the BATTLE PALACE, there are several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES that are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: BATTLE PALACES on mitu saali ÜKSIKLAHINGUTE jaoks, mille nimi on ÜKSIKLAHINGU SAALID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in the usual way, except with one crucial rule that must be obeyed.
et: ÜKSIKLAHINGUD peetakse tavapärasel viisil, kuid ühe olulise reegliga, mida tuleb järgida.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are permitted only to switch their POKéMON in and out.
et: TRAINERitel on lubatud vaid oma POKéMONe sisse ja välja vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to command their POKéMON.
et: Muidu on TRAINERitel keelatud oma POKéMONe käsutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The POKéMON are to behave according to their nature and battle on their own.
et: POKéMONid peavad käituma vastavalt oma loomusele ja võitlema iseseisvalt.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.
et: Sa pead usaldama oma POKéMONe ja neid valvama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui saavutad au alistada seitse TRAINERit järjest, kingime sulle Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must save the game.
et: Kui tahad oma väljakutse katkestada, pead mängu salvestama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
en: When you have fortified your heart and POKéMON, you must return.
et: Kui oled oma südant ja POKéMONe kindlustanud, pead tagasi tulema.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
en: There are two BATTLE HALLS, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice of a challenge?
et: On kaks BATTLE SAALI, Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumma väljakutse valid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for the challenge.
et: Sul pole väljakutseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To enter, you must provide three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Sisenemiseks pead tooma kolm erinevat liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: These POKéMON must all be of Level 50 or lower.
et: Kõik need POKéMONid peavad olema tasemel 50 või madalamal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not be holding the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Come back when you have made your preparations.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled ettevalmistused teinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for the challenge.
et: Sul pole väljakutseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To enter, you must provide three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Sisenemiseks pead tooma kolm erinevat liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not be holding the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad hoida ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Come back when you have made your preparations.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled ettevalmistused teinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NowSelectThreeMons
en: Good. Now, you must select your three POKéMON.
et: Hea. Nüüd pead valima oma kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge2
en: I must save before I show you to the BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?
et: Ma pean salvestama, enne kui sind BATTLE SAALI juhatan. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
en: Good. Now, follow me.
et: Hea. Nüüd järgne mulle.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
en: I feel privileged for having seen your POKéMON's exploits.
et: Ma tunnen end privilegeeritult, et sain su POKéMONide vägitegusid näha.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
en: The results will be recorded. I must ask you to briefly wait.
et: Tulemused salvestatakse. Pean paluma sul korraks oodata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: To achieve a 7-win streak…
et: Et saavutada 7-võidusari…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: The bonds that bind your heart with your POKéMON seem firm and true.
et: Sidemed, mis seovad su südant su POKéMONidega, näivad kindlad ja tõelised.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
en: Your feat will be recorded. I must ask you to briefly wait.
et: Su saavutus salvestatakse. Pean paluma sul korraks oodata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
en: For the feat of your 7-win streak, we present you with Battle Point(s).
et: Su 7-võidusarja eest kingime sulle Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
en: You seem to have no space for our prize.
et: Sul ei näi olevat meie auhinna jaoks ruumi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
en: You should return when you have organized your BAG.
et: Sa peaksid tagasi tulema, kui oled KOTI korrastanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting
en: We have been waiting for you…
et: Me oleme sind oodanud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
en: I must save before I show you to the BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?
et: Ma pean salvestama, enne kui sind BATTLE SAALI juhatan. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: You failed to save before you ended your challenge the last time.
et: Sa ei salvestanud enne, kui viimati oma väljakutse lõpetasid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: As a result, your challenge has been disqualified. It is most unfortunate.
et: Selle tulemusel on su väljakutse diskvalifitseeritud. See on äärmiselt kahetsusväärne.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: For a hardy fellow like me, hardy POKéMON are the best.
et: Minusuguse sitke sepiku jaoks on sitked POKéMONid parimad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Offense is the best defense! A relentless attack is the ultimate!
et: Rünnak on parim kaitse! Halastamatu rünnak on ülim!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: But that's not what I wanted to chat about.
et: Aga see pole see, millest ma vestelda tahtsin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Every so often a really cute lady swings by here.
et: Aeg-ajalt põikab siia sisse üks tõesti nunnu daam.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: She says that she can tell what POKéMON are thinking.
et: Ta ütleb, et oskab öelda, mida POKéMONid mõtlevad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: I don't know about that part, but she is really cute.
et: Ma ei tea selle osa kohta, aga ta on tõesti nunnu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?
et: Ää? Miks sa mind niimoodi vaatad?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: It appears that the nature of POKéMON and the moves that they have been taught are the keys to battle here.
et: Näib, et POKéMONide loomus ja võtted, mida neile on õpetatud, on siin lahingu võtmeks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: To be more precise, it's how well the moves match the nature of the POKéMON.
et: Täpsemalt, see on see, kui hästi võtted POKéMONi loomusega sobivad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: If your POKéMON is in trouble and unable to live up to its potential, you may need to examine how well its moves match its nature.
et: Kui su POKéMON on hädas ega suuda potentsiaali täita, võib olla vaja uurida, kui hästi ta võtted ta loomusega sobivad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: My POKéMON is usually very docile.
et: Mu POKéMON on tavaliselt väga taltsas.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: But when it's in a BATTLE HALL, it sometimes seems to become transformed into something wicked!
et: Aga kui ta on BATTLE SAALIS, näib ta vahel muutuvat millekski kurjaks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: It becomes totally intimidating. It's shocking, even.
et: Ta muutub täiesti hirmuäratavaks. See on isegi ehmatav.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON would have if it favored enfeebling its opponents and chipping away slowly.
et: Huvitav, milline loomus oleks POKéMONil, kes eelistaks vaenlasi nõrgestada ja neid aeglaselt murendada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.
et: Ma imestaksin, kui see oleks LAX loomus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: But, nah, that can't be right.
et: Aga ei, see ei saa õige olla.

et: POKéMONid peavad käituma vastavalt oma loomusele ja võitlema iseseisvalt.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.
et: Sa pead usaldama oma POKéMONe ja neid valvama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui saavutad au alistada seitse TRAINERit järjest, kingime sulle Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad oma väljakutse katkestada, palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers
en: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN and seven TRAINERS in a row…
et: Et alistada PALACE MAVEN ja seitse TRAINERit järjest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints
en: In honor of the bond you share with your POKéMON, we present you with these Battle Point(s).
et: Sinu POKéMONidega jagatud sideme auks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
en: Would you like to record your latest BATTLE PALACE match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase BATTLE PALACE matši FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.
et: BATTLE SAALI reeglid on loetletud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Here, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.
et: Siin peavad POKéMONid ise mõtlema ja võitlema.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
et: Erinevalt loodusest käituvad inimestega elavad POKéMONid olenevalt oma loomusest erinevalt.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.
et: Olenevalt loomusest võib POKéMON eelistada rünnata, ükskõik mis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.
et: Teine POKéMON võib eelistada end igasuguse kahju eest kaitsta.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
et: Veel üks võib nautida vaenlaste ärritamist või segadusse ajamist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Due to its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.
et: Oma loomuse tõttu on POKéMONil lemmikvõtted, mida ta oskab hästi kasutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.
et: Ta võib ka mõnda võtet mitte sallida, mille kasutamisega tal on raskusi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.
et: On ründevõtteid, mis teevad vaenlasele otsest kahju.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
et: On kaitsevõtteid, mida kasutatakse vaenlase rünnakuteks valmistumiseks või elupunktide taastamiseks jne.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.
et: On ka teisi veidravõitu võtteid, mis võivad vaenlasi nõrgestada seisundihädadega, sealhulgas mürgi ja halvatusega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.
et: POKéMON kaalub nendesse kolme kategooriasse kuuluvate võtete kasutamist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.
et: Kui POKéMON pole TRAINERi käsu all, ei pruugi ta teatud võtteid tõhusalt kasutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
et: POKéMON pole hea üheski võttes, mida ta ei salli.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
et: Kui POKéMON oskab vaid võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi, ei suuda ta sageli oma potentsiaali täita.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
et: Olenevalt loomusest võib POKéMON hädas hakata kasutama võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
et: Kui POKéMON hakkab kitsikuses veidralt käituma, jälgi teda hoolikalt.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERite intelligents!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Welcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE FACTORYSSE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I am your guide to the Battle Swap Single Tournament.
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht Battle Swap üksikturniirile.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
en: Would you like to take the Battle Swap Single challenge?
et: Kas soovid võtta vastu Battle Swap üksikväljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: The Battle Swap Single Tournament is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using only rental POKéMON.
et: Battle Swap üksikturniir on ÜKSIKLAHINGU võistlus, mis kasutab ainult renditud POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: First, you will be loaned three POKéMON specifically for this event.
et: Esiteks laenatakse sulle spetsiaalselt selle ürituse jaoks kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: Using the supplied rental POKéMON, you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.
et: Kasutades antud renditud POKéMONe, pead pidama ÜKSIKLAHINGU.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you win, you are permitted to trade one of your rental POKéMON.
et: Kui võidad, on sul lubatud üks oma renditud POKéMONidest vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: Repeat this cycle of battling and trading--if you win seven times in a row, you will earn Battle Points.
et: Korda seda võitlemise ja vahetamise tsüklit — kui võidad seitse korda järjest, teenid Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad oma väljakutse katkestada, palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will be disqualified from your challenge.
et: Kui sa ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind väljakutsest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
en: We look forward to your next visit.
et: Ootame su järgmist külastust.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: Which level do you wish to challenge? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Millist taset soovid vastu võtta? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
en: Before you begin your challenge, I need to save the game. Is that okay?
et: Enne kui väljakutset alustad, pean mängu salvestama. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping
en: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for safekeeping while you compete.
et: Olgu, ma hoian su POKéMONid hoiul, kuni sa võistled.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way.
et: Palun astu siiapoole.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: Thank you for participating!
et: Aitäh osalemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: I will return your POKéMON in exchange for our rental POKéMON.
et: Ma annan su POKéMONid tagasi meie renditud POKéMONide vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: I must also save the event results. Please wait.
et: Ma pean ka ürituse tulemused salvestama. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons
en: I will return your POKéMON in exchange for our rental POKéMON.
et: Ma annan su POKéMONid tagasi meie renditud POKéMONide vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins
en: Congratulations! You've won seven straight Battle Swap matches!
et: Palju õnne! Sa võitsid seitse Battle Swapi matši järjest!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePointsForStreak
en: In recognition of your 7-win streak, we award you these Battle Point(s).
et: Sinu 7-võidusarja tunnustuseks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Oh, oh, oh!
et: Oh, oh, oh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Your Battle Points are maxed.
et: Su Battle Pointid on maksimumis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Please come back after using some Battle Points.
et: Palun tule tagasi pärast mõne Battle Pointi kasutamist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
en: We've been waiting for you!
et: Me oleme sind oodanud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
en: Before we resume your challenge, I must save the game.
et: Enne kui su väljakutset jätkame, pean mängu salvestama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't save before you quit playing last time.
et: Kahju seda öelda, aga sa ei salvestanud enne, kui viimati mängu jätsid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: As a result, you have been disqualified from your challenge.
et: Selle tulemusel oled sa oma väljakutsest diskvalifitseeritud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WellReturnMons
en: We'll return your personal POKéMON.
et: Me anname su isiklikud POKéMONid tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

en: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS is put to the test!

en: Welcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE FACTORYSSE!
