et: Samuti peavad nad hoidma erinevaid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Please come see me when you are ready…
et: Palun tule mind vaatama, kui oled valmis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PleaseChooseThreeMons
en: Please choose the three POKéMON you wish to enter in the challenge…
et: Palun vali kolm POKéMONi, keda soovid väljakutsel üles panna…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
en: Before starting your Battle Choice challenge, I must save the game. Is that acceptable?
et: Enne Battle Choice väljakutse alustamist pean mängu salvestama. Kas see on vastuvõetav?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way…
et: Palun astu siiapoole…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ChallengeEndedRecordResults
en: Your challenge has ended…
et: Su väljakutse on lõppenud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ChallengeEndedRecordResults
en: I shall record your results. Please wait…
et: Ma salvestan su tulemused. Palun oota…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PossessLuckInAbundance
en: You have completed the challenge…
et: Sa oled väljakutse läbinud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PossessLuckInAbundance
en: I must say… You seem to possess luck in abundance…
et: Pean ütlema… Sul näib olevat õnne külluses…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ShallRecordResults
en: I shall record your results. Please wait…
et: Ma salvestan su tulemused. Palun oota…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints2
en: To commemorate your completion of the Battle Choice challenge, we award you these Battle Point(s)…
et: Battle Choice väljakutse läbimise mälestuseks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReachedBattlePointLimit
en: You appear to have reached the limit for Battle Points…
et: Sa näid olevat jõudnud Battle Pointide piirini…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReachedBattlePointLimit
en: Please exchange some Battle Points for prizes, then return…
et: Palun vaheta mõned Battle Pointid auhindade vastu, siis tule tagasi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting
en: I beg your pardon, but…
et: Palun vabandust, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting
en: You failed to save before you quit your challenge the last time.
et: Sa ei salvestanud enne, kui viimati oma väljakutsest loobusid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting
en: Because of that, your challenge so far has been disqualified. I am sorry…
et: Selle tõttu on su senine väljakutse diskvalifitseeritud. Mul on kahju…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SnatchedVictoryFromQueen
en: Congratulations…
et: Palju õnne…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SnatchedVictoryFromQueen
en: You have snatched victory from the PIKE QUEEN and cleared the event…
et: Sa napsasid PIKE QUEENILT võidu ja läbisid ürituse…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints
en: In recognition of your amazing luck, we award you these Battle Point(s)…
et: Sinu hämmastava õnne tunnustuseks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_OneRoomAwayFromGoal
en: Arrgh! I blew my chance! I was one room away from the goal!
et: Ahh! Ma raiskasin oma võimaluse! Ma olin sihist ühe ruumi kaugusel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_OneRoomAwayFromGoal
en: In this place, you'd better watch out for poison, freezing, and so on.
et: Selles kohas hoia parem silm peal mürgil, külmumisel jne.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NeverHadToBattleTrainer
en: I've completed the challenge 10 times now, but I've never had to battle a TRAINER once.
et: Ma olen väljakutse nüüd 10 korda läbinud, aga pole kordagi pidanud TRAINERiga võitlema.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ThinkAbilitiesUsefulHere
en: Listen! Listen!
et: Kuula! Kuula!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ThinkAbilitiesUsefulHere
en: Don't you think that the special abilities of POKéMON will be useful here?
et: Kas sa ei arva, et POKéMONide erivõimed on siin kasulikud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TrainersWhicheverPathIChoose
en: What is this weird place? I can't figure it out at all!
et: Mis veider koht see on? Ma ei saa üldse aru!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TrainersWhicheverPathIChoose
en: I've taken the challenge a bunch of times, but all I ever do is run into TRAINERS whichever path I choose.
et: Ma olen väljakutse mitu korda võtnud, aga ainult, mida ma teen, on TRAINERite otsa jooksmine, ükskõik millise tee valin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Choice's rules are listed.
et: Battle Choice'i reeglid on loetletud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainPokenavBagRules
en: The BAG and POKéNAV may not be used during a Battle Choice challenge.
et: KOTTI ja POKéNAVi ei tohi Battle Choice väljakutse ajal kasutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainHeldItemRules
en: During a Battle Choice challenge, any BERRY or HERB held by POKéMON will be effective only once.
et: Battle Choice väljakutse ajal toimib POKéMONide hoitav BERRY või HERB vaid ühe korra.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules
en: During a Battle Choice challenge, the sequence of POKéMON cannot be changed.
et: Battle Choice väljakutse ajal ei saa POKéMONide järjekorda muuta.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules
en: The sequence must be set before starting your challenge.
et: Järjekord tuleb määrata enne väljakutse alustamist.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
en: We came here to chaperon our grandson.
et: Me tulime siia oma pojapoega saatma.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
en: But since we're here, we thought we should get some souvenirs.
et: Aga kuna me siin oleme, mõtlesime, et peaksime mõned suveniirid hankima.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
en: Dear, what do you think of this? Wouldn't this make a nice gift?
et: Kallis, mida arvad sellest? Kas poleks tore kingitus?

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
en: It's…PRO…TE…IN? It sounds delicious, doesn't it?
et: See on…PRO…TE…IN? Kõlab maitsvalt, kas pole?

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
en: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities don't allow the use of items during battles.
et: Paljud BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatised ei luba lahingutes esemeid kasutada.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
en: That rule makes things tougher than they already are!
et: See reegel teeb asjad veelgi raskemaks, kui nad juba on!

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro
en: When I'm here… A curious power flows into me…
et: Kui ma siin olen… Kummaline jõud voolab minusse…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieDefeat
en: The power is ebbing away…
et: Jõud vajub ära…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle
en: Perhaps the power is from the spirits of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…
et: Ehk on see jõud pärit POKéMONide vaimudest, kes siin rahutult magavad…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
en: Fufufu… I lost the match, but… I have this little ability…
et: Fufufu… Ma kaotasin matši, aga… Mul on see väike võime…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
en: Without ever laying my hands on your POKéNAV… Hiyah!
et: Ilma iial käega su POKéNAVi puudutamata… Hijaa!

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
en: Behind you… What is it…
et: Su selja taga… Mis see on…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchDefeat
en: Something faded away…
et: Miski hääbus ära…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch
en: The POKéMON at rest here… Sometimes, they play…
et: POKéMONid, kes siin puhkavad… Vahel nad mängivad…

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro
en: Have you lost your bearings? Have no fear for I am here!
et: Kas oled suunataju kaotanud? Ära karda, sest mina olen siin!

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricDefeat
en: Weren't you lost?
et: Kas sa ei eksinud?

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
en: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER would be panicked and easy to beat.
et: Mul oli selline tunne, et eksinud TRAINER oleks paanikas ja kerge alistada.

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
en: It's dirty and I won't try it again…
et: See on räpane ja ma ei proovi seda enam…

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Welcome, my name is GLACIA of the ELITE FOUR.
et: Tere tulemast, mu nimi on GLACIA ELITE FOURIST.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: I've traveled from afar to HOENN so that I may hone my ice skills.
et: Ma rändasin kaugelt HOENNi, et lihvida oma jääoskusi.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: But all I have seen are challenges by weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.
et: Aga kõik, mida ma näinud olen, on väljakutsed nõrkadelt TRAINERitelt ja nende POKéMONidelt.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: What about you?
et: Aga sina?

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: It would please me to no end if I could go all out against you!
et: Mulle valmistaks lõputut rõõmu, kui saaksin sinu vastu täie hooga minna!

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
en: You and your POKéMON… How hot your spirits burn!
et: Sina ja su POKéMONid… Kui kuumalt teie vaimud lõõmavad!

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
en: The all-consuming heat overwhelms.
et: Kõikeneelav kuumus võtab võimust.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
en: It's no surprise that my icy skills failed to harm you.
et: Pole üllatav, et mu jäised oskused ei suutnud sulle kahju teha.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Advance to the next room.
et: Liigu järgmisse ruumi.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: And there, confirm the truly fearsome side of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Ja seal kinnita POKéMON LEAGUE'i tõeliselt hirmuäratav külg.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out and cycle as fast as you'd like.
et: JALGRATTATEEL saad anda kõik ja sõita nii kiiresti kui tahad.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: It feels great to go that fast, but try not to crash into anyone!
et: On suurepärane tunne nii kiiresti kihutada, aga püüa mitte kellelegi otsa sõita!

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING ROAD. It's too dangerous.
et: Vabandust, sa ei saa JALGRATTATEEL kõndida. See on liiga ohtlik.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Please come back with a BIKE.
et: Palun tule tagasi JALGRATTAGA.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
en: You can't consider yourself a real TRAINER if you don't have faith in your POKéMON.
et: Sa ei saa end pidada tõeliseks TRAINERIKS, kui sul pole oma POKéMONidesse usku.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
en: Only those people who can believe in their battling POKéMON can win through to the very end.
et: Ainult need inimesed, kes suudavad uskuda oma võitlevatesse POKéMONidesse, saavad päris lõpuni võita.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
en: The reason why anyone would visit VERDANTURF…
et: Põhjus, miks keegi üldse VERDANTURFI külastaks…

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
en: It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without saying.
et: See on BATTLE TENT. See on iseenesestmõistetav.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
en: Or is there somebody here that you came to see?
et: Või on siin keegi, keda sa tulid vaatama?

label: Route106_Text_TrainerTips
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route106_Text_TrainerTips
en: Advice on catching POKéMON with a ROD: Press the A Button if you get a bite.
et: Nõuanne POKéMONide püüdmiseks RODiga: vajuta A-nuppu, kui saad hammustuse.

label: Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrigin
en: I heard about a cave called the CAVE OF ORIGIN.
et: Ma kuulsin koopast nimega CAVE OF ORIGIN.

label: Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrigin
en: People rumor that the spirits of POKéMON are revived there. Could something like that really happen?
et: Inimesed kuulutavad, et seal äratatakse POKéMONide vaime ellu. Kas midagi sellist saab tõesti juhtuda?

label: Route119_House_Text_Wingull
en: WINGULL: Pihyoh!
et: WINGULL: Pihjoh!

label: Route101_Text_HelpMe
en: H-help me!
et: A-aita mind!

label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
en: Hello! You over there! Please! Help!
et: Tere! Sina seal! Palun! Aita!

label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
en: In my BAG! There's a POKé BALL!
et: Mu KOTIS! Seal on POKé BALL!

label: Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe
en: Wh-Where are you going?! Don't leave me like this!
et: K-kuhu sa lähed?! Ära jäta mind sellisena!

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: PROF. BIRCH: Whew…
et: PROF. BIRCH: Uhh…

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: I was in the tall grass studying wild POKéMON when I was jumped.
et: Ma olin kõrges rohus metsikuid POKéMONe uurimas, kui mind rünnati.

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: You saved me. Thanks a lot!
et: Sa päästsid mu. Suur tänu!

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: Oh?
et: Oh?

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: Hi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Tere, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
en: This is not the place to chat, so come by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?
et: See pole vestlemise koht, nii et tule hiljem mu POKéMON LABORISSE, eks?

label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
en: If POKéMON get tired, take them to a POKéMON CENTER.
et: Kui POKéMONid väsivad, vii nad POKéMON CENTERISSE.

label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
en: There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE TOWN right close by.
et: Siinsamas lähedal OLDALE TOWNIS on POKéMON CENTER.

label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
en: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in tall grass.
et: Metsikud POKéMONid hüppavad su peale kõrges rohus.

label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
en: If you want to catch POKéMON, you have to go into the tall grass and search.
et: Kui tahad POKéMONe püüda, pead minema kõrgesse rohtu ja otsima.

label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
en: ROUTE 101 {UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
et: ROUTE 101 {UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
en: Fufufufufu.
et: Fufufufufu.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
en: I'm going to make everyone think I'm just a kid and let them play down.
et: Ma panen kõik arvama, et ma olen lihtsalt laps, ja lasen neil end alahinnata.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
en: Then, I'll shock them and grab the title!
et: Siis ma ehmatan neid ja haaran tiitli!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
en: You know how BATTLE TENTS offer different events in different towns?
et: Tead ju, kuidas BATTLE TENTID pakuvad eri linnades eri üritusi?

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
en: My favorite is definitely the BATTLE TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.
et: Mu lemmik on kindlasti BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR TOWNIS.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
en: I think it's fantastic how TRAINERS try to win with all their faith in their POKéMON.
et: Ma arvan, et on fantastiline, kuidas TRAINERid üritavad võita täie usuga oma POKéMONidesse.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
en: I heard something about some tent, so I came to camp out.
et: Ma kuulsin midagi mingist telgist, nii et tulin telkima.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
en: I didn't know that tents these days are so luxurious!
et: Ma ei teadnud, et tänapäeval on telgid nii luksuslikud!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
en: Since I'm here, I may as well try my hand at battling!
et: Kuna ma siin olen, võin sama hästi ka võitlemist proovida!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!
et: SCOTT: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Nii et sa tulid sellesse BATTLE TENTI!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: The people in these parts tend to be easygoing and laid-back.
et: Selle kandi inimesed kipuvad olema muretud ja lõdvestunud.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: But, you see, what I'm looking for are people with…
et: Aga, näed, ma otsin inimesi, kellel on…

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: How should I say this?
et: Kuidas seda öelda?

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: Someone bursting with the desire and the drive to win.
et: Keegi, kes pakatab võidusoovist ja tungist.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: If there were a TRAINER like that, I'd immediately…
et: Kui oleks selline TRAINER, ma kohe…

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
en: Whoops! Never mind! Keep working at it!
et: Uups! Pole midagi! Jätka pingutust!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
en: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your time with the likes of me, why not make a challenge?
et: SCOTT: Selle asemel, et minusugusega aega raisata, miks mitte võtta väljakutse?

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!
et: Ma olen POKéMON LEAGUE'i ELITE FOURI viimane, DRAKE, DRAAKONI meister!

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: In their natural state, POKéMON are wild living things. They are free.
et: Loomulikus seisundis on POKéMONid metsikud elusolendid. Nad on vabad.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: At times, they hinder us. At times, they help us.
et: Vahel takistavad nad meid. Vahel aitavad nad meid.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: For us to battle with POKéMON as partners, do you know what it takes?
et: Et meie saaksime võidelda POKéMONidega kui partneritega, kas tead, mida see nõuab?

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Do you know what is needed?
et: Kas tead, mida on vaja?

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: If you don't, then you will never prevail over me!
et: Kui ei tea, siis ei jää sa kunagi minust peale!

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Superb, it should be said.
et: Suurepärane, tuleb öelda.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You deserve every credit for coming this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.
et: Sa väärid iga tunnustust, et jõudsid POKéMONi TRAINERina nii kaugele.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You do seem to know what is needed.
et: Sa näidki teadvat, mida on vaja.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Yes, what a TRAINER needs is a virtuous heart.
et: Jah, mida TRAINER vajab, on vooruslik süda.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: POKéMON touch the good hearts of TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.
et: POKéMONid puudutavad TRAINERite häid südameid ja õpivad head halvast.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: They touch the good hearts of TRAINERS and grow strong.
et: Nad puudutavad TRAINERite häid südameid ja kasvavad tugevaks.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Go! Go onwards! The CHAMPION is waiting!
et: Mine! Mine edasi! MEISTER ootab!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureBeingWatched
en: You're being watched…
et: Sind jälgitakse…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathDesk
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathDesk
en: How did you know I concealed myself beneath this desk? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end selle laua alla peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindTree
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindTree
en: How did you know I concealed myself behind this tree? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end selle puu taha peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInDresser
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInDresser
en: How did you know I concealed myself in this dresser? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end sellesse kummutisse peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConealedBeyondWindow
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConealedBeyondWindow
en: How did you know I concealed myself beyond this window? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end selle akna taha peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInPlanter
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInPlanter
en: How did you know I concealed myself in this planter? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end sellesse lillepotti peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInCupboard
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInCupboard
en: How did you know I concealed myself in this cupboard? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end sellesse kappi peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindWindow
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindWindow
en: How did you know I concealed myself behind this window? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end selle akna taha peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathCushion
en: Hah? Grrr…
et: Hah? Grrr…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathCushion
en: How did you know I concealed myself beneath this cushion? You're sharp!
et: Kuidas sa teadsid, et ma end selle padja alla peitsin? Sa oled terav!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCallMeTrickMaster
en: Behold!
et: Ennäe!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCallMeTrickMaster
en: For I am the greatest living mystery of a man in all of HOENN! They call me…
et: Sest mina olen suurim elav mehemõistatus kogu HOENNIS! Mind kutsutakse…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCallMeTrickMaster
en: The TRICK MASTER! Wahahaha! Glad to meet you!
et: TRICK MASTER! Vahahahaa! Rõõm tutvuda!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
en: You, you've come to challenge my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?
et: Sina, sa oled tulnud mu TRICK HOUSE'ile väljakutset esitama, kas pole?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
en: That's why you're here, isn't it? Yes, it is!
et: Just seepärast sa siin oled, kas pole? Jah, on küll!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
en: Consider your challenge accepted!
et: Loe oma väljakutse vastuvõetuks!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
en: Enter through the scroll there, and let your challenge commence!
et: Sisene sealt kaudu läbi kirjarulli ja alaku su väljakutse!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
en: I shall be waiting in the back!
et: Ma ootan tagatoas!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ItsAScroll
en: It's a scroll.
et: See on kirjarull.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHoleBehindScroll
en: There is a big hole behind the scroll!
et: Kirjarulli taga on suur auk!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHoleBehindScroll
en: Want to go in?
et: Tahad sisse minna?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_LeavingOnJourneyNote
en: There is a note affixed to the scroll…
et: Kirjarullile on kinnitatud sedel…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_LeavingOnJourneyNote
en: “I am leaving on a journey. Don't look for me. TRICK MASTER”
et: „Ma asun rännakule. Ära otsi mind. TRICK MASTER”

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTimeUseThisTrick
en: For the next time, I'll use this trick, and that scheme, and those ruses…
et: Järgmiseks korraks kasutan ma seda trikki ja tolle skeemi ja neid riugasid…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTimeUseThisTrick
en: Mufufufu… If I may say so, it's brilliantly difficult, even for me!
et: Mufufufu… Kui tohin nii öelda, on see hiilgavalt raske, isegi minu jaoks!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidstOfDevisingNewChallenges
en: Hah? What?! Oh, it's you!
et: Hah? Mida?! Oh, see oled sina!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidstOfDevisingNewChallenges
en: I'm in the midst of devising new tricky challenges!
et: Ma olen keset uute keeruliste väljakutsete väljamõtlemist!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidstOfDevisingNewChallenges
en: It's not too much to ask for a bit more time for me to think, is it now? You wouldn't begrudge me that? Come back in a little while!
et: Pole liig paluda veidi rohkem aega mõtlemiseks, ega ju? Sa ju ei jätaks mind sellest ilma? Tule veidi aja pärast tagasi!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHereToAcceptReward
en: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the reward from before, isn't that right? Yes, right I am!
et: Ah, see oled sina! Sa oled tulnud eelmisele tasule järele, kas pole? Jah, õige mul on!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHereToAcceptReward
en: Here! I'll give it to you now!
et: Siin! Ma annan selle sulle nüüd!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouNotComeToClaimReward
en: Hah? Did you not come to claim your reward?
et: Hah? Kas sa ei tulnudki oma tasule järele?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_MechadollWhichTent
en: MECHADOLL 5 I AM! IF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU, THEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.
et: MINA OLEN MECHADOLL 5! KUI SINA TASU EI VÕTA, SIIS TRICK MASTERIT JÄRGIDA SA EI SAA.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_MechadollWhichTent
en: RED TENT OR BLUE TENT, WHICH DO YOU PREFER?
et: PUNANE TELK VÕI SININE TELK, KUMBA EELISTAD?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ThenFarewell
en: THEN FAREWELL.
et: SIIS HÜVASTI.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullAgain
en: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN. MEAN, YOU ARE.
et: SU PC-STAATUS: JÄLLE TÄIS. ILGE, SA OLED.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_FoundAScroll
en: {PLAYER} found a scroll.
et: {PLAYER} leidis kirjarulli.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_MemorizedSecretCode
en: {PLAYER} memorized the secret code written on the scroll.
et: {PLAYER} jättis kirjarullile kirjutatud salakoodi meelde.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_SecretCodeWrittenOnIt
en: A secret code is written on it.
et: Sellele on kirjutatud salakood.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLockedWriteSecretCodeHere
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLockedWriteSecretCodeHere
en: …On closer inspection, this is written on it: “Write the secret code here.”
et: …Lähemal vaatlusel on sellele kirjutatud: „Kirjuta salakood siia.”

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
en: There's a bed… Let's take a rest.
et: Seal on voodi… Puhkame veidi.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
en: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.
et: Ma purjetan tihti LILYCOVE CITYSSE.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
en: I enjoy attending CONTESTS, you see.
et: Mulle meeldib KONKURSSIDEL käia, näed.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonDefeat
en: That was an enjoyable match!
et: See oli nauditav matš!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle
en: I get so excited imagining what kinds of POKéMON I'll get to see in the next CONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!
et: Ma erutun nii väga, ette kujutades, milliseid POKéMONe ma järgmisel KONKURSIL näha saan. Selle ootus paneb põnevil olema!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahIntro
en: Are your friends strong?
et: Kas su sõbrad on tugevad?

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahDefeat
en: Your friends are, indeed, strong.
et: Su sõbrad on tõesti tugevad.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle
en: Friends need not be human. For me, POKéMON are treasured friends!
et: Sõbrad ei pea olema inimesed. Minu jaoks on POKéMONid hinnalised sõbrad!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro
en: Child… Did you knock on the door?
et: Laps… Kas sina koputasid uksele?

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat
en: A loss is to be accepted without haste or panic.
et: Kaotust tuleb võtta ilma kiirustamise või paanikata.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle
en: To be never ruffled in any situation is the GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.
et: Mitte kunagi üheski olukorras endast välja minna on HÄRRASMEHE käitumiskoodeks.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro
en: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
et: JED: Ma tunnen selle pärast veidi häbi, aga… Me näitame sulle oma armunud väge!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedDefeat
en: JED: Sigh…
et: JED: Ohh…

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle
en: JED: It's the first time that our loveydovey power couldn't prevail! You must be an awesome TRAINER!
et: JED: See on esimene kord, kui meie armunud vägi ei suutnud peale jääda! Sa pead olema äge TRAINER!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
en: JED: You only have one POKéMON? Isn't that just too lonesome?
et: JED: Sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Kas pole see lihtsalt liiga üksildane?

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro
en: LEA: I feel a little silly, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
et: LEA: Ma tunnen end veidi rumalana, aga… Me näitame sulle oma armunud väge!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaDefeat
en: LEA: Oh, boo!
et: LEA: Oh, puu!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle
en: LEA: I can't believe it! Our lovey-dovey power failed… You must be an awesome TRAINER!
et: LEA: Ma ei suuda seda uskuda! Meie armunud vägi vedas alt… Sa pead olema äge TRAINER!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
en: LEA: I wanted to battle… But you don't even have two POKéMON…
et: LEA: Ma tahtsin võidelda… Aga sul pole isegi kahte POKéMONi…

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro
en: Ah, you've come just in time.
et: Ah, sa tulid just õigel ajal.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro
en: I'm bored, you see. You may entertain me.
et: Mul on igav, näed. Sa võid mind lõbustada.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretDefeat
en: …That will do.
et: …Sellest piisab.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle
en: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire a yacht for me. A yacht for me and POKéMON!
et: Ehk panen ma Isa mulle jahti hankima. Jaht minu ja POKéMONide jaoks!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro
en: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER. Would you like to have tea? Or would you rather battle?
et: Oh, sa oled nii armas TRAINER. Kas sooviksid teed juua? Või pigem võidelda?

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat
en: I see. You're the active sort.
et: Ma näen. Sa oled tegus tüüp.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle
en: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its charms, I must say…
et: Maailmareisil luksuslaineril on omad võlud, pean ütlema…

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle
en: But, I will admit there is an appealing side to touring HOENN by ferry.
et: Aga ma tunnistan, et HOENNI praamiga läbimisel on ka üks ahvatlev külg.

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis
en: Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious! Uh… You can have this! For free!
et: Öö… Tere! Ma… Ma ei käitu kahtlaselt! Öö… Sa võid selle saada! Tasuta!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis
en: It… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from someone! I'd never do such a thing! It's clean! You can use it!
et: See… Ausalt, ma ei NÄPANUD seda kelleltki! Ma ei teeks kunagi midagi sellist! See on puhas! Sa võid seda kasutada!

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch
en: SNATCH steals the beneficial effects of certain moves before they can be used by a foe or ally.
et: SNATCH varastab teatud võtete kasulikud mõjud, enne kui vaenlane või liitlane neid kasutada saab.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
en: Don't they have set dates for their clear-out sales?
et: Kas neil pole tühjendusmüükidele kindlaid kuupäevi?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
en: I watch TV, but they never show any commercials.
et: Ma vaatan telekat, aga nad ei näita kunagi reklaame.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
en: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for this clear-out sale.
et: Jah! Ma olen seda tühjendusmüüki kaua oodanud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
en: They have items that you can only get here. I'm going to load up, that I am!
et: Neil on esemeid, mida saab ainult siit. Ma laen end täis, seda ma teen!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BoneDryThirsty
en: Ohh… I'm bone-dry thirsty!
et: Ohh… Ma olen surmani janus!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_WhichDrinkWouldYouLike
en: It's a VENDING MACHINE. Which drink would you like?
et: See on MÜÜGIAUTOMAAT. Millist jooki sooviksid?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
en: Clang!
et: Klõnks!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
en: A can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.
et: Purk {STR_VAR_1} kukkus alla.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
en: Clang!
et: Klõnks!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
en: Score! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down!
et: Vedas! Lisapurk {STR_VAR_1} kukkus alla!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: Not enough money…
et: Pole piisavalt raha…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_DecidedAgainstBuyingDrink
en: Decided against buying a drink.
et: Otsustasin jooki mitte osta.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: The BOSS got interested in the research they have going here, so he sent us out.
et: BOSSI hakkas huvitama uurimistöö, mida nad siin teevad, nii et ta saatis meid välja.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: You quit meddling!
et: Sina lõpeta jamamine!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Blast it… Blasted by a kid…
et: Neetud… Ühe lapse poolt nurja aetud…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Our BOSS knows everything.
et: Meie BOSS teab kõike.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: But I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know about what he's thinking?
et: Aga mina olen lihtsalt REAMEES. Mida mina peaks teadma, mida ta mõtleb?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Huh? What's a kid doing here?
et: Huh? Mida üks laps siin teeb?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Huh? I lost?!
et: Huh? Ma kaotasin?!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: Oh, no… I'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…
et: Oh, ei… Ma saan lapsele kaotamise eest sõimata…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: I should just take a nap in the bed…
et: Ma peaksin lihtsalt voodis uinaku tegema…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_EveryoneWentUpstairs
en: While I was sleeping, everyone went upstairs!
et: Sel ajal, kui ma magasin, läksid kõik ülakorrusele!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYoureStrong
en: Wow, you're really strong!
et: Ohoo, sa oled tõesti tugev!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYoureStrong
en: I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER like you!
et: Ma sooviksin, et saaksin olla sinusugune POKéMON TRAINER!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
en: The PROFESSOR loves rain. That's a fact.
et: PROFESSOR armastab vihma. See on fakt.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
en: But if it keeps raining, people will be in trouble. That's another fact.
et: Aga kui aina sajab, jäävad inimesed hätta. See on teine fakt.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
en: And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying if the rain can be put to good use.
et: Ja seetõttu uurib PROFESSOR, kas vihma saaks heaks otstarbeks rakendada.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_NoticingAbnormalWeather
en: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE, we study the weather patterns over the HOENN region.
et: INSTITUUDI 2. korrusel uurime me HOENNI piirkonna ilmastikumustreid.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_NoticingAbnormalWeather
en: We've been noticing temporary and isolated cases of droughts and heavy rain lately…
et: Me oleme viimasel ajal märganud ajutisi ja eraldatud põua- ja paduvihmajuhtumeid…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWereAquasUpTo
en: Hello! We've been saved by your actions!
et: Tere! Su tegudega oleme päästetud!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWereAquasUpTo
en: What I don't understand is what on earth the AQUAS were up to.
et: Mida ma ei mõista, on see, mida AQUAD õieti plaanisid.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRestInBed
en: There's a bed… Let's take a rest.
et: Seal on voodi… Puhkame veidi.

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
en: I love all things horrifying… It's like a disease…
et: Mulle meeldib kõik õudne… See on nagu haigus…

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
en: When I'm here… I shiver with fear…
et: Kui ma siin olen… Ma värisen hirmust…

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaDefeat
en: Losing, I dislike…
et: Kaotamine, see ei meeldi mulle…

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
en: I want to see dreadful things… I can't leave…
et: Ma tahan näha jubedaid asju… Ma ei suuda lahkuda…

label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
en: Stay… Won't you stay with me?
et: Jää… Kas sa ei jääks minuga?

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
en: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER! I'm the fortune-teller of names!
et: Tere, tere! Ma olen NAME RATER! Ma olen nimede ennustaja!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
en: I shall be pleased to rate your POKéMON's nickname.
et: Mul on hea meel su POKéMONi hüüdnime hinnata.

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_CritiqueWhichMonNickname
en: Which POKéMON's nickname should I critique?
et: Millise POKéMONi hüüdnime ma peaksin arvustama?

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
en: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is quite a fine name you bestowed.
et: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, on või? See on üsna kena nimi, mille sa andsid.

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
en: But! What say you, if I were to suggest a slightly better name?
et: Aga! Mida sa ütled, kui ma pakuksin veidi paremat nime?

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatShallNewNameBe
en: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
et: Ah, hea. Siis, mis saab uus hüüdnimi olema?

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
en: Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Tehtud! Nüüdsest tuntakse seda POKéMONi nime all {STR_VAR_1}!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
en: It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!
et: See on parem nimi kui enne! Kui vedanud sul on!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
en: I see. Do come visit again.
et: Ma näen. Tule kindlasti jälle külla.

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
en: Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Tehtud! Nüüdsest tuntakse seda POKéMONi nime all {STR_VAR_1}!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
en: It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
et: See ei näe endisest erinev välja, ja ometi on see tunduvalt parem!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
en: How fortunate for you!
et: Kui vedanud sul on!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
en: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!
et: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} siis!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
en: This is a magnificent nickname! It is impeccably beyond reproach!
et: See on suurepärane hüüdnimi! See on laitmatult veatu!

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
en: You'll do well to cherish your {STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.
et: Sa teed hästi, kui hoiad oma {STR_VAR_1} au sees nüüd ja edaspidi.

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
en: Now, now. That is merely an EGG!
et: No kuule. See on ju lihtsalt MUNA!

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
en: I'm the MOVE TUTOR.
et: Ma olen MOVE TUTOR.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
en: I know all the moves that POKéMON learn--every one of them--and I can teach POKéMON those moves.
et: Ma tunnen kõiki võtteid, mida POKéMONid õpivad — igat üht — ja saan neid POKéMONidele õpetada.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
en: I can teach a move to a POKéMON of yours if you'd like.
et: Ma saan õpetada võtte su POKéMONile, kui soovid.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
en: I'll do it for a HEART SCALE. I'm collecting those now.
et: Ma teen seda HEART SCALE'i eest. Ma kogun neid praegu.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
en: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness HEART SCALE!
et: Oh! See ongi! See on ehtsast ehtsam HEART SCALE!

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
en: Let me guess, you want me to teach a move?
et: Lase arvata, sa tahad, et ma õpetaksin võtte?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?
et: Milline POKéMON vajab õpetamist?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
en: Which move should I teach?
et: Millist võtet peaksin õpetama?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
en: Sorry…
et: Vabandust…

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
en: It doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach that POKéMON.
et: Ei näi, et mul oleks ühtki võtet, mida sellele POKéMONile õpetada.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
en: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE in exchange.
et: {PLAYER} andis vastutasuks ühe HEART SCALE'i.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
en: If your POKéMON need to learn a move, come back with a HEART SCALE.
et: Kui su POKéMONid peavad mõne võtte õppima, tule tagasi HEART SCALE'iga.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
en: Hunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an EGG.
et: Ähh? Pole ainustki võtet, mida saaksin MUNALE õpetada.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in SLATEPORT!
et: HR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Me oleme SLATEPORTIS maabunud!

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
en: I suppose you're going to visit CAPT. STERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?
et: Ma arvan, et sa kavatsed külastada KAPTEN STERNI ja toimetada DEVONI KAUBA?

label: Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestion
en: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed to deliver the DEVON GOODS.
et: HR. BRINEY: Ma arvasin, et sa pidid DEVONI KAUBA toimetama.

label: Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestion
en: Would you like to sail back to DEWFORD, then?
et: Kas tahaksid siis tagasi DEWFORDI purjetada?

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs
en: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!
et: HR. BRINEY: DEWFORDI siis!

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud üles! PEEKO, me purjetame, mu kallis!

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods
en: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.
et: HR. BRINEY: Siis mine ja toimeta DEVONI KAUP. Ma ootan.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in SLATEPORT!
et: HR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Me oleme SLATEPORTIS maabunud!

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!
et: Ütle mulle lihtsalt, millal iganes tahad taas purjetama minna!

label: Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Sinu jaoks lähen ma merele igal ajal!

label: Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound
en: Now, my friend, where are we bound?
et: Nüüd, mu sõber, kuhu me suundume?

label: Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToSail
en: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ütle mulle lihtsalt, millal iganes vajad taas purjetamist!

label: Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot
en: Yo, TRAINERS! Whether you're hot to trot, or cool cat not, chill at my papa's spot!
et: Jou, TRAINERID! Ükskõik kas oled tulikuum või jahe kass mitte, lõõgastu mu papa kohas!

label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
en: Little kids can dart around so quickly…
et: Väikesed lapsed suudavad nii kiiresti sinna-tänna sööstelda…

label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
en: You don't dare take your eyes off them for an instant. It's very taxing.
et: Sa ei julge neilt silmi hetkekski pöörata. See on väga kurnav.

label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
en: Mine are with my POKéMON, so they should be okay, but…
et: Minu omad on mu POKéMONidega, nii et nendega peaks olema kõik korras, aga…

label: Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime
en: Our sand castle's taking a long time to make.
et: Meie liivalossi tegemine võtab kaua aega.

label: Route109_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: You can have this!
et: Sa võid selle saada!

label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
en: We're going to get all the sand from the beach and make a big castle!
et: Me kavatseme võtta kogu liiva rannast ja teha suure lossi!

label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
en: And then we're going to be a king and queen.
et: Ja siis me hakkame kuningaks ja kuningannaks.

label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
en: We'll let you be a servant.
et: Me laseme sul olla teenija.

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
en: The water around these parts is clean.
et: Vesi selles kandis on puhas.

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
en: But, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up litter from the shoreline at times.
et: Aga vahel panen ma oma ZIGZAGOONi rannajoonelt prügi korjama.

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
en: Dirty water becomes rain and joins our rivers, which we drink from…
et: Räpasest veest saab vihm ja see liitub meie jõgedega, millest me joome…

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
en: If we pollute the sea, it all comes back to haunt us eventually.
et: Kui me merd reostame, tuleb see kõik lõpuks meile kummitama.

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonCry
en: ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?
et: ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?

label: Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign
en: SEASHORE HOUSE
et: RANNAMAJA

label: Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign
en: “May hot battles rage on hot sands! The place for hot TRAINERS!”
et: „Möllaku tulised lahingud tulisel liival! Koht tulistele TRAINERITELE!”

label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
en: POKéMON at the same level may not always have identical stats.
et: Samal tasemel POKéMONidel ei pruugi alati olla ühesugused näitajad.

label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
en: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said to grow stronger than wild POKéMON.
et: Öeldakse, et TRAINERITE kasvatatud POKéMONid muutuvad tugevamaks kui metsikud POKéMONid.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
en: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON there are in the world.
et: Huvitav, kui palju liike POKéMONe maailmas on.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
en: It'd be great to cross seas and trade POKéMON with people far away.
et: Oleks suurepärane ületada meresid ja kaubelda POKéMONidega kaugete inimestega.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardAboutRottenScoundrels
en: I've been hearing about some rotten scoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip off METEORITES.
et: Ma olen kuulnud mõnest mädast lurjusest, kes varastavad POKéMONe ja röövivad METEORIITE.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaventSeenRottenScoundrels
en: Those rotten scoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip off METEORITES…
et: Need mädad lurjused, kes varastavad POKéMONe ja röövivad METEORIITE…

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaventSeenRottenScoundrels
en: I haven't seen them around recently.
et: Ma pole neid viimasel ajal näinud.

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
en: WALLACE: This room…
et: WALLACE: See ruum…

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
en: This is where we keep records of POKéMON that prevailed through harsh battles.
et: Siin peame rekordeid POKéMONide kohta, kes karmides lahingutes peale jäid.

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
en: It is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are honored.
et: Just siin austatakse LEAGUE'i MEISTREID.

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
en: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your name as a TRAINER who triumphed over the POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of the partners who battled with you.
et: WALLACE: Tule, jäädvustame su nime kui TRAINERi, kes POKéMON LEAGUE'i üle triumfeeris, ja partnerite nimed, kes sinuga võitlesid.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
en: MAY: Oh, hey? {PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?
et: MAY: Oh, hei? {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sinagi oled ostlemas?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
en: I bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and POSTERS.
et: Ma ostsin terve hunniku NUKKE ja PLAKATEID.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
en: Of course, I've also caught a lot of POKéMON, and I'm raising them properly, too.
et: Muidugi olen ma ka palju POKéMONe püüdnud ja kasvatan neid samuti korralikult.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
en: Actually, I'm more worried if you're raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Tegelikult muretsen ma rohkem selle pärast, kas sina oma POKéMONe korralikult kasvatad, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
en: I'll battle with you, so you can show me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ma võitlen sinuga, et saaksid mulle oma POKéMONe näidata, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
en: MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you been raising your POKéMON?
et: MAY: Oh, miks? {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa pole oma POKéMONe kasvatanud?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
en: That's not a very good showing as a TRAINER…
et: See pole TRAINERina eriti hea sooritus…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
en: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can check out your POKéMON!
et: MAY: Tule, võitle minuga, et saaksin su POKéMONe uurida!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
en: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be beaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: POKéMONid, keda ma kasvatasin, ei jää su POKéMONidele alla, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
en: I remember the battle I had with you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.
et: Ma mäletan lahingut, mis mul sinuga ROUTE 103 peal oli, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
en: That battle helped you become this strong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?
et: See lahing aitas sul nii tugevaks saada, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas pole?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
en: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to LITTLEROOT soon.
et: MAY: Ma mõtlen peagi LITTLEROOTI tagasi minna.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
en: I've caught a decent group of POKéMON, and my POKéDEX is coming along, so I'm going home to show my dad.
et: Ma olen püüdnud korraliku hulga POKéMONe ja mu POKéDEX tuleb kokku, nii et ma lähen koju isale näitama.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: Collect all the GYM BADGES and take the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?
et: Koguda kõik GYM BADGE'id ja võtta POKéMON LEAGUE'i väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: Well, while you're collecting BADGES, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my POKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!
et: Noh, kuni sina MÄRKE kogud, {PLAYER}{KUN}, tegelen mina oma POKéDEXiga. Ma lõpetan selle enne sind!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: See you!
et: Näeme!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: Are you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?
et: Kas võtad POKéMON LEAGUE'i väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: Or, are you going to complete your POKéDEX?
et: Või kavatsed oma POKéDEXi täita?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: I might've lost to you in battling, but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!
et: Ma võisin sulle võitluses kaotada, aga ma lõpetan oma POKéDEXi enne sind!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: See you!
et: Näeme!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER challenge?
et: Kas võtad BATTLE FRONTIERi väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Or, are you going to complete your POKéDEX?
et: Või kavatsed oma POKéDEXi täita?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: I might've lost to you in battling, but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!
et: Ma võisin sulle võitluses kaotada, aga ma lõpetan oma POKéDEXi enne sind!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: See you!
et: Näeme!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
en: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.
et: BRENDAN: Oh, hei, see on {PLAYER}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
en: I'm running an errand for my dad. No, I'm not buying any DOLLS.
et: Ma ajan oma isa jaoks asja. Ei, ma ei osta NUKKE.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
en: Anyways, it's been a while.
et: Igatahes, ammu pole näinud.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
en: Want to have a battle to see who's been raising POKéMON better?
et: Tahad võidelda, et näha, kumb on POKéMONe paremini kasvatanud?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
en: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter? Don't have the confidence?
et: BRENDAN: Oh, mis viga? Pole enesekindlust?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
en: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's been raising POKéMON better?
et: BRENDAN: Tahad võidelda, et näha, kumb on POKéMONe paremini kasvatanud?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten
en: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not going to lose to no {PLAYER}.
et: BRENDAN: Ohh, aga tead ju, et ma ei kaota mingile {PLAYER}-le.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: Humph… You've done a lot of raising.
et: Hmph… Sa oled palju kasvatanud.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: That stings a bit--I had a head start on you as a TRAINER…
et: See torkab veidi — mul oli TRAINERina sinu ees edumaa…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
en: BRENDAN: I… I plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.
et: BRENDAN: Ma… ma plaanin koju LITTLEROOTI minna.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
en: You know I'm helping out my dad on his POKéDEX. It's coming together pretty decently, so I should go show him.
et: Sa tead, et ma aitan oma isa POKéDEXiga. See tuleb päris kenasti kokku, nii et ma peaksin talle näitama.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: Collect all the GYM BADGES and take the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?
et: Koguda kõik GYM BADGE'id ja võtta POKéMON LEAGUE'i väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: Maybe I'll do that, too…
et: Võib-olla teen ka seda…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
en: Well, anyway, hang in there!
et: Noh, igatahes, pea vastu!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: Since you're that strong, are you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?
et: Kuna sa oled nii tugev, kas võtad POKéMON LEAGUE'i väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: Heh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON a bit more, I should be stronger than you, {PLAYER}.
et: Heh, isegi mina — kui ma oma POKéMONe veel veidi treeniksin, peaksin sinust tugevam olema, {PLAYER}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
en: Well, anyway, hang in there!
et: Noh, igatahes, pea vastu!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?
et: {PLAYER}, mida sa kavatsed teha?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER challenge?
et: Kas võtad BATTLE FRONTIERi väljakutse?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Or, are you going to complete your POKéDEX?
et: Või kavatsed oma POKéDEXi täita?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Since you're that strong, you should consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Kuna sa oled nii tugev, peaksid kaaluma BATTLE FRONTIERit.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Heh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more, I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.
et: Heh, kui ma oma POKéMONe veel veidi treenin, saan sinust tugevamaks, {PLAYER}.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Maybe I should go to the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Võib-olla peaksin BATTLE FRONTIERisse minema.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
en: Well, anyway, hang in there!
et: Noh, igatahes, pea vastu!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
en: Fufufu…
et: Fufufu…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
en: We moved more loot into our secret HIDEOUT today…
et: Me viisime täna oma salajasesse PEIDIKUSSE rohkem saaki…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
en: Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!
et: K-kes sa oled?! Ma lihtsalt rääkisin iseendaga!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
en: I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what the BOSS is thinking…
et: Ma olen lihtsalt SELL, nii et ma ei tea, mida BOSS mõtleb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
en: But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get the chance to do big things!
et: Aga TEAM AQUAS olles tean, et saan võimaluse teha suuri asju!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
en: Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!
et: K-kes sa oled?! Ma lihtsalt rääkisin iseendaga!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
en: Hey, you!
et: Hei, sina!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
en: Don't go near the cave in the cove!
et: Ära mine lahesopi koopa lähedale!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
en: Why? You don't need a reason why! I'm an adult, so you just listen to me!
et: Miks? Sa ei vaja põhjust! Ma olen täiskasvanu, nii et sa lihtsalt kuula mind!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs
en: If this whole wide world becomes ours, TEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier place for POKéMON, too.
et: Kui kogu see avar maailm saab meie omaks, TEAM AQUA omaks, on see POKéMONidele õnnelikum paik.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater
en: There! WAILMER! Leap out of the water now!
et: Sealt! WAILMER! Hüppa nüüd veest välja!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
en: Hunh? What do you want?
et: Ähh? Mida sa tahad?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
en: You're messing up our training, so can you, like, get lost?
et: Sa segad meie treeningut, nii et kas saaksid nagu kaduda?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
en: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL right in this here town.
et: Siinsamas linnas on POKéMON VÕISTLUSSAAL.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
en: That means well-raised POKéMON will come from all over the country.
et: See tähendab, et hästi kasvatatud POKéMONid tulevad üle kogu riigi.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
en: My heart swells with excitement!
et: Mu süda pakatab elevusest!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove
en: Have you seen that strange cave in the cove at the edge of town?
et: Kas oled näinud seda veidrat koobast lahesopis linna serval?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
en: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new moves for entering a CONTEST.
et: Ma õpetan oma POKéMONile mõned uued võtted VÕISTLUSELE astumiseks.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
en: So, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER and make it forget HM moves.
et: Nii et ma lähen MOVE DELETERi juurde ja lasen tal HM-võtted unustada.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
en: I came from KANTO.
et: Ma tulin KANTOST.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
en: The HOENN region is beautiful with all its water and verdant nature.
et: HOENNi piirkond on kaunis kogu oma vee ja rohelusega.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
en: Hunh? Wait a second…
et: Ähh? Oota hetk…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
en: Could there be rare POKéMON that live only in this area?
et: Kas võib olla haruldasi POKéMONe, kes elavad ainult selles kandis?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
en: TEAM AQUA's been training their WAILMER in the cove.
et: TEAM AQUA on treeninud oma WAILMERit lahesopis.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
en: We SAILORS can't get our boats out to sea with them in the way!
et: Meie, MADRUSED, ei saa oma paate merele, kui nad ees on!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
en: Ahoy, did you know?
et: Ahoi, kas teadsid?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
en: Someone punted TEAM AQUA out of the way for us!
et: Keegi lükkas TEAM AQUA meie eest teelt!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
en: That got the WAILMER out of the cove, so we can get our boats out again.
et: See viis WAILMERI lahesopist välja, nii et saame oma paadid taas välja.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
en: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the seaside inn to the sound of waves…
et: Ma tegin lainete häälel mereäärses võõrastemajas lõõgastavat uinakut…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
en: When someone stole my POKéMON!
et: Kui keegi varastas mu POKéMONi!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
en: Who's the abductor? TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?
et: Kes on röövel? TEAM AQUA? Kas see on TEAM AQUA?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack
en: My missing POKéMON… It came back without me noticing!
et: Mu kadunud POKéMON… See tuli tagasi, ilma et ma märkasin!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
en: I'm an ART DEALER.
et: Ma olen KUNSTIVAHENDAJA.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
en: I am a buyer and seller of fine art, especially paintings.
et: Ma olen kaunite kunstide, eriti maalide ostja ja müüja.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
en: I've heard that the MUSEUM here has magnificent works on exhibit…
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et siinsel MUUSEUMIL on väljas suurepärased tööd…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
en: Even as we grow old and wrinkled, the sea remains forever young with the vivid brilliance of life…
et: Isegi kui me vananeme ja kortsuliseks jääme, jääb meri igavesti nooreks elu erksa säraga…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
en: Fwohoho fwohohohoho…
et: Fvohoho fvohohohoho…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
en: It was sixty years ago that my husband proposed to me here. The sea remains as beautiful as ever.
et: Kuuskümmend aastat tagasi tegi mu abikaasa mulle siin abieluettepaneku. Meri on jäänud sama kauniks kui ikka.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
en: Mufufufu mufufufufufu…
et: Mufufufu mufufufufufu…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
en: Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern in this cove?
et: Hm, kas tead sellest omapärasest koopast selles lahesopis?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
en: That had been a natural formation, but then that TEAM AQUA lot came along and made their renovations.
et: See oli olnud looduslik moodustis, aga siis tuli see TEAM AQUA kamp ja tegi oma ümberehitused.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
en: They call themselves the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!
et: Nad kutsuvad end „loodust armastavaks TEAM AQUAKS”!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
en: But what they do and what they say don't match at all!
et: Aga see, mida nad teevad, ja see, mida nad ütlevad, ei ühti üldse!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
en: That cave in the cove…
et: See koobas lahesopis…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
en: I didn't notice it right away, but it's completely empty now.
et: Ma ei märganud seda kohe, aga see on nüüd täiesti tühi.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
en: That TEAM AQUA lot, they must have gone away for good.
et: See TEAM AQUA kamp, nad pidid lõplikult ära minema.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
en: LILYCOVE CITY
et: LILYCOVE CITY

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
en: “Where the land ends and the sea begins.”
et: „Kus maa lõpeb ja meri algab.”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign
en: POKéMON CONTEST HALL “The gathering place for TRAINERS!”
et: POKéMON VÕISTLUSSAAL „TRAINERite kogunemispaik!”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
en: COVE LILY MOTEL
et: COVE LILY MOTEL

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
en: “Remember us as COVE LILY of LILYCOVE.”
et: „Pea meid meeles kui LILYCOVE'i COVE LILY.”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
en: LILYCOVE MUSEUM
et: LILYCOVE MUSEUM

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
en: “POKéMON Masterpiece Collection on exhibit!”
et: „POKéMONi meistriteoste kollektsioon väljas!”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
en: LILYCOVE MUSEUM
et: LILYCOVE MUSEUM

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
en: “{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection on exhibit!”
et: „{PLAYER} POKéMONi kollektsioon väljas!”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
en: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR
et: LILYCOVE CITY SADAM

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
en: “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under construction in SLATEPORT CITY.
et: „Praam S.S. TIDAL on SLATEPORT CITYs ehitamisel.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
en: “Service is scheduled to begin shortly.”
et: „Teenindus algab peagi.”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
en: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR
et: LILYCOVE CITY SADAM

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
en: “Enjoy a delightful cruise on the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”
et: „Naudi meeldivat kruiisi praamil S.S. TIDAL.”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
en: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB
et: POKéMON TRAINERI FÄNNIKLUBI

label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
en: The names of TRAINERS are scribbled all over the sign…
et: TRAINERite nimed on üle kogu sildi kritseldatud…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
en: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE
et: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
en: “Overflowing with great merchandise and excitement!
et: „Tulvil suurepärast kaupa ja elevust!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
en: “A great place to find that something you need!”
et: „Suurepärane koht leida see, mida vajad!”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
en: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE
et: MOVE DELETERi MAJA

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
en: “Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”
et: „Soovimatud POKéMON-võtted kustutatakse.”

label: LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBlender
en: Do you know about the machine BERRY BLENDER?
et: Kas tead masinat BERRY BLENDER?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
en: People have to work together to get it to spin faster.
et: Inimesed peavad koos töötama, et panna see kiiremini pöörlema.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
en: The faster you can make it spin, the better {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.
et: Mida kiiremini suudad seda pöörlema panna, seda paremaid {POKEBLOCK}e saad, olen kuulnud.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
en: It's used for making a kind of candy called a {POKEBLOCK}.
et: Seda kasutatakse maiuse tegemiseks, mida kutsutakse {POKEBLOCK}iks.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
en: If you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON, its condition will improve by a lot.
et: Kui annad POKéMONile hea {POKEBLOCK}i, paraneb ta seisund palju.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
en: I heard there's a tower somewhere out on the sea routes.
et: Ma kuulsin, et kuskil mereteedel on torn.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
en: It's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.
et: Seda kutsutakse SKY PILLARiks, kuulsin.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
en: I saw this tall tower somewhere around ROUTE 131.
et: Ma nägin seda kõrget torni kuskil ROUTE 131 ümbruses.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
en: Could that possibly be…?
et: Kas see võiks olla…?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
en: We just arrived here on our honeymoon vacation.
et: Me just saabusime siia mesinädalate puhkusele.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
en: We happened to see a DRAGON-type POKéMON flying way up in the sky.
et: Me juhtusime nägema DRAAKON-tüüpi POKéMONi kõrgel taevas lendamas.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
en: Do cool POKéMON like that live in the HOENN region?
et: Kas selliseid lahedaid POKéMONe elab HOENNi piirkonnas?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
en: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as many rare POKéMON as we can.
et: Oma mesinädalatel tõotasime näha nii palju haruldasi POKéMONe kui suudame.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
en: So we were delighted to see a rare POKéMON as soon as we arrived.
et: Nii et olime rõõmsad, et nägime haruldast POKéMONi kohe pärast saabumist.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
en: I mean, we are totally happy!
et: Ma mõtlen, me oleme täiesti õnnelikud!

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
en: That determined expression… That limber way you move… And your well-trained POKéMON…
et: See otsusekindel ilme… See nõtke viis, kuidas sa liigud… Ja su hästi treenitud POKéMONid…

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
en: You're obviously a skilled TRAINER!
et: Sa oled ilmselgelt osav TRAINER!

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
en: No, wait, don't say a word. I can tell just by looking at you.
et: Ei, oota, ära ütle sõnagi. Ma näen seda juba sind vaadates.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
en: I'm sure that you can put this HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.
et: Ma olen kindel, et sa oskad seda PEIDETUD MASINAT hästi kasutada.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
en: No need to be modest or shy. Go on, take it!
et: Pole vaja tagasihoidlik ega häbelik olla. Mine, võta see!

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
en: That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for short, is CUT.
et: See PEIDETUD MASIN ehk lühidalt HM on CUT.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
en: An HM move is one that can be used by POKéMON outside of battle.
et: HM-võte on selline, mida POKéMONid saavad kasutada väljaspool lahingut.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
en: Any POKéMON that's learned CUT can chop down thin trees if the TRAINER has earned the STONE BADGE.
et: Iga POKéMON, kes on õppinud CUTi, saab peenikesi puid maha raiuda, kui TRAINER on teeninud STONE BADGE'i.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
en: And, unlike a TM, an HM can be used more than once.
et: Ja erinevalt TM-ist saab HM-i kasutada rohkem kui üks kord.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
en: When they were expanding the city of RUSTBORO, my dad helped out.
et: Kui nad RUSTBORO linna laiendasid, aitas mu isa kaasa.

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
en: He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear the land of trees.
et: Ta pani oma POKéMONi kasutama CUTi, et maa puudest puhtaks teha.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
en: There was someone here using a POKéMON I've never seen before.
et: Siin oli keegi, kes kasutas POKéMONi, keda ma pole kunagi näinud.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
en: I never learned about it at TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.
et: Vähemalt TRAINERI KOOLIS ma sellest ei õppinud.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
en: I wonder where you can catch POKéMON like that.
et: Huvitav, kust selliseid POKéMONe püüda saab.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
en: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA! I'd better get the right POKéMON from the PC Storage System.
et: Olgu! Järgmine peatus, BATTLE ARENA! Parem ma võtan õiged POKéMONid PC hoiusüsteemist.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
en: Giggle… I'm going to go through every challenge with just this baby!
et: Kihi… Ma lähen läbi iga väljakutse ainult selle beebiga!

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!
et: SKITTY: Mjaa mjaaah!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get important guarding assignments in the order that we line up.
et: Kui TEAM MAGMAL on nimekutsumine, saame tähtsad valveülesanded järjekorras, milles ritta seame.

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: That's why I'm stuck off in this corner. I'm always late to roll call!
et: Sellepärast olen ma siia nurka kinni jäänud. Ma jään alati nimekutsumisele hiljaks!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I'm always late for training sessions, too!
et: Ka mina jään treeningutele alati hiljaks!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…
et: Mul on vastumeelne seda öelda, aga ma olen nõrguke…

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Okay, I'll try to put a little more effort into things from now on…
et: Olgu, ma üritan nüüdsest asjadesse veidi rohkem pingutust panna…

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Our leader told us to dig into MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.
et: Meie juht käskis meil MT. CHIMNEY sisse kaevata, nii et me kaevasime ja kaevasime.

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: And in the course of digging, we came across something that blew our minds!
et: Ja kaevamise käigus komistasime millegi otsa, mis meid pahviks lõi!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: What did we find?
et: Mida me leidsime?

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Fuhahaha! I'll tell you if you beat me!
et: Fuhahaha! Ma ütlen sulle, kui sa mind võidad!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Arrgh! Taken down!
et: Ahh! Maha löödud!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: I won't tell you after all. You'll find out when you get there!
et: Ma ei ütle sulle ikkagi. Sa saad teada, kui kohale jõuad!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: It'd be better if you saved surprises to the end, don't you think?
et: Parem oleks üllatused lõppu hoida, kas sa ei arva?

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
en: All sorts of beings wander the slopes of MT. PYRE…
et: Igasugused olendid uitavad MT. PYRE nõlvadel…

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
en: There is no telling what may happen. Take this. It's for your own good.
et: Pole öelda, mis juhtuda võib. Võta see. See on su enda hüvanguks.

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
en: Have a POKéMON hold that CLEANSE TAG.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda CLEANSE TAGi.

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
en: It will help ward off wild POKéMON.
et: See aitab metsikuid POKéMONe eemal hoida.

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
en: Did you come to pay your respect to the spirits of departed POKéMON?
et: Kas tulid avaldama austust lahkunud POKéMONide vaimudele?

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
en: You must care for your POKéMON a lot.
et: Sa pead oma POKéMONidest väga hoolima.

label: MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon
en: This is the final resting place of my ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…
et: See on mu ZIGZAGOONi viimne puhkepaik. Ma pidasin temast lugu…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
en: People and POKéMON, they are but the same…
et: Inimesed ja POKéMONid — nad on samasugused…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
en: Their individual nature makes them good at certain things, and not good at others.
et: Nende individuaalne loomus teeb nad heaks teatud asjades ja mitte-nii-heaks teistes.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
en: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON do what it dislikes, try to let it do what it likes and is good at doing.
et: Selle asemel, et sundida POKéMONi tegema, mida ta ei salli, lase tal teha, mis talle meeldib ja mida ta oskab.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
en: Put yourself in the POKéMON's position and consider what moves it would like.
et: Aseta end POKéMONi asemele ja mõtle, milliseid võtteid ta sooviks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
en: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable thing…
et: POKéMONi loomus on tähelepanuväärne asi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
en: Some POKéMON behave in a completely different way when they are cornered.
et: Mõned POKéMONid käituvad täiesti teisiti, kui nad on nurka surutud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature
en: Are you beginning to understand how a POKéMON's nature makes it behave?
et: Kas hakkad mõistma, kuidas POKéMONi loomus paneb ta käituma?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons
en: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond between you and your POKéMON…
et: Ah… Ma näen tugevat südamlikku sidet sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel…

label: Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis
en: All my POKéMON does is ROAR… No one dares to come near me…
et: Kõik, mida mu POKéMON teeb, on RÕÕKIMINE… Keegi ei julge mulle ligineda…

label: Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis
en: Sigh… If you would, please take this TM away…
et: Ohh… Kui sa saaksid, palun vii see TM ära…

label: Route114_Text_ExplainRoar
en: TM05 contains ROAR. A ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.
et: TM05 sisaldab ROARi. RÕÕK saadab POKéMONid minema tormama.

label: Route114_Text_Poochyena
en: Bow! Bowwow!
et: Auh! Auhauh!

label: Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign
en: METEOR FALLS RUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE
et: METEOR FALLS RUSTBORO CITY SIIT LÄBI

label: Route114_Text_FossilManiacsHouseSign
en: FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE “Fossils gratefully accepted!”
et: FOSSIILIMAANIA MAJA „Fossiilid tänuga vastu võetud!”

label: Route114_Text_LanettesHouse
en: LANETTE'S HOUSE
et: LANETTE MAJA

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
