en: When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER.
et: Kui ma noor olin, rändasin maailmas kui POKéMON TRAINER.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
en: Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.
et: Nüüd, kui olen vanaks kaarnaks saanud, on mu ainus meelelahutus vaadata noori TRAINEReid võitlemas.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_DoorAppearsToBeLocked
en: The door appears to be locked.
et: Uks näib olevat lukus.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
en: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is visiting my home.
et: TRAINER nimega {STR_VAR_1} külastab mu kodu.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
en: Would you like to challenge {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas sooviksid {STR_VAR_1} välja kutsuda?

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
en: You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…
et: Sa ei võitle? Ma olen pettunud, et ei saa sind võitlemas näha…

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
en: Oh, good, good!
et: Oh, tubli, tubli!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
en: But my house isn't all that sturdy.
et: Aga mu maja pole eriti vastupidav.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
en: Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?
et: Kas võiksin paluda hoida see 3-vastu-3 matši piires?

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
en: Before you two battle, you should save your progress.
et: Enne kui te kaks võitlete, peaksite oma edenemise salvestama.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
en: I hope to see a good match!
et: Loodan näha head matši!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
en: The match ended up a draw.
et: Matš lõppes viigiga.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
en: So, it became a standoff.
et: Nii et sellest sai patiseis.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
en: It was a brilliant match in which neither side conceded a step!
et: See oli hiilgav matš, kus kumbki pool sammugi järele ei andnud!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
en: That was superlative!
et: See oli suurepärane!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
en: Why, it was like seeing myself in my youth again!
et: Ohoo, see oli nagu näeksin end taas nooruses!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
en: Ah, too bad for you!
et: Ah, kahju sinu jaoks!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
en: But it was a good match. I hope you can win next time.
et: Aga see oli hea matš. Loodan, et järgmine kord võidad.

label: Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass
en: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a wondrous thing!
et: Vahahahaa! Tänapäeva tehnoloogia on imepärane asi!

label: Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass
en: Take this volcanic ash here. It can be fashioned into glass.
et: Võta seda vulkaanilist tuhka siin. Sellest saab teha klaasi.

label: Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh
en: It's fun walking through the volcano's ashes on the ground and grass.
et: On lõbus kõndida läbi vulkaanituha maapinnal ja rohul.

label: Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh
en: You can see where you walked--it's really neat!
et: Sa näed, kus sa kõndisid – see on tõesti tore!

label: Route113_Text_RouteSign111
en: ROUTE 113 {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 111
et: ROUTE 113 {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 111

label: Route113_Text_RouteSignFallarbor
en: ROUTE 113 {LEFT_ARROW} FALLARBOR TOWN
et: ROUTE 113 {LEFT_ARROW} FALLARBOR TOWN

label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
en: You may register one of the KEY ITEMS in your BAG as SELECT.
et: Sa võid registreerida ühe oma KOTIS oleva VÕTMEESEME SELECTiks.

label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
en: Simply press SELECT to use the registered item conveniently.
et: Vajuta lihtsalt SELECTi, et registreeritud eset mugavalt kasutada.

label: Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign
en: GLASS WORKSHOP “Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”
et: KLAASITÖÖKODA „Vulkaanituhast klaasesemeteks”

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
en: It is a delight to see you here! You have reached the summit of the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: On rõõm sind siin näha! Sa oled jõudnud BATTLE PYRAMIDi tippu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
en: Above here is the PYRAMID's lookout point.
et: Siit ülalpool on PÜRAMIIDI vaateplatvorm.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
en: It is a place open only to those who have conquered the PYRAMID.
et: See on koht, mis on avatud vaid neile, kes on PÜRAMIIDI vallutanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
en: Now, please! Up you go!
et: Nüüd, palun! Üles sa lähed!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
en: The PYRAMID's new conqueror! Let the name {PLAYER} be known!
et: PÜRAMIIDI uus vallutaja! Saagu nimi {PLAYER} teatavaks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: It is a delight to see you here!
et: On rõõm sind siin näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: Unfortunately, you were second by a mere fraction of time!
et: Kahjuks olid sa teine vaid ajakillu võrra!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: Our chief has already conquered the PYRAMID ahead of you.
et: Meie pealik on juba sinust ees PÜRAMIIDI vallutanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: However, my young explorer… You are a TRAINER!
et: Kuid, mu noor maadeuurija… Sina oled TRAINER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: Assert your power and take the glory of the pinnacle from our chief!
et: Näita oma jõudu ja võta meie pealikult tipu hiilgus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
en: Now, please! When you are ready, take one more step of courage!
et: Nüüd, palun! Kui oled valmis, astu veel üks julge samm!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: Young adventurer…
et: Noor seikleja…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: Wouldn't you agree that explorations are the grandest of adventures?
et: Kas sa ei nõustuks, et uurimisretked on kõige suurejoonelisemad seiklused?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: Your own wits!
et: Sinu enda taip!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: Your own strength!
et: Sinu enda jõud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: Your own POKéMON!
et: Sinu enda POKéMONid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
en: And, above all, only your own courage to lead you through unknown worlds…
et: Ja eelkõige vaid sinu enda julgus, mis juhib sind läbi tundmatute maailmade…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand! Grand, it is! Eh?
et: Aah, jah, see elu on tõesti suurejooneline! Suurejooneline! Ää?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: I'm BRANDON!
et: Ma olen BRANDON!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: I'm the PYRAMID KING, which means I'm in charge here.
et: Ma olen PYRAMID KING, mis tähendab, et ma vastutan siin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: Most people call me the chief!
et: Enamik inimesi kutsub mind pealikuks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: You coming here means you have that much confidence in yourself, am I right?
et: See, et sa siia tulid, tähendab, et sul on nii palju enesekindlust, eks ole?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
en: Hahahah! This should be exciting!
et: Hahahaa! See tuleb põnev!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
en: Now, then! Bring your courage to our battle!
et: Nüüd siis! Too oma julgus meie lahingusse!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
en: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was! Grand, yes, indeed!
et: BRANDON: Hahahaa! Suurejooneline see oli! Suurejooneline, jah, tõesti!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
en: Well done! You've earned recognition! Your FRONTIER PASS, please!
et: Tublisti! Sa oled tunnustuse ära teeninud! Sinu FRONTIER PASS, palun!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
en: The Brave Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Brave-sümbol pressiti FRONTIER PASSile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
en: Young explorer! I look forward to our next meeting!
et: Noor maadeuurija! Ma ootan meie järgmist kohtumist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: BRANDON: …You've finally returned, young explorer…
et: BRANDON: …Sa lõpuks naasid, noor maadeuurija…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: Your love of adventure seems to come deep from within your heart…
et: Su seikluste armastus näib tulevat sügavalt su südamest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: Yes… You are exactly as I was in my own youth…
et: Jah… Sa oled täpselt selline, nagu mina omas nooruses olin…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: The passionate!
et: Kirglikud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: The dangerous!
et: Ohtlikud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: The desperate!
et: Meeleheitlikud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
en: Those days of death-defying, life-affirming adventures are back…
et: Need surma trotsivate, elu jaatavate seikluste päevad on tagasi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
en: Now, then!
et: Nüüd siis!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
en: I sense my own courage is off the meter!
et: Ma tunnen, et mu enda julgus on skaalast väljas!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
en: Everything you have! I'm braced for it all!
et: Kõik, mis sul on! Ma olen kõigeks valmis!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
en: BRANDON: Hahahah! Remarkable! Yes, it's grand, indeed!
et: BRANDON: Hahahaa! Tähelepanuväärne! Jah, see on tõesti suurejooneline!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
en: Young explorer!
et: Noor maadeuurija!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
en: You've bested me through and through! Here! I want you to have this!
et: Sa alistasid mind läbinisti! Siin! Ma tahan, et sa selle saaksid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Brave Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Brave-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
en: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that I have much to learn still!
et: Ah, jah! See näitabki, et mul on veel palju õppida!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
en: May our paths cross again! Farewell for now, young explorer!
et: Kohtugu meie teed taas! Hüvasti esialgu, noor maadeuurija!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
en: Now, when you are ready, take courage and step forward.
et: Nüüd, kui oled valmis, võta julgust kokku ja astu ette.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
en: An underwater volcano erupted and forced itself up from the depths.
et: Veealune vulkaan purskas ja surus end sügavustest üles.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
en: Its crater emerged from the sea and became filled with rainwater.
et: Selle kraater kerkis merest ja täitus vihmaveega.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
en: That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into being.
et: Nõnda tekkiski SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
en: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and the outside world…
et: Koobas, mis ühendab SOOTOPOLISE ja välismaailma…

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
en: It seems as if the cave was made to keep something from getting out.
et: Näib, nagu oleks koobas tehtud selleks, et midagi välja pääsemast hoida.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
en: Or am I just imagining things?
et: Või ma lihtsalt kujutan asju ette?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
en: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA?
et: Mis? Mis? Mida sa TEAM AQUALT tahad?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
en: Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to snatch something important!
et: Meie BOSSI pole siin! Ta läks midagi olulist napsama!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
en: … … Where did he go?
et: … … Kuhu ta läks?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
en: Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
et: Vahaha! Kas sa tõesti arvad, et ma räägiksin sulle midagi nii olulist?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
en: What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?
et: Mis? Mis? Kas sa oled TEAM MAGMA sell?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
en: I hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to awaken an awesome POKéMON at their HIDEOUT.
et: Ma kuulsin, et TEAM MAGMA üritab oma PEIDIKUS äratada vägevat POKéMONi.

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
en: But where might their HIDEOUT be?
et: Aga kus võiks nende PEIDIK olla?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
en: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA?
et: Mis? Mis? Mida sa TEAM AQUALT tahad?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
en: Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to jack a submarine!
et: Meie BOSSI pole siin! Ta läks allveelaeva röövima!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
en: … … Where did he go?
et: … … Kuhu ta läks?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
en: Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
et: Vahaha! Kas sa tõesti arvad, et ma räägiksin sulle midagi nii olulist?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
en: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA?
et: Mis? Mis? Mida sa TEAM AQUALT tahad?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
en: Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!
et: Meie BOSSI pole siin! Ta on teel MT. PYRE'sse ROUTE 122 peal!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
en: … … Why did he go?
et: … … Miks ta läks?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
en: Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
et: Vahaha! Kas sa tõesti arvad, et ma räägiksin sulle midagi nii olulist?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
en: What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?
et: Mis? Mis? Kas sa oled TEAM MAGMA sell?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
en: I hear that TEAM MAGMA is after an awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.
et: Ma kuulsin, et TEAM MAGMA jahib MT. CHIMNEY peal vägevat POKéMONi.

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
en: But what is that POKéMON like?
et: Aga milline see POKéMON on?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
en: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA?
et: Mis? Mis? Mida sa TEAM AQUALT tahad?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
en: Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!
et: Meie BOSSI pole siin! Ta on teel SLATEPORT CITYsse!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
en: … … Why did he go?
et: … … Miks ta läks?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
en: Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?
et: Vahaha! Kas sa tõesti arvad, et ma räägiksin sulle midagi nii olulist?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Ayiyiyi! Suspicious character spotted!
et: Ai-jai-jai! Kahtlane tegelane märgatud!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Grrrrr… I lost it!
et: Grrrrr… Ma kaotasin selle!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: I took the loss for the TEAM, but I did my job…
et: Ma võtsin kaotuse MEESKONNA eest, aga tegin oma töö…

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
en: That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…
et: See RUSTURF TUNNEL seal…

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
en: At first, we had a huge work crew boring through rock with the latest machinery. But, we had to stop.
et: Alguses oli meil suur töörühm uusima tehnikaga läbi kalju puurimas. Aga me pidime peatuma.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
en: It turns out that we would have had a negative effect on wild POKéMON in the area.
et: Selgus, et me oleksime avaldanud negatiivset mõju selle piirkonna metsikutele POKéMONidele.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
en: So, we've got nothing to do but loll around here doing nothing.
et: Nii et meil pole muud teha, kui siin ilmaasjata logeleda.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
en: There's a man digging his way to VERDANTURF all by his lonesome. He's desperate to get through.
et: On üks mees, kes kaevab omal jõul teed VERDANTURFI. Ta on meeleheitlikult tahtmas läbi jõuda.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
en: He says that if he digs little by little without using machines, he won't disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid harming the natural environment.
et: Ta ütleb, et kui ta kaevab pisitasa ilma masinateta, ei häiri ta POKéMONe ja väldib looduskeskkonna kahjustamist.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
en: I wonder if he made it through yet.
et: Huvitav, kas ta on juba läbi jõudnud.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVerdanturfWithoutTunnel
en: To get to VERDANTURF without using this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT, then travel through MAUVILLE.
et: Et VERDANTURFI jõuda seda TUNNELIT kasutamata, peaksid ületama mere DEWFORDI, purjetama edasi SLATEPORTI ja siis rändama läbi MAUVILLE.

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelHasGoneThrough
en: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF has gone through!
et: Kas kuulsid? TUNNEL VERDANTURFI on läbi jõudnud!

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelHasGoneThrough
en: Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough, dreams do come true.
et: Vahel, kui piisavalt tugevasti loodad, unistused tõesti täituvad.

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
en: I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC… I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…
et: Ma olen FOSSIILIMAANIK… Ma olen tore sell, kes armastab FOSSIILE…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
en: Do you want a FOSSIL?
et: Kas tahad FOSSIILI?

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
en: But the FOSSILS around these parts all belong to me… None for you…
et: Aga siinkandi FOSSIILID kuuluvad kõik mulle… Sulle ei midagi…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
en: If you can't bear to go without a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there are boulders and sand that may hide FOSSILS…
et: Kui sa ei suuda FOSSIILITA olla, vaata kõrbes, kus on rahnud ja liiv, mis võivad FOSSIILE peita…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
en: You found a FOSSIL, didn't you? That's so nice… It's so dreamy…
et: Sa leidsid FOSSIILI, kas pole? See on nii tore… See on nii unelmlik…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
en: What are you going to do with that FOSSIL?
et: Mida sa kavatsed selle FOSSIILIGA teha?

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
en: From what I've heard, DEVON is doing research on reviving POKéMON from FOSSILS…
et: Kuulu järgi teeb DEVON uurimistööd POKéMONide FOSSIILIDEST elustamise kohta…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
en: I love my FOSSILS, so I would never do anything like that…
et: Ma armastan oma FOSSIILE, nii et ma ei teeks kunagi midagi sellist…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_FossilsAreWonderful
en: FOSSILS are so… Wonderful… It's so dreamy…
et: FOSSIILID on nii… Imelised… See on nii unelmlik…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
en: Oh… It's not safe that way…
et: Oh… Nii ei ole ohutu…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
en: I was digging away, you see… When the whole wall collapsed…
et: Ma kaevasin, näed… Kui terve sein kokku varises…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
en: I think there's a giant cavern underneath now…
et: Ma arvan, et nüüd on selle all hiiglaslik koobas…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
en: But I've left it alone because I don't think there are any FOSSILS there…
et: Aga ma olen selle rahule jätnud, sest ma ei arva, et seal on mingeid FOSSIILE…

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
en: Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone? But you're so young! Good for you!
et: Oh, heldeke! Kas sa rändad üksi? Aga sa oled nii noor! Tubli sinust!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
en: I'm sure my kids could learn a thing or two from you!
et: Olen kindel, et mu lapsed võiksid sinult mõndagi õppida!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
en: Me? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Mina? Ma olen {POKEBLOCK}ide meister.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
en: If I get serious just a little, why, I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Kui ma vaid veidi tõsiseks lähen, ohoo, suudan ma valmistada suurepäraseid {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
en: Would you like to learn from me, a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?
et: Kas sooviksid õppida minult, {POKEBLOCK}ide meistrilt?

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
en: Oh? Are you sure?
et: Oh? Oled sa kindel?

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
en: You shouldn't always try to do everything by yourself, dear!
et: Sa ei peaks alati üritama kõike üksi teha, kallis!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: Oh, good! You're a smart soul! This is a bit long, so listen up!
et: Oh, tubli! Sa oled nutikas hing! See on veidi pikk, nii et kuula tähelepanelikult!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: Are you ready?
et: Kas oled valmis?

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: If you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see that they are rated on how they feel.
et: Kui vaatad {POKEBLOCK}e, peaksid nägema, et neid hinnatakse selle järgi, kuidas nad tunduvad.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: The lower the feel rating, the better it is. Don't forget this!
et: Mida madalam tundehinnang, seda parem see on. Ära seda unusta!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: A good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel rating and a high level.
et: Heal {POKEBLOCK}il on madal tundehinnang ja kõrge tase.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: A POKéMON can eat more good {POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.
et: POKéMON saab süüa rohkem häid {POKEBLOCK}e kui tavalisi.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: And this is important.
et: Ja see on oluline.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: If you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, use different kinds of BERRIES.
et: Kui tahad teha sujuvaid {POKEBLOCK}e, kasuta eri liiki BERRYsid.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: Don't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Ära ole ihnus — BERRYde liigid mõjutavad {POKEBLOCK}ide sujuvust.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: And another thing.
et: Ja veel üks asi.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: The more people blending BERRIES, the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Mida rohkem inimesi BERRYsid segab, seda sujuvamad {POKEBLOCK}id.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: That's why you should talk to other people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.
et: Sellepärast peaksid teiste inimestega rääkima ja koos {POKEBLOCK}e tegema.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: That's about all you need to know to make good {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: See on umbes kõik, mida sul on vaja teada, et teha häid {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: If everyone had POKéMON they love, smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family, the world would be a happier place.
et: Kui kõigil oleks POKéMONid, keda nad armastavad, sujuvad {POKEBLOCK}id ja armastav pere, oleks maailm õnnelikum paik.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
en: Don't give up, dear!
et: Ära anna alla, kallis!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
en: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets, you bet I was shocked.
et: Kui mu naine sünnitas neliku, siis mõistagi olin ma šokis.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
en: But, now, seeing them play together, it makes me happy.
et: Aga nüüd, nähes neid koos mängimas, teeb see mind õnnelikuks.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMultiBattles
en: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know I'm going to win.
et: Me peame MULTI-LAHINGUID, aga ma tean, et ma võidan.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
en: We like mixing stuff at the RECORD CORNER.
et: Meile meeldib RECORD CORNERis asju segada.

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
en: But what gets mixed up?
et: Aga mis segamini läheb?

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
en: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S with a BERRY BLENDER!
et: Me hakkame BERRY BLENDERiga super-{POKEBLOCK}e tegema!

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterContest
en: I want to brag about how tough my POKéMON is, so we're going to enter a CONTEST together.
et: Ma tahan kiidelda, kui sitke mu POKéMON on, nii et me astume koos VÕISTLUSELE.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
en: I'm the GAME DESIGNER.
et: Ma olen MÄNGUDISAINER.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
en: Oh, is that right? You're working on a POKéDEX?
et: Oh, on või? Sa tegeled POKéDEXiga?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
en: It's tough trying to complete it, but don't give up.
et: Selle täitmine on raske, aga ära anna alla.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
en: If you do complete it, please come show me.
et: Kui sa selle valmis saad, palun tule mulle näita.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
en: Wow! That's awesome! Yep, it's totally awesome!
et: Ohoo! See on vägev! Jah, see on täiesti vägev!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
en: This POKéDEX is completely filled! You really must love POKéMON!
et: See POKéDEX on täiesti täis! Sa pead tõesti POKéMONe armastama!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
en: I'm so impressed!
et: Ma olen nii muljet avaldatud!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
en: Let me give you something in recognition of your feat!
et: Lase mul anda sulle midagi su vägiteo tunnustuseks!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
en: Me? You're talking to me? I'm the PROGRAMMER.
et: Mina? Sa räägid minuga? Ma olen PROGRAMMEERIJA.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
en: I wonder what the SLOTS are like here.
et: Huvitav, millised SLOTID siin on.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
en: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the POKéMON of HOENN interesting?
et: Ma olen GRAAFILINE KUNSTNIK! Kas HOENNi POKéMONid pole huvitavad?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
en: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey? To battle against a cute TUBER…
et: Need tüdruk-TUBERID, nad on nunnud, hei? Nunnu TUBERI vastu võidelda…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
en: Whoop, it's so awesome!
et: Ohoo, see on nii vägev!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
en: And the TWINS! Aren't they cute? A 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…
et: Ja need KAKSIKUD! Kas pole nunnud? 2-vastu-2 lahing KAKSIKUTEGA…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
en: Whoop, it's unbearably fun!
et: Ohoo, see on talumatult lõbus!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBreezeTicklesHeart
en: The sea breeze tickles my heart. It feels wonderful here!
et: Meretuul kõditab mu südant. Siin on imeline tunne!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
en: You never know when and where people will challenge you.
et: Kunagi ei tea, millal ja kus sind välja kutsutakse.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
en: That's why I never leave home without my GAME BOY ADVANCE.
et: Sellepärast ei lahku ma kunagi kodust ilma oma GAME BOY ADVANCEita.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: SCOTT: … … … … … … … … … … Zzz…
et: SCOTT: … … … … … … … … … … Zzz…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: … … … … … Huh?! Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!
et: … … … … … Ää?! Oh, vabandust, vabandust! Ma tukkusin!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: I came to check out this POKéMON CONTEST thing.
et: Ma tulin seda POKéMON VÕISTLUSE asja uurima.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: I have to admit, it does look quite entertaining, but…
et: Ma pean tunnistama, et see näeb üsna lõbus välja, aga…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: Consider me a purist--I prefer battles and tough TRAINERS.
et: Pea mind puristiks — ma eelistan lahinguid ja sitkeid TRAINEReid.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: But that's just me.
et: Aga see olen lihtsalt mina.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT, the whole works!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, loodan, et naudid kõike, nagu SAALID, VÕISTLUSED, BATTLE TENT, kõike kokku!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
en: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy to win a CONTEST.
et: SCOTT: Ma arvan, et VÕISTLUSE võitmiseks on vaja strateegiat.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
en: Devising CONTEST strategies is one way of becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.
et: VÕISTLUSE strateegiate väljamõtlemine on üks viis paremaks TRAINERiks saada, ütleksin.

label: OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress
en: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my progress.
et: Ma tahan puhata, nii et ma salvestan oma edenemise.

label: OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart
en: Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART.
et: Tere! Ma töötan POKéMON MARTis.

label: OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart
en: Can I get you to come with me?
et: Kas saan su endaga kaasa võtta?

label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
en: This is a POKéMON MART. Just look for our blue roof.
et: See on POKéMON MART. Vaata lihtsalt meie sinist katust.

label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
en: We sell a variety of goods including POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
et: Me müüme mitmesugust kaupa, sealhulgas POKé BALLe POKéMONide püüdmiseks.

label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
en: Here, I'd like you to have this as a promotional item.
et: Siin, ma tahaksin, et saaksid selle reklaamesemena.

label: OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation
en: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER in certain situations.
et: POTIONit saab kasutada igal ajal, nii et see on teatud olukordades isegi kasulikum kui POKéMON CENTER.

label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
en: Aaaaah! Wait! Please don't come in here.
et: Aaaah! Oota! Palun ära tule siia sisse.

label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
en: I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON!
et: Ma avastasin just haruldase POKéMONi jäljed!

label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
en: Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?
et: Oota, kuni ma need visandi lõpetan, eks?

label: OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints
en: I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON!
et: Ma avastasin just haruldase POKéMONi jäljed!

label: OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints
en: Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?
et: Oota, kuni ma need visandi lõpetan, eks?

label: OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootprints
en: I finished sketching the footprints of a rare POKéMON.
et: Ma lõpetasin haruldase POKéMONi jälgede visandi.

label: OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootprints
en: But it turns out they were only my own footprints…
et: Aga selgus, et need olid ainult mu enda jäljed…

label: OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Over here! Let's hurry home!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Siiapoole! Kiirustame koju!

label: OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack
en: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's LAB now. {PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.
et: BRENDAN: Ma suundun nüüd tagasi oma isa LABORISSE. {PLAYER}, sina peaksid ka kähku tagasi kihutama.

label: OldaleTown_Text_TownSign
en: OLDALE TOWN “Where things start off scarce.”
et: OLDALE TOWN „Kus asjad algavad nappusega.”

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
en: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS who have collected all the GYM BADGES are permitted to enter.
et: Sellest punktist edasi tohivad siseneda vaid need TRAINERid, kes on kogunud kõik GYM BADGE'id.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
en: TRAINER, let us confirm that you have all the GYM BADGES.
et: TRAINER, kinnitame, et sul on kõik GYM BADGE'id.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
en: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.
et: Sa pole kõiki MÄRKE hankinud.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
en: If you're bound for the POKéMON LEAGUE, you must return with them.
et: Kui sa oled teel POKéMON LEAGUE'ile, pead nendega tagasi tulema.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
en: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your POKéMON, and go forth!
et: TRAINER! Usu endasse ja oma POKéMONidesse ning mine edasi!

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
en: This planet's biggest mysteries are at the bottom of the sea.
et: Selle planeedi suurimad saladused on mere põhjas.

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
en: Somebody said that, but I don't know…
et: Keegi ütles seda, aga ma ei tea…

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
en: There's a deep underwater trench between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.
et: MOSSDEEP ja SOOTOPOLISe vahel on sügav veealune süvend.

label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
en: That's what someone told me, anyway.
et: Nii mulle igatahes keegi ütles.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome
en: What, are you coming? Come and get some, then!
et: Mida, kas sa tuled? Tule ja saa siis kätte!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_Peeko
en: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!
et: PEEKO: Pii pihüoh!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
en: Grah, keelhaul it all!
et: Grah, mingu see kõik põhja!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
en: That hostage POKéMON turned out to be worthless!
et: See pantvang-POKéMON osutus väärtusetuks!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
en: And to think I made a getaway… In this tunnel to nowhere!
et: Ja mõelda, et ma põgenesin… Sellesse tühjaks jooksvasse tunnelisse!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
en: Hey! You! So you want to battle me?
et: Hei! Sina! Nii et sa tahad minuga võidelda?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat
en: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to a dead end!
et: Urrrggh! Mu kuritegelik karjäär jõuab ummikusse!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
en: This is plain not right…
et: See lihtsalt pole õige…

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
en: The BOSS told me this would be a slick-and-easy job to pull.
et: BOSS ütles mulle, et see on libe-ja-kerge töö.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
en: All I had to do was steal some package from DEVON.
et: Kõik, mida ma pidin tegema, oli varastada mingi pakk DEVONILT.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
en: Tch! You want it back that badly, take it!
et: Tsc! Kui sa nii väga tahad seda tagasi, võta!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe
en: PEEKO! Am I glad to see you're safe!
et: PEEKO! On mul hea meel näha, et sa oled turvaline!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: PEEKO owes her life to you!
et: PEEKO võlgneb oma elu sulle!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: They call me MR. BRINEY. And, you are?
et: Mind kutsutakse HR. BRINEYKS. Ja sina oled?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}! I sincerely thank you!
et: Ah, nii et sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ma tänan sind siiralt!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: Now, if there's anything that troubles you, don't hesitate to tell me!
et: Nüüd, kui sind midagi vaevab, ära kõhkle mulle öelda!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: You can usually find me in my cottage by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.
et: Tavaliselt leiad mind mu mereäärsest suvilast PETALBURG WOODSi lähedal.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: Come, PEEKO, we should make our way home.
et: Tule, PEEKO, me peaksime koju teele asuma.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
en: PEEKO: Pihyoh!
et: PEEKO: Pihüoh!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
en: Why can't they keep digging? Is the bedrock too hard?
et: Miks nad ei saa edasi kaevata? Kas aluspõhi on liiga kõva?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
en: My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF TOWN just beyond here…
et: Mu armsam ootab mind VERDANTURF TOWNIS siit veidi eemal…

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
en: If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were joined by this tunnel, I could visit her every day…
et: Kui RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURF oleksid selle tunneliga ühendatud, saaksin teda iga päev külastada…

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
en: But this… What am I to do?
et: Aga see… Mida ma tegema pean?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf
en: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF, you need to go to DEWFORD, then pass through SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…
et: Et RUSTBOROST VERDANTURFI jõuda, pead minema DEWFORDI, siis läbima SLATEPORTI ja MAUVILLE…

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
en: Wow! You shattered that boulder blocking the way.
et: Ohoo! Sa purustasid selle teed tõkestava rahnu.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
en: To show you how much I appreciate it, I'd like you to have this HM.
et: Et näidata, kui väga ma seda hindan, ma tahaksin, et sa saaksid selle HM-i.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
en: That HM contains STRENGTH.
et: See HM sisaldab STRENGTHi.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
en: If a muscular POKéMON were to learn that, it would be able to move even large boulders.
et: Kui lihaseline POKéMON selle õpiks, suudaks ta liigutada isegi suuri rahne.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
en: WANDA! Now I can see you anytime!
et: WANDA! Nüüd saan ma sind igal ajal näha!

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
en: WANDA: That's…wonderful.
et: WANDA: See on…imeline.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
en: Please, take some rest at my home.
et: Palun puhka veidi mu kodus.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
en: On the other side of this rock… My boyfriend is there.
et: Selle kivi teisel pool… Seal on mu poiss-sõber.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
en: He… He's not just digging the tunnel to come see me.
et: Ta… Ta ei kaeva tunnelit ainult selleks, et mind vaatama tulla.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
en: He works his hands raw and rough for the benefit of everyone.
et: Ta töötab oma käed tooreks ja kareks kõigi heaks.

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
en: What do you call a wild man up in the mountains? A mountain man, right?
et: Kuidas nimetatakse metsikut meest mägedes? Mägimees, eks?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
en: So why don't they call a POKéMON in the mountains a mountain POKéMON?
et: Nii miks siis ei nimetata POKéMONi mägedes mägi-POKéMONiks?

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat
en: My POKéMON… Ran out of power…
et: Mu POKéMONil… Sai jõud otsa…

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle
en: They halted development here to protect POKéMON, right? There's a feel-good story!
et: Nad peatasid siin arenduse, et POKéMONe kaitsta, eks? See on üks südantsoojendav lugu!

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
en: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.
et: Sa leidsid ROOT FOSSILi.

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
en: If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground around it will likely crumble away…
et: Kui see FOSSIIL võetakse, siis selle ümber olev maapind tõenäoliselt pudeneb ära…

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
en: Take the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?
et: Võtta ROOT FOSSIL ikkagi?

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeftRootFossilAlone
en: {PLAYER} left the ROOT FOSSIL alone.
et: {PLAYER} jättis ROOT FOSSILi rahule.

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
en: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.
et: Sa leidsid CLAW FOSSILi.

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
en: If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground around it will likely crumble away…
et: Kui see FOSSIIL võetakse, siis selle ümber olev maapind tõenäoliselt pudeneb ära…

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
en: Take the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?
et: Võtta CLAW FOSSIL ikkagi?

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeaveClawFossilAlone
en: {PLAYER} left the CLAW FOSSIL alone.
et: {PLAYER} jättis CLAW FOSSILi rahule.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the POKéMON FAN CLUB!
et: Ehem! Ma olen POKéMON FAN CLUBi ESIMEES!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally the most important!
et: ESIMEHENA olen ma loomulikult kõige tähtsam!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: No one can best me when it comes to raising POKéMON. No one!
et: Keegi ei suuda mind ületada, kui asi puudutab POKéMONide kasvatamist. Mitte keegi!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: Well, let me tell you about POKéMON CONTESTS.
et: Noh, las ma räägin sulle POKéMON KONKURSSIDEST.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: They're events where one can show off POKéMON for the world to see!
et: Need on üritused, kus saab oma POKéMONe kogu maailmale näidata!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: However, they're held in far-off towns, so I cannot participate often enough.
et: Ent neid peetakse kaugetes linnades, nii et ma ei saa piisavalt tihti osaleda.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
en: That is why we gather here to show off our POKéMON, and have others show us theirs.
et: Just seepärast me kogunemegi siia, et oma POKéMONe näidata ja lasta teistel meile enda omi näidata.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeToSeeEnteredContestPokemon
en: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has entered a POKéMON CONTEST… That, I would like to see.
et: TRAINERI POKéMON, kes on osalenud POKéMON KONKURSIL… Seda ma tahaksin näha.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: Er-hem! I see you've participated in a POKéMON CONTEST!
et: Ehem! Ma näen, et oled osalenud POKéMON KONKURSIL!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: Please! Allow me to examine how you have raised your POKéMON.
et: Palun! Luba mul uurida, kuidas oled oma POKéMONi kasvatanud.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: It delights me no end to see POKéMON raised by other TRAINERS.
et: Mind rõõmustab lõputult näha teiste TRAINERITE kasvatatud POKéMONe.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: The happy expressions of POKéMON raised with proper care…
et: Korralikult hoolitsetud POKéMONide õnnelikud ilmed…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: The kindly eyes of the TRAINER that nurtured and raised the POKéMON…
et: Selle TRAINERI lahked silmad, kes POKéMONi hellitas ja kasvatas…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: The very thought fills my heart to overwhelming with joy.
et: Juba ainuüksi see mõte täidab mu südame rõõmuga üleni.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: Oh! I do beg your pardon! Forgive me for prattling on so!
et: Oh! Ma palun väga vabandust! Andesta mulle, et ma nõnda lobisen!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
en: Please! Allow me to examine how much your POKéMON has grown!
et: Palun! Luba mul uurida, kui palju su POKéMON on kasvanud!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsYourPokemonGrowing
en: How is your POKéMON growing? Allow me to examine it.
et: Kuidas su POKéMON kasvab? Luba mul teda uurida.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HmHmISee
en: Hm, hm… I see…
et: Hm, hm… Ma näen…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
en: Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not good, either…
et: Hmmm… See pole halb, aga see pole ka hea…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
en: You, the TRAINER, must put more effort into raising this POKéMON!
et: Sina, TRAINER, pead selle POKéMONi kasvatamisse rohkem vaeva panema!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
en: For instance, may I suggest that you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?
et: Näiteks, kas tohin soovitada, et annaksid talle rohkem {POKEBLOCK}e?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
en: Oh, my…
et: Oh, heldeke…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
en: Your POKéMON is growing quite well, so you deserve a reward.
et: Su POKéMON kasvab päris hästi, nii et sa väärid tasu.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
en: Unfortunately, you have no space for this in your BAG.
et: Kahjuks pole sul selle jaoks KOTIS ruumi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
en: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in a most impressive manner! It is one fine specimen!
et: Su {STR_VAR_1}, ta kasvab kõige muljetavaldavamal moel! Ta on üks vahva isend!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
en: But! If you were to give it this, it would grow even better! Indeed!
et: Aga! Kui sa annaksid talle selle, kasvaks ta veelgi paremini! Tõesti!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
en: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda RED SCARFi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
en: Everyone will recognize the coolness of that POKéMON!
et: Kõik tunnevad ära, kui lahe see POKéMON on!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
en: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda BLUE SCARFi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
en: Its beauty will be accentuated much more than now!
et: Selle ilu rõhutatakse palju rohkem kui praegu!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
en: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda PINK SCARFi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
en: It will draw out the cuteness of the POKéMON some more!
et: See toob POKéMONi armsuse veelgi rohkem esile!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
en: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda GREEN SCARFi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
en: That will enhance the smartness of POKéMON!
et: See võimendab POKéMONi nutikust!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
en: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.
et: Lase POKéMONil hoida seda YELLOW SCARFi.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
en: It will bolster your POKéMON's toughness so much more!
et: See tugevdab su POKéMONi vastupidavust palju rohkem!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
en: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to give you! None at all!
et: Vabandust, aga mul pole sulle midagi muud anda! Mitte midagi!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
en: After all, you're blessed with the gift of raising POKéMON without resorting to any items!
et: Lõppude lõpuks oled sa õnnistatud andega kasvatada POKéMONe ilma ühtki eset kasutamata!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
en: I love seeing POKéMON that love their TRAINERS.
et: Mulle meeldib näha POKéMONe, kes armastavad oma TRAINEREID.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
en: POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS.
et: POKéMONid on väga tundlikud oma TRAINERITE tunnete suhtes.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
en: If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back.
et: Kui kohtled oma POKéMONe armastuse ja hoolega, armastavad nad sind vastu.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
en: When your POKéMON grow to love you, please come show me.
et: Kui su POKéMONid on sind armastama õppinud, palun tule mulle näita.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
en: Your POKéMON really adores you.
et: Su POKéMON tõesti jumaldab sind.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
en: For you, a most compassionate TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!
et: Sinule, kõige kaastundlikumale TRAINERILE, kink FAN CLUBILT!

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
en: POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS.
et: POKéMONid on väga tundlikud oma TRAINERITE tunnete suhtes.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
en: If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back.
et: Kui kohtled oma POKéMONe armastuse ja hoolega, armastavad nad sind vastu.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
en: If you keep letting a POKéMON faint in battle, it'll come to resent it.
et: Kui lased POKéMONil aina lahingus minestada, hakkab ta seda pahaks panema.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
en: Soon, it will become less trusting of the TRAINER.
et: Peagi muutub ta TRAINERI vastu vähem usaldavaks.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
en: In other words, it certainly won't like you very much.
et: Teisisõnu, sa ei meeldi talle kindlasti eriti.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
en: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used on them?
et: Kas POKéMONidele meeldib, kui nende peal esemeid kasutatakse?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
en: Mine acted really happy when I gave it some PROTEIN.
et: Minu oma käitus tõesti õnnelikult, kui ma talle veidi PROTEINi andsin.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…
et: SKITTY: Fffnjaaah…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Zigzagoon
en: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…
et: ZIGZAGOON: Küüü…

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Marimari?
et: AZUMARILL: Marimari?

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrike
en: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's SPEED in battle.
et: Kasuta X SPEEDi, et lisada POKéMONi KIIRUST lahingus.

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrike
en: That will help it get in the first strike--a decided advantage!
et: See aitab tal saada esimese löögi — kindel eelis!

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOnMtChimney
en: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local specialty that you can buy only there.
et: MT. CHIMNEY tipus on kohalik hõrgutis, mida saad osta vaid seal.

label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOnMtChimney
en: Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.
et: Anna see POKéMONile — ta on vaimustuses.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
en: Oh, it's so hard every day…
et: Oh, iga päev on nii raske…

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
en: What's hard? You need to ask?
et: Mis on raske? Sa pead küsima?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
en: It's trying to figure out what to make for meals every day.
et: See on igal päeval välja mõelda, mida süüa teha.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
en: It really isn't easy coming up with meals every day.
et: Igal päeval söögikordadega välja tulla pole tõesti kerge.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: Oh, hello! Welcome to the PEPPER household.
et: Oh, tere! Tere tulemast PEPPERITE perekonda.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: I have a question for you. Have you ever baby-sat?
et: Mul on sulle üks küsimus. Kas oled kunagi last hoidnud?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: You see, I'm a new father, so raising a child is all new to me.
et: Näed, ma olen värske isa, nii et lapse kasvatamine on mulle täiesti uus.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: And I have a problem. My daughter WALDA doesn't laugh enough.
et: Ja mul on üks mure. Mu tütar WALDA ei naera piisavalt.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: I think she'd laugh for me if I told her something funny.
et: Ma arvan, et ta naeraks mulle, kui ütleksin talle midagi naljakat.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
en: Do you know of a funny word or phrase you can tell me?
et: Kas tead mõnda naljakat sõna või fraasi, mille saad mulle öelda?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
en: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}” to amuse her lately.
et: Ma olen viimasel ajal öelnud „{STR_VAR_1}”, et teda lõbustada.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
en: Do you know of a better word or a phrase that might work?
et: Kas tead paremat sõna või fraasi, mis võiks toimida?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
en: Oh, that's wonderful. So, let's hear it, your suggestion.
et: Oh, see on imeline. Nii et lase kuulda, su ettepanek.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
en: Oh, is that right?
et: Oh, on või?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
en: Well, if you come up with a good suggestion, I'm all ears.
et: Noh, kui tuled hea ettepanekuga, olen üleni kõrv.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
en: Ah, I see. Well, let's give it a try, shall we?
et: Ah, ma näen. Noh, proovime seda, kas pole?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
en: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
en: Oh, yes! She's laughing! Oh, I am as delighted as she!
et: Oh, jah! Ta naerab! Oh, ma olen sama rõõmus kui tema!

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
en: Ah, I see. Well, let's give it a try, shall we?
et: Ah, ma näen. Noh, proovime seda, kas pole?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
en: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
en: Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. Maybe WALDA is one serious child…
et: Hmmm… Ta ei naerata üldse. Ehk on WALDA üks tõsine laps…

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
en: Oh, so you don't know any good words. I'd better think for myself, then.
et: Oh, nii et sa ei tea ühtki head sõna. Siis ma parem mõtlen ise.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
en: Hmm… How about “{STR_VAR_1}”? Let's see if that will work.
et: Hmm… Kuidas oleks „{STR_VAR_1}”? Vaatame, kas see toimib.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
en: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {STR_VAR_1}. {STR_VAR_1}.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
en: Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. Maybe WALDA is one serious child…
et: Hmmm… Ta ei naerata üldse. Ehk on WALDA üks tõsine laps…

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
en: Oh, so you don't know any good words. I guess I'll try to amuse her with the saying I used before.
et: Oh, nii et sa ei tea ühtki head sõna. Ma vist proovin teda lõbustada ütlusega, mida enne kasutasin.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
en: Anyways, if you have a good suggestion, don't hesitate in telling me, okay?
et: Igatahes, kui sul on hea ettepanek, ära kõhkle mulle öelda, eks?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: Thank you!
et: Aitäh!

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: Thanks to you, my darling WALDA laughed for me!
et: Tänu sinule naeris mu kallis WALDA mulle!

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: Actually, I may not look all that special, but I'm one of DEVON CORPORATION's top researchers.
et: Tegelikult ei pruugi ma nii eriline välja näha, aga ma olen üks DEVON CORPORATIONI tippteadlasi.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: So, how about I do something in return for you?
et: Nii et kuidas oleks, kui teeksin sinu heaks midagi vastu?

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: I know, I'll add some new wallpaper patterns for the BOXES in the PC POKéMON Storage System.
et: Ma tean, ma lisan PC POKéMONide Hoiusüsteemi KASTIDELE mõned uued tapeedimustrid.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: In the wallpaper pattern menu, select “FRIENDS.”
et: Tapeedimustrite menüüs vali „SÕBRAD.”

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
en: That will give you access to the new wallpaper patterns.
et: See annab sulle ligipääsu uutele tapeedimustritele.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
en: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!
et: See on POKéMONi plüüsist NUKK!

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
en: Hello! You're our first guest in a good while.
et: Tere! Sa oled meie esimene külaline pikaks ajaks.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
en: You've brightened up my day, so I'll give you a big WAILMER DOLL.
et: Sa oled mu päeva rõõmsamaks teinud, nii et ma annan sulle suure WAILMER NUKU.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
en: Take good care of it!
et: Hoolitse selle eest hästi!

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
en: Oh, you want it, but not right now? Okay, then I'll hold it for you.
et: Oh, sa tahad seda, aga mitte praegu? Olgu, siis ma hoian selle sulle alles.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
en: Are you sure? You don't want this DOLL?
et: Kas oled kindel? Sa ei taha seda NUKKU?

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
en: I love plush DOLLS!
et: Ma armastan plüüsist NUKKE!

label: Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing
en: Hey, man, is our leader really going to awaken that thing?
et: Hei, sõber, kas meie juht tõesti kavatseb selle asja äratada?

label: Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite
en: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard we need a METEORITE to do it.
et: Kõlab nii, jah. Aga ma kuulsin, et me vajame selleks METEORIITI.

label: Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallarbor
en: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest of the crew went out to FALLARBOR.
et: Oh, nüüd ma saan aru. Just seepärast läks ülejäänud kamp FALLARBORISSE.

label: Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilTheyreBack
en: You got it. And until they come back, we're not to let anyone pass, right.
et: Selge. Ja kuni nad tagasi tulevad, ei tohi me kellelgi mööda lasta, jah.

label: Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridge
en: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if I went down these ledges, it'd be no easy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.
et: Öö, ma tahaksin MAUVILLE jõuda, aga kui ma neist astangutest alla läheksin, poleks kerge LAVARIDGE'i tagasi saada.

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign
en: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR “A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”
et: MT. CHIMNEY KÖISRAUDTEE „Lühike jalutuskäik {UP_ARROW} teed pidi!”

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
en: MT. CHIMNEY
et: MT. CHIMNEY

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
en: “For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit, please take the CABLE CAR.”
et: „LAVARIDGE TOWNI või tippu, palun võtke KÖISRAUDTEE.”

label: Route112_Text_RouteSignLavaridge
en: ROUTE 112 {LEFT_ARROW} LAVARIDGE TOWN
et: ROUTE 112 {LEFT_ARROW} LAVARIDGE TOWN

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty
en: Memories of my darling SKITTY… My eyes overflow thinking about it.
et: Mälestused mu kallist SKITTYST… Mu silmad valguvad üle, kui sellele mõtlen.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
en: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the ground here and there.
et: Ohh, ai… Siin on maapinnas siin-seal auke.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
en: I didn't notice and took a tumble from the floor above.
et: Ma ei märganud ja kukkusin ülemiselt korruselt alla.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro
en: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON? You came along after me! You're rude!
et: Hei! Kas sa otsid POKéMONe? Sa tulid mulle järele! Sa oled ebaviisakas!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat
en: Ayieeeeh! I'm sorry, forgive me, please!
et: Aiiih! Vabandust, andesta mulle, palun!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle
en: People don't come here often, so I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.
et: Inimesed ei käi siin tihti, nii et ma mõtlesin, et siin on haruldasi POKéMONe.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
en: LUKE: We're here on a dare.
et: LUKE: Me oleme siin kihlveo peale.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
en: Heheh, if I show her how cool I am, she'll fall for me. I know it!
et: Hehee, kui ma näitan talle, kui lahe ma olen, ta armub minusse. Ma tean seda!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
en: I know! I'll cream you and show her how cool I am!
et: Ma tean! Ma teen su kabjaks ja näitan talle, kui lahe ma olen!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeDefeat
en: LUKE: Whoopsie!
et: LUKE: Uupsakauu!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle
en: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay! I'm right here by your side. We'll make it through this dare!
et: LUKE: Noh, me kaotasime, aga see on okei! Ma olen siinsamas su kõrval. Me tuleme sellest kihlveost läbi!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
en: LUKE: If you want to take me on, bring some more POKéMON.
et: LUKE: Kui tahad minuga jõudu katsuda, too rohkem POKéMONe.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
en: If you don't, I won't be able to show off to my girl how cool I am!
et: Kui sa seda ei tee, ei saa ma oma tüdrukule uhkustada, kui lahe ma olen!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
en: DEZ: I came here on a dare with my boyfriend.
et: DEZ: Ma tulin siia kihlveo peale oma poiss-sõbraga.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
en: It's really scary, but I'm with my boyfriend. It's okay.
et: See on tõesti hirmus, aga ma olen oma poiss-sõbraga. Kõik on korras.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
en: I know! I'll get my boyfriend to look cool by beating you!
et: Ma tean! Ma panen oma poiss-sõbra lahedalt paistma, alistades sind!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezDefeat
en: DEZ: Waaaah! I'm scared!
et: DEZ: Vaaah! Ma kardan!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle
en: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't care if we lose!
et: DEZ: Me oleme armunud, nii et meil pole vahet, kui kaotame!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
en: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you should bring at least two POKéMON.
et: DEZ: Kui tahad meile väljakutse esitada, peaksid tooma vähemalt kaks POKéMONi.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
en: My boyfriend's strong. Just one POKéMON won't do at all.
et: Mu poiss-sõber on tugev. Ainult üks POKéMON ei sobi üldse.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro
en: You are an unfamiliar sight… Depart before anything befalls you!
et: Sa oled võõras vaatepilt… Lahku, enne kui sinuga midagi juhtub!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahDefeat
en: Hmm… You're durable.
et: Hmm… Sa oled vastupidav.

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
en: Our family has been TRAINERS here since my great-grandmother's time…
et: Meie pere on siin olnud TRAINERID juba mu vanavanaema ajast…

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
en: It is my duty to protect this mountain…
et: Minu kohus on seda mäge kaitsta…

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderIntro
en: Kiyaaaaah! I'm terrified!
et: Kijaaah! Ma olen hirmul!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderDefeat
en: Nooooooo! I lost my wits!
et: Eiiii! Ma kaotasin mõistuse!

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
en: I get freaked out every time I see anything move…
et: Ma satun paanikasse iga kord, kui näen midagi liikumas…

label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
en: I shouldn't have come here to train…
et: Ma poleks pidanud siia treenima tulema…

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
en: The feeling of being watched faded…
et: Jälgimise tunne hajus…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going?
et: Jou, kuidas läheb?

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Listen, my friend! Would you like to become the CHAMPION?
et: Kuula, mu sõber! Kas sooviksid saada MEISTRIKS?

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: I'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can sure give you winning advice.
et: Ma pole TRAINER, mina mitte, aga ma suudan sulle küll võiduni viivat nõu anda.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: That's settled, then! We'll aim for the POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!
et: Siis on asi otsustatud! Me sihime koos POKéMON MEISTRIVÕISTLUST!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: It's your job as a TRAINER to collect GYM BADGES, am I right?
et: See on su töö TRAINERina koguda SAALI MÄRKE, kas pole nii?

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: But GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!
et: Aga SAALI JUHID pole mingid lonused!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And that's where I come in! I'm here to provide expert advice!
et: Ja siin astun minagi mängu! Ma olen siin, et anda ekspertnõu!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user of ROCK-type POKéMON.
et: ROXANNE, SAALI JUHT, kasutab KIVI-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The ROCK type is very durable, but it can't stand WATER-type and GRASS-type moves.
et: KIVI-tüüp on väga vastupidav, aga see ei talu VEE-tüüpi ja ROHU-tüüpi võtteid.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Come see me afterwards, if you beat the GYM LEADER.
et: Tule pärast mind vaatama, kui SAALI JUHI võidad.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Well, go for it!
et: Noh, anna minna!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoa! What a breathtaking victory! My cheering must've worked!
et: Ohoo! Milline hingematv võit! Mu kaasaelamine pidi mõjuma!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Great! Check your TRAINER CARD.
et: Suurepärane! Kontrolli oma TRAINER CARDi.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: The STONE BADGE you got should be properly recorded on it.
et: STONE BADGE, mille said, peaks olema sellel korralikult kirjas.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: In other words…
et: Teisisõnu…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: You've climbed the first step on the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!
et: Sa oled astunud esimese sammu MEISTRIVÕISTLUSE trepil!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: That's got to feel awesome!
et: See peab olema äge tunne!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
en: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly! I'll show you why we're better!
et: Ära võta meid, SAALI TRAINEREID, kergelt! Ma näitan sulle, miks me paremad oleme!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
en: You were too good for me…
et: Sa olid mulle liiga hea…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
en: You haven't seen anything of the ROCK type's terrifying power!
et: Sa pole näinud midagi KIVI-tüübi hirmuäratavast jõust!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
en: If you can't beat me, you won't stand a chance against ROXANNE!
et: Kui sa mind võita ei suuda, pole sul ROXANNE vastu mingit šanssi!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
en: Wow! You've got some potential!
et: Ohoo! Sul on potentsiaali!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
en: ROXANNE is stronger than me by several times.
et: ROXANNE on minust mitu korda tugevam.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
en: You'd better be on your guard!
et: Sa parem ole valvel!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
en: We might be in the middle of town, but so what?
et: Me võime olla keset linna, aga mis siis?

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
en: My ROCK POKéMON need room to rampage!
et: Mu KIVI-POKéMONidele on vaja ruumi märatsemiseks!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
en: Oh, man oh man! Our challenger is one feisty customer!
et: Oh, sõber oh sõber! Meie väljakutsuja on üks tuline klient!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
en: I have to hand it to our LEADER.
et: Ma pean meie JUHILE au andma.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
en: It took smarts and sense for her to pick the ROCK type at her young age.
et: Tal oli tarkust ja arukust valida KIVI-tüüp oma noores eas.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
en: Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO POKéMON GYM LEADER.
et: Tere, ma olen ROXANNE, RUSTBORO POKéMON GYMi JUHT.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
en: I became a GYM LEADER so that I might apply what I learned at the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.
et: Ma sain SAALI JUHIKS, et saaksin lahingus rakendada seda, mida POKéMON TRAINERI KOOLIS õppisin.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
en: Would you kindly demonstrate how you battle, and with which POKéMON?
et: Kas näitaksid lahkelt, kuidas sa võitled ja milliste POKéMONidega?

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
en: So… I lost…
et: Nii et… Ma kaotasin…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
en: It seems that I still have much more to learn…
et: Näib, et mul on veel palju õppida…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
en: I understand.
et: Ma saan aru.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state that TRAINERS are to be given this if they defeat a GYM LEADER.
et: POKéMON LEAGUE'i reeglid ütlevad, et TRAINERITELE tuleb see anda, kui nad SAALI JUHI alistavad.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
en: Please accept the official POKéMON LEAGUE STONE BADGE.
et: Palun võta vastu ametlik POKéMON LEAGUE STONE BADGE.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE from ROXANNE.
et: {PLAYER} sai ROXANNELT STONE BADGE'i.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK power of your POKéMON.
et: STONE BADGE tõstab su POKéMONide RÜNNAKU jõudu.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: It also enables them to use the HM move CUT outside of battle.
et: See võimaldab neil ka kasutada HM-võtet CUT väljaspool lahingut.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: Please take this with you, too.
et: Palun võta ka see endaga kaasa.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
en: That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39, contains ROCK TOMB.
et: See TEHNILINE MASIN, TM39, sisaldab ROCK TOMBi.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
en: It not only inflicts damage by dropping rocks, it also lowers SPEED.
et: See mitte üksnes ei tee kahju, pillates kive, vaid alandab ka KIIRUST.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
en: If you use a TM, it instantly teaches the move to a POKéMON.
et: Kui kasutad TM-i, õpetab see võtte POKéMONile silmapilkselt.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
en: Remember, a TM can be used only once, so think before you use it.
et: Pea meeles, TM-i saab kasutada ainult üks kord, nii et mõtle, enne kui seda kasutad.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
en: Since you are so strong, you should challenge other GYM LEADERS.
et: Kuna sa oled nii tugev, peaksid esitama väljakutse teistele SAALI JUHTIDELE.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
en: ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}? This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.
et: ROXANNE: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}? See on ROXANNE RUSTBORO CITYST.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall

et: Ma kuulsin BRAWLYLT, et sa liigud TRAINERITE ridades üles uskumatu hooga.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
en: Well, I'd rather not think that I can't beat you.
et: Noh, ma pigem ei tahaks mõelda, et ma ei suuda sind võita.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
en: I promise, I will shape up my GYM so that you may challenge us again.
et: Ma luban, ma panen oma SAALI vormi, et saaksid meile taas väljakutse esitada.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall

et: Ma loodan, et sa ootad seda hetke sama väga kui mina!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne

et: SAALI JUHT ROXANNE registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
en: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.
et: ROXANNE: Ma olen nii rõõmus sind taas nähes. Ma olen ROXANNE, siinne SAALI JUHT.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
en: I'm sure we've both experienced many battles since we last met.
et: Ma olen kindel, et me mõlemad oleme kogenud palju lahinguid, kuna viimati kohtusime.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
en: I would like to see how much better we've become. Let us battle!
et: Ma tahaksin näha, kui palju paremaks oleme saanud. Võidelgem!

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
en: Grr… Again, I have lost…
et: Grr… Jälle olen ma kaotanud…

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
en: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn when it comes to battling POKéMON.
et: ROXANNE: Mul on veel palju õppida, kui asi puudutab POKéMONidega võitlemist.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch

et: See teadmine paneb mind võitlemist veelgi rohkem armastama!

en: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.
et: ROXANNE: Ma olen nii rõõmus sind taas nähes. Ma olen ROXANNE, siinne SAALI JUHT.

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: I'm the no. 1 star of the BATTLE DOME! I, TUCKER the DOME ACE, will bathe you in my brilliant glow!
et: Ma olen BATTLE DOME'i number 1 täht! Mina, TUCKER, DOME ACE, suplen sind oma hiilgavas säras!

en: TUCKER: Ah… The pummeling roar of the crowd… Their furnace-like heat of excitement… This is a wonderful place…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed
