et: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
en: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE “Forbidden to the faint of heart.”
et: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE „Keelatud nõrganärvilistele.”

label: Route123_Text_BerryMastersHouse
en: BERRY MASTER'S HOUSE
et: BERRY MASTERI MAJA

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
en: Is it your first time here? Please step this way!
et: Kas oled esimest korda siin? Palun astu siiapoole!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: The front lines of POKéMON battling! Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: POKéMON-lahingute eesliin! Tere tulemast BATTLE FRONTIERisse!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: For a first-time visitor, we issue the FRONTIER PASS.
et: Esmakordsele külastajale väljastame FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: It's for use at all the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Seda kasutatakse kõigis BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatistes.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: Here you are!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
en: {PLAYER} obtained the FRONTIER PASS.
et: {PLAYER} sai FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
en: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD in the FRONTIER PASS.
et: {PLAYER} asetas TRAINER CARDi FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
en: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE FRONTIER has to offer!
et: Loodame, et naudid kõike, mida BATTLE FRONTIER pakkuda oskab!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
en: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! You came out here!
et: ???: Ohoo, kas pole mitte {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa tulid siia välja!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
en: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir! Good day to you, sir!
et: TEEJUHT: Oh! MR. SCOTT, härra! Tere päevast teile, härra!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: SCOTT: It's great to see you here, it really is!
et: SCOTT: On suurepärane sind siin näha, tõesti on!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: I hope you'll take your time and explore everywhere.
et: Loodan, et võtad aega ja uurid kõikjal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: Naturally, I hope you'll also experience the pure essence of battling.
et: Loomulikult loodan, et kogeksid ka võitlemise puhast olemust.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: I also have my quarters here, so feel free to visit if you have time.
et: Mul on ka siin oma korter, nii et külasta julgelt, kui aega on.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
en: I'm your guide to the various facilities here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht BATTLE FRONTIERi eri rajatiste juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
en: Which would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid õppida?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
en: It is the gigantic tower considered to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.
et: See on hiiglaslik torn, mida peetakse BATTLE FRONTIERi sümboliks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
en: There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI, and LINK MULTI BATTLES.
et: Tornis on neli liiki BATTLE ROOMe ÜKSIK-, TOPELT-, MULTI- ja LINK MULTI-LAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: The BATTLE DOME is the large building shaped like a huge egg.
et: BATTLE DOME on suur hoone, mis on kujult nagu hiiglaslik muna.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: Events named Battle Tourneys are held in this facility.
et: Selles rajatises peetakse üritusi nimega lahinguturniirid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: The Battle Tourneys are offered in two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Lahinguturniire pakutakse kahes rajas — ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
en: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE PALACE on punane hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi paremal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
en: There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: On kaks liiki BATTLE SAALE ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
en: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like building at the center-right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE ARENA on dojo-laadne hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi kesk-paremal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
en: An event called the Set KO Tourney takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.
et: BATTLE ARENAS toimub üritus nimega Set KO turniir.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: The BATTLE FACTORY is the large building that is the closest to us.
et: BATTLE FACTORY on suur hoone, mis on meile kõige lähemal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: An event called the Battle Swap is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Swap.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: The Battle Swap event is offered in two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Battle Swap üritust pakutakse kahes rajas ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
en: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped like a POKéMON at the center-left of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE PIKE on POKéMONi-kujuline hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi kesk-vasakul.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
en: An event called the Battle Choice is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Choice.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
en: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous pyramid.
et: BATTLE PYRAMID on see tohutu püramiid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
en: An event called the Battle Quest is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Quest.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
en: The RANKING HALL is located near the BATTLE TOWER.
et: RANKING HALL asub BATTLE TOWERi lähedal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
en: There, you may see the most fantastic records left by the TRAINERS that took on the many challenges of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Seal võid näha kõige fantastilisemaid rekordeid, mille jätsid TRAINERid, kes võtsid BATTLE FRONTIERi paljusid väljakutseid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
en: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near the BATTLE TOWER.
et: EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER on BATTLE TOWERi lähedal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
en: The Battle Points you have earned in the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged for fabulous prizes there.
et: Battle Pointe, mille oled BATTLE FRONTIERis teeninud, saab seal vapustavate auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
en: I'm your guide to the basic rules that are common to all the challenges offered by the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht põhireeglite juurde, mis on ühised kõigile BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatiste väljakutsetele.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
en: What would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid õppida?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
en: All the challenges at the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities come in two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.
et: Kõiki BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatiste väljakutseid pakutakse kahes rajas — Tase 50 ja Avatud tase.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON up to and including Level 50.
et: Tase 50 rada on avatud POKéMONidele kuni tasemeni 50 (kaasa arvatud).

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: Please keep in mind, however, that no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 50.
et: Pane siiski tähele, et ühelgi TRAINERil, kellega kohtud, pole POKéMONe alla taseme 50.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: This course is the entry level for battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: See rada on BATTLE FRONTIERi lahingute sisenemistase.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: To begin, we hope you will challenge this course.
et: Alustuseks loodame, et võtad selle raja väljakutse.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: The Open Level course places no limit on the levels of POKéMON entering challenges.
et: Avatud taseme rada ei sea väljakutsele astuvate POKéMONide tasemele piiri.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: The levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON.
et: Su vastaste tasemed kohandatakse su POKéMONide tasemetega.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 60.
et: Ühelgi TRAINERil, kellega kohtud, pole aga POKéMONe alla taseme 60.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take on the challenges at all facilities.
et: Praktiliselt iga POKéMON võib kõigi rajatiste väljakutseid võtta.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON, however, are not permitted.
et: MUNAD ja teatud liiki POKéMONid pole aga lubatud.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: The numbers of POKéMON required for challenges will depend on the facility.
et: Väljakutseteks vajalik POKéMONide arv oleneb rajatisest.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: At all facilities, however, two or more of the same kind of POKéMON are not permitted.
et: Kõigis rajatistes pole aga kahte või enamat sama liiki POKéMONi lubatud.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
en: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not be holding the same kind of item.
et: BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatise väljakutsele astudes ei tohi POKéMONid hoida ühesugust eset.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
en: Please make sure that all POKéMON entering a challenge are holding different items.
et: Palun veendu, et kõik väljakutsele astuvad POKéMONid hoiavad erinevaid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
en: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.
et: Ma olen sinu teejuht FRONTIER PASSi juurde.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
en: Which would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid õppida?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: There are seven facilities at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE FRONTIERis on seitse rajatist.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: TRAINERS who gain recognition for their abilities may be rewarded with symbols from each of the facilities.
et: TRAINEReid, kes pälvivad oma võimete eest tunnustust, võidakse premeerida sümbolitega igast rajatisest.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need to defeat other TRAINERS in a row, and may need to win events repeatedly.
et: Sümboli teenimiseks võib TRAINERitel olla vaja alistada teisi TRAINEReid järjest ja võib olla vaja üritusi korduvalt võita.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: It's certainly not easy to win symbols. I wish you the best of luck!
et: Sümboleid pole kindlasti kerge võita. Soovin sulle parimat õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: It is possible to record one battle on your FRONTIER PASS.
et: FRONTIER PASSile on võimalik salvestada üks lahing.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: You may record a battle you had with a friend or friends.
et: Võid salvestada lahingu, mille pidasid sõbra või sõpradega.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: Or you may record a battle conducted at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding matches at the BATTLE PIKE or the BATTLE PYRAMID.
et: Või võid salvestada BATTLE FRONTIERis peetud lahingu, välja arvatud BATTLE PIKE või BATTLE PYRAMIDi matšid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: You may choose to record your match at the end of a battle.
et: Võid valida oma matši salvestamise lahingu lõpus.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
en: Battle Points are rewards given to TRAINERS who battled outstandingly at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Battle Pointid on tasud, mida antakse TRAINERitele, kes BATTLE FRONTIERis silmapaistvalt võitlesid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
en: You may trade in your Battle Points for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER.
et: Võid oma Battle Pointid EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNERis auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse
en: HUNTER'S HOUSE
et: KÜTI MAJA

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DirectYouToBattleRoom
en: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.
et: Ma juhatan sind nüüd su BATTLE ROOMi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: Excuse me!
et: Vabandust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: You didn't save before you quit your challenge last time.
et: Sa ei salvestanud enne, kui eelmine kord oma väljakutsest loobusid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: Because of that, your challenge so far has been disqualified. Sorry!
et: Selle tõttu on su senine väljakutse diskvalifitseeritud. Vabandust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsBeatenSeven
en: Congratulations! You've beaten all seven TRAINERS!
et: Palju õnne! Sa alistasid kõik seitse TRAINERit!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_EarnedFabulousPrize
en: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row, you have earned this fabulous prize!
et: Seitsme TRAINERi järjest alistamise eest oled teeninud selle vapustava auhinna!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom
en: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.
et: Oh, su KOTT näib olevat täis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom
en: Please make room in your BAG, then come see me.
et: Palun tee KOTIS ruumi, siis tule mind vaatama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing!
et: Aitäh mängimast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved
en: Your record will be saved. Please wait.
et: Su rekord salvestatakse. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
en: We've been waiting for you!
et: Me oleme sind oodanud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved
en: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your progress will be saved. Please wait.
et: Enne BATTLE ROOMi sisenemist salvestatakse su edenemine. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
en: You're finally about to face the 50th TRAINER.
et: Sa oled lõpuks 50. TRAINERile vastu astumas.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
en: From here on, every time you beat seven TRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will receive a commemorative RIBBON.
et: Siit alates saab su POKéMON iga kord, kui alistad seitse TRAINERit järjest, mälestusliku RIBBONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
en: Good luck!
et: Edu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons
en: Here are some RIBBONS for beating seven tough TRAINERS in a row.
et: Siin on mõned RIBBONid seitsme sitke TRAINERi järjest alistamise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons
en: {PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!
et: {PLAYER} sai mõned RIBBONid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons
en: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on the challenger POKéMON.
et: {PLAYER} pani RIBBONid väljakutsuja POKéMONidele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
en: Excuse me, do you have a moment?
et: Vabandust, kas sul on hetk?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
en: Can you describe your feelings when you're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER match, or when you've either won or lost a match?
et: Kas oskad kirjeldada oma tundeid, kui hakkad BATTLE TOWERi matši alustama või kui oled matši võitnud või kaotanud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin
en: Okay, what are your feelings when you're about to begin a match?
et: Olgu, mida sa tunned, kui hakkad matši alustama?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon
en: What do you feel when you've won a match?
et: Mida sa tunned, kui oled matši võitnud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost
en: Can I hear about your feelings when you have lost a match?
et: Kas võin kuulda su tunnetest, kui oled matši kaotanud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt
en: Oh, so you don't think much about it? You're one cool customer.
et: Oh, nii et sa ei mõtle sellest palju? Sa oled üks jahe klient.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind
en: Hunh? You changed your mind? I guess you're fickle.
et: Ää? Sa mõtlesid ümber? Vist oled tujukas.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
en: Okay, so that's how you feel? That's quite original.
et: Olgu, nii et niimoodi sa tunned? See on üsna omanäoline.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
en: Thanks!
et: Aitäh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
en: The number of matches you win in a row is recorded.
et: Järjest võidetud matšide arv salvestatakse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
en: I'd better not get beaten in an embarrassing way!
et: Parem ma ei saa piinlikul moel lüüa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
en: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER, you can't leave until you either lose or you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.
et: Kui oled BATTLE TOWERisse sisenenud, ei saa sa lahkuda enne, kui kas kaotad või alistad seitse TRAINERit järjest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
en: You'd best be certain that you're up to the challenge.
et: Parem veendu, et oled väljakutseks valmis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction
en: Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER DOUBLE BATTLE CORNER!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE TOWERi TOPELTLAHINGU NURKA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction
en: Unfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS are still under construction.
et: Kahjuks on BATTLE ROOMid veel ehitamisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction
en: Please come back when the work is completed.
et: Palun tule tagasi, kui töö on valmis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction
en: Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER MULTI BATTLE CORNER!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE TOWERi MULTI-LAHINGU NURKA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction
en: Unfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS are still under construction.
et: Kahjuks on BATTLE ROOMid veel ehitamisel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction
en: Please come back when the work is completed.
et: Palun tule tagasi, kui töö on valmis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookForwardToAnotherChallenge
en: We look forward to seeing you on another challenge!
et: Ootame sind mõnel teisel väljakutsel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The BATTLE ROOM offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?
et: BATTLE ROOM pakub kahte raskusastet, Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumb on sinu valik?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectMons
en: Please select the POKéMON you wish to enter.
et: Palun vali POKéMONid, keda soovid üles panna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeEntering
en: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your progress must be saved. Is that okay?
et: Enne BATTLE ROOMi sisenemist tuleb su edenemine salvestada. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleRoom
en: I will now show you to the {STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOM.
et: Ma juhatan sind nüüd {STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOMi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas salvestada su viimane BATTLE TOWERi matš FRONTIER PASSile?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Excuse me!
et: Vabandust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.
et: Sul pole {STR_VAR_2} sobivat POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON of Level 50 or less to enter.
et: Sisenemiseks pead sul olema {STR_VAR_2} erinevat POKéMONi tasemel 50 või madalamal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must be holding different kinds of items.
et: Samuti peavad nad hoidma erinevaid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Please come see me when you are ready.
et: Palun tule mind vaatama, kui oled valmis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Excuse me!
et: Vabandust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
