label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where four types of battles are waged-SINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI BATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.
et: BATTLE TOWER on rajatis, kus peetakse nelja tüüpi lahinguid — ÜKSIKLAHING, TOPELTLAHING, MULTI-LAHING ja LINK MULTI-LAHING.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: For each of these types, there are separate BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Iga sellise tüübi jaoks on eraldi BATTLE ROOMid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: Please speak with a guide offering the type of battle you wish to enter.
et: Palun räägi teejuhiga, kes pakub seda tüüpi lahingut, millesse soovid siseneda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are entering, you will be required to take a certain number of POKéMON.
et: Olenevalt sellest, millisesse BATTLE ROOMi sisened, nõutakse sinult teatud arvu POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The SINGLE BATTLE mode requires three POKéMON.
et: ÜKSIKLAHINGU režiim nõuab kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four, and the MULTI modes both require two.
et: TOPELTLAHINGU režiim nõuab nelja ja mõlemad MULTI-režiimid nõuavad kahte.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: The BATTLE SALON is where you must find a partner to form a tag team for the MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.
et: BATTLE SALONIS pead leidma partneri, et moodustada paarismeeskond MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI väljakutseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: Choose the best partner for you by examining other TRAINERS' POKéMON and their moves.
et: Vali endale parim partner, uurides teiste TRAINERite POKéMONe ja nende võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: You may choose a new tag partner after winning seven straight matches.
et: Võid valida uue paarispartneri pärast seitset järjestikust võitu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two friends to mount a challenge together.
et: LINK MULTI-LAHINGU režiim on kahele sõbrale koos väljakutse esitamiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You and your friend must be linked with Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link cable.
et: Sina ja su sõber peate olema ühendatud juhtmevabade adapterite või GBA Game Link kaabli abil.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You must choose two POKéMON at the registration counter.
et: Pead registreerimislaua juures valima kaks POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: These POKéMON must be different from those of your friend.
et: Need POKéMONid peavad erinema su sõbra omadest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You may not interrupt this challenge in the middle, unlike other modes.
et: Sa ei tohi seda väljakutset keskel katkestada, erinevalt teistest režiimidest.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: Hm, so they doubled the guests by using POKéMON as attractions?
et: Hm, nii et nad kahekordistasid külaliste arvu, kasutades POKéMONe atraktsioonidena?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute POKéMON our inn's mascot.
et: Hm, noh, võib-olla peaksin tegema nunnu POKéMONi meie võõrastemaja maskotiks.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: I wonder if that will attract more guests to stay with us?
et: Huvitav, kas see meelitab rohkem külalisi meie juurde jääma?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV!
et: Oh, vabandust, vabandust! Ma olin liiga sisse võetud telekavaatamisest!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
en: Since that TEAM AQUA came to town, the tourists have been staying away.
et: Kuna see TEAM AQUA linna tuli, on turistid eemale jäänud.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
en: Hey, down in front! I can't see the TV!
et: Hei, seal ees! Ma ei näe telekat!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON found someone's lost item?
et: Hämmastav! Sa ütled mulle, et POKéMON leidis kellegi kadunud eseme?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: That's something. If we had some smart POKéMON like that…
et: See on midagi. Kui meil oleks mõni nutikas POKéMON nagu see…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: We could recover anything that our guests mislaid…
et: Me suudaksime tagasi saada kõik, mille meie külalised valesse kohta panid…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV!
et: Oh, vabandust, vabandust! Ma olin liiga sisse võetud telekavaatamisest!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: I heard that someone busted the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.
et: Ma kuulsin, et keegi lõi TEAM AQUA PEIDIKU laiaks.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: Thanks to that, we just booked a reservation from a big group.
et: Tänu sellele broneerisime just suure seltskonna reservatsiooni.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: It was a company called… Uh… GAME something…
et: See oli ettevõte nimega… Äh… GAME midagi…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON caught a burglar?
et: Hämmastav! Maja valvav POKéMON püüdis sissemurdja?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: That's something. If we had a tough POKéMON as a security guard…
et: See on midagi. Kui meil oleks sitke POKéMON turvamehena…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: We would be able to provide our guests with greater safety.
et: Me suudaksime pakkuda oma külalistele suuremat turvalisust.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV.
et: Oh, vabandust, vabandust! Ma olin liiga sisse võetud telekavaatamisest.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Oh, yes. A big group of guests arrived a little while ago.
et: Oh, jah. Suur seltskond külalisi saabus veidi aega tagasi.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: They booked in as GAME FREAK, so I guess they must make games.
et: Nad broneerisid nimega GAME FREAK, nii et vist teevad nad mänge.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Uh-oh, I'd better get working on their dinner!
et: Oih, parem ma asun nende õhtusöögi kallale!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
en: DAN: While searching for treasures, we discovered a TRAINER!
et: DAN: Aardeid otsides avastasime TRAINERi!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
en: DAN: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
et: DAN: Me ei suutnud võita isegi koos töötades…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
en: DAN: We can't find any treasures… I wonder if someone got them already?
et: DAN: Me ei leia ühtki aaret… Huvitav, kas keegi sai need juba kätte?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
en: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
et: DAN: Sul pole isegi kahte POKéMONi. Sa ei saa loota meid niimoodi võita.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
en: KIRA: Oh? We were searching for treasures. But we discovered a TRAINER instead!
et: KIRA: Oh? Me otsisime aardeid. Aga leidsime selle asemel TRAINERi!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
en: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!
et: KIRA: Ohoo, nii tugev!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
en: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?
et: KIRA: Kus need aarded küll võiksid olla?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
en: I've already decided what I'm buying when we find the treasures!
et: Ma juba otsustasin, mida ostan, kui me aarded leiame!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
en: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
et: KIRA: Oh, sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Peame mõni teine kord võitlema!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
en: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry! I'm going to register you for that!
et: KIRA: Oh, sa ajad mu nii vihaseks! Ma registreerin sind selle eest!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
en: DAN: We've been searching for treasures all this time.
et: DAN: Me oleme kogu selle aja aardeid otsinud.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
en: Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. Let us show you, okay?
et: Ka meie POKéMONid on tugevamaks saanud. Lase meil sulle näidata, olgu?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
en: DAN: You're strong, as usual!
et: DAN: Sa oled tugev, nagu ikka!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
en: DAN: We can't find any treasures, we lose at POKéMON…
et: DAN: Me ei leia aardeid, kaotame POKéMONides…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
en: I want to go home… But if I say that, she gets all angry with me…
et: Ma tahan koju… Aga kui ma seda ütlen, läheb ta minu peale pahaseks…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
en: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
et: DAN: Sul pole isegi kahte POKéMONi. Sa ei saa loota meid niimoodi võita.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!
et: KIRA: Oh? Me kohtume taas!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: Just like us, you still haven't given up searching for treasures, have you?
et: Nagu meiegi, pole sa aardeotsingut veel maha jätnud, ega ju?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: Want to make it so the loser has to give up searching?
et: Tahad panna nii, et kaotaja peab otsingu maha jätma?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
en: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…
et: KIRA: Oh, kaotasime jälle…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
en: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise our POKéMON some more and we find the treasures here!
et: KIRA: Me ei lahku enne, kui oleme oma POKéMONe veel kasvatanud ja siit aarded leidnud!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
en: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
et: KIRA: Oh, sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Peame mõni teine kord võitlema!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
en: I'm not good at swimming, but I am good at battles!
et: Ma pole ujumises hea, aga lahingutes olen!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
en: Oops. That didn't go very well.
et: Uups. See ei läinud eriti hästi.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
en: Walking around barefoot in this ship is kind of gross.
et: Selles laevas paljajalu ringi kõndimine on kuidagi jälk.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
en: Strength and compassion… Those are a TRAINER's treasures!
et: Jõud ja kaastunne… Need on TRAINERi aarded!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
en: Ah, there is something about you that sparkles.
et: Ah, sinus on midagi, mis sätendab.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
en: In a cabin somewhere on board, I saw something sparkle.
et: Ühes kajutis kuskil pardal nägin ma midagi sätendamas.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut
en: The clerk says they're all sold out. I can't buy any POKé BALLS.
et: Müüja ütleb, et need on kõik välja müüdud. Ma ei saa ühtki POKé BALLi osta.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBalls
en: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS and catch a bunch of POKéMON!
et: Ma kavatsen osta hunniku POKé BALLe ja püüda hunniku POKéMONe!

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
en: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP and faints, it won't be able to battle.
et: Kui POKéMON saab viga ja kaotab oma HP ja minestab, ei saa ta võidelda.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
en: To prevent your POKéMON from fainting, restore its HP with a POTION.
et: Et takistada oma POKéMONi minestamast, taasta selle HP POTIONiga.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UseBasementKey
en: Use the BASEMENT KEY?
et: Kasutada KELDRIVÕTIT?

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
en: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas KELDRIVÕTIT.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
en: The door opened!
et: Uks avanes!

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one at the left of the list goes out first.
et: Kui POKéMON-lahing algab, läheb esimesena välja see, kes on nimekirjas vasakul.

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: So, when you get more POKéMON in your party, try switching around the order of your POKéMON.
et: Nii et kui saad oma seltskonda rohkem POKéMONe, proovi oma POKéMONide järjekorda muuta.

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: It could give you an advantage.
et: See võiks anda sulle eelise.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
en: Every POKéMON has a special ability that it can use.
et: Igal POKéMONil on eriline võime, mida ta saab kasutada.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
en: POKéMON are such strange creatures.
et: POKéMONid on nii veidrad olendid.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
en: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time, and it gets the job done.
et: SUPER REPEL kestab kaua ja teeb töö ära.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
en: It's much better than an ordinary REPEL.
et: See on palju parem kui tavaline REPEL.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
en: I always stock up on more items than I'm sure I'll need.
et: Ma varun alati rohkem esemeid, kui olen kindel, et vajan.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
en: You never know what might happen. Better to be safe than sorry!
et: Kunagi ei tea, mis võib juhtuda. Parem karta kui kahetseda!

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
en: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow immediately by one level.
et: RARE CANDY paneb POKéMONi kohe ühe taseme võrra kasvama.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
en: That PC-based POKéMON Storage System…
et: See PC-põhine POKéMONide Hoiusüsteem…

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
en: Whoever made it must be some kind of a scientific wizard!
et: Kes iganes selle tegi, peab olema mingisugune teadusnõid!

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
en: When my POKéMON ate an ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!
et: Kui mu POKéMON sõi ORAN BERRY, taastas ta HP-d!

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: There are many types of POKéMON.
et: POKéMONe on palju eri tüüpe.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: All types have their strengths and weaknesses against other types.
et: Kõigil tüüpidel on oma tugevused ja nõrkused teiste tüüpide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: Depending on the types of POKéMON, a battle could be easy or hard.
et: Sõltuvalt POKéMONide tüüpidest võib lahing olla kerge või raske.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: For example, your TREECKO is a GRASS type.
et: Näiteks su TREECKO on ROHU-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: It's strong against the WATER and GROUND types.
et: Ta on tugev VEE- ja MAA-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: But, it's weak against FIRE-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk TULE-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: For example, your TORCHIC is a FIRE type.
et: Näiteks su TORCHIC on TULE-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: It's strong against the GRASS and BUG types.
et: Ta on tugev ROHU- ja PUTUKA-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: But, it's weak against WATER-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk VEE-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: For example, your MUDKIP is a WATER type.
et: Näiteks su MUDKIP on VEE-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: It's strong against the FIRE type.
et: Ta on tugev TULE-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: But, it's weak against GRASS-type and ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk ROHU-tüüpi ja ELEKTRI-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short distance after the VICTORY ROAD.
et: POKéMON LEAGUE on vaid lühikese vahemaa kaugusel pärast VICTORY ROADI.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
en: If you've come this far, what choice do you have but to keep going?
et: Kui oled nii kaugele jõudnud, mis valik sul muud on kui edasi minna?

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…
et: Pikk ja piinarikas VICTORY ROAD…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: It's like reliving the path one has traveled in life…
et: See on nagu uuesti läbi elada tee, mille inimene on elus käinud…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: Believe in your POKéMON and give it your very best!
et: Usu oma POKéMONi ja anna sellele oma parim!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!
et: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa küünitasid end üles POKéMON LEAGUE'ile vastu astuma!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: I'm happy for you! You made my cheering worthwhile!
et: Ma olen su üle rõõmus! Sa tegid mu ergutamise seda väärt!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kui sinust saaks POKéMON LEAGUE'i MEISTER…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: I'll get in touch with you then.
et: Ma võtan sinuga siis ühendust.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Go for greatness!
et: Olgu, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Püüdle suuruse poole!

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
en: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect rare stones.
et: DEVONI PRESIDENDILE meeldib haruldasi kive koguda.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
en: I think the PRESIDENT's son also collects rare stones.
et: Ma arvan, et PRESIDENDI poeg kogub samuti haruldasi kive.

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
en: Huh? What? What's that?
et: Ää? Mis? Mis see on?

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
en: I'm not near awake yet… You can have this…
et: Ma pole veel ligilähedaltki ärkvel… Sa võid selle saada…

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
en: Yawn…
et: Haigutus…

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
en: Sleep is essential for good health… Sleep and regain health…
et: Uni on hea tervise jaoks hädavajalik… Maga ja taasta tervis…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: Got here already, did you? We underestimated you!
et: Jõudsid juba siia, mis? Me alahindasime sind!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: But this is it!
et: Aga siin ta on!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: I'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen so far.
et: Ma olen astme võrra parem SELLIDEST, keda sa siiani näinud oled.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: I'm not stalling for time. I'm going to pulverize you!
et: Ma ei viivita. Ma teen su pihuks ja põrmuks!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
en: Hehehe… So, I lost, too…
et: Hehehe… Nii et minagi kaotasin…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
en: While I was toying with you, our BOSS got through his preparations!
et: Kuni ma sinuga mängisin, sai meie BOSS oma ettevalmistused tehtud!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: Our BOSS has already gone on his way to some cave under the sea!
et: Meie BOSS on juba teel mingisse mere all olevasse koopasse!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: If you're going to give chase, you'd better search the big, wide sea beyond LILYCOVE.
et: Kui sa kavatsed järele minna, otsi parem läbi suur avar meri LILYCOVE'ist eemal.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: But will you find it then? Hehehe!
et: Aga kas sa siis leiad? Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting! You owe me a battle, too!
et: Vahahaa, mind tüütas ootamine! Sa võlgned mullegi lahingu!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Tired of waiting… Lost and dazed…
et: Ootamisest väsinud… Kaotanud ja uimane…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: BOSS… Is this good enough?
et: BOSS… Kas sellest piisab?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride and joy!
et: Teleportpaneelid, PEIDIKU uhkus ja rõõm!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: You're clueless about where you are, aren't you?
et: Sul pole aimugi, kus sa oled, ega ju?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: Fluster and tire out the enemy, then lower the boom! That's our plan!
et: Aja vaenlane segadusse ja väsita ära, siis vajuta nupule! Selline on meie plaan!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
en: What's wrong with you? You're not tired at all!
et: Mis sul viga on? Sa pole üldse väsinud!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: That reminds me… I can't remember where I put the MASTER BALL.
et: See tuletab meelde… Ma ei mäleta, kuhu ma MASTER BALLi panin.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: If I fail to guard it, our BOSS will chew me out…
et: Kui ma seda ei valva, saan BOSSILT sõimu…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first thing I had to learn was how these warp panels connected.
et: Kui ma TEAM AQUAGA liitusin, oli esimene asi, mida pidin õppima, kuidas need teleportpaneelid ühenduvad.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
en: I was too occupied thinking about the warp panels…
et: Ma olin liiga hõivatud teleportpaneelide peale mõtlemisega…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
en: I'll have to learn about how I can battle more effectively…
et: Ma pean õppima, kuidas tõhusamalt võidelda…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner
en: This is MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.
et: See on MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
en: Okay, you wanted some COINS for the games?
et: Olgu, sa tahtsid mängude jaoks MÜNTE?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
en: But you don't have a COIN CASE for stowing the COINS.
et: Aga sul pole COIN CASE'i MÜNTIDE hoidmiseks.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
en: Were you looking for COINS?
et: Kas otsisid MÜNTE?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
en: It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS. Would you like some?
et: See on ¥1000 50 MÜNDI eest. Kas sooviksid?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
en: Thank you very much! Here are your COINS!
et: Suur tänu! Siin on su MÜNDID!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
en: Um… You don't appear to have enough money…
et: Öö… Sul ei näi olevat piisavalt raha…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
en: Oh? Your COIN CASE is full.
et: Oh? Su COIN CASE on täis.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
en: Oh… You don't need COINS, then? Good luck on your adventure!
et: Oh… Sa ei vaja siis MÜNTE? Edu su seiklusel!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
en: Welcome.
et: Tere tulemast.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
en: You can exchange your COINS for prizes here.
et: Siin saad oma MÜNDID auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
en: Which prize would you like?
et: Millist auhinda sooviksid?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsTheTMX
en: So your choice is the {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?
et: Nii et su valik on {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
en: Thank you! We'll send it to your PC at home.
et: Aitäh! Me saadame selle su koju PC-sse.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
en: You don't have enough COINS.
et: Sul pole piisavalt MÜNTE.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPlacingDecor
en: There isn't any room available for placing {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Pole vaba ruumi {STR_VAR_1} asetamiseks.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: Oh, is that so? You need to save some COINS before coming back here.
et: Oh, on või? Sa pead veidi MÜNTE koguma, enne kui siia tagasi tuled.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
en: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Nii et su valik on {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo
en: Here you go!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAnyMore
en: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.
et: Oh, sa ei saa rohkem kaasas kanda.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
en: I made a mistake and got two of the same DOLLS.
et: Ma eksisin ja sain kaks sama NUKKU.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
en: Would you like one of them?
et: Kas sooviksid üht neist?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
en: Here you go!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItButNotNow
en: Huh? You want it, but not right now?
et: Ää? Sa tahad seda, aga mitte praegu?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
en: Oh, don't be so negative! You can have this!
et: Oh, ära ole nii negatiivne! Sa võid selle saada!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
en: There's a prize I want, but I can't win the jackpot.
et: On auhind, mida ma tahan, aga ma ei suuda peavõitu võita.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
en: Hey, kid, if you want to play here, you need a COIN CASE.
et: Hei, laps, kui tahad siin mängida, vajad COIN CASE'i.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
en: I think the young lady next door had one. Go see her!
et: Ma arvan, et naabertüdrukul oli üks. Mine vaata teda!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
en: My luck can only last so long. This is too much for me. Here, take some COINS!
et: Mu õnn saab kaua kesta. See on mulle liig. Siin, võta veidi MÜNTE!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
en: MAUVILLE has something for everyone.
et: MAUVILLES on midagi igaühele.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
en: For me, it's the GAME CORNER.
et: Minu jaoks on see GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
en: The ROULETTE tables have different rates.
et: ROULETTE'i laudadel on erinevad määrad.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
en: Check your COINS if you're going to pick a table.
et: Kontrolli oma MÜNTE, kui hakkad lauda valima.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
en: It's easy to lose track of time in here. I should get back to work.
et: Siin on kerge aja arvet kaotada. Ma peaksin töö juurde tagasi minema.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNeededToPlay
en: COINS are needed to play here in the GAME CORNER.
et: MÜNTE on vaja, et siin GAME CORNERis mängida.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
en: This ROULETTE thing… It's rather demanding.
et: See ROULETTE asi… See on üsna nõudlik.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
en: Win or lose, it's only by luck.
et: Võit või kaotus, see on ainult õnne asi.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsCanBeUsed
en: Up to three COINS can be used to play the SLOTS.
et: SLOTIDE mängimiseks saab kasutada kuni kolme MÜNTI.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
en: It's very difficult to make it stop right on “7.”
et: On väga raske panna see peatuma just „7” peal.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
en: If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.
et: Kui see peatub „7” peal REEL TIME boonusmängus, saad lisamünte.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: Here's some information for you about the SLOTS.
et: Siin on sulle veidi teavet SLOTIDE kohta.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: The more lightning bolts you stock, the more REEL TIME chances you get.
et: Mida rohkem välgunooli varud, seda rohkem REEL TIME võimalusi saad.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: In a game with the maximum five REEL TIME chances…
et: Mängus, kus on maksimaalselt viis REEL TIME võimalust…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: It is possible to receive four regular bonuses, then a big bonus.
et: On võimalik saada neli tavalist boonust ja siis suur boonus.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: That would total 660 COINS, but it's very difficult to get.
et: See teeks kokku 660 MÜNTI, aga seda on väga raske saada.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWithNoCoinCase
en: You can't play if you don't have a COIN CASE.
et: Sa ei saa mängida, kui sul pole COIN CASE'i.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
en: Let me see your POKéMON. I'll check to see how much it likes you.
et: Lase mul su POKéMONi näha. Ma kontrollin, kui palju sa talle meeldid.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
en: Oh. Your POKéMON…
et: Oh. Su POKéMON…

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
en: It adores you. It can't possibly love you any more. I even feel happy seeing it.
et: Ta jumaldab sind. Ta ei saakski sind rohkem armastada. Mul on lausa hea meel teda näha.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
en: It seems to be very happy. It obviously likes you a whole lot.
et: Näib, et ta on väga õnnelik. Talle ilmselgelt meeldid sa väga.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
en: It likes you quite a lot. It seems to want to be babied a little.
et: Sa meeldid talle päris palju. Näib, et ta tahab, et teda veidi hellitataks.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
en: It's getting used to you. It seems to believe in you.
et: Ta harjub sinuga. Näib, et ta usub sinusse.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
en: It's not very used to you yet. It neither loves nor hates you.
et: Ta pole veel sinuga eriti harjunud. Ta ei armasta ega vihka sind.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
en: It's very wary. It has scary viciousness in its eyes. It doesn't like you much at all.
et: Ta on väga ettevaatlik. Tal on silmis hirmus õelus. Sa ei meeldi talle üldse.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
en: This is a little hard for me to say…
et: Seda on mul veidi raske öelda…

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
en: Your POKéMON simply detests you. Doesn't that make you uncomfortable?
et: Su POKéMON lihtsalt jälestab sind. Kas see ei tee sind ebamugavaks?

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
en: PIKACHU: Pika pika!
et: PIKACHU: Pika pika!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
en: MOM: See, {PLAYER}? Isn't it nice in here, too?
et: EMME: Näed, {PLAYER}? Kas pole siin ka kena?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: The mover's POKéMON do all the work of moving us in and cleaning up after. This is so convenient!
et: Kolija POKéMONid teevad kogu töö, meid sisse kolides ja järelt koristades. See on nii mugav!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: {PLAYER}, your room is upstairs. Go check it out, dear!
et: {PLAYER}, su tuba on üleval. Mine vaata, kallis!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: DAD bought you a new clock to mark our move here. Don't forget to set it!
et: ISA ostis sulle uue kella meie siia kolimise tähistamiseks. Ära unusta seda seada!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
en: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?
et: EMME: Noh, {PLAYER}?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
en: Aren't you interested in seeing your very own room?
et: Kas sind ei huvita näha oma tuba?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
en: MOM: {PLAYER}.
et: EMME: {PLAYER}.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
en: Go set the clock in your room, honey.
et: Mine sea oma toas kell, kullake.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
en: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}! Quick! Come quickly!
et: EMME: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}! Kärme! Tule kiiresti!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
en: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM! Maybe DAD will be on!
et: EMME: Vaata! See on PETALBURG GYM! Võib-olla on ISA ekraanil!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
en: MOM: Oh… It's over.
et: EMME: Oh… See on läbi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
en: I think DAD was on, but we missed him. Too bad.
et: Ma arvan, et ISA oli ekraanil, aga me jäime temast ilma. Kahju.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: Oh, yes. One of DAD's friends lives in town.
et: Oh, jah. Üks ISA sõpradest elab linnas.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: PROF. BIRCH is his name.
et: PROF. BIRCH on tema nimi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: He lives right next door, so you should go over and introduce yourself.
et: Ta elab siinsamas naabruses, nii et sa peaksid minema ja end tutvustama.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
en: MOM: See you, honey!
et: EMME: Näeme, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
en: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
et: EMME: Kas sa tutvustasid end PROF. BIRCHILE?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
en: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}? You look a little tired.
et: EMME: Kuidas läheb, {PLAYER}? Sa näed veidi väsinud välja.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
en: I think you should rest a bit.
et: Ma arvan, et sa peaksid veidi puhkama.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
en: MOM: Take care, honey!
et: EMME: Hoia end, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
en: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?
et: EMME: Oh? Kas ISA andis sulle selle MÄRGI?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
en: Then here's something from your MOM!
et: Siis siin on midagi su EMMELT!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
en: Don't push yourself too hard, dear. You can always come home.
et: Ära pinguta end liiga üle, kallis. Sa võid alati koju tulla.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
en: Go for it, honey!
et: Anna minna, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
en: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV? Someone from DEVON gave it to you?
et: EMME: Mis see on, kullake? POKéNAV? Keegi DEVONIST andis selle sulle?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
en: Well, honey, how about registering your mom?
et: Noh, kullake, kuidas oleks, kui registreeriksid oma ema?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
en: Registered MOM in the POKéNAV.
et: EMME registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
en: Fugiiiiih!
et: Fugiiiih!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
en: Huggoh, uggo uggo…
et: Huggoh, uggo uggo…

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
en: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this report from in front of PETALBURG GYM.
et: INTERVJUEERIJA: …Me tõime teile selle reportaaži PETALBURG GYMi eest.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: There is a movie on TV.
et: Telekas on film.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: Two men are dancing on a big piano keyboard.
et: Kaks meest tantsivad suurel klaveriklahvistikul.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: Better get going!
et: Parem asun teele!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: It's the instruction booklet for the RUNNING SHOES.
et: See on RUNNING SHOESE kasutusjuhend.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: “Press the B Button to run while wearing your RUNNING SHOES.
et: „Vajuta B-nuppu, et joosta, kui kannad oma RUNNING SHOESE.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: “Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit the road running!”
et: „Nööri kinni oma RUNNING SHOES ja lase teele jooksuga!”

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: DAD: Hm?
et: ISA: Hm?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!
et: Hei, see on {PLAYER}!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: It's been a while since I saw you, but you look…stronger, somehow.
et: Ammu pole sind näinud, aga sa näed…kuidagi tugevam välja.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: That's the impression I get. But your old man hasn't given up yet!
et: Selline mulje mul on. Aga su vanaisa pole veel alla andnud!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: Oh, yes, I have something for you. This came to you from someone named MR. BRINEY.
et: Oh, jah, mul on sulle midagi. See tuli sulle kelleltki nimega MR. BRINEY.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
en: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?
et: ISA: Hm, praami PILET?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
en: If I recall, there are ferry ports in SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.
et: Kui õigesti mäletan, on praamisadamad SLATEPORTIS ja LILYCOVE'is.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
en: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.
et: Parem ma lähen tagasi PETALBURG GYMi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
en: MOM, thanks for looking after the house while I'm away.
et: EMME, aitäh, et minu äraolekul maja eest hoolitsed.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: MOM: That DAD of yours…
et: EMME: See sinu ISA…

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: He comes home for the first time in a while, but all he talks about is POKéMON.
et: Ta tuleb pärast pikka aega koju, aga räägib ainult POKéMONidest.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: He should relax and stay a little longer.
et: Ta peaks lõõgastuma ja veidi kauemaks jääma.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
en: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?
et: EMME: Kas see on erakorraline uudis?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: We bring you this emergency news flash!
et: Me toome teile selle erakorralise uudise!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: In various HOENN locales, there have been reports of a BZZT…colored POKéMON in flight.
et: Erinevates HOENNi paikades on teatatud BZZT…värvi POKéMONist lennus.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: The identity of this POKéMON is currently unknown.
et: Selle POKéMONi isik on hetkel teadmata.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: We now return you to the regular movie program.
et: Nüüd tagastame teid tavapärase filmisaate juurde.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?
et: EMME: {PLAYER}, kas sa said sellest aru?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
en: What color did the announcer say that POKéMON was?
et: Mis värvi ütles teadustaja, et see POKéMON oli?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
en: MOM: Well, isn't that something! There are still unknown POKéMON.
et: EMME: Noh, kas pole midagi! On veel tundmatuid POKéMONe.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HmmYourPokemon
en: Hmm! Your {STR_VAR_1}…
et: Hmm! Su {STR_VAR_1}…

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
en: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S, doesn't it?
et: Talle meeldivad {STR_VAR_1}, kas pole?

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
en: No, I'm positive of it! It definitely likes {STR_VAR_1}S!
et: Ei, ma olen selles kindel! Talle kindlasti meeldivad {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
en: It doesn't appear to like or dislike any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Näib, et talle ei meeldi ega ei häiri ükski {POKEBLOCK}.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
en: My husband can tell what kind of {POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.
et: Mu abikaasa oskab pilguga öelda, milliseid {POKEBLOCK}e POKéMONile meeldivad.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: This area is covered in volcanic ash, huff-puff!
et: See ala on kaetud vulkaanituhaga, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: I'm specially gifted, huff-puff.
et: Ma olen erilise andega, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: I make glass out of volcanic ash and make items, huff-puff.
et: Ma teen vulkaanituhast klaasi ja valmistan esemeid, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.
et: Mine kogu sellega tuhka, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: Just take that SOOT SACK and walk through piles of ash, huff-puff.
et: Võta lihtsalt see NÕESALV ja kõnni läbi tuhahunnikute, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: And it will fill up with the volcanic ash, huff-puff.
et: Ja see täitub vulkaanituhaga, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: Once you think you've collected a good amount, come see me, huff-puff.
et: Kui arvad, et oled korralikus koguses kogunud, tule mind vaatama, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeCollectedAshes
en: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff? Let me see, huff-puff.
et: Kas oled tuhka kogunud, ähh-puhh? Lase mul vaadata, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
en: Hmmm… There's not enough ash here, huff-puff. I can't make glass with this, huff-puff.
et: Hmmm… Siin pole piisavalt tuhka, ähh-puhh. Ma ei saa sellest klaasi teha, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
en: Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps you'll need to walk for me to make you a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.
et: Vaatame… {STR_VAR_1} on sammude arv, mille pead kõndima, et ma sulle SINISE FLÖÖDI teeksin, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
en: Oh! You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!
et: Oh! Sul on palju tuhka, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
en: I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff! Which one would you like, huff-puff?
et: Ma teen sulle klaaseseme, ähh-puhh! Millist sooviksid, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
et: {STR_VAR_1}, ähh-puhh? Kas see on see, mis sulle sobib, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
en: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
et: Millist sooviksid, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!
et: {STR_VAR_1} siis, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff. Just wait a little while, huff-puff.
et: Olgu! Ma teen selle sulle, ähh-puhh. Oota vaid pisut, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?
et: {STR_VAR_1}, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: There's not enough ash here to make that, though, huff-puff.
et: Siin pole selle tegemiseks piisavalt tuhka, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps you'll need to walk through volcanic ash for me to make that item, huff-puff.
et: Vaatame… {STR_VAR_2} on sammude arv, mille pead vulkaanituhas kõndima, et ma selle eseme teeksin, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Which item would you rather have me make instead, huff-puff?
et: Millise eseme laseksid mul selle asemel teha, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
en: You've collected all that ash, but you don't want anything, huff-puff?
et: Sa oled kogunud kogu selle tuha, aga sa ei taha midagi, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
en: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}. Take it, huff-puff.
et: Ah, ma sain su {STR_VAR_1} valmis. Võta see, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: Oh? You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.
et: Oh? Su KOTIS pole ruumi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian selle alles, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: Oh? You've no room in your PC, huff-puff?
et: Oh? Su PC-s pole ruumi, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian selle alles, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK with you, huff-puff.
et: Hah? Sul pole NÕESALVE kaasas, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: You have to keep it with you to collect volcanic ash, huff-puff.
et: Sa pead seda kaasas hoidma, et vulkaanituhka koguda, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my boss is talking.
et: On lõbus puhuda klaasflööti, kui mu ülemus räägib.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: Huff-huff! Puff-puff!
et: Ähh-ähh! Puhh-puhh!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.
et: Meri PACIFIDLOGI ja SLATEPORTI vahel on kiire vooluga.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: If you decide to SURF, you could end up swept away somewhere else.
et: Kui otsustad SURFida, võid lõpuks kuhugi mujale minema uhutud saada.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: See, isn't it neat? These houses are on water!
et: Näed, kas pole tore? Need majad on vee peal!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: I was born here!
et: Ma sündisin siin!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: The SKY PILLAR?
et: SKY PILLAR?

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: …Oh, you must mean that tall, tall tower a little further out.
et: …Oh, sa pead silmas seda kõrget, kõrget torni veidi eemal.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. It's too scary to get up that high.
et: Kui minult küsida, ma ei roniks sinna. On liiga hirmus nii kõrgele minna.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, that suits me fine.
et: Elu merepinnal PACIFIDLOGIS, see sobib mulle hästi.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: PACIFIDLOG TOWN
et: PACIFIDLOG TOWN

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: “Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.”
et: „Kus hommikupäike naeratab vetele.”

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE…
et: Mõte, et ma lähen POKéMON LEAGUE'ile lähemale…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: I'm getting stage fright…
et: Mind tabab lavahirm…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
en: I couldn't do a thing…
et: Ma ei suutnud midagi teha…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…
et: POKéMON LEAGUE muutus jälle kaugeks… Kui pettumus…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
en: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.
et: Et võita end läbi POKéMON LEAGUE'i, vajad sa oma POKéMONide usaldust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
en: Your relationship is based on solid trust.
et: Teie suhe põhineb kindlal usaldusel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
en: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.
et: Kogu aeg koos olles kasvab usaldus POKéMONide ja TRAINERITE vahel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
en: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: See pole eesmärk. See on lihtsalt üks koht teel POKéMON LEAGUE'i.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
en: That's the way!
et: Just nii!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
en: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!
et: Sul läheb kindlasti hästi! Su POKéMONid on kõik minekuhimulised!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
en: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!
et: Mu POKéMONid on kosmiliselt aukartustäratavad!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
en: I've never met anyone like you before.
et: Ma pole kunagi varem kohanud kedagi sinusugust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
en: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.
et: Isegi väljaspool lahingut aiman ma sinust ja su POKéMONidest uskumatut jõudu.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
en: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!
et: Olgu, pole vaja karvu turri ajada! Lõdvestu, võtame rahulikult!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
en: Whoa! Wonderful!
et: Ohoo! Imeline!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.
et: Muidugi, see on VICTORY ROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far.
et: Aga see pole sugugi nii erinev teest, mille oled seni läbinud.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!
et: Püüa ülejäänud teel asju nautida!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship?
et: Palun? Sa otsid laeva?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…
et: Vabandust, praamiteenus pole hetkel saadaval…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas oled praami pärast siin? Kas tohin näha su PILETIT?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER}-l pole PILETIT…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Praamile astumiseks peab sul olema PILET.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas PILETIT.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Suurepärane! Rohkem polegi vaja!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu sa minna sooviksid?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Palun purjeta meiega mõni teine kord!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: LILYCOVE CITY siis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
en: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!
et: BATTLE FRONTIER siis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astu praamile ja oota väljasõitu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna sooviksid?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: A journey to the bottom of the sea… I wonder what it'd be like?
et: Teekond merepõhja… Huvitav, milline see oleks?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: I'd love to go deep underwater like that someday.
et: Ma tahaksin kunagi nõnda sügavale vee alla minna.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: For a ship to sail safely, we need to know about the weather!
et: Et laev ohutult purjetaks, peame ilmast teadma!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: Speaking of weather, I heard something from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: Ilmast rääkides, ma kuulsin midagi ühelt tüübilt WEATHER INSTITUTE'ist.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: He was saying abnormal weather has been reported all over the place!
et: Ta rääkis, et igal pool on raporteeritud ebanormaalset ilma!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE and ask around!
et: Sa peaksid WEATHER INSTITUTE'i külastama ja ringi pärima!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on the ocean floor exploration.
et: Ma tahtsin KAPTEN STERNIGA merepõhja uurimisele minna.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: But the sub's too small for me.
et: Aga allveelaev on minu jaoks liiga väike.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be any room for the CAPTAIN…
et: Kui ma end sinna sisse suruksin, poleks KAPTENILE üldse ruumi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…
et: KAPTEN STERN: Need sulid…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: They're the same lot who tried to rob the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.
et: Nad on sama kamp, kes üritas MUUSEUMIS DEVONI KAUPA röövida.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: ARCHIE: Oh? Not you again…
et: ARCHIE: Oh? Jälle sina…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: You are tenacious to track us here, that much I will give you.
et: Sa oled visa, et meid siia jälitasid, seda ma sulle tunnistan.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: But now… No one can stop us! No one!
et: Aga nüüd… Keegi ei suuda meid peatada! Mitte keegi!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Or, will you follow us back to our HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?
et: Või kas sa järgned meile tagasi meie PEIDIKUSSE LILYCOVE CITYS?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Fwahahahaha…
et: Fvahahahaa…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: CAPT. STERN: Why…
et: KAPTEN STERN: Miks…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: Why would TEAM AQUA steal my SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?
et: Miks küll TEAM AQUA varastaks mu SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: They can't be after the slumbering POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…
et: Nad ei saa jahtida merepõhjas uinuvat POKéMONi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: But even if I were to chase them, I don't stand a chance against them…
et: Aga isegi kui ma neid taga ajaksin, pole mul nende vastu mingit šanssi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: KAPTEN STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Okay… So TEAM AQUA left before you could stop them…
et: Olgu… Nii et TEAM AQUA lahkus, enne kui sa neid peatada said…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Oh, no, don't blame yourself. You're not responsible for this.
et: Oh, ei, ära süüdista ennast. Sina pole selle eest vastutav.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible for most people.
et: Üritada allveelaeva püüda… See on enamiku inimeste jaoks võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Sul oleks vaja POKéMONi, kes oskab DIVE'i…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui läheksid MOSSDEEP CITYSSE…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sulle õpetada…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible.
et: KAPTEN STERN: Üritada allveelaeva püüda… See on võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Sul oleks vaja POKéMONi, kes oskab DIVE'i…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui läheksid MOSSDEEP CITYSSE…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sulle õpetada…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes. MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.
et: KAPTEN STERN: Oh, jah. HR. BRINEY tuli meie LAEVATEHASESSE.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: It won't be long now before we finish making the ferry!
et: Nüüd ei lähe enam kaua, kui praami valmis saame!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: KAPTEN STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We finally finished making the ferry S.S. TIDAL!
et: Me lõpuks saime praami S.S. TIDAL valmis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We couldn't have done it without your friend MR. BRINEY.
et: Me poleks seda suutnud ilma su sõbra HR. BRINEYTA.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: Please go for a short cruise on it!
et: Palun mine tee sellega lühike merereis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…
et: KAPTEN STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, see ese, mis sul on…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: That's a SCANNER! That would sure help us on our explorations.
et: See on SCANNER! See aitaks meid meie uurimustel kindlasti.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your SCANNER for something?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas vahetaksid oma SCANNERI millegi vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?
et: Näiteks, ütleme, DEEPSEATOOTHi või DEEPSEASCALE vastu, mis mul on?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain? It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: KAPTEN STERN: Kas oled kindel? See on sulle kasutu, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: Well, okay, then. If you want to trade your SCANNER, let me know.
et: Noh, olgu siis. Kui tahad oma SCANNERit vahetada, anna teada.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEATOOTH?
et: KAPTEN STERN: Nii et sa vahetad selle mu DEEPSEATOOTH vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEASCALE?
et: KAPTEN STERN: Nii et sa vahetad selle mu DEEPSEASCALE vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
en: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?
et: KAPTEN STERN: Kumba sa tahad?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
en: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to CAPT. STERN.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas SCANNERI KAPTEN STERNILE.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
en: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}! This will help our research a lot!
et: KAPTEN STERN: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See aitab meie uurimistööd palju!

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
en: DEWFORD is a tiny island community. If something gets trendy here, everyone picks up on it right away.
et: DEWFORD on väike saarekogukond. Kui midagi läheb siin moodi, haaravad kõik selle kohe.

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN “A tiny island in the blue sea.”
et: DEWFORD TOWN „Väike saar sinises meres.”

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”
et: DEWFORD TOWNi POKéMON GYMi SAALI JUHT: BRAWLY „Suur laine kakluses!”

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
en: DEWFORD HALL “Everyone's information exchange!”
et: DEWFORD HALL „Kõigi teabevahetus!”

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD.
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Me jõudsime maale DEWFORDIS.

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: I suppose you're off to deliver that LETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!
et: Ma arvan, et sa lähed seda KIRJA kohale viima, kes see nüüd oligi, STEVENILE!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your LETTER?
et: MR. BRINEY: Kas oled oma KIRJA kohale viinud?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: Or were you meaning to sail back to PETALBURG?
et: Või tahtsid tagasi PETALBURGI purjetada?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!
et: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG siis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud üles! PEEKO, me purjetame, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
en: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver the LETTER. I'll be waiting.
et: MR. BRINEY: Siis mine ja vii KIRI kohale. Ma ootan.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Me jõudsime maale DEWFORDIS!

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!
et: Ütle mulle lihtsalt, millal iganes tahad taas purjetama minna!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Sinu jaoks lähen ma merele igal ajal!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: Now, my friend, where are we bound?
et: Nüüd, mu sõber, kuhu me suundume?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, jah?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud üles! PEEKO, me purjetame, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, jah?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankrud üles! PEEKO, me purjetame, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
en: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ütle mulle lihtsalt, millal iganes vajad taas purjetamist!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
en: This is a renowned fishing spot. Are you getting the itch to fish?
et: See on tuntud kalastuskoht. Kas sul kipub kalastama?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I hear you, and I like what you're saying!
et: Ma kuulen sind ja mulle meeldib, mida sa ütled!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.
et: Ma annan sulle ühe oma kalaÕNGEDEST.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw in a little fishing advice!
et: Ja lisaboonusena viskan sisse veel veidi kalastusnõu!

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Esiteks, sa pead näoga vee poole olema, siis kasuta ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.
et: Keskenda meelt… Kui saad nõksu, tõmba ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel saad kohe midagi haakida, aga suuremate saakide puhul pead ÕNGE tõmbeid ajastama, et need välja vinnata.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
en: Oh, is that so? That's too bad, then.
et: Oh, on või? Noh, siis on kahju.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
en: Yo! How's your fishing?
et: Jou! Kuidas kalapüük läheb?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
en: Is that right! That's great! Haul in some big ones!
et: On või! See on suurepärane! Vinna mõned suured välja!

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself! I'll give you a little fishing advice.
et: Oh, hei, ära löö end norgu! Ma annan sulle veidi kalastusnõu.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Esiteks, sa pead näoga vee poole olema, siis kasuta ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull the ROD.
et: Keskenda meelt… Kui saad nõksu, tõmba ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel saad kohe midagi haakida, aga suuremate saakide puhul pead ÕNGE tõmbeid ajastama, et need välja vinnata.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I like what's hip, happening, and trendy. I'm always checking it out.
et: Mulle meeldib see, mis on hipp, põnev ja trendikas. Ma jälgin seda pidevalt.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Listen, have you heard about this new “{STR_VAR_1}”?
et: Kuula, kas oled kuulnud sellest uuest „{STR_VAR_1}”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: That's right! Of course you know!
et: Just nii! Muidugi sa tead!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I mean, sheesh, “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's the hottest thing in cool!
et: Ma mõtlen, heldeke, „{STR_VAR_1}”… See on kõige kuumem asi lahedas!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Wherever you're from, “{STR_VAR_1}” is the biggest happening thing, right?
et: Kust iganes sa pärit oled, „{STR_VAR_1}” on kõige suurem toimuv asi, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Hunh? It's not the hip and happening thing?
et: Ähh? See pole hipp ja põnev asi?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Well, hey, you have to tell me, what's new and what's “in”?
et: Noh, hei, sa pead mulle ütlema, mis on uus ja mis on „sees”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Hunh? “{STR_VAR_2}”?
et: Ähh? „{STR_VAR_2}”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: …Uh… Yeah! That's right! Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!
et: …Äh… Jah! Just nii! Jah, ma teadsin seda! Teadsin kogu aeg!

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Of course I know about that! “{STR_VAR_2},” right?
et: Muidugi ma tean sellest! „{STR_VAR_2}”, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Yeah, that's it, it's there! Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}” the coolest, or what?
et: Jah, seesama, see on olemas! Kas „{STR_VAR_2}” pole kõige lahedam või mis?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: It's the hippest thing in hip. You think I'd not know about it?
et: See on kõige hipim, mis hipp olla saab. Kas sa arvad, et ma sellest ei teaks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's, like, so five minutes ago.
et: „{STR_VAR_1}”… See on nagu viie minuti tagune uudis.

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is what's vital and in tune with the times!
et: Nüüd on „{STR_VAR_2}” see, mis on eluliselt tähtis ja ajaga kooskõlas!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: Hmm… “{STR_VAR_2},” huh?
et: Hmm… „{STR_VAR_2}”, mis?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: But personally, I think “{STR_VAR_1}” is what's real in cool.
et: Aga isiklikult arvan, et „{STR_VAR_1}” on see, mis on tõeliselt lahe.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
en: Well, if you hear of any happening new trends, come share them with me, okay?
et: Noh, kui kuuled mõnest põnevast uuest trendist, tule jaga neid minuga, olgu?

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: Yeah, absolutely right!
et: Jah, absoluutselt õige!

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: “{STR_VAR_1}” is the definition of “in” right now.
et: „{STR_VAR_1}” on „sees” olemise definitsioon praegu.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: With this METEORITE, that thing in MT. CHIMNEY will…
et: Selle METEORIIDIGA teeb see asi MT. CHIMNEYS…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: Heh?
et: Häh?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: I don't know who you are, but if you get in the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't expect any mercy!
et: Ma ei tea, kes sa oled, aga kui TEAM MAGMALE ette jääd, ära oota mingit halastust!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!
et: Pea sealsamas kinni, TEAM MAGMA!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: You're badly mistaken if you think you can have your way with the world!
et: Sa eksid rängalt, kui arvad, et võid maailmaga oma tahtmist teha!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Hehehe! Even TEAM AQUA joins us!
et: Hehehe! Isegi TEAM AQUA liitub meiega!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: But it's too much trouble to deal with you all…
et: Aga on liiga palju tüli teiega kõigiga tegeleda…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Heh, it doesn't matter!
et: Heh, see pole tähtis!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: We've got the METEORITE, so off to MT. CHIMNEY we go!
et: Meil on METEORIIT, nii et MT. CHIMNEYSSE me läheme!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Ah, so your name is {PLAYER}.
et: Ah, nii et su nimi on {PLAYER}.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: At the time, I thought you were one of TEAM MAGMA's goons.
et: Sel ajal arvasin, et sa oled üks TEAM MAGMA nurjatutest.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Humph… You're one odd kid.
et: Hmph… Sa oled üks veider laps.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore

et: Nad on rivaalid meile, merd armastavale TEAM AQUALE!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma

et: BOSS, me peaksime TEAM MAGMALE järele minema…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must! We've got to hurry.
et: ARCHIE: Jah, jah, me peame! Me peame kiirustama.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: There's no telling what TEAM MAGMA will do at MT. CHIMNEY!
et: Pole öelda, mida TEAM MAGMA MT. CHIMNEYS teeb!

en: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep an eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.
et: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, sa peaksid ka TEAM MAGMA järele silma peal hoidma.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
en: Farewell!
et: Hüvasti!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: I… I'm COZMO… I'm a PROFESSOR…
et: Ma… ma olen COZMO… Ma olen PROFESSOR…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: TEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them to METEOR FALLS…
et: TEAM MAGMA palus mul juhatada nad METEOR FALLSISSE…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But they tricked me. They even took my METEORITE away…
et: Aga nad petsid mind. Nad võtsid isegi mu METEORIIDI ära…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: And then another similar bunch, TEAM AQUA showed up.
et: Ja siis ilmus veel üks sarnane kamp, TEAM AQUA.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: After that… I don't understand any of it.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But that TEAM MAGMA…
et: Aga see TEAM MAGMA…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: What are they going to do with that METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

en: They're the results of the last Level 50 SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.
et: Need on viimase Tase 50 ÜKSIKLAHINGU turniiri tulemused.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLv50
en: They're the results of the last Level 50 DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.
et: Need on viimase Tase 50 TOPELTLAHINGU turniiri tulemused.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsSinglesLvOpen
en: They're the results of the last Open Level SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.
et: Need on viimase Avatud taseme ÜKSIKLAHINGU turniiri tulemused.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLvOpen
en: They're the results of the last Open Level DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.
et: Need on viimase Avatud taseme TOPELTLAHINGU turniiri tulemused.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_LastWinnerWasTough
en: Did you see it? The last Battle Tournament?
et: Kas nägid seda? Viimast lahinguturniiri?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_LastWinnerWasTough
en: The winner, {STR_VAR_1}, was seriously tough.
et: Võitja {STR_VAR_1} oli tõsiselt sitke.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_LastWinnerWasTough
en: You should check out the results on the monitor beside the PC.
et: Sa peaksid tulemusi vaatama PC kõrval oleval monitoril.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LongDreamedAboutBattleFrontier
en: The BATTLE FRONTIER… I've long dreamed about a place like it.
et: BATTLE FRONTIER… Ma olen kaua unistanud sellisest kohast.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign2
en: The BATTLE DOME Become the Unbeatable Superstar!
et: BATTLE DOME — saa võitmatuks supertäheks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_QuestionMarkUnderConstruction
en: The ?????? Under Construction!
et: ?????? Ehitamisel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WinnersGainReputation
en: When a TRAINER chains tournament wins at the BATTLE DOME, he or she gains a reputation as a star.
et: Kui TRAINER kogub BATTLE DOME'is järjestikuseid turniirivõite, pälvib ta tähe maine.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WinnersGainReputation
en: Tough TRAINERS are drawn by that reputation to the BATTLE DOME.
et: Sitked TRAINERid meelitab see maine BATTLE DOME'i.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WinnersGainReputation
en: A true superstar is a TRAINER who can keep winning tournaments.
et: Tõeline supertäht on TRAINER, kes suudab turniire pidevalt võita.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TrashedInFirstRound
en: I ran into one of the tournament favorites in the very first round.
et: Ma sattusin päris esimeses voorus ühe turniirisoosiku otsa.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TrashedInFirstRound
en: Of course I got trashed…
et: Muidugi sain keretäie…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentCarefully
en: I would've won if I'd kept this POKéMON held in reserve.
et: Ma oleksin võitnud, kui oleksin selle POKéMONi varus hoidnud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentCarefully
en: You need to check your opponent's POKéMON carefully before choosing your battling POKéMON.
et: Sa pead vastase POKéMONe hoolikalt kontrollima, enne kui valid oma võitlevad POKéMONid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedTucker
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedTucker
en: You defeated the DOME ACE and won the Battle Tournament!
et: Sa alistasid DOME ACE'i ja võitsid lahinguturniiri!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_AwardTheseBattlePoints
en: In recognition of your strategy-a thing of beauty it was, too-we award you these Battle Point(s)!
et: Sinu strateegia tunnustuseks — see oli tõesti kaunis — kingime sulle need Battle Pointid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Would you like to record your last BATTLE DOME match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase BATTLE DOME matši FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Tournament rules are listed.
et: Lahinguturniiri reeglid on loetletud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainMatchupRules
en: The tournament matchups are drawn up based on the toughness of POKéMON held by TRAINERS.
et: Turniiri paarid koostatakse TRAINERite POKéMONide sitkuse põhjal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainMatchupRules
en: The matchups avoid having tough TRAINERS face each other right away.
et: Paarid väldivad seda, et sitked TRAINERid kohe vastamisi satuksid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree
en: The tournament chart, or as we call it, the “Tree,” is available for viewing in the Waiting Room from any guide.
et: Turniiritabel, või nagu meie ütleme, „Puu”, on Ooteruumis igalt teejuhilt vaadata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree
en: The Tournament Tree will provide several kinds of data.
et: Turniiripuu pakub mitut liiki andmeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree
en: The data on view includes the previous tournament's results, the POKéMON held by TRAINERS, and the battle styles of TRAINERS.
et: Vaadatavad andmed hõlmavad eelmise turniiri tulemusi, TRAINERite POKéMONe ja TRAINERite võitlusstiile.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleKORules
en: If battling POKéMON faint at the same time--a double KO--in a tournament match, the REFEREES will review the match and declare the winner.
et: Kui võitlevad POKéMONid minestavad korraga — topeltnokaut — turniirimatšis, vaatavad KOHTUNIKUD matši üle ja kuulutavad võitja.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas salakoodi uksele.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: “TRICK MASTER I love.” … … … … … … … …
et: „TRICK MASTERit ma armastan.” … … … … … … … …

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: The lock clicked open!
et: Lukk klõpsatas lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentIntro
en: Not many TRAINERS have made it this far.
et: Pole palju TRAINEREID, kes on nii kaugele jõudnud.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentDefeat
en: That must mean you're tough, too…
et: See peab tähendama, et sinagi oled kõva…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentPostBattle
en: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION? That's too much!
et: Sa oled võitnud POKéMON LEAGUE MEISTRI? See on liiast!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraIntro
en: Consider yourself lucky to be battling me!
et: Loe end õnnelikuks, et minuga võitled!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDefeat
en: This isn't right! I can't lose!
et: See pole õige! Ma ei saa kaotada!
