label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReturnedEverythingMonsHeld
en: {PLAYER} returned everything that the POKéMON held.
et: {PLAYER} andis tagasi kõik, mida POKéMONid hoidsid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
en: The BATTLE BAG you used will be kept in readiness for your next challenge.
et: Su kasutatud BATTLE BAG hoitakse valmis su järgmiseks väljakutseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
en: {PLAYER} turned the BATTLE BAG over for the BAG's return.
et: {PLAYER} andis BATTLE BAGi üle KOTI tagasisaamiseks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RecordResultsWait
en: I must record your results. Please wait.
et: Ma pean su tulemused salvestama. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ForConqueringPyramidTakeThis
en: As a memento for conquering the BATTLE PYRAMID, please take this.
et: BATTLE PYRAMIDi vallutamise mälestuseks palun võta see.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull
en: …Ah… Your BAG appears to be filled.
et: …Ah… Su KOTT näib olevat täis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull
en: Please return after you've organized your BAG's contents.
et: Palun tule tagasi, kui oled KOTI sisu korrastanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: How disappointing for you…
et: Kui kahju sinu jaoks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: Here is the BAG we've been holding for you.
et: Siin on KOTT, mida sinu jaoks hoidsime.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
en: {PLAYER} got the BAG back.
et: {PLAYER} sai KOTI tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextChallenge
en: We look forward to your next challenge!
et: Ootame su järgmist väljakutset!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival!
et: Me oleme sinu saabumist oodanud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
en: Here is your prize for conquering the PYRAMID.
et: Siin on su auhind PÜRAMIIDI vallutamise eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
en: Welcome…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
en: I shall be pleased to tell you what misfortunes await in the PYRAMID…
et: Mul on hea meel öelda, millised õnnetused PÜRAMIIDIS ootavad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
en: I see a shower of sparks…
et: Ma näen sädemevihma…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
en: …And in it, I see your POKéMON struggling with paralysis…
et: …Ja selles näen su POKéMONe halvatusega maadlemas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
en: I see poison…
et: Ma näen mürki…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from the effects of poison…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe mürgi mõju all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
en: I see bright red flames…
et: Ma näen erepunaseid leeke…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from burns…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe põletushaavade all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: I sense the tremendous pressure of unrequited anger…
et: Ma tajun tohutut survet vastamata vihast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: It is a curse…
et: See on needus…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
en: …And, I see your POKéMON drained of Power Points and having no recourse but to use STRUGGLE…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe Power Pointidest tühjaks kurnatud ega jää muud üle kui kasutada võtet STRUGGLE…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
en: I see POKéMON loftily airborne…
et: Ma näen kõrgel õhus hõljuvaid POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
en: …And, I see your POKéMON frustrated by powerless GROUND-type moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe jõuetute MAA-tüüpi võtete pärast pettunud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
en: I sense terrific energy rising from the ground below…
et: Ma tajun tohutut energiat allpool maast tõusmas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
en: …And, I see your POKéMON unable to escape the power's clutches…
et: …Ja ma näen, et su POKéMONid ei pääse selle jõu haardest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
en: I see ICE-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen JÄÄ-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
en: …And, I see your POKéMON fighting the freezing effects of ice…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe jää külmutava mõjuga võitlemas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
en: I see a flurry of moves that imperil the user…
et: Ma näen võtete tulva, mis ohustab kasutajat…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
en: …And, I see your POKéMON falling to them…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe neile alla jäämas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
en: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen VAIMSE-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
en: …And, I see your POKéMON in torment from PSYCHIC moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe VAIMSETE võtete piinades…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
en: I see ROCK-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen KIVI-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from ROCK moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe KIVI-võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
en: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen KAKLUS-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
en: …And, I see your POKéMON pummeled by FIGHTING moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe KAKLUS-võtete käes pekstud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY… SANDSTORM… HAIL…
et: RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY… SANDSTORM… HAIL…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: I see POKéMON that become stronger with the weather…
et: Ma näen POKéMONe, kes muutuvad ilmaga tugevamaks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
en: …And, I see your POKéMON confounded by different types of moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe erinevat tüüpi võtetest segadusse aetud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
en: I see BUG-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen PUTUKA-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from different kinds of attacks…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe erinevate rünnakute all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
en: I see DARK-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen PIMEDUSE-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from DARK-type moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe PIMEDUSE-tüüpi võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
en: I see WATER-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen VEE-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from WATER-type moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe VEE-tüüpi võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost
en: I see GHOST-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen KUMMITUS-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from GHOST-type moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe KUMMITUS-tüüpi võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel
en: I see STEEL-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen TERAS-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe tohutult võimsate võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
en: I see flying POKéMON…
et: Ma näen lendavaid POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe tohutult võimsate võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: I see those that have evolved from the power of stones…
et: Ma näen neid, kes on arenenud kivide jõust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: I also sense fire, water, and electricity…
et: Ma tajun ka tuld, vett ja elektrit…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from those three powers…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe nende kolme jõu all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
en: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen TAVA-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…
et: …Ja ma näen su POKéMONe tohutult võimsate võtete all kannatamas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
en: Whether you believe my fortunes or not, the choice is yours…
et: Kas usud mu ennustusi või mitte, valik on sinu…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
en: The future can be changed anytime… I wish you safe passage…
et: Tulevikku saab alati muuta… Soovin sulle turvalist teekonda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: If you run fast, TRAINERS may notice and come after you for a battle.
et: Kui jooksed kiiresti, võivad TRAINERid seda märgata ja sulle lahingu pärast järele tulla.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: So, if you want to avoid TRAINERS, don't catch their eyes, but sneak cautiously and quietly past them.
et: Nii et kui tahad TRAINEReid vältida, ära torka silma, vaid hiili ettevaatlikult ja vaikselt neist mööda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!
et: Aaaaaarrrrgh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: I had a whole lot of items, but I lost them all when I lost!
et: Mul oli hulk esemeid, aga kaotasin need kõik, kui kaotasin!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!
et: Aaaaaarrrrgh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: Welcome back! You've done the unthinkable!
et: Tere tulemast tagasi! Sa tegid mõeldamatu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: You've defeated the PYRAMID KING and conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: Sa alistasid PYRAMID KINGi ja vallutasid BATTLE PYRAMIDi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
en: Young explorer! In commendation of your courage, we give you these Battle Point(s)!
et: Noor maadeuurija! Sinu julguse tunnustuseks anname sulle need Battle Pointid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Quest rules are listed.
et: Battle Questi reeglid on loetletud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: When the PYRAMID is conquered, the wild POKéMON that appear in it are replaced by different kinds.
et: Kui PÜRAMIID on vallutatud, asendatakse selles ilmuvad metsikud POKéMONid teiste liikidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: Explore, observe, and learn what kinds of wild POKéMON you may encounter.
et: Uuri, jälgi ja õpi, milliseid metsikuid POKéMONe võid kohata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: TRAINERS are lying in wait for you inside the PYRAMID.
et: TRAINERid varitsevad sind PÜRAMIIDI sees.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: On each floor, there are up to eight TRAINERS.
et: Igal korrusel on kuni kaheksa TRAINERit.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: When you defeat a TRAINER, you will get a helpful hint for your adventure.
et: Kui alistad TRAINERi, saad oma seikluseks kasuliku vihje.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange themselves every time you enter it.
et: PÜRAMIIDI labürindid korraldavad end ümber iga kord, kui sa sisened.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes are poorly lit. You must advance with caution.
et: Labürindid on halvasti valgustatud. Pead ettevaatlikult edasi liikuma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The light grows brighter whenever you defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.
et: Valgus muutub eredamaks iga kord, kui alistad metsiku POKéMONi või TRAINERi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG while in the PYRAMID.
et: BATTLE BAG toimib su KOTINA PÜRAMIIDIS olles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: There are two separate BATTLE BAGS-one each for the Level 50 and Open Level adventures.
et: On kaks eraldi BATTLE BAGi — üks Tase 50 ja üks Avatud taseme seikluse jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: They each can hold up to 99 pieces of ten kinds of items.
et: Kumbki mahutab kuni 99 tükki kümmet liiki esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The contents of the BATTLE BAG are lost if you fail in your quest.
et: BATTLE BAGi sisu läheb kaotsi, kui su retk ebaõnnestub.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas salakoodi uksele.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: “TRICK MASTER is huggable.” … … … … … … … …
et: „TRICK MASTERit tahaks kallistada.” … … … … … … … …

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: The lock clicked open!
et: Lukk klõpsatas lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
en: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?
et: TRICK MASTER kaob alati nagu suits. Kuidas ta seda teeb?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
en: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?
et: Aiiih! Sa oled palju liiga tugev! Kuidas sa seda teed?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
en: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.
et: Ma sooviksin, et minagi saaksin ilmuda ja kaduda, justkui oleksin suits.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
en: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…
et: Sama koha ümber tiirlemine… See toob halba õnne…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
en: Defeated! It's a bad sign…
et: Alistatud! See on halb märk…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
en: I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…
et: Ma olen nüüd sama koha üle kümne korra ümber teinud… See on halb õnn…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
en: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.
et: Kes iganes võidab, saab siit esimesena läbi. Selline tunne mul on.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
en: Oh! Well, go ahead, then!
et: Oh! Noh, siis mine aga!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
en: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
et: Sa lahendad kõik TRICK HOUSE'i mõistatused. Selline tunne mul on.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
en: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!
et: Nufufufu, lõpuks siin! Asugem kohe asja kallale!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
en: You're so casual about winning!
et: Sa oled võitmise suhtes nii muretu!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
en: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!
et: Hmpf! Ma pole pahane! Mina mitte!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
en: I ever so closely watched you coming!
et: Ma jälgisin ülimalt tähelepanelikult su tulekut!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
en: This outcome I didn't see coming…
et: Seda tulemust ma ette ei näinud…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT? It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Kas tunned POKéMONi SEEDOT? Teda näeb SOOTOPOLISES peaaegu kunagi mitte.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Anyway, I love big SEEDOT. The bigger the better.
et: Igatahes, ma armastan suuri SEEDOTe. Mida suurem, seda parem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: But my younger brother, he says that LOTAD is bigger.
et: Aga mu noorem vend, tema ütleb, et LOTAD on suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: That's silly. SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!
et: See on rumal. SEEDOT peab sellest suurem olema!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you? P-p-please, show me!
et: Huh? Kas sul on SEEDOT kaasas? P-p-palun, näita mulle!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches! Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli! Oh, heldeke, see on suur!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: It might even beat the big LOTAD my younger brother saw!
et: See võib isegi lüüa suurt LOTADi, keda mu noorem vend nägi!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: Thanks for showing me. This is my thanks!
et: Aitäh näitamast. See on minu tänu!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
en: {PLAYER} received a POTION.
et: {PLAYER} sai POTIONi.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
en: Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.
et: Häh? Su KOTT on puupüsti täis.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches, is it?
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli, on või?

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
en: Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT than this one.
et: Hmm… Ma olen näinud suuremat SEEDOTi kui see siin.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
en: Oh, now this is quite something… But it's not a SEEDOT!
et: Oh, nüüd see on küll miski… Aga see pole SEEDOT!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
en: You don't have a big SEEDOT? That's too bad…
et: Sul pole suurt SEEDOTi? See on kahju…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
en: If you get a big SEEDOT, please come show me.
et: Kui saad suure SEEDOTi, palun tule mulle näita.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
en: The biggest SEEDOT in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch giant!
et: Suurim SEEDOT ajaloos! {STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_3}-tolline hiiglane!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
en: A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD always wanted!
et: SEEDOT suurem, kui LOTAD ealeski soovis!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD? It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Kas tunned POKéMONi LOTAD? Teda näeb SOOTOPOLISES harva.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: I love, I mean love, big LOTAD!
et: Ma armastan, ma mõtlen armastan, suuri LOTADeid!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: My big brother says that SEEDOT is bigger.
et: Mu suur vend ütleb, et SEEDOT on suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: But that's wrong! Everyone knows that LOTAD is a lot bigger.
et: Aga see on vale! Kõik teavad, et LOTAD on palju suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD? P-p-please show me!
et: Häh? Kas sul on LOTAD? P-p-palun näita mulle!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches! Wow, that is big!
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli! Ohoo, see on suur!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: It might be even bigger than the huge SEEDOT my big brother saw.
et: See võib olla isegi suurem kui see tohutu SEEDOT, keda mu suur vend nägi.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: Thanks for showing me! This is my thanks!
et: Aitäh näitamast! See on minu tänu!

et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli?

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
en: Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD than this one here.
et: Hmm… Ma olen näinud suuremat LOTADi kui see siin.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
en: Well, isn't this something! But it's no LOTAD!
et: Noh, kas pole see miski! Aga see pole mingi LOTAD!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
en: Don't you have a big LOTAD? How disappointing…
et: Kas sul pole suurt LOTADi? Kui pettumus…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
en: If you get a big LOTAD, please come show me!
et: Kui saad suure LOTADi, palun tule mulle näita!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
en: The biggest LOTAD in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch colossus!
et: Suurim LOTAD ajaloos! {STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_3}-tolline koloss!

et: LOTAD suurem, kui SEEDOT ealeski soovis!

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman5
en: If I win a whole lot of link battles and show everyone how good I am, I might get a fan following!
et: Kui võidan hulga ühenduslahinguid ja näitan kõigile, kui hea ma olen, võin fänniparve saada!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Gorge your eyes on this!
et: Söö silmad selle täis!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: It's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the cutting edge of fashion, yeah!
et: See on SILK SCARF. See on täpselt moe tipul, jaa!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Oh, I can see your eyes twinkling! You appreciate my dazzling style!
et: Oh, ma näen su silmi sätendamas! Sa hindad mu pimestavat stiili!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Oh, you're a delight! Here you go. I want you to have it!
et: Oh, sa oled rõõm! Palun, siin ta on. Ma tahan, et sa selle saaksid!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Oh, you don't have room?
et: Oh, sul pole ruumi?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Now, listen tight, this SCARF is a musthave! Why, I would sell all my items in order to get it!
et: Nüüd kuula tähelepanelikult, see SALL on kohustuslik! Ohoo, ma müüksin kõik oma esemed, et see saada!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
en: The SILK SCARF raises the power of NORMAL-type moves.
et: SILK SCARF tõstab TAVA-tüüpi võtete jõudu.

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
en: It's a marvelous SCARF that will go with almost all POKéMON!
et: See on imeline SALL, mis sobib peaaegu kõigi POKéMONidega!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: Wow, you bothered to cross the sea to visit DEWFORD?
et: Ohoo, sa viitsisid mere ületada, et DEWFORDI külastada?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: Did you maybe come here because you heard about BRAWLY?
et: Kas sa ehk tulid siia, sest kuulsid BRAWLYST?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: He's so cool… Everyone idolizes him.
et: Ta on nii lahe… Kõik jumaldavad teda.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: An attacking move… Or a defensive move…
et: Ründevõte… Või kaitsevõte…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: It's no easy matter to decide which TM moves should be taught to POKéMON…
et: Pole kerge otsustada, milliseid TM-võtteid POKéMONidele õpetada…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
en: There are so many different kinds of TM moves.
et: TM-võtteid on nii palju erinevaid.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
en: A catalog I read said there are fifty different kinds.
et: Kataloog, mida lugesin, ütles, et neid on viiskümmend eri liiki.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
en: I'd like to get all the different TMs, but a POKéMON learns only four moves.
et: Ma sooviksin hankida kõik erinevad TM-id, aga POKéMON õpib vaid neli võtet.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
en: We're developing a device for talking with POKéMON.
et: Me arendame seadet POKéMONidega rääkimiseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
en: But we haven't had much success…
et: Aga meil pole eriti edu olnud…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS…
et: Ma arendan uut sorti POKé BALLe…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: But I haven't made much headway…
et: Aga ma pole eriti edasi jõudnud…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: We finally made new kinds of POKé BALLS!
et: Me lõpuks tegime uut sorti POKé BALLe!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to catch POKéMON you've caught before.
et: REPEAT BALL teeb kergemaks püüda POKéMONe, keda oled varem püüdnud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The TIMER BALL gets better at catching POKéMON the longer a battle runs.
et: TIMER BALL läheb POKéMONide püüdmisel paremaks, mida kauem lahing kestab.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Both are proudly developed by the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Mõlemat arendab uhkusega DEVON CORPORATION.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Please give them a try!
et: Palun proovi neid!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: I made the POKéNAV!
et: Mina tegin POKéNAVi!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!
et: Insenerina tunnen end õnnistatuna, et olen teinud midagi nii suurepärast!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Oh, wow! That's a POKéNAV!
et: Oh, ohoo! See on POKéNAV!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: It came about as a result of our PRESIDENT's desire to learn about the feelings of POKéMON.
et: See sündis meie PRESIDENDI soovist saada teada POKéMONide tunnetest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Would you like me to describe its features in detail?
et: Kas sooviksid, et ma kirjeldaksin selle funktsioone üksikasjalikult?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: No, no. I think you'll find out just by trying the POKéNAV out.
et: Ei, ei. Ma arvan, et sa saad kõik teada juba POKéNAVi proovides.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON…
et: Ma üritan välja töötada seadet, mis reprodutseerib visuaalselt POKéMONide unenägusid…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga see ei lähe hästi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: I've been trying to develop a device that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…
et: Ma olen üritanud välja töötada seadet, mis äratab POKéMONid fossiilidest ellu…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: And, it's working!
et: Ja see toimib!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Wait! That thing you have there… Is that a POKéMON fossil?
et: Oota! See asi, mis sul seal on… Kas see on POKéMONi fossiil?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Would you like to bring that POKéMON back to life?
et: Kas sooviksid selle POKéMONi ellu tagasi tuua?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: I can with my newly developed FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
et: Ma saan seda oma äsjaarendatud FOSSIL REGENERATORIGA.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: Oh, is that so?
et: Oh, on või nii?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: DEVON's technological expertise is outstanding, I tell you.
et: DEVONI tehnoloogiline oskusteave on silmapaistev, tean ütelda.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Oh, now that's a surprise! You have not one, but two, fossils?
et: Oh, nüüd see on üllatus! Sul pole mitte üks, vaid kaks fossiili?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Unfortunately, my machine can only regenerate one POKéMON at a time.
et: Kahjuks suudab mu masin korraga elustada ainult ühe POKéMONi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Would you like to pick one of your fossils for regeneration?
et: Kas sooviksid valida ühe oma fossiilidest elustamiseks?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: Excellent! Let's do this right away.
et: Suurepärane! Teeme selle kohe ära.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: {PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas {STR_VAR_1} DEVONI UURIJALE.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, is incredible.
et: FOSSIL REGENERATOR, mille ma tegin, on uskumatu.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: But it has one drawback--it takes a long time to work.
et: Aga sel on üks puudus – selle töö võtab kaua aega.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: So, uh… How about you go for a stroll and look around for a while?
et: Nii et, öö… Kuidas oleks, kui läheksid jalutama ja vaataksid veidi ringi?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Thanks for waiting!
et: Aitäh ootamast!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Your fossilized POKéMON has been brought back to life!
et: Su fossiilistunud POKéMON on ellu äratatud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: The fossil was an ancient POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, it was!
et: Fossiil oli muistne POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, see oli!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
en: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} sai DEVONI UURIJALT {STR_VAR_2}.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
en: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON. You have no room for this one.
et: Oh-oo, sul on liiga palju POKéMONe. Sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV…
et: Ma üritan välja töötada POKéNAVi uut funktsiooni…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga see ei lähe hästi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Well, now what shall I work on developing next?
et: Noh, mille kallal ma nüüd järgmisena arendama peaksin hakkama?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Our company allows us to make our inspirations into reality.
et: Meie firma laseb meil oma inspiratsioone reaalsuseks muuta.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: One couldn't ask for a better environment as an engineer.
et: Insenerina ei saaks paremat keskkonda soovidagi.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Who… Who are you?
et: Ää? Kes… Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}. So your move was today.
et: Oh, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}. Nii et su kolimine oli täna.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Um… I'm MAY. Glad to meet you!
et: Öö… Ma olen MAY. Rõõm kohtuda!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I have this dream of becoming friends with POKéMON all over the world.
et: Ma… mul on unistus saada sõbraks POKéMONidega üle kogu maailma.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
et: Ma… ma kuulsin sinust, {PLAYER}{KUN}, oma isalt, PROF. BIRCHILT.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was hoping that you would be nice, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa oled tore, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ja et me võiksime sõbrad olla.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, this is silly, isn't it? I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Oh, see on rumal, kas pole? Ma… ma just kohtasin sind, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Eheheh…
et: Ehehe…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, no! I forgot!
et: Oh ei! Ma unustasin!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was supposed to go help Dad catch some wild POKéMON!
et: Ma pidin minema aitama isa mõnd metsikut POKéMONi püüda!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näeme hiljem!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
en: POKéMON fully restored! Items ready, and…
et: POKéMONid täielikult taastatud! Esemed valmis, ja…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Hey! You…
et: Hei! Sina…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Who are you?
et: Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you? Moved in next door, right?
et: Oh, sa oled {PLAYER}, kas pole? Kolisid naabrusse, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I didn't know that you're a girl.
et: Ma ei teadnud, et sa oled tüdruk.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: A CONTEST has two stages of judging, primary and secondary.
et: KONKURSIL on kaks hindamise etappi, esmane ja teisene.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Primary judging is a popularity poll involving the audience.
et: Esmane hindamine on populaarsusküsitlus, mis kaasab publiku.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Secondary judging features appeals by the POKéMON using their moves.
et: Teiseses hindamises esitavad POKéMONid oma võtetega sära.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Plan appeals carefully to earn the most attention of the JUDGE and excite the audience. Do your best to stand out.
et: Kavanda sära hoolikalt, et pälvida KOHTUNIKULT kõige rohkem tähelepanu ja panna publik elevile. Anna endast parim, et silma paista.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: The primary and secondary scores are added at the end.
et: Esmane ja teisene tulemus liidetakse lõpus kokku.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: The POKéMON garnering the highest score is declared the winner.
et: POKéMON, kes kogub kõrgeima tulemuse, kuulutatakse võitjaks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
en: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.
et: KONKURSSE on viit liiki.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
en: COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and TOUGH are the five categories.
et: COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART ja TOUGH on need viis kategooriat.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
en: Choose the CONTEST that is right for the POKéMON you plan to enter.
et: Vali KONKURSS, mis sobib POKéMONile, keda kavatsed panna.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: There are four ranks of POKéMON CONTESTS.
et: POKéMON KONKURSSE on neli rangi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: NORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER are the four ranks.
et: NORMAALNE, SUPER, HYPER ja MASTER on need neli rangi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: In the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may enter.
et: NORMAALSES Rangis võib osaleda iga POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank in the same category.
et: Iga POKéMON, kes võitis NORMAALSE Rangi KONKURSI, võib samas kategoorias tõusta SUPER Rangi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner can move up to the HYPER Rank, and a HYPER Rank winner can advance to the MASTER Rank in the same category.
et: Samamoodi saab SUPER Rangi võitja tõusta HYPER Rangi ja HYPER Rangi võitja edeneda MASTER Rangi samas kategoorias.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: A POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank may compete in the MASTER Rank as often as its TRAINER wants.
et: POKéMON, kes võitis MASTER Rangis, võib MASTER Rangis võistelda nii tihti kui ta TRAINER tahab.

en: Which Rank would you like to enter?
et: Millisesse Rangisse sa astuda sooviksid?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EggCannotTakePart

et: Vabandust väga, aga MUNA ei saa POKéMON KONKURSIL osaleda.

en: Would you like to enter it in this CONTEST anyway?

et: Kas see on su KONKURSI-POKéMON?

et: Olgu, su POKéMON pannakse sellele KONKURSILE.

et: Su POKéMON on Osaleja nr. 4. KONKURSS algab peagi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ComeThroughHere
en: Please come in through here. Good luck!
et: Palun tule siit kaudu sisse. Edu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PokemonWonWeHavePrize
en: Congratulations! Your POKéMON is the CONTEST winner!
et: Palju õnne! Su POKéMON on KONKURSI võitja!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PokemonWonWeHavePrize
en: We have your prize right here. Please, right this way!
et: Su auhind on siinsamas. Palun, siiapoole!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ComeBackForPrizeLater
en: Please come back for your prize later on.
et: Palun tule oma auhinnale hiljem järele.

label: ContestHall_Text_ThankYouForAppeals

label: ContestHall_Text_ThankYouForAppeals

et: KONKURSS algab niipea, kui kõik mängijad oma osalemise registreerivad.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_Explain4PlayerContest

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: This is a CONTEST for two to four players linked using a Wireless Adapter or a GBA Game Link cable.
et: See on KONKURSS kahele kuni neljale mängijale, kes on ühendatud Wireless Adapteri või GBA Game Link kaabliga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: Participants are first asked to choose the mode they wish to enter.
et: Osalejatel palutakse kõigepealt valida režiim, millesse nad astuda soovivad.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: There are two different modes.
et: On kaks erinevat režiimi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) is for two to four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.
et: E-REŽIIM (EMERALD MODE) on kahele kuni neljale mängijale, igaühel POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: G-REŽIIM (GLOBAL MODE) on ainult neljale mängijale, igaühel POKéMON Emerald, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: The players should discuss which mode they want, then choose the same mode.
et: Mängijad peaksid arutama, millist režiimi nad tahavad, ja siis valima sama režiimi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest

et: Kui kõik mängijad on valinud sama KONKURSI samas režiimis, on osalemise registreerimine lõpetatud.

en: After that, a CONTEST will start in the usual manner.
et: Pärast seda algab KONKURSS tavapärasel viisil.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode

et: E-REŽIIMIS (EMERALD MODE) saab pidada LINK CONTESTi kahe kuni nelja mängijaga. Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: The players must be linked with each other using Wireless Adapters or GBA Game Link cables.
et: Mängijad peavad olema omavahel ühendatud Wireless Adapterite või GBA Game Link kaablitega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode

et: Kui mängijaid on vähem kui neli, liituvad saalis olevad TRAINERID, et täita 4-mängija KONKURSI koosseis.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: Please be aware that E-MODE is not available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.
et: Palun pane tähele, et E-REŽIIM pole POKéMON Ruby ega Sapphire'is saadaval.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is specifically for four players who are linked using GBA Game Link cables.
et: G-REŽIIM (GLOBAL MODE) on spetsiaalselt neljale mängijale, kes on ühendatud GBA Game Link kaablitega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: Each player must have a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Emerald, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: The CONTEST starts after all players choose G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) or enter through the 4-player reception counter (POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire).
et: KONKURSS algab pärast seda, kui kõik mängijad valivad G-REŽIIMI (POKéMON Emerald) või sisenevad 4-mängija vastuvõtuleti kaudu (POKéMON Ruby või Sapphire).

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile, there.
et: Tere seal, TRAINER! Sul on kena naeratus.

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: I have a hobby--collecting the profiles of POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Mul on hobi – koguda POKéMON TRAINERITE profiile.

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourProfile
en: So, how about it? May I see your profile?
et: Nii, kuidas oleks? Kas tohin näha su profiili?

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You make your own profile by putting together four words or phrases.
et: Sa teed oma profiili, pannes kokku neli sõna või fraasi.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Here, I'll show you an example of a profile using four pieces of text.
et: Siin, ma näitan sulle näidisprofiili, mis kasutab nelja tekstitükki.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You can switch those four pieces with other text pieces any which way you like to make your own profile.
et: Sa võid need neli tükki vahetada teiste tekstitükkidega kuidas iganes tahad, et teha oma profiil.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: There are a lot of text pieces that you can use.
et: On palju tekstitükke, mida saad kasutada.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: They are arranged in groups like POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so it is easier to look them up.
et: Need on jaotatud gruppidesse nagu POKéMONid, eluviisid ja hobid, nii et neid on lihtsam üles otsida.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: So, first, choose the group of text pieces to display a list of choices.
et: Nii et kõigepealt vali tekstitükkide grupp, et kuvada valikute nimekiri.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Then, pick the choice you want.
et: Siis vali valik, mida tahad.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Repeat for the remaining text choices, and you'll have your very own profile.
et: Korda ülejäänud tekstivalikute jaoks ja sul on oma isiklik profiil.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LetsSeeItThen
en: Yes! Thank you! So, let's see it, then.
et: Jah! Aitäh! Nii et lase näha siis.

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile
en: Oh, no, really?
et: Oh, ei, tõesti?

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile
en: I imagine someone like you would have a wonderful profile…
et: Ma kujutan ette, et sinusugusel oleks imeline profiil…

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow
en: Oh? You're not into it right now?
et: Oh? Sa pole praegu tujus?

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow
en: Well, anytime is good by me!
et: Noh, iga aeg sobib mulle!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouHaveWonderfulSmile
en: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile.
et: Tere seal, TRAINER! Sul on kena naeratus.

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourNewProfile
en: May I see your new profile?
et: Kas tohin näha su uut profiili?

label: ProfileMan_Text_EvenBetterThanLastProfile
en: Yes! Thank you!
et: Jah! Aitäh!

label: ProfileMan_Text_EvenBetterThanLastProfile
en: I hope it's even better than the profile you showed me before.
et: Ma loodan, et see on isegi parem kui profiil, mille sa mulle enne näitasid.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
en: Oh, you like your profile the way it is.
et: Oh, sulle meeldib su profiil nii, nagu see on.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
en: I don't blame you--it's a wonderful profile the way it is now.
et: Ma ei süüdista sind – see on imeline profiil nii, nagu see praegu on.

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: F-fantastic!
et: F-fantastiline!

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Your profile, it's wonderful! It really says what you're about.
et: Su profiil, see on imeline! See tõesti ütleb, milline sa oled.

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Why, anyone hearing this profile would be captivated by you!
et: No igaüks, kes seda profiili kuuleb, oleks sinust võlutud!

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
en: Thank you!
et: Aitäh!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouKnowSecretSaying
en: Oh? You know the secret saying!
et: Oh? Sa tead salaütlust!

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouKnowSecretSaying
en: That means you're now a fellow member of the MYSTERY EVENT CLUB!
et: See tähendab, et sa oled nüüd MYSTERY EVENT CLUBi kaasliige!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE'i!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Here, you may witness many kinds of POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.
et: Siin võid näha paljusid POKéMONide liike, keda HOENNIS harva näeb.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: And, you'll see them in their wild, untamed state in natural habitats.
et: Ja sa näed neid nende metsikus, taltsutamata olekus looduslikes elupaikades.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: What's more, we've thrown open the gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Veelgi enam, me oleme väravad POKéMON TRAINERITELE avanud.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: You're encouraged to catch POKéMON for keeps!
et: Sind julgustatakse POKéMONe endale püüdma!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE'i!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! Is it your first time here?
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE'i! Kas oled esimest korda siin?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE'i!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you start with 30 SAFARI BALLS for catching POKéMON.
et: Kui sisened SAFARI ZONE'i, alustad 30 SAFARI BALLiga POKéMONide püüdmiseks.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: The SAFARI Game is over when you run out of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've walked 500 steps.
et: SAFARI Mäng lõpeb, kui su SAFARI BALLid otsa saavad või kui oled kõndinud 500 sammu.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE'i!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE'i!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: All you can catch for just ¥500! Would you like to play a SAFARI Game?
et: Kõik, mida suudad püüda, vaid ¥500 eest! Kas sooviksid mängida SAFARI Mängu?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PlayAnotherTime
en: Okay. Please play another time!
et: Olgu. Palun mängi mõni teine kord!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have enough money. Sorry.
et: Sul pole piisavalt raha. Vabandust.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
en: That will be ¥500, please.
et: See teeb ¥500, palun.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_HereAreYourSafariBalls
en: Here are your SAFARI BALLS.
et: Siin on su SAFARI BALLid.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Received30SafariBalls
en: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.
et: {PLAYER} sai 30 SAFARI BALLi.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: We'll let you know when your game is over.
et: Me anname sulle teada, kui su mäng läbi saab.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: So, until then, enjoy yourself, please! Off you go on your wild excursion!
et: Nii et kuni selle ajani naudi end, palun! Mine aga oma metsikule ekskursioonile!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFull
en: Excuse me! Your PC BOX is full.
et: Vabandust! Su PC KAST on täis.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Excuse me! You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Vabandust! Näib, et sul pole {POKEBLOCK} CASE'i.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Your SAFARI Game will be much more fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Su SAFARI Mäng on palju viljakam, kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Please come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Palun tule tagasi {POKEBLOCK} CASE'iga.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: You may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.
et: Sa võid saada {POKEBLOCK} CASE'i LILYCOVE KONKURSI SAALIST.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
en: You still have time left. Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE now?
et: Sul on veel aega jäänud. Kas sooviksid nüüd SAFARI ZONE'ist väljuda?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
en: Please enjoy the rest of your wild adventure!
et: Palun naudi oma metsiku seikluse ülejäänud osa!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Okay.
et: Olgu.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: I'll take back your remaining SAFARI BALLS.
et: Ma võtan su ülejäänud SAFARI BALLid tagasi.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again.
et: Aitäh mängimast. Me loodame sind jälle näha.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: Good luck!
et: Edu!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me, please!
et: Kui midagi vajad, ära kõhkle mulle öelda, palun!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box, POKéMON gather around.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK}i sellesse nelinurksesse kasti, kogunevad POKéMONid ümber.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: I want to keep going deeper, but I forgot to bring a BIKE.
et: Ma tahan aina sügavamale minna, aga ma unustasin JALGRATTA kaasa võtta.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: Something tells me that rare POKéMON live in the outlying areas.
et: Miski ütleb mulle, et haruldased POKéMONid elavad äärealadel.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at POKéMON, it gets ignored.
et: Vahel, kui ma viskan POKéMONide pihta {POKEBLOCK}i, jäetakse see tähelepanuta.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Do POKéMON have likes and dislikes about what they eat?
et: Kas POKéMONidel on eelistused ja vastumeelsused selle suhtes, mida nad söövad?

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: Gasp… Gasp… I…made it out here…but…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Ma…jõudsin siia välja…aga…

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: I'm exhausted… I don't have the energy to catch POKéMON…
et: Ma olen kurnatud… Mul pole energiat POKéMONide püüdmiseks…

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON you don't see in HOENN.
et: Ma olen missioonil leida VEE-POKéMONe, keda HOENNIS ei näe.

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: Do you have any idea where the lake is?
et: Kas sul on aimu, kus järv on?

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
en: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON here and trade them with my friends!
et: Ma kavatsen siin palju haruldasi POKéMONe püüda ja neid oma sõpradega vahetada!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. But it seems to have disappeared.
et: Ma panin {POKEBLOCK}i {POKEBLOCK} SÖÖTJALE. Aga näib, et see on kadunud.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I guess POKéMON must have eaten it without me noticing.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMONid pidid selle ära sööma, ilma et ma märkaksin.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!
et: SAFARI ZONE TRAINERI NÕUANNE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: Throw {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make them less likely to flee.
et: Viska metsikute POKéMONide pihta {POKEBLOCK}e, et nad väiksema tõenäosusega põgeneksid.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
en: “Relieve your tired feet.” REST HOUSE
et: „Anna oma väsinud jalgadele puhkust.” PUHKEMAJA

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught a good number of POKéMON.
et: Mul pole ühtki {POKEBLOCK}i, aga ma püüdsin korraliku hulga POKéMONe.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: You can improve your chances of making a catch by getting closer to them before throwing a SAFARI BALL.
et: Sa võid parandada oma püügišansse, minnes neile lähemale, enne kui SAFARI BALLi viskad.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't be so quick to run away.
et: Kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}e, ei põgene metsikud POKéMONid nii kärmelt.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: It's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON that don't flee easily.
et: Pole eriti kasu anda {POKEBLOCK}e POKéMONidele, kes ei põgene kergesti.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER, POKéMON are attracted to it.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK}i SÖÖTJALE, tõmbab see POKéMONe ligi.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: I think POKéMON with the same sort of nature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.
et: Ma arvan, et sama sorti loomusega POKéMONe tõmbab ligi teatud {POKEBLOCK}.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See ala on veel ehitusjärgus. See on suletud, vabandust!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project is finished now.
et: SAFARI ZONE'i laiendusprojekt on nüüd valmis.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: We hope you will enjoy the new area.
et: Me loodame, et sa naudid uut ala.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See ala on veel ehitusjärgus. See on suletud, vabandust!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl
en: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of these POKéMON before!
et: Ohoo! Vihh! Ma pole ühtki neist POKéMONidest varem näinud!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: The POKéMON in this area are all new to me.
et: Selle ala POKéMONid on mulle kõik uued.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: And I'm allowed to catch these rare POKéMON! Too cool!
et: Ja mul on lubatud neid haruldasi POKéMONe püüda! Liiga lahe!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
en: The POKéMON around here seem to be from somewhere other than HOENN.
et: Näib, et siinsed POKéMONid on kuskilt mujalt kui HOENNIST.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.
et: Mul on jäänud vaid paar SAFARI BALLi.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I'm having a hard time trying to decide what I should catch.
et: Mul on raske otsustada, mida ma peaksin püüdma.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
en: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here. Where might one be?
et: Ma kuulsin, et siin võib näha PIKACHUT. Kus üks olla võiks?

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: Oh, boo! I can't seem to catch anything!
et: Oh, puu! Ma ei suuda vist midagi püüda!

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: I'll end up wasting the admission price if I don't catch something!
et: Ma raiskan lõpuks sissepääsutasu ära, kui midagi ei püüa!

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeCanBeClimbed
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.
et: Kui mõned väänid alla langevad, saab sellele puule ronida.

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeUseSecretPower
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.

label: SecretBase_Text_VineDroppedDown
en: A thick vine dropped down!
et: Jäme väänd langes alla!

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpOfGrass
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda rohutuusti saab liigutada, võib olla võimalik sisse minna.

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpUseSecretPower
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda rohutuusti saab liigutada, võib olla võimalik sisse minna.

et: Kasutada SECRET POWERit?

label: SecretBase_Text_DiscoveredSmallEntrance
en: Discovered a small entrance!
et: Avastati väike sissepääs!

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: All decorations and furniture in your SECRET BASE will be returned to your PC.
et: Kõik kaunistused ja mööbel su SALABAASIS tagastatakse su PC-sse.

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: Is that okay?
et: Kas on okei?

label: SecretBase_Text_WantToRegisterSecretBase
en: Do you want to register {STR_VAR_1}'s SECRET BASE?
et: Kas tahad registreerida {STR_VAR_1} SALABAASI?

label: SecretBase_Text_AlreadyRegisteredDelete
en: This data is already registered. Would you like to delete it?
et: Need andmed on juba registreeritud. Kas sooviksid need kustutada?

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Up to 10 locations can be registered.
et: Registreerida saab kuni 10 asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Delete a location if you want to register another location.
et: Kustuta üks asukoht, kui tahad registreerida teise asukoha.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistrationCompleted
en: Registration completed.
et: Registreerimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_DataUnregistered
en: Data has been unregistered.
et: Andmed on registrist eemaldatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_BootUpPC
en: {PLAYER} booted up the PC.
et: {PLAYER} käivitas PC.

label: SecretBase_Text_WhatWouldYouLikeToDo
en: What would you like to do?
et: Mida sa sooviksid teha?

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not disappear unless the other TRAINER moves it to a different location.
et: Kui SALABAAS on registreeritud, ei kao see, välja arvatud juhul, kui teine TRAINER selle teise kohta liigutab.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: If a SECRET BASE is deleted from the registered list, another one may take its place.
et: Kui SALABAAS kustutatakse registreeritud nimekirjast, võib mõni teine selle koha üle võtta.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Up to ten SECRET BASE locations may be registered.
et: Registreerida saab kuni kümme SALABAASI asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_BattleTowerShield
en: A shield of {STR_VAR_2} that marks winning {STR_VAR_1} times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.
et: {STR_VAR_2} kilp, mis tähistab {STR_VAR_1} korda järjest võitmist BATTLE TOWERIS.

label: SecretBase_Text_ToyTV
en: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily mistaken for the real thing.
et: Realistlik mänguteler. Selle võiks kergesti pärisasjaga segamini ajada.

label: SecretBase_Text_SeedotTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT. It looks ready to roll away on its own…
et: SEEDOTi kujuline mänguteler. Näib, nagu oleks valmis ise minema veerema…

label: SecretBase_Text_SkittyTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY. It looks ready to stroll away…
et: SKITTY kujuline mänguteler. Näib, nagu oleks valmis ise minema jalutama…

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: You may only make one SECRET BASE.
et: Sa võid teha ainult ühe SALABAASI.

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: Would you like to move from the SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas sooviksid kolida SALABAASIST {STR_VAR_1} lähedal?

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Moving completed.
et: Kolimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Would you like to use the SECRET POWER?
et: Kas sooviksid kasutada SECRET POWERit?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: What's that? What am I doing?
et: Mis see on? Mida ma teen?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I'm thinking about making my own room here using a POKéMON move.
et: Ma mõtlen siia oma toa tegemisele POKéMONi võtet kasutades.

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I know! I'll give you this TM. Will you use it to make your own room?
et: Ma tean! Ma annan sulle selle TM-i. Kas kasutad seda, et teha oma tuba?

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Find a big tree that looks like it might drop some vines.
et: Leia suur puu, mis näeb välja, nagu võiks mõned väänid alla lasta.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Use SECRET POWER in front of the tree. Some vines should get free and drop down, so you can climb the tree.
et: Kasuta SECRET POWERit puu ees. Mõned väänid peaksid vabanema ja alla langema, nii et saad puule ronida.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You'll find a lot of space for putting your favorite things.
et: Sa leiad palju ruumi oma lemmikasjade paigutamiseks.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: It'll be your own secret room… A SECRET BASE!
et: See saab sinu enda salatuba… SALABAAS!

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You should make one, too.
et: Sinagi peaksid ühe tegema.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Another thing, you don't always have to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.
et: Veel üks asi, sa ei pea oma SALABAASI alati puusse tegema.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Try using SECRET POWER on rock walls that have small indents in them.
et: Proovi kasutada SECRET POWERit kaljuseintel, milles on väikesed süvendid.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: I'm going to look for other places, too. Okay, bye!
et: Ma lähen otsin ka teisi kohti. Olgu, nägemist!

label: Route111_Text_DontWantThis
en: Oh, you don't want this? If you change your mind, tell me, okay?
et: Oh, sa ei taha seda? Kui meelt muudad, ütle mulle, eks?

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: Oh, you don't have any room for this.
et: Oh, sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back for it another time, okay?
et: Ma hoian selle alles, nii et tule sellele mõni teine kord järele, eks?

label: SecretBase_Text_SmallIndentInWall
en: There's a small indent in the wall.
et: Seinas on väike süvend.

label: SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower
en: There's a small indent in the wall.

et: Tahad teha oma SALABAASI siia?

label: gDummyPokedexText
en: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is currently under investigation. No detailed information is available at this time.
et: See on äsja avastatud POKéMON. Praegu seda uuritakse. Hetkel pole täpsemat teavet saadaval.
raw:
This is a newly discovered POKéMON.
It is currently under investigation.
No detailed information is available
at this time.

label: gBulbasaurPokedexText
en: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
et: BULBASAURi võib näha eredas päikesevalguses tukkumas. Ta seljal on seeme. Päikesekiiri imedes kasvab seeme järjest suuremaks.
raw:
BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright
sunlight. There is a seed on its back.
By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed
grows progressively larger.

label: gIvysaurPokedexText
en: To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
et: Et sibulat toetada, kasvavad IVYSAURi jalad tugevaks. Kui ta veedab rohkem aega päikese käes lamades, puhkeb pung peagi suureks õieks.
raw:
To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs
grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in
the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into
a large flower.

label: gVenusaurPokedexText
en: VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
et: Öeldakse, et VENUSAURi õis omandab erksad värvid, kui ta saab rohkelt toitaineid ja päikest. Õie aroom rahustab inimeste tundeid.
raw:
VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid
colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and
sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the
emotions of people.

label: gCharmanderPokedexText
en: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
et: Leek, mis põleb ta saba tipus, näitab ta tundeid. Kui CHARMANDER on rõõmus, leek võbeleb, ja kui ta on raevus, see lõõmab.
raw:
The flame that burns at the tip of its
tail is an indication of its emotions.
The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is
happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

label: gCharmeleonPokedexText
en: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
et: Halastamatult hävitavad ta teravad küünised vaenlasi. Kui ta kohtab tugevat vaenlast, muutub ta ärevaks ja saba leek lõõmab sinakasvalgena.
raw:
Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes.
If it encounters a strong enemy, it
becomes agitated, and the flame on its
tail flares with a bluish white color.

label: gCharizardPokedexText
en: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
et: CHARIZARD lendab ringi, otsides tugevaid vastaseid. Ta hingab ägedaid leeke, mis suudavad sulatada iga materjali. Kuid ta ei kõrveta kunagi nõrgemat vaenlast.
raw:
A CHARIZARD flies about in search of
strong opponents. It breathes intense
flames that can melt any material. However,
it will never torch a weaker foe.

label: gSquirtlePokedexText
en: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.
et: Ta kilp pole ainult kaitseks. Selle ümar kuju ja pinna sooned vähendavad vees takistust, võimaldades SQUIRTLEl suurel kiirusel ujuda.
raw:
Its shell is not just for protection.
Its rounded shape and the grooves on its
surface minimize resistance in water,
enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.

label: gWartortlePokedexText
en: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON's toughness in battle.
et: Ta suurt saba katab rikkalik paks karv, mis vanusega tumeneb. Kilbi kriimustused annavad tunnistust selle POKéMONi karastatusest lahingus.
raw:
Its large tail is covered with rich, thick
fur that deepens in color with age.
The scratches on its shell are evidence
of this POKéMON's toughness in battle.

label: gBlastoisePokedexText
en: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
et: Ta kilbist väljaulatuvad veejoad on väga täpsed. Nende veekuulid suudavad tabada plekkpurke enam kui 50 meetri kauguselt.
raw:
The waterspouts that protrude from its
shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of
water can precisely nail tin cans from
a distance of over 160 feet.

label: gCaterpiePokedexText
en: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
et: Ta ahne isu sunnib teda kõhklemata neelama endast suuremaid lehti. Ta antennidest eritub kohutavalt tugev lõhn.
raw:
Its voracious appetite compels it to
devour leaves bigger than itself without
hesitation. It releases a terribly strong
odor from its antennae.

label: gMetapodPokedexText
en: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A METAPOD does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.
et: Ta kilp on kõva nagu raudplaat. METAPOD ei liigu eriti palju, sest ta valmistab kilbi sees oma pehmet sisemust arenguks ette.
raw:
Its shell is as hard as an iron slab.
A METAPOD does not move very much
because it is preparing its soft innards
for evolution inside the shell.

label: gButterfreePokedexText
en: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.
et: Tal on suurepärane võime otsida õitest maitsvat mett. Ta oskab leida, ammutada ja kanda mett õitelt, mis õitsevad üle kümne kilomeetri kaugusel.
raw:
It has a superior ability to search for
delicious honey from flowers. It can seek,
extract, and carry honey from flowers
blooming over six miles away.

label: gWeedlePokedexText
en: A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
et: WEEDLEl on äärmiselt terav haistmismeel. Ta eristab oma lemmiklehti neist, mis talle ei meeldi, nuusutades neid suure punase koonuga.
raw:
A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense
of smell. It distinguishes its favorite
kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by
sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

label: gKakunaPokedexText
en: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.
et: Ta püsib peaaegu liikumatuna, klammerdudes puu külge. Seesmiselt valmistub ta aga usinasti arenguks. Seda näitab, kui kuumaks ta kilp muutub.
raw:
It remains virtually immobile while it
clings to a tree. However, on the inside,
it busily prepares for evolution. This is
evident from how hot its shell becomes.

label: gBeedrillPokedexText
en: A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.
et: BEEDRILL on äärmiselt territoriaalne. Ohutuse huvides ei tohiks keegi kunagi ta pesale läheneda. Vihastades ründavad nad sülemina.
raw:
A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.
For safety reasons, no one should 
ever approach its nest. If angered,
they will attack in a swarm.

label: gPidgeyPokedexText
en: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
et: Tal on äärmiselt terav suunataju. Ta leiab eksimatult tee koju oma pessa, ükskõik kui kaugele ta tuttavast ümbrusest on viidud.
raw:
It has an extremely sharp sense of
direction. It can unerringly return home to
its nest, however far it may be removed
from its familiar surroundings.

label: gPidgeottoPokedexText
en: This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
et: See POKéMON lendab ringi, patrullides oma suurt territooriumi. Kui ta eluruumi rikutakse, ei halasta ta teravate küüntega vaenlast põhjalikult karistada.
raw:
This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its
large territory. If its living space is
violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly
punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

label: gPidgeotPokedexText
en: This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.
et: Sellel POKéMONil on uhked läikivad suled. Paljud TRAINERid on ta pea kaunitest sulgedest nii lummatud, et valivad PIDGEOTi oma POKéMONiks.
raw:
This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy
feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated
by the beautiful feathers on its head that
they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

label: gRattataPokedexText
en: A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.
et: RATTATA on ülimalt ettevaatlik. Isegi magades liigutab ta pidevalt kõrvu ja kuulatab ohtu. Ta teeb pesa ükskõik kuhu.
raw:
A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.
Even while it is asleep, it constantly
moves its ears and listens for danger.
It will make its nest anywhere.

label: gRaticatePokedexText
en: A RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
et: RATICATE tugevad kihvad kasvavad pidevalt. Et neid maha lihvida, näkib ta kive ja palke. Ta võib närida isegi majaseinu.
raw:
A RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.
To keep them ground down, it gnaws on
rocks and logs. It may even chew on the
walls of houses.

label: gSpearowPokedexText
en: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
et: Ta valju kisa on kuulda enam kui kilomeetri kaugusele. Kui ta kõrget kaeblikku kisa on kõikjal kuulda, on see märk, et nad hoiatavad üksteist ohu eest.
raw:
Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile
away. If its high, keening cry is heard
echoing all around, it is a sign that they
are warning each other of danger.

label: gFearowPokedexText
en: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.
et: Ta pikk kael ja piklik nokk sobivad ideaalselt saagi püüdmiseks pinnasest või veest. Ta liigutab osavalt seda pikka peenikest nokka, et saaki napata.
raw:
Its long neck and elongated beak are
ideal for catching prey in soil or water.
It deftly moves this extended and skinny
beak to pluck prey.

label: gEkansPokedexText
en: An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.
et: EKANS keerdub puhkamise ajaks spiraali. See asend võimaldab tal kiiresti reageerida vaenlasele igast suunast, ähvardades püstitõstetud peaga.
raw:
An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while
it rests. This position allows it to quickly
respond to an enemy from any direction
with a threat from its upraised head.

label: gArbokPokedexText
en: This POKéMON has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.
et: Sellel POKéMONil on hirmuäratavalt tugev pigistusjõud. Ta suudab lapikuks litsuda isegi terasest naftavaate. Kui ta keha vaenlase ümber mähib, on põgenemine võimatu.
raw:
This POKéMON has a terrifically strong
constricting power. It can even flatten
steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body
around its foe, escaping is impossible.

label: gPikachuPokedexText
en: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
et: Ta salvestab elektrit põskede elektrikottidesse. Kui ta vallandab kogutud energia pahvakuna, võrdub elektrijõud välgunoolega.
raw:
It stores electricity in the electric sacs
on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up
energy in a burst, the electric power is
equal to a lightning bolt.

label: gRaichuPokedexText
en: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.
et: Kui ta salvestab liiga palju elektrit, muutub ta käitumine agressiivseks. Selle vältimiseks laseb ta aeg-ajalt liigse energia välja ja rahuneb.
raw:
If it stores too much electricity, its
behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this,
it occasionally discharges excess energy
and calms itself down.

label: gSandshrewPokedexText
en: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.
et: Kui ta keeb kerra, suudab ta panna iga rünnaku kahjutult tagasi põrkama. Ta nahk on kõrbes elamise tõttu muutunud sitkeks ja tugevaks.
raw:
When it curls up in a ball, it can make any
attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has
turned tough and solid as a result of
living in the desert.

label: gSandslashPokedexText
en: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.
et: Ta keerdub kerra, et kaitsta end vaenlase rünnakute eest. Samuti keerdub ta kerra, et vältida päeval kuumarabandust, kui temperatuur järsult tõuseb.
raw:
It curls up in a ball to protect itself from
enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent
heatstroke during the daytime when
temperatures rise sharply.

label: gNidoranFPokedexText
en: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this smallbodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
et: Arvatakse, et ta väga mürgised okkad on välja arenenud selle väikesekehalise POKéMONi kaitseks. Vihastades vabastab ta sarvest kohutava mürgi.
raw:
Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have
developed as protection for this small-
bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases
a horrible toxin from its horn.

label: gNidorinaPokedexText
en: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
et: Kui ta on sõprade või perega, on okkad ära peidetud, et vältida vigastusi. Teistest eraldatuna näib ta muutuvat närviliseks.
raw:
When it is with its friends or
family, its barbs are tucked away to
prevent injury. It appears to become
nervous if separated from the others.

label: gNidoqueenPokedexText
en: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This POKéMON is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
et: Ta oskab osavalt vaenlasi minema paisata karmide rammidega, kasutades oma sitket soomuskeha. See POKéMON on kõige tugevam, kui ta kaitseb oma poegi.
raw:
It is adept at sending foes flying with
harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body.
This POKéMON is at its strongest when
it is defending its young.

label: gNidoranMPokedexText
en: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON's notice.
et: Isane NIDORAN on arendanud lihaseid, mis liigutavad kõrvu vabalt igas suunas. Isegi väikseim heli ei jää sellel POKéMONil märkamata.
raw:
The male NIDORAN has developed muscles
that freely move its ears in any direction.
Even the slightest sound does not escape
this POKéMON's notice.

label: gNidorinoPokedexText
en: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
et: Ta sarv on kõvem kui teemant. Kui ta tajub vaenulikkust, tõusevad kõik ta selja okkad korraga püsti ja ta esitab vaenlasele kogu jõust väljakutse.
raw:
Its horn is harder than a diamond.
