If it senses a hostile presence, all the
barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it
challenges the foe with all its might.

label: gNidokingPokedexText
en: A NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
et: NIDOKINGi paks saba peidab tohutut hävitavat jõudu, mis suudab kummutada metallist tornmasti. Kui ta märatsema hakkab, ei suuda teda miski peatada.
raw:
A NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously
destructive power capable of toppling
a metal transmission tower. Once it goes
on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

label: gClefairyPokedexText
en: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
et: Igal täiskuuööl tulevad nad mängima. Koidu saabudes lähevad väsinud CLEFAIRYd sügavates vaiksetes mägedes üksteise vastu magama.
raw:
On every night of a full moon, they come
out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired
CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against
each other in deep and quiet mountains.

label: gClefablePokedexText
en: A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
et: CLEFABLE kasutab tiibu, et kergelt hüpelda, justkui lendaks. Ta vetruv samm laseb tal isegi vee peal kõndida. Vaiksetel kuuvalgetel öödel jalutab ta järvedel.
raw:
A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly 
as if it were flying. Its bouncy step
lets it even walk on water. On quiet,
moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

label: gVulpixPokedexText
en: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
et: Ta oskab tuld vabalt juhtida, pannes tulekerad lendama nagu virvatuled. Vahetult enne arengut kuumenevad ta kuus saba, justkui põleksid.
raw:
It can freely control fire, making fiery
orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just
before evolution, its six tails grow hot 
as if on fire.

label: gNinetalesPokedexText
en: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
et: Kaua on räägitud, et igas ta üheksast sabast peitub nõiavägi. Kaua elanud NINETALESil on karv, mis läigib nagu kuld.
raw:
It has long been said that each of the
nine tails embody an enchanted power.
A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that
shines like gold.

label: gJigglypuffPokedexText
en: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
et: Miski ei suuda JIGGLYPUFFi laulu kuuldes uinumast pääseda. Ta lauluhääle helilained sobituvad sügavas unes oleva inimese ajulainetega.
raw:
Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a
JIGGLYPUFF's song. The sound waves of its
singing voice match the brain waves of
someone in a deep sleep.

label: gWigglytuffPokedexText
en: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
et: Ta karv on ülim luksus. WIGGLYTUFFi kõrval magamine on lihtsalt jumalik. Sisse hingates paisub ta keha justkui lõputult.
raw:
Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness.
Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply
divine. Its body expands seemingly without
end when it inhales.

label: gZubatPokedexText
en: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
et: Elades pilkpimedates koobastes, kasvasid nende silmad tasapisi kinni ja jätsid nad nägemisest ilma. Takistuste tajumiseks kasutavad nad ultrahelilaineid.
raw:
While living in pitch-black caverns, their
eyes gradually grew shut and deprived
them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves
to detect obstacles.

label: gGolbatPokedexText
en: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and POKéMON. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.
et: Ta kihvad läbistavad kergesti isegi paksu loomanahka. Ta armastab pidutseda inimeste ja POKéMONide vere kallal. Ta lendleb pimeduses ja ründab selja tagant.
raw:
Its fangs easily puncture even thick
animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood
of people and POKéMON. It flits about in
darkness and strikes from behind.

label: gOddishPokedexText
en: This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.
et: See POKéMON kasvab kuuvalgust imedes. Päeval matab ta end maasse, jättes vaid lehed välja, et vaenlased teda ei märkaks.
raw:
This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight.
During the daytime, it buries itself in the
ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to
avoid detection by its enemies.

label: gGloomPokedexText
en: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
et: Ta suust nõrgub kohutavalt mürgist mett. Üksainus lõhnasõõm võib põhjustada mälukaotuse. Mõned fännid nautivat aga seda ülekaalukat hõngu.
raw:
A horribly noxious honey drools from its
mouth. One whiff of the honey can result
in memory loss. Some fans are said to
enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

label: gVileplumePokedexText
en: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.
et: Hooaegadel, mil ta toodab rohkem õietolmu, muutub VILEPLUME ümbritsev õhk ta kõndides pulbrist kollaseks. Õietolm on väga mürgine ja põhjustab halvatust.
raw:
In seasons when it produces more pollen,
the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow
with the powder as it walks. The pollen is
highly toxic and causes paralysis.

label: gParasPokedexText
en: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.
et: PARASel kasvavad seljal parasiitseened tochukaso. Need kasvavad, ammutades peremehest toitaineid. Neid hinnatakse pikaealisuse rohuna.
raw:
A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso
mushrooms growing on its back. They grow
by drawing nutrients from the host. They
are valued as a medicine for long life.

label: gParasectPokedexText
en: PARASECT are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
et: PARASECTid on tuntud sellega, et nakatavad massiliselt suurte puude juuri ja kurnavad toitaineid. Kui nakatatud puu sureb, kolivad nad korraga teisele puule.
raw:
PARASECT are known to infest the roots of
large trees en masse and drain nutrients.
When an infested tree dies, they move
onto another tree all at once.

label: gVenonatPokedexText
en: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
et: Öeldakse, et ta kogu keha kattev õhuke jäik karv on välja arenenud kaitseks. Ta suured silmad ei jäta märkamata isegi tillukest saaki.
raw:
Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers
its entire body is said to have evolved
for protection. Its large eyes never fail
to spot even miniscule prey.

label: gVenomothPokedexText
en: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
et: VENOMOTHid on öölised — nad on aktiivsed vaid öösel. Nende lemmiksaak on putukad, kes kogunevad tänavalampide ümber, pimeduses valgusest ligi meelitatuna.
raw:
VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are
active at night. Their favorite prey are
insects that gather around streetlights,
attracted by the light in the darkness.

label: gDiglettPokedexText
en: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.
et: DIGLETTe kasvatatakse enamikus taludes. Põhjus on lihtne — kuhu iganes nad urgu kaevavad, jääb pinnas maitsvate viljade kasvatamiseks ideaalselt haritud.
raw:
DIGLETT are raised in most farms.
The reason is simple--wherever they
burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled
for growing delicious crops.

label: gDugtrioPokedexText
en: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
et: Kuna kolmikud pärinevad algselt ühest kehast, mõtlevad nad täpselt ühtemoodi. Nad töötavad koostöös, et lõputult läbi maa kaevata.
raw:
Because the triplets originally split from
one body, they think exactly alike.
They work cooperatively to burrow
endlessly through the ground.

label: gMeowthPokedexText
en: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
et: MEOWTH tõmbab teravad küünised käppadesse, et vaikselt ringi hiilida. Millegipärast armastab see POKéMON läikivaid münte, mis valguses sätendavad.
raw:
MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into
their paws to silently sneak about.
For some reason, this POKéMON loves
shiny coins that glitter with light.

label: gPersianPokedexText
en: A PERSIAN's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
et: PERSIANI kuus julget vurru tajuvad õhu liikumist, et määrata, mis on ta läheduses. Vurrudest haaratuna muutub ta taltsaks.
raw:
A PERSIAN's six bold whiskers sense air
movements to determine what is in its
vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed
by the whiskers.

label: gPsyduckPokedexText
en: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
et: Kui ta peavalu ägenevad, hakkab ta kasutama imelikke jõude. Kuid ta ei mäleta oma jõude, nii et ta näeb alati jahmunud ja hämmingus välja.
raw:
When its headache intensifies, it starts
using strange powers. However, it has no
recollection of its powers, so it always
looks befuddled and bewildered.

label: gGolduckPokedexText
en: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
et: GOLDUCK on osav ujuja. Ta liitub vahel võistlusujujatega treeningul. Ta kasutab vaimseid jõude, kui ta laup valgusest sätendab.
raw:
A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer.
It sometimes joins competitive swimmers
in training. It uses psychic powers when
its forehead shimmers with light.

label: gMankeyPokedexText
en: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
et: Kui ta hakkab värisema ja ta ninahingamine muutub raskeks, on see kindel märk vihast. Kuid kuna see juhtub silmapilkselt, pole aega põgeneda.
raw:
When it starts shaking and its nasal
breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign
of anger. However, since this happens
instantly, there is no time to flee.

label: gPrimeapePokedexText
en: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
et: Kui ta raevu läheb, muutub ta vereringe jõulisemaks ja lihased tugevamaks. Kuid ta muutub ka palju vähem arukaks.
raw:
When it becomes furious, its blood
circulation becomes more robust, and
its muscles are made stronger. But it
also becomes much less intelligent.

label: gGrowlithePokedexText
en: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
et: Ta suurepärane haistmismeel tagab, et see POKéMON ei unusta ühtki lõhna, ükskõik mis. Ta kasutab haistmist teiste tunnete tuvastamiseks.
raw:
Its superb sense of smell ensures that
this POKéMON won't forget any scent,
no matter what. It uses its sense of smell
to detect the emotions of others.

label: gArcaninePokedexText
en: This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
et: Öeldakse, et see väledajalgne POKéMON jookseb ühe ööpäevaga üle 10 000 kilomeetri. Ta jõu allikaks on tuli, mis metsikult ta kehas lõõmab.
raw:
This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run
over 6,200 miles in a single day and night.
The fire that blazes wildly within its body
is its source of power.

label: gPoliwagPokedexText
en: It is possible to see this POKéMON's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
et: Selle POKéMONi keerulist sisikonda on läbi ta õhukese naha näha. Nahk on aga ka väga elastne. Isegi teravad kihvad põrkavad sellelt tagasi.
raw:
It is possible to see this POKéMON's spiral
innards right through its thin skin.
However, the skin is also very flexible.
Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

label: gPoliwhirlPokedexText
en: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
et: Ta kehapind on alati märg ja libe õlise vedelikuga. Selle rasvase katte tõttu libiseb ta lahingus kergesti iga vaenlase haardest välja.
raw:
Its body surface is always wet and slick
with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy
covering, it can easily slip and slide out
of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

label: gPoliwrathPokedexText
en: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
et: Ta hästi arenenud lihased ei väsi kunagi, ükskõik kui palju ta harjutab. See POKéMON suudab vaevata ujuda edasi-tagasi üle Vaikse ookeani.
raw:
Its highly developed muscles never grow
fatigued, however much it exercises.
This POKéMON can swim back and forth
across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

label: gAbraPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
et: POKéMON, kes magab 18 tundi päevas. Vaatlus näitas, et ta kasutab TELEPORTi, et kord tunnis oma asukohta muuta.
raw:
A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day.
Observation revealed that it uses
TELEPORT to change its location once
every hour.

label: gKadabraPokedexText
en: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
et: Räägitakse, et vaimsete võimetega poiss muutus ootamatult KADABRAKS, kui ta abistas uurimistööd üleaistiliste jõudude alal.
raw:
It is rumored that a boy with psychic
abilities suddenly transformed into
KADABRA while he was assisting research
into extrasensory powers.

label: gAlakazamPokedexText
en: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.
et: Kuigi tal on tugevad vaimsed võimed ja kõrge intelligents, on ALAKAZAMi lihased väga nõrgad. Keha liigutamiseks kasutab ta vaimset jõudu.
raw:
While it has strong psychic abilities and
high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM's muscles
are very weak. It uses psychic power to
move its body.

label: gMachopPokedexText
en: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
et: Ta harjutab pidevalt rasket treeningut, et omandada kõik võitluskunstid. Ta jõud laseb tal kergesti tõsta sumomaadleja õlgadele.
raw:
It continually undertakes strenuous
training to master all forms of martial
arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist
a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

label: gMachokePokedexText
en: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.
et: MACHOKE kannab vööd, et hoida oma ülekaalukat jõudu kontrolli all. Kuna see on nii ohtlik, pole keegi kunagi vööd eemaldanud.
raw:
A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its
overwhelming power under control.
Because it is so dangerous, no one has
ever removed the belt.

label: gMachampPokedexText
en: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.
et: Ta nelja käega jagatud löökide ja raiete vastu on võimatu kaitsta. Ta võitlusvaim lõõmab, kui ta seisab silmitsi kõva vastasega.
raw:
It is impossible to defend against punches
and chops doled out by its four arms.
Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces
a tough opponent.

label: gBellsproutPokedexText
en: A BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
et: BELLSPROUTi õhuke painduv keha laseb tal painduda ja õõtsuda, et vältida iga rünnakut, ükskõik kui tugev. Ta suust nõrgub vedelik, mis sulatab isegi rauda.
raw:
A BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body lets
it bend and sway to avoid any attack,
however strong it may be. From its mouth,
it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

label: gWeepinbellPokedexText
en: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
et: Öösel ripub WEEPINBELL konksja tagakehaga puuoksa küljes ja magab. Kui ta unes liigub, võib ta ärgates leida end maast.
raw:
At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree
branch with its hooked rear and sleeps.
If it moves around in its sleep, it may
wake up to find itself on the ground.

label: gVictreebelPokedexText
en: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
et: Ta peast ulatuvat pikka vääti vibutatakse, justkui oleks see elus, et saaki ligi meelitada. Kui pahaaimamatu ohver läheneb, neelatakse ta tervelt alla.
raw:
The long vine extending from its head is
waved about as if it were a living thing to
attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim
approaches, it is swallowed whole.

label: gTentacoolPokedexText
en: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
et: Ta keha koosneb peaaegu täielikult veest. Ta püüab vaenlase kahe pika kombitsaga, seejärel torkab nende tippudes olevate mürgiastladega.
raw:
Its body is almost entirely composed of
water. It ensnares its foe with its two
long tentacles, then stabs with the poison
stingers at their tips.

label: gTentacruelPokedexText
en: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
et: Ta elab ookeanipõhja keerukates kaljumoodustistes ja püüab saaki 80 kombitsa abil. Ta punased kerad hõõguvad, kui ta erutub või ärritub.
raw:
It lives in complex rock formations on
the ocean floor and traps prey using its
80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it
grows excited or agitated.

label: gGeodudePokedexText
en: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
et: Ta ronib mäeradadel üles ainult käte jõul. Kuna nad näevad välja täpselt nagu radu ääristavad rahnud, võivad matkajad neile märkamatult peale astuda.
raw:
It climbs mountain paths using only the
power of its arms. Because they look just
like boulders lining paths, hikers may step
on them without noticing.

label: gGravelerPokedexText
en: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
et: Nad laskuvad mägedelt, veeredes mööda järske nõlvu alla. Nad on nii jõhkrad, et purustavad äikeselaadsete rammidega teele jäävad puud ja hiigelrahnud.
raw:
They descend from mountains by tumbling
down steep slopes. They are so brutal,
they smash aside obstructing trees and
massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

label: gGolemPokedexText
en: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
et: Öeldakse, et ta elab mäetippude vulkaanikraatrites. Kord aastas heidab ta naha ja kasvab suuremaks. Heidetud nahk pudeneb ja naaseb pinnasesse.
raw:
It is said to live in volcanic craters
on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds
its hide and grows larger. The shed hide
crumbles and returns to the soil.

label: gPonytaPokedexText
en: A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
et: PONYTA on sündides väga nõrk. Ta suudab vaevu püsti seista. Ta jalad tugevnevad, kui ta komistab ja kukub, üritades vanemaga sammu pidada.
raw:
A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can
barely stand up. Its legs become stronger
as it stumbles and falls while trying to
keep up with its parent.

label: gRapidashPokedexText
en: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
et: Tavaliselt traavib ta väljadel ja tasandikel muretult. Kuid kui RAPIDASH tõsiseks läheb, lõõmavad ta tulised lakad, kui ta kihutab kiirusega kuni 240 km/h.
raw:
It usually canters casually in the fields
and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns
serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze
as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

label: gSlowpokePokedexText
en: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.
et: Ta püüab saaki, kastes saba jõe ääres vette. Kuid tihti unustab ta, mida teeb, ja veedab terveid päevi lihtsalt vee ääres logeledes.
raw:
It catches prey by dipping its tail in
water at the side of a river. But it often
forgets what it is doing and spends entire
days just loafing at water's edge.

label: gSlowbroPokedexText
en: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
et: Ta saba küljes on SHELLDER, kes on end kinni hammustanud. Selle tõttu ei saa saba enam kalastamiseks kasutada. See sunnib teda vastumeelselt ujuma ja saaki püüdma.
raw:
Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached
with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be
used for fishing anymore. This forces it
to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

label: gMagnemitePokedexText
en: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
et: Ta külgedel olevad üksused on äärmiselt võimsad magnetid. Nad tekitavad piisavalt magnetismi, et tõmmata raudesemeid ligi enam kui 90 meetri kauguselt.
raw:
The units at its sides are extremely
powerful magnets. They generate enough
magnetism to draw in iron objects from
over 300 feet away.

label: gMagnetonPokedexText
en: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
et: See on tegelikult kolm MAGNEMITEt, mis on magnetismiga ühendatud. Ta tekitab võimsaid raadiolaineid, mis tõstavad temperatuuri 1 km raadiuses.
raw:
It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked
by magnetism. It generates powerful radio
waves that raise temperatures by 3.6
degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

label: gFarfetchdPokedexText
en: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
et: Teda nähakse alati taimekepiga. Ilmselt on olemas head ja halvad kepid. See POKéMON tülitseb vahel teistega hea kepi pärast.
raw:
It is always seen with a stick from a plant.
Apparently, there are good sticks and bad
sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights
with others over choice sticks.

label: gDoduoPokedexText
en: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.
et: Isegi süües või magades jääb üks pea alati ohu suhtes valvsaks. Ohu korral põgeneb ta kiirusega üle 90 km/h.
raw:
Even while eating or sleeping, one of the
heads remains always vigilant for any sign
of danger. When threatened, it flees at
over 60 miles per hour.

label: gDodrioPokedexText
en: A peculiar POKéMON species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.
et: Omapärane POKéMON-liik kolme peaga. Ta kihutab jõuliselt üle rohtunud tasandike isegi kuivadel hooaegadel, mil sajab vähe vihma.
raw:
A peculiar POKéMON species with three
heads. It vigorously races across grassy
plains even in arid seasons with little
rainfall.

label: gSeelPokedexText
en: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
et: SEELid jahivad saaki jäätunud külmades meredes. Kui tal on vaja hingata, lööb ta pea teravalt väljaulatuva osaga jäässe augu.
raw:
SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered
seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches
a hole through the ice with the sharply
protruding section of its head.

label: gDewgongPokedexText
en: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
et: Ta armastab tukkuda kibekülmal jääl. Meremees pidas kaua aega ekslikult sellel POKéMONil liustikul magamist näkiks.
raw:
It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice.
The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on
a glacier was mistakenly thought to be
a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

label: gGrimerPokedexText
en: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
et: Sündinud mere saastunud solgist, on GRIMERi lemmiktoiduks kõik räpane. Ta toitub tehastest välja pumbatud reoveest.
raw:
Born from polluted sludge in the sea,
GRIMER's favorite food is anything filthy.
They feed on wastewater pumped out from
factories.

label: gMukPokedexText
en: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
et: Ta eelistab sooje ja niiskeid elupaiku. Suvel ägenevad ta kehas olevad mürgised ained, pannes MUKi haisema nagu mäda köögiprügi.
raw:
It prefers warm and humid habitats.
In the summertime, the toxic substances
in its body intensify, making MUK reek like
putrid kitchen garbage.

label: gShellderPokedexText
en: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
et: Öösel kaevab ta laia keelega ookeanipõhja augu, et teha magamiskoht. Magades sulgeb ta kilbi, kuid jätab keele välja rippuma.
raw:
At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor
with its broad tongue to make a place to
sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell,
but leaves its tongue hanging out.

label: gCloysterPokedexText
en: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
et: Ta ujub meres, neelates vett ja pahvatades selle taha välja. CLOYSTER tulistab kilbist okkaid sama süsteemi abil.
raw:
It swims in the sea by swallowing water,
then jetting it out toward the rear.
The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its
shell using the same system.

label: gGastlyPokedexText
en: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
et: Tugeva tuule käes kahaneb GASTLY gaasiline keha kiiresti. Nad kogunevad tuule laastamise eest majade räästaste alla.
raw:
When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY's
gaseous body quickly dwindles away.
They cluster under the eaves of houses
to escape the ravages of wind.

label: gHaunterPokedexText
en: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
et: Kui HAUNTER sind pimeduses hõljudes viipab, ära lähene. See POKéMON üritab sind keelega lakkuda ja su elu röövida.
raw:
If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is
floating in darkness, don't approach it.
This POKéMON will try to lick you with its
tongue and steal your life away.

label: gGengarPokedexText
en: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
et: Sügaval öösel võib su vari, mille heidab tänavalatern, sind ootamatult mööda joosta. Tegelikult on see GENGAR, kes su vari olles sinust mööda jookseb.
raw:
Deep in the night, your shadow cast by
a streetlight may suddenly overtake you.
It is actually a GENGAR running past
you, pretending to be your shadow.

label: gOnixPokedexText
en: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
et: Ta ajus on magnet, mis takistab ONIXil tunneldades suunda kaotamast. Vanemaks saades muutub ta keha järjest ümaramaks ja siledamaks.
raw:
There is a magnet in its brain that
prevents an ONIX from losing direction
while tunneling. As it grows older, its body
becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

label: gDrowzeePokedexText
en: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
et: Kui su nina magades sügeleb, on see kindel märk, et DROWZEE seisab su padja kohal ja üritab su unenägu ninasõõrmetest välja süüa.
raw:
If your nose becomes itchy while you are
sleeping, it's a sure sign that a DROWZEE is
standing above your pillow and trying to
eat your dream through your nostrils.

label: gHypnoPokedexText
en: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
et: HYPNO käes oleva pendli kaarjas liikumine ja sära uinutavad vaenlase sügavasse hüpnoosi. Saaki otsides poleerib ta pendlit.
raw:
The arcing movement and glitter of the
pendulum in a HYPNO's hand lull the foe
into deep hypnosis. While searching for
prey, it polishes the pendulum.

label: gKrabbyPokedexText
en: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
et: KRABBYd elavad randadesse kaevatud aukudes. Toiduvaestel liivarandadel võib neid näha territooriumi pärast omavahel nääklemas.
raw:
KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches.
On sandy shores with little in the way
of food, they can be seen squabbling with
each other over territory.

label: gKinglerPokedexText
en: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this POKéMON quickly tires.
et: Ta vibutab õhus oma tohutut ülemõõdulist sõra, et teistega suhelda. Kuid kuna sõrg on nii raske, väsib see POKéMON kiiresti.
raw:
It waves its huge, oversized claw in the
air to communicate with others.
But since the claw is so heavy, this
POKéMON quickly tires.

label: gVoltorbPokedexText
en: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
et: Ta sarnaneb kummaliselt ja seletamatult POKé BALLiga. Kuna ta plahvatab vähimagi põrutuse peale, kohtlevad isegi kogenud TRAINERid teda ettevaatusega.
raw:
It bears an uncanny and unexplained
resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it
explodes at the slightest shock, even
veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.

label: gElectrodePokedexText
en: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
et: Nad ilmuvad suurel arvul elektrijaamadesse. Kuna nad toituvad elektrist, põhjustavad nad lähedastes linnades massilisi ja kaootilisi elektrikatkestusi.
raw:
They appear in great numbers at electric
power plants. Because they feed on
electricity, they cause massive and
chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

label: gExeggcutePokedexText
en: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
et: See koosneb kuuest munast, mis hoolitsevad üksteise eest. Munad tõmbuvad teineteise poole ja keerlevad ringi. Kui ilmub üha rohkem pragusid, on ta arengule lähedal.
raw:
It consists of six eggs that care for each
other. The eggs attract each other and
spin around. When cracks increasingly
appear, it is close to evolution.

label: gExeggutorPokedexText
en: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.
et: Pärit troopikast, kasvavad EXEGGUTORi pead tugeva päikese käes suuremaks. Öeldakse, et kui pead maha kukuvad, koonduvad nad EXEGGCUTEks.
raw:
Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR's
heads grow larger from exposure to strong
sunlight. It is said that when the heads
fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.

label: gCubonePokedexText
en: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
et: Ta igatseb ema, keda ta enam kunagi ei näe. Nähes täiskuus ema kuju, ta nutab. Kolbal, mida ta kannab, olevad plekid on ta pisaratest.
raw:
It pines for the mother it will never see
again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in
the full moon, it cries. The stains on the
skull it wears are from its tears.

label: gMarowakPokedexText
en: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
et: MAROWAK on CUBONE arenenud vorm, kes on tugevnenud, ületades ema kaotamise leina. Ta karastatud ja karastunud vaim ei murdu kergesti.
raw:
A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE
that has grown tough by overcoming the
grief of losing its mother. Its tempered
and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

label: gHitmonleePokedexText
en: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
et: Ta jalad venivad ja tõmbuvad vabalt kokku. Neid vedrutaolisi jäsemeid kasutades kummutab ta vaenlasi laastavate löökidega. Pärast lahingut masseerib ta väsinud jalgu.
raw:
Its legs freely stretch and contract.
Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over
foes with devastating kicks. After battle,
it rubs down its tired legs.

label: gHitmonchanPokedexText
en: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
et: Öeldakse, et HITMONCHANi valdab poksija vaim, kes ihaldas maailmameistriks saada. Vankumatu vaim tähendab, et ta ei anna kunagi alla.
raw:
A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the
spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the
world champion. Having an indomitable
spirit means that it will never give up.

label: gLickitungPokedexText
en: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
et: Kui ta näeb midagi tundmatut, lakub ta seda alati, sest ta jätab asju meelde tekstuuri ja maitse järgi. Hapud asjad talle veidi ei meeldi.
raw:
Whenever it sees something unfamiliar,
it always licks the object because it
memorizes things by texture and taste.
It is somewhat put off by sour things.

label: gKoffingPokedexText
en: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
et: KOFFINGile lähedale minnes saad läbi ta õhukese naha jälgida mürgiseid gaase seespool keerlemas. Ta plahvatab vähimagi ärrituse peale.
raw:
Getting up close to a KOFFING will give
you a chance to observe, through its thin
skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It
blows up at the slightest stimulation.

label: gWeezingPokedexText
en: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
et: Lahjendades oma mürgiseid gaase erilise protsessiga, saab neist ammutada kõrgeima klassi parfüümi. WEEZINGile on prügist tulevad gaasid ülim pidusöök.
raw:
By diluting its toxic gases with a special
process, the highest grade of perfume can
be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating
from garbage are the ultimate feast.

label: gRhyhornPokedexText
en: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.
et: Kui ta jooksma hakkab, ei peatu ta enam. Ta pisike aju teeb ta nii rumalaks, et ta ei mäleta, miks ta üldse jooksma hakkas.
raw:
Once it starts running, it doesn't stop.
Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it
can't remember why it started running in
the first place.

label: gRhydonPokedexText
en: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
et: Ta sarv, mis pöörleb nagu puur, purustab ühe löögiga kõrged hooned. Ta seisab tagajalgadel ja ta aju on hästi arenenud.
raw:
Its horn, which rotates like a drill,
destroys tall buildings with one strike.
It stands on its hind legs, and its brain
is well developed.

label: gChanseyPokedexText
en: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
et: CHANSEYd munevad iga päev toiteväärtuslikke mune. Munad on nii maitsvad, et neid õgivad innukalt isegi need, kes on isu kaotanud.
raw:
CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs
every day. The eggs are so delicious, they
are eagerly devoured by even those people
who have lost their appetite.

label: gTangelaPokedexText
en: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
et: Ta väädid murduvad kergesti ja valutult, kui neist haaratakse, lastes tal kiiresti põgeneda. Kaotatud väädid asenduvad juba järgmisel päeval uue kasvuga.
raw:
Its vines snap off easily and painlessly
if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a
quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced
by new growth the very next day.

label: gKangaskhanPokedexText
en: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
et: Kui satud üksinda mängiva noore KANGASKHANi peale, ära kunagi ürita teda püüda. Poja vanem on kindlasti läheduses ja läheb metsikult raevu.
raw:
If you come across a young KANGASKHAN
playing by itself, never try to catch it.
The baby's parent is sure to be in the area,
and it will become violently enraged.

label: gHorseaPokedexText
en: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.
et: Vibutades osavalt selja tagaküljel olevaid uimi küljelt küljele, liigub ta igas suunas näoga ette. Ohtu tajudes pritsib ta põgenemiseks tinti.
raw:
By cleverly flicking the fins on its back
side to side, it moves in any direction
while facing forward. It spits ink to
escape if it senses danger.

label: gSeadraPokedexText
en: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.
et: Ta üle keha olevaid mürgiseid okkaid hinnatakse kõrgelt traditsioonilise ravimtaimede rohu koostisosana. Ta ei halasta millelegi, mis ta pesale läheneb.
raw:
The poisonous barbs all over its body are
highly valued as ingredients for making
traditional herbal medicine. It shows no
mercy to anything approaching its nest.

label: gGoldeenPokedexText
en: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.
et: Kevadel võib näha GOLDEENi parvi koski ja jõgesid mööda üles ujumas. Ta jagab oma ainsa sarvega uskumatut kahju.
raw:
In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN
can be seen swimming up falls and rivers.
It metes out staggering damage with its
single horn.

label: gSeakingPokedexText
en: It punches holes in boulders on streambeds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.
et: Ta lööb jõesängi rahnudesse auke. See on nutikas leiutis, mis takistab ta munade ründamist või vooluga minema uhtumist.
raw:
It punches holes in boulders on stream-
beds. This is a clever innovation that
prevents its eggs from being attacked or
washed away by the current.

label: gStaryuPokedexText
en: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
et: Ta koguneb öösel teistega ja paneb oma punase südamiku vilkuvate tähtedega koos hõõguma. Ta suudab jäsemeid taastada, kui need ta kehast lahti lõigatakse.
raw:
It gathers with others in the night and
makes its red core glow on and off with
the twinkling stars. It can regenerate
limbs if they are severed from its body.

label: gStarmiePokedexText
en: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
et: Muistsed inimesed kujutasid ette, et STARMIEd on tekkinud tähtede peegeldustest, mis öösel õrnadel lainetel sätendasid.
raw:
People in ancient times imagined that
STARMIE were transformed from the
reflections of stars that twinkled on
gentle waves at night.

label: gMrMimePokedexText
en: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
et: MR. MIME on pantomiimimeister. Ta suudab teisi veenda, et miski nähtamatu on tegelikult olemas. Kui usutakse, muutub kujuteldav ese päriselt reaalseks.
raw:
A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can
convince others that something unseeable
actually exists. Once believed, the
imaginary object does become real.

label: gScytherPokedexText
en: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
et: Ta pimestavalt kiire kiirus lisab teravust ta kaksik-käsivikatitele. Vikatid suudavad ühe kurja hoobiga läbi lõigata paksud palgid.
raw:
Its blindingly fast speed adds to the
sharpness of its twin forearm scythes.
The scythes can slice through thick logs
in one wicked stroke.

label: gJynxPokedexText
en: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
et: JYNX õõtsub rütmiliselt, justkui tantsiks. Ta võtted on nii vetruvalt ahvatlevad, et neid nähes on inimesed sunnitud märkamatult puusi liigutama.
raw:
A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were
dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly
alluring, people seeing it are compelled to
shake their hips without noticing.

label: gElectabuzzPokedexText
en: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
et: Kui torm läheneb, võistleb ta teistega kõrguste ronimises, mida välk tõenäoliselt tabab. Mõned linnad kasutavad ELECTABUZZi piksevarraste asemel.
raw:
When a storm approaches, it competes with
others to scale heights that are likely to
be stricken by lightning. Some towns use
ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.

label: gMagmarPokedexText
en: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
et: Lahingus puhub ta vaenlase hirmutamiseks kogu kehast ägedaid leeke. Need tulepahvakud tekitavad kuumalaineid, mis süütavad ümbruskonna rohu ja puud.
raw:
In battle, it blows out intense flames from
all over its body to intimidate its foe.
These fiery bursts create heat waves that
ignite grass and trees in the area.

label: gPinsirPokedexText
en: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
et: Ta sõrad on piisavalt tugevad, et purustada paksud palgid. Kuna nad ei salli külma, kaevuvad PINSIRid külmadel öödel maa alla magama.
raw:
Their pincers are strong enough to
shatter thick logs. Because they dislike
cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under
the ground on chilly nights.

label: gTaurosPokedexText
en: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
et: Ta pole rahul, kui ta pidevalt ei märatse. Kui TAUROSel pole vastast, kellega võidelda, sööstab ta paksude puude vastu ja lööb need enda rahustamiseks maha.
raw:
It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging
at all times. If there is no opponent for
TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick
trees and knock them down to calm itself.

label: gMagikarpPokedexText
en: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.
et: Ta ujumislihased on nõrgad, nii et vool uhub ta kergesti minema. Kohtades, kuhu vesi koguneb, võib näha palju MAGIKARPe, mille vool on sinna toonud.
raw:
Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is
easily washed away by currents. In places
where water pools, you can see many
MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.

label: gGyaradosPokedexText
en: It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.
et: See on äärmiselt julm ja vägivaldne POKéMON. Kui inimesed tülitsema hakkavad, ilmub ta ja põletab kõik ägedalt kuumade leekidega maani maha.
raw:
It is an extremely vicious and violent
POKéMON. When humans begin to fight,
it will appear and burn everything to the
ground with intensely hot flames.

label: gLaprasPokedexText
en: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
et: Inimesed on ajanud LAPRASe peaaegu väljasuremiseni. Öeldakse, et õhtuti laulab ta kaeblikult, otsides neid väheseid omasuguseid, kes veel alles on.
raw:
People have driven LAPRAS almost to the
point of extinction. In the evenings,
it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks
what few others of its kind still remain.

label: gDittoPokedexText
en: A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.
et: DITTO korraldab oma rakustruktuuri ümber, et end muuta. Kui ta aga üritab muutuda mälu järgi, eksib ta detailides.
raw:
A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to
transform itself. However, if it tries to
change based on its memory, it will get
details wrong.

label: gEeveePokedexText
en: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
et: EEVEEl on ebastabiilne geneetika, mis mutteerub ootamatult keskkonna tõttu. Erinevatest KIVIDEST tulev kiirgus paneb selle POKéMONi arenema.
raw:
An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup
that suddenly mutates due to its
environment. Radiation from various
STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.

label: gVaporeonPokedexText
en: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.
et: VAPOREONidel toimus spontaanne mutatsioon ja neil kasvasid uimed ja lõpused, mis lasevad neil vee all elada. Neil on võime vett vabalt juhtida.
raw:
VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous
mutation and grew fins and gills that
allow them to live underwater. They have
the ability to freely control water.

label: gJolteonPokedexText
en: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
et: Ta rakud tekitavad nõrka jõudu, mida võimendab karva staatiline elekter, et lasta välja välgunooli. Turris karv koosneb elektriga laetud nõeltest.
raw:
Its cells generate weak power that is
amplified by its fur's static electricity
to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is
made of electrically charged needles.

label: gFlareonPokedexText
en: FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
et: FLAREONi kohev karv laseb kuumust õhku, et ta keha liiga kuumaks ei läheks. Ta kehatemperatuur võib tõusta kuni 900 kraadini.
raw:
FLAREON's fluffy fur releases heat into
the air so that its body does not get
excessively hot. Its body temperature can
rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

label: gPorygonPokedexText
en: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A PORYGON is copyprotected so it cannot be duplicated.
et: Ta suudab end täielikult tagasi programmiandmeteks muuta, et küberruumi siseneda. PORYGON on kopeerimiskaitsega, nii et teda ei saa paljundada.
raw:
It is capable of reverting itself entirely
back to program data in order to enter
cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy-
protected so it cannot be duplicated.

label: gOmanytePokedexText
en: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.
et: Üks iidsetest ja ammu väljasurnud POKéMONidest, kelle inimesed on fossiilidest taastanud. Rünnaku korral tõmbub ta oma kõva kilbi sisse.
raw:
One of the ancient and long-since-extinct
POKéMON that have been regenerated
from fossils by humans. If attacked,
it withdraws into its hard shell.

label: gOmastarPokedexText
en: An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.
et: OMASTAR kasutab saagi püüdmiseks oma kombitsaid. Arvatakse, et ta suri välja, sest ta kilp kasvas liiga suureks, muutes ta võtted aeglaseks ja kohmakaks.
raw:
An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture
its prey. It is believed to have become
extinct because its shell grew too large,
making its movements slow and ponderous.

label: gKabutoPokedexText
en: It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.
et: See on POKéMON, kes on fossiilist taastatud. Harvadel juhtudel on aga leitud elavaid isendeid. KABUTOd pole 300 miljonit aastat muutunud.
raw:
It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated
from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living
examples have been discovered. KABUTO
have not changed for 300 million years.

label: gKabutopsPokedexText
en: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.
et: KABUTOPS ujus kunagi vee all saaki jahtides. Ilmselt arenes ta veeelanikust maismaal elavaks, mida näitavad muutused lõpustes ja jalgades.
raw:
KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt 
for prey. It was apparently evolving from
being a water dweller to living on land as
evident from changes in its gills and legs.

label: gAerodactylPokedexText
en: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.
et: AERODACTYL on POKéMON dinosauruste ajastust. Ta taastati merevaigust ammutatud DNA-st. Arvatakse, et ta oli taeva kuningas.
raw:
AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age
of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA
extracted from amber. It is imagined to
have been the king of the skies.

label: gSnorlaxPokedexText
en: SNORLAX's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.
et: SNORLAXi tüüpiline päev ei koosne millestki muust kui söömisest ja magamisest. Ta on nii taltsas POKéMON, et lapsed kasutavad ta suurt kõhtu mängupaigana.
raw:
SNORLAX's typical day consists of nothing
more than eating and sleeping. It is such
a docile POKéMON that there are children
who use its big belly as a place to play.

label: gArticunoPokedexText
en: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
et: ARTICUNO on legendaarne linnu-POKéMON, kes suudab jääd juhtida. Ta tiibade lehvitamine jahutab õhku. Seetõttu öeldakse, et kui ta lendab, sajab lund.
raw:
ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that
can control ice. The flapping of its wings
chills the air. As a result, it is said that
when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.

label: gZapdosPokedexText
en: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
et: ZAPDOS on legendaarne linnu-POKéMON, kellel on võime elektrit juhtida. Ta elab tavaliselt äikesepilvedes. Ta saab jõudu, kui välk teda tabab.
raw:
ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that
has the ability to control electricity.
It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains
power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.

label: gMoltresPokedexText
en: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
et: MOLTRES on legendaarne linnu-POKéMON, kes suudab tuld juhtida. Öeldakse, et vigastatuna kastab ta keha vulkaani sulamagmasse, et end põletades terveks ravida.
raw:
MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON
that can control fire. If injured, it is said
to dip its body in the molten magma of
a volcano to burn and heal itself.

label: gDratiniPokedexText
en: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
et: DRATINI heidab pidevalt vana nahka. Ta teeb seda, sest ta kehas olev elujõud kogunab pidevalt kontrollimatute tasemeteni.
raw:
A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs
off its old skin. It does so because the
life energy within its body steadily builds
to reach uncontrollable levels.

label: gDragonairPokedexText
en: A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
et: DRAGONAIR salvestab kehas tohutu hulga energiat. Öeldakse, et ta muudab enda ümber ilma, vabastades energiat kaela ja saba kristallidest.
raw:
A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of
energy inside its body. It is said to alter
the weather around it by loosing energy
from the crystals on its neck and tail.

label: gDragonitePokedexText
en: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
et: Ta suudab tiirutada ümber maakera vaid 16 tunniga. Ta on heasüdamlik POKéMON, kes juhib tormis eksinud ja hätta sattunud laevad maismaa turvalisusse.
raw:
It can circle the globe in just 16 hours.
It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads
lost and foundering ships in a storm
to the safety of land.

label: gMewtwoPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.
et: POKéMON, kes loodi geneetilise manipuleerimisega. Kuid kuigi inimeste teadusjõud lõi ta keha, ei suutnud nad talle anda sooja südant.
raw:
A POKéMON that was created by genetic
manipulation. However, even though the
scientific power of humans made its body,
they failed to give it a warm heart.

label: gMewPokedexText
en: A MEW is said to possess the genes of all POKéMON. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.
et: Öeldakse, et MEW valdab kõigi POKéMONide geene. Ta suudab end soovi korral nähtamatuks teha, nii et ta jääb täiesti märkamatuks isegi inimestele lähenedes.
raw:
A MEW is said to possess the genes of all
POKéMON. It is capable of making itself
invisible at will, so it entirely avoids
notice even if it approaches people.

label: gChikoritaPokedexText
en: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.
et: Ta vibutab lehte, et vaenlasi eemal hoida. Kuid lehest hõngub ka magus lõhn, luues sõbraliku õhkkonna, mis rahustab võitlejaid.
raw:
It waves its leaf around to keep foes
at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also
wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly
atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

label: gBayleefPokedexText
en: A BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
et: BAYLEEFi kaela ümbritsevad kokkukeerdunud lehed. Igas lehes on väike puuvõrse. Selle võrse lõhn teeb inimesed reipaks.
raw:
A BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up
leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree
shoot. The fragrance of this shoot
makes people peppy.

label: gMeganiumPokedexText
en: The fragrance of a MEGANIUM's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
et: MEGANIUMi õie lõhn rahustab ja vaigistab tundeid. Lahingus eritab ta rohkem rahustavat lõhna, et nüristada vaenlase võitlusvaimu.
raw:
The fragrance of a MEGANIUM's flower
soothes and calms emotions. In battle,
it gives off more of its becalming scent
to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

label: gCyndaquilPokedexText
en: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the POKéMON is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.
et: Ta laseb seljast leeke, et end kaitsta. Kui POKéMON on vihane, põleb tuli hoogsalt. Väsinuna pahvakleb ta poolikust põlemisest.
raw:
It flares flames from its back to protect
itself. The fire burns vigorously if the
POKéMON is angry. When it is tired,
it sputters with incomplete combustion.

label: gQuilavaPokedexText
en: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.
et: Ta hirmutab vaenlasi ägedate leegipuhangute ja ülekuuma õhuga. Ta väle nobedus laseb tal rünnakuid vältida isegi vaenlast kõrvetades.
raw:
It intimidates foes with intense gusts of
flames and superheated air. Its quick
nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even
while scorching an enemy.

label: gTyphlosionPokedexText
en: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. TYPHLOSION create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
et: Ta suudab end peita väreleva kuumaudu taha, mille ta tekitab ägedate leekidega. TYPHLOSIONid tekitavad lõõmavaid plahvatuslikke pahvakuid, mis põletavad kõik tuhaks.
raw:
It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze
that it creates using its intense flames.
TYPHLOSION create blazing explosive
blasts that burn everything to cinders.

label: gTotodilePokedexText
en: Despite its small body, TOTODILE's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.
et: Vaatamata väiksele kehale on TOTODILE lõuad väga võimsad. Kuigi ta arvab, et lihtsalt mänguliselt näpistab, on ta hammustusel jõudu tõsist vigastust tekitada.
raw:
Despite its small body, TOTODILE's jaws
are very powerful. While it may think it is
just playfully nipping, its bite has enough
strength to cause serious injury.

label: gCroconawPokedexText
en: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.
et: Kui ta lõuad on vaenlase ümber klõpsanud, ei lase ta absoluutselt lahti. Kuna ta kihvade tipud on tagasi kõverdunud nagu õngekonksud, kinnituvad nad eemaldamatult.
raw:
Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will
absolutely not let go. Because the tips of
its fangs are forked back like fishhooks,
they become irremovably embedded.

label: gFeraligatrPokedexText
en: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.
et: Ta avab tohutu suu, et vaenlasi hirmutada. Lahingus jookseb ta paksude võimsate tagajalgade abil, et sööstada vaenlasele uskumatu kiirusega.
raw:
It opens its huge mouth to intimidate
enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick
and powerful hind legs to charge the
foe with incredible speed.

label: gSentretPokedexText
en: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.
et: Nad seisavad kordamööda valvel, kui on aeg magada. Valvur äratab teised, kui ta ohtu tajub. Kui üks eraldub, muutub ta hirmust uneta.
raw:
They take turns standing guard when it
is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the
others if it senses danger. If one becomes
separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

label: gFurretPokedexText
en: A FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.
et: FURRETil on väga sale kehaehitus. Rünnaku all suudab ta läbi kitsaste pilude pugeda ja pääseda. Vaatamata lühikestele jäsemetele on ta väga nobe ja väle.
raw:
A FURRET has a very slim build. When under
attack, it can squirm through narrow
spaces and get away. In spite of its short
limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

label: gHoothootPokedexText
en: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
et: Tal on siseorgan, mis tajub maa pöörlemist. Seda eriorganit kasutades hakkab HOOTHOOT huikama iga päev täpselt samal ajal.
raw:
It has an internal organ that senses
the earth's rotation. Using this special
organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at
precisely the same time every day.

label: gNoctowlPokedexText
en: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. NOCTOWL owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.
et: Ta püüab pimeduses eksimatult saaki. NOCTOWLide edu tuleneb suurepärasest nägemisest, mis laseb neil näha minimaalses valguses, ning painduvatest ja vaiksetest tiibadest.
raw:
It unfailingly catches prey in darkness.
NOCTOWL owe their success to superior
vision that allows them to see in minimal
light, and to their supple and silent wings.

label: gLedybaPokedexText
en: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.
et: LEDYBAd suhtlevad vedeliku abil, mida nad eritavad kohalt, kus jalad kehaga liituvad. Öeldakse, et nad annavad teistele tundeid edasi, muutes vedeliku lõhna.
raw:
LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that
they secrete from where the legs join the
body. They are said to convey feelings to
others by altering the fluid's scent.

label: gLedianPokedexText
en: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.
et: Öeldakse, et maades, kus on puhas õhk ja tähed täidavad taeva, elab palju LEDIANe. Hea põhjusega kasutavad nad energiaks tähtede valgust.
raw:
It is said that in lands with clean air,
where the stars fill the sky, there live
many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use
the light of the stars as energy.

label: gSpinarakPokedexText
en: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
et: Võrku, mille ta koob, võib pidada ta teiseks närvisüsteemiks. Öeldakse, et SPINARAK määrab oma saagi tillukeste võnkumiste järgi, mida ta läbi võrgu tunneb.
raw:
The web it spins can be considered its
second nervous system. It is said that a
SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny
vibrations it feels through the web.

label: gAriadosPokedexText
en: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
et: Ta jalad on kaetud tillukeste konksjate küüntega, mis lasevad tal lagedel ja püstsetel seintel sibada. Ta pigistab vaenlast õhukese ja tugeva siidvõrguga.
raw:
Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws
that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and
vertical walls. It constricts its foe with
thin and strong silk webbing.

label: gCrobatPokedexText
en: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
et: Evolutsiooni käigus muutusid ta tagajalad tiibadeks. Puhates vaheldumisi esi- ja tagatiibu, suudab ta lennata terve päeva ilma peatumata.
raw:
Over the course of evolution, its hind legs
turned into wings. By alternately resting
its front and rear wings, it can fly all day
without having to stop.

label: gChinchouPokedexText
en: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.
et: Ohtu tajudes laseb ta kahest antennist välja positiivset ja negatiivset elektrit. Ta elab sügavustes, kuhu päikesevalgus ei ulatu.
raw:
When it senses danger, it discharges
positive and negative electricity from its
two antennae. It lives in depths beyond
sunlight's reach.

label: gLanturnPokedexText
en: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
et: Ta seljal olevad valgust kiirgavad kerad on väga eredad. Nad moodustuvad ta seljauime osast. See POKéMON valgustab süvamere tindipimedust.
raw:
The light-emitting orbs on its back are
very bright. They are formed from a part of
its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates
the inky darkness of deep seas.

label: gPichuPokedexText
en: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
et: Ta ei oska veel elektrit hoida. Ehmatades laseb ta jõu kogemata välja. Vanemaks saades õpib ta jõudu paremini hoidma.
raw:
It is still inept at retaining electricity.
When it is startled, it discharges power
accidentally. It gets better at holding
power as it grows older.

label: gCleffaPokedexText
en: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
et: Öödel, mil on palju langevaid tähti, võib CLEFFAsid näha ringis tantsimas. Nad tantsivad koiduni, mil nad kustutavad janu hommikukastega.
raw:
On nights with many shooting stars,
CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.
They dance until daybreak, when they
quench their thirst with the morning dew.

label: gIgglybuffPokedexText
en: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
et: Ta pehme ja painduv keha on väga vetruv. Kui ta laulab pidevalt kõigest väest, muutub ta keha järjest sügavamalt roosaks.
raw:
Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy.
When it sings continuously with all its
might, its body steadily turns a deepening
pink color.

label: gTogepiPokedexText
en: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
et: Energiaks kasutab ta kaastunnet ja naudingut, mida inimesed ja POKéMONid õhkavad. Ta salvestab kilpi õnnelikke tundeid, seejärel jagab neid välja.
raw:
As its energy, it uses the feelings of
compassion and pleasure exuded by
people and POKéMON. It stores up happy
feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

label: gTogeticPokedexText
en: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
et: Öeldakse, et ta on POKéMON, kes toob õnne. Kui ta märkab puhta südamega inimest, ilmub TOGETIC ja jagab selle inimesega oma õnne.
raw:
It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good
fortune. When it spots someone who is pure
of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its
happiness with that person.

label: gNatuPokedexText
en: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU's eyes look as if they are always observing something.
et: Ta ronib savannil kasvavaid madalaid puid, et uusi võrseid nokkida. NATU silmad näivad, nagu jälgiksid nad alati midagi.
raw:
It runs up short trees that grow on the
savanna to peck at new shoots.
A NATU's eyes look as if they are
always observing something.

label: gXatuPokedexText
en: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
et: Tal on mõistatuslik võime tulevikku ette näha. Mõned inimesed eri maades on kaua uskunud, et XATUd on saadikud teisest maailmast.
raw:
It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing
the future. Some people in different lands
have long believed that XATU are
emissaries from another world.

label: gMareepPokedexText
en: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
et: Ta kohev vill hõõrdub kokku ja tekitab staatilise laengu. Mida rohkem energiat koguneb, seda eredamalt hõõgub saba tipus olev pirn.
raw:
Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds
a static charge. The more energy is
charged, the more brightly the lightbulb
at the tip of its tail glows.

label: gFlaaffyPokedexText
en: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
et: Ta villa kvaliteet muutub, et väikese villahulgaga tekitada tugevat staatilist elektrit. Ta naha paljad libedad osad on elektri eest kaitstud.
raw:
Its fleece quality changes to generate
strong static electricity with a small
amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its
hide are shielded against electricity.

label: gAmpharosPokedexText
en: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
et: Ta kiirgab nii palju valgust, et teda võib näha isegi kosmosest. Vanasti kasutasid inimesed ta valgust, et kaugetega signaale vahetada.
raw:
It gives off so much light that it can be
seen even from space. People in the old
days used its light to send signals back
and forth with others far away.

label: gBellossomPokedexText
en: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
et: Ta õielehed tumenevad päikese käes. Kui pilvine ilm püsib, teeb ta tantsu, mida peetakse rituaaliks päikese esilekutsumiseks.
raw:
Its flower petals deepen in color through
exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather
persists, it does a dance that is thought
to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

label: gMarillPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.
et: Ta keha katab vetthülgav karv. Selle karva tõttu suudab ta ujuda vees suurel kiirusel, ilma et vee takistus teda pidurdaks.
raw:
Its body is covered with water-repellent
fur. Because of the fur, it can swim
through water at high speed without being
slowed by the water's resistance.

label: gAzumarillPokedexText
en: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
et: Ta elab praktiliselt terve päeva vees. Ta kehavärv ja muster toimivad maskeeringuna, mis teeb vaenlastel ta vees märkamise raskeks.
raw:
It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.

label: gSudowoodoPokedexText
en: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
et: Ta jäljendab puud, et vaenlaste rünnakut vältida. Kuid kuna ta esijalad jäävad terve aasta roheliseks, on ta talvel kergesti võltsinguna tuvastatav.
raw:
It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked
by enemies. But since its forelegs
remain green throughout the year, it is
easily identified as a fake in the winter.

label: gPolitoedPokedexText
en: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
et: Ta pea kähar karv tõestab ta kuninga staatust. Öeldakse, et mida pikem ja käharam karv, seda rohkem austust ta omasuguste seas pälvib.
raw:
The curled hair on its head proves its
status as a king. It is said that the
longer and curlier the hair, the more
respect it earns from its peers.

label: gHoppipPokedexText
en: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
et: See POKéMON triivib ja hõljub tuulega. Kui ta tajub tugeva tuule lähenemist, seob HOPPIP lehed teistega, et valmistuda äraminema puhumise vastu.
raw:
This POKéMON drifts and floats with the
wind. If it senses the approach of strong
winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others
to prepare against being blown away.

label: gSkiploomPokedexText
en: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
et: Ta õitseb, kui temperatuur tõuseb üle 18 kraadi. Kuna ta õie õitsemine muutub koos temperatuuriga, kasutatakse teda vahel termomeetrina.
raw:
It blossoms when the temperature rises
above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's
blooming changes with the temperature,
it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

label: gJumpluffPokedexText
en: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
et: JUMPLUFFid ratsutavad soojadel lõunatuultel, et ületada meri ja lennata võõrastesse maadesse. See POKéMON maandub, kui ta hõljudes külma õhku kohtab.
raw:
JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to
cross the sea and fly to foreign lands.
This POKéMON lands when it encounters
cold air while it is floating.

label: gAipomPokedexText
en: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have become rather clumsy.
et: Ta saba lõpeb osava käelaadse jätkega. Kuid kuna ta kasutab saba nii palju, on AIPOMi tegelikud käed muutunud üsna kohmakaks.
raw:
Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike
appendage. However, because it uses the
tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have
become rather clumsy.

label: gSunkernPokedexText
en: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
et: SUNKERNid üritavad liikumist minimeerida, et säästa toitaineid, mille nad on arenguks kehasse salvestanud. Nad ei söö, elades vaid hommikukastest.
raw:
SUNKERN try to minimize movement to
conserve the nutrients they have stored
in their bodies for evolution. They will
not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

label: gSunfloraPokedexText
en: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
et: SUNFLORAd muudavad päikeseenergia toiduks. Nad on soojal päeval väga aktiivsed, kuid peatuvad järsult niipea, kui päike loojub.
raw:
SUNFLORA convert solar energy into
nutrition. They are highly active in the
warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as
soon as the sun sets.

label: gYanmaPokedexText
en: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.
et: Ta näeb 360 kraadi ilma silmi liigutamata. Ta on suurepärane lendaja, kes suudab järsult peatuda ja õhus pöörata, et kiiresti saaki taga ajada.
raw:
It can see 360 degrees without moving
its eyes. It is a great flier capable of
making sudden stops and turning midair to
quickly chase down targeted prey.

label: gWooperPokedexText
en: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.
et: WOOPERid elavad tavaliselt vees, kuid tulevad vahel toitu otsides maale. Maal katavad nad keha kleepuva mürgise kilega.
raw:
WOOPER usually live in water but come
out onto land seeking food occasionally.
On land, they coat their bodies with a
gooey, toxic film.

label: gQuagsirePokedexText
en: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.
et: QUAGSIRE jahib, jättes suu vees pärani lahti ja oodates, et saak sisse eksiks. Kuna ta ei liigu, ei lähe ta väga näljaseks.
raw:
A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide
open in water and waiting for its prey to
blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it
does not get very hungry.

label: gEspeonPokedexText
en: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
et: ESPEON on äärmiselt lojaalne igale TRAINERile, keda ta väärikaks peab. Öeldakse, et tal on välja arenenud ettenägemisvõime, et TRAINERit kaitsta.
raw:
An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any
TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is
said to have developed precognitive
powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.

label: gUmbreonPokedexText
en: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
et: UMBREON arenes kuu energiaimpulsside käes. Ta varitseb pimeduses ja ootab, et vaenlased liiguksid. Ta keha ringid hõõguvad, kui ta rünnakuks hüppab.
raw:
UMBREON evolved from exposure to the
moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness
and waits for its foes to move. The rings
on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

label: gMurkrowPokedexText
en: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
et: MURKROW'e kardeti kui väidetavaid ebaõnnetuse toojaid. Ta tunneb tugevat huvi kõige sätendava vastu. Ta üritab isegi naistelt sõrmuseid varastada.
raw:
MURKROW were feared as the alleged
